snying po/ 297rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen sdes bsgyur cing —/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge blo dang ca nam mkha' la sogs pas sdo/sa te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(300) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(301)0558 sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 302bsdur mchan/(312) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(315)0559 'phags pa shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs/ 316bsdur mchan/(317) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(317)0560 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 318bsdur mchan/(319) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(319)0561 zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ 320bsdur mchan/(321) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(321)7

bdun pa/ ras ris kyi cho ga bzhi pa'i le'u/ 478brgyad pa/ sgrub pa'i thabs mchog gi las kyi le'u/ 486dgu pa/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i thabs dam pa'i las kyi le'u/ go0bcu pa/ ras ris chen po'i cho ga'i le'u/ ga7bcu gcig pa/ sgrub pa'i thabs kyi las kyi gnas bzhi pa las bzlas pa dang nges par sdom pa dang sbyin sreg dang bsam gtan dang / gtsang sbra'i spyod pa dang las thams cad kyi cho ga sgrub pa'i le'u/ 509bcu gnyis pa/ ras ris bar ma la brten pa cho ga rab 'byam las phreng ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 542bcu gsum pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'byam gyi le'u/ 547bcu bzhi pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i ras ris kyi cho ga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs rab 'byam gyi le'u/ 554bco lnga pa/ las thams cad kyi bya ba'i don gyi le'u/ 574bcu drug pa/ tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u/ 598bcu bdun pa/ las bdag gir byas pa'i rkyen gyi le'u/ 562bco brgyad pa/ skar ma'i dpyad kyi rgyu mtshan shes pa'i le'u/ 608bcu dgu pa/ yi ge gcig pa 'khor los sgyur ba 'byung ba'i le'u/ 630nyi shu pa/ yi ge gcig pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i las kyi cho ga dang ras ris bstan pa'i le'u/ 637le'u nyer gcig pa/ 657nyer gnyis pa/ cho ga'i bya ba 'jam dpal gyi cho ga'i le'u/ 673ras ris kyi cho ga dang po/ 673ras ris kyi cho ga gnyis pa/ 676ras ris kyi cho ga gsum pa/ 683ras ris kyi cho ga bzhi pa/ 68410

༄ga /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi snying po gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs theg pa chen po'i mdo/(1nir༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba ta thā ga tā nasadhiṣ+ṭha ( smin ṣ+ṭṛ gi)da ya gu h+ya dhā tu ka raṇ+ḍa (snye nā ma dhā ra tsā (6rim hā yā ri na smu tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rinasakyi byin gyis brlabs 9)kyi snying po gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa tsodus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dhā 1glen dri ma med pa'i kun dga' ra ba dang yi rin po che sna bdun gyi rdzing na byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa bye ba mang po rnams dang / yul gyi mi 'bum phrag du ma rnams kyis yongs su bskor ——3

cing mdun du byas nas thabs cig 6)tu bzhugs so/ /de nas 'khor gyi nang de na ⑤bram ze chen po shing sā ①la chen po lta bu mkhas pa/ mdzangs ④pa/ gsal ba yid gzhungs pa/ mthong na dga' ba/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yongs su bzung ⑤ba/ dri med legs snang zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de yang gcig tu rjodakon mchog gsum la dad cing gus la phyag byed ⑦pa'i dge ba'i bsams ⑧pa dang ldan pa/ zhib mo brtags ⑨pa/ sems can thams cad dang tsodage ba'i don la brtson pa/ nor che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ phyug pa/ rdzas mang ba/yo byad phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /de nas bram ze chen po dri med legs snang /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste 6)phyin nas yang yonyebacom ldan 'das la (nyelan bdun bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang / bdug pas mngon par mchod do/ /na bza' rin 'bum ri ba yang gsol/ bcom ldan 'das la mu tig gi do shal 'bum ri ba yang cigasol nas zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 7te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sras tsotshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pa/ bdag gi 7sdum par gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren na de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar mdzad par tu)ci gnang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze chen po dri med legs snang gis spyan drangs par — thugs su chud nas cang 6)mi gsung bar gyur pas 6gyeganang ngo / /de nas bram ze chen po dri med ( 7legs snang bcom ldan 'das kyi ( )spyan snga ne nas cang mi gsung bas riganang bar rig nas des (gerings pa rings par rang spi khyim du song ste/de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das pa dang / zhal zas dang / yo byad dang / zhal ——4

zas ro brgya pa/ ①mang po bshams nas bkod pa chen pos bkra shis kyi gzhal med khang phyidang / gzhal med khang chen po sna tshogs dang / me tog dang /bdug ①pa khyer te/ 'khor mang po dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la dus la bab par dugasol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bram ze chen po dri med legs snang gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni ⑤gshegs pa'i dus lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa'i dus kyi ⑥tshod la bab na bdag la gnang bar mdzad par ci gnang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze chen po dri med legs snang dbugs phyung nas nyid kyi 'khor la gzigs te bka' stsal pa/ 'khor ji ltar lhags ⑦pa thams cad deng nidon chen po ⑨mdzad par 'gyur gyis tshur shegatso /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdan de las bzhengs nas / bcom ldan 'das gdan de las bzhengs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od zer 7tha dad pa sna tshogs byung ste/ 'od zer (nyegyi snang ba des phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la tiyang dag par bskul te/ gzigs nas gshegs par shes so//de nas bram ze chen po dri med tsolegs snang gis snyimachod pa dang / bkur ⑩ste chen pos mchod cing bcom ldan 'das kyi gshegs shul mdzes pa 6)cher byas so/ /'khor mang po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye tunyechen po dang ske/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / srid med kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang gshegs ——5

shul mdzes par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang ha cang mi ring ba'i lam gyi bar gyi nang zhig na skyed 6)mos tshal bde byed ces bya ba zhig yod do/ /skyed phyimos tshal de'i nang na mchod rten rnying pa chen po zhig yod de/ zhig pa/tsher mas gang ba rtswa chadang / shing dang / gyo mos kun tu gang ba phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu zhig yod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i drung du gshegs pa dang —/ mchod rten rnying pa phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu de yang kun nas 'bar zhing 'od zer 'bar ba kha dog sna tshogs pa dag byung ngo / /phyag dar dang gyo mo'i ④phung po de las kyang legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa legs so legs so/ /deng ni gshegs pa'i ltas (9bzang po'o /bram ze chen po de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs pa na yang khyod (7legs so/ /deng khyod gal don chen po mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas mchod rten rnying pa phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu de la yan lag lngas phyag mdzad nas lan gsum bskor ba mdzad nas(gyi/ nyid kyi sku las na bza' gsil (9tshonas mchod rten rnying 7pa phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu de la gsol te(spel/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mchi ma byung ba chen po phyung bas ()bshums pa mdzad nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa bstan to/ /'dzum (nyapa bstan pa des phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad lag mthil na bzhugs pa —bzhin du mthong ngo / /7de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang 'od zer bkye ste/ mchod rten rnying pa'i phung po chen po der zhugs 7so/ /de nas 'khor mang po 'dus pa de dag khri ya mtshan chen por gyur cing yid ches te (me'akhod par gyur to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 1 lag na rdo rje lus ——6

ni 'dar/ 0)snying ni 'gul/ rdo rje ni gsor zhing rings pa rings par bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste ②phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal (kyete/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bshums ④pa'i snga ltas chen po gda' ba gang gis na (7bcom ldan 'das kyi 6)spyan mchi mas gang bar bstan ⑦pa'i snga ltas gda' ba bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ci'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis (nya'akhor 'di'i nang du zhu ba 'di skabs dbye bar ci gnang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na sdo rje ring bsrel gyi phung po de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba 6)til gyi gang bu snyed thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i mchod rten gyi chos kyi yinam grangs yod de(1/ lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang na gnas pa der7/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba til gyi gang bu ()snyed gnas shing de bzhin gshegs pa khar yas khar yas zhes yibya ba snyed kyi sku gdung ring bsrel rnams gnas so/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba til gyi gang bu snyed tsodagu bcu tsom dgu'i gtsug tor dang / spyi bo yang de bzhin du gnas so/ /lag na rdo rje gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gnas pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten du lung bstan to/ /lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni 'di ltar phan yon che zhing mthu che ba yin no/ /lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni phan yon che ba yin no / /lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni bkra shis thams cad rdzogs par byed pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das las 'khor mang po 'dus pa de dag ——7

ma'am / dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la las chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dri tsobar byed na/ lag na rdo rje des de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig til gyi gang bu snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis rjes su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig klog par byed pa de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i mdo sde rnams bcang bar ②'gyur ro/ /gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu 'dzin pa de dag phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig til gyi gang bu snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / phyogs re re'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gzung ①bar 'gyur zhing / nyin ④gcig bzhin gzigs par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mchod pa byed pa dang / khong du chud par byed pa dang / me tog dang /bdug pa dang / dri dang / me tog phreng rgyud (5)dang / byug pa dang / na bza' dang / lhab lhub dang /(6) rgyan gyis mchod pa byed pa'i rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma des phyogs bcu dang / phyogs re re'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig til gyi (7gang bu snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu la lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / bdug pa dang /dri dang / me tog phreng rgyud (8)dang / byug pa dang / na bza' dang / lhab lhub dang / rgyan gyis mchod par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs re re'i de bzhin gshegs pa la de bzhin gshegs pa tsa)mchod pa'i sprin rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i ri rab chen po tsam gyi ⑩phung po'i yon tan byung ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ——9

lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang /mi ma yin pa de rnams dang / sems can gyi tshogs chen po de rnams kyang ya mtshan du gyur nas gcig la gcig 'di skad du mchod rten rnying pa phyag dar dang /gyo mo'i phung po de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 6)kyis byin gyis brlabs (minas 'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul (5)chen po ston pas mthu che ba yin no zhes zer rol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di sus phyag dar gyi phung por bgyis pa las rin po che'i mchod rten du gda' bar stibagyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje 'di phyag dar gyi phung po ma yin gyi 'di ni rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i (5)rin po che'i mchod rten chen po yin no/ /lag na rdo rje 'on kyang sems can rnams kyi las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ston pas nub par gyur zhigyi/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po'i mchod rten rnams ni 'jig (7)pa'am/ 'gyes (8)par mi 'gyur te / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i snying po'i sku ji ltar 'gyes par 'gyur/'on kyang sems can rnams kyi las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin par snang ba las kyang nub par gyur to9/ /lag na rdo rje gzhan yang phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe/sdig pa bokun tu spyod pa dang / sdig pa can dang / dmyal ba la 1nyagazhol ba shin tu tshabs cher 'byung bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas ma yin/ chos ma yin/dge 'dun tshol 12ba ma yin zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba dag kyang bskyed par mi byed de (1nyargyu de dang / rkyen des dam pa'i chos nub bo/ /lag na rdo rje de'i phyir nga'i ——10
