cad dang phreng yo)ba dang / mar me dag kyang rang gi rgyud kyi sngags kyis sbyin par byed de/ mdor na ji lta ji (bltar sbyar ba de lta de ltar sgrub par byed pa ni yi ge gsum zhes bya ba/ stobs chen po don thams cad sgrub par byed pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i sngags smras pa de gang zhe na/ o āḥ(mirtsu/ 'di ni khro bo chen po de'i snying po ste las thams cad byed pa dkyil 'khor thams cad dang sngags thams cad kyi spyod pa la sems dpa' chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis (gesmras te/bgegs thams cad 'jigs ⑤par byed pa'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas lag pa g.yas pa bteg ste/ khro bo'i spyi bor gzhag ⑥pa byas so/ /'di skad du yang smras te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dgongs su gsol/ gang su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rnam par gnas shing mtha' yas mu med pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dam tshig la lhag par gnas par gyis shig /de skad ces ( rasmras nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po la lag pa bskor nas btang (kyebar gyur to/ /khro bo'i rgyal po chen po btang ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag tu song nas/ skad cig tsam gyis gang dag sdang ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sems can rdzu 'phrul che ba dag tshar bcad cing der bkug par gyur nas/ 'khor gyi 5)dkyil 'khor chen po gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang der yang dag par bcug ste/ gnas ji (7lta ba bzhin du 1steganas par byas nas sems can ma rungs pa dag la yang kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i tshogs su byas shing / spyi bo la yang dag par gnas par byas so/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de la yang bltas / 88—407

nas / sems can khyed cag thams cad nyon cig /gang yang dam tshig 'di las 'das par gyur na de la khro bo'i rgyal po 'dis chad pa gcod par 'gyur te ①gang gi phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ②dam tshig ni ①'da' bar bya ba ma yin te/ sngags kyi don gyi tshig ligasang ba byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi (5)mdor bstan pa brjod par bya yis⑥/ de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung (beshig dang bshad par bya'o/ /(kyen maḥsarba bud dhā 5)dzā/ oṃ ra ra smra bor a pra ti (1ha yi ta shā sa na/ ku mā ra rū pa dhā ri ṇi yo rgyu hūṃ phaṭa yiswā hā/ grogs po dag 'di ni rtsa ba'i sngags yin te 'phags skapa 'jam dpal zhes bya ba yin no/ /phyag rgya ni gtsug phud lnga pa zhes grags te de la rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sngags 'di ni las thams cad pa zhes bya'o/ /snying po'i sngags 'di tshani las thams cad byed cing shes pa yin te/oṃ bā kye rda na maḥ 'dir phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni gtsug phud gsum ( 7zhes bya ba yin te/ longs spyod thams cad mngon par 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /'dir nye ba'i snying por 'gyur ba ni/ bākye hūm̐/ 'dir phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni gtsug phud gsum pa zhes grags pa yin te/ sems can thams cad 'gugs (nyepar byed pa yin no/ /'dir snying po mchog tu 'gyur ba ni rma/ 'dir phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni rma bya'i gdan zhes bya bar bstan pa yin te/ sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya thams cad kyi snying po dpa' bo chen po zhes bya ba yi ge brgyad yod de/ dpal mchog tu byed pa/ dag byed chen po srid pa gsum gyi chos nye bar gcod par byed pa/ ngan 'gro thams cad zlog 17par byed pa / zhi ba thams cad byed pa/ las thams cad byed pa/ mya ngan las 'das ——408

pa'i bde ba thob par byed pa/ sangs rgyas mngon sum 0)du mthong ba bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa nyid bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir/ mchog tu gsang ba'i ngo bos nye bar gnas pa re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pal/ gang du dran pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga yang yongs su sbyong bar (mibyed na bzlas pas ①lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de yang gang zhe na/ o ā ④gri ra hūṃ/khe tsa ra/ grogs po dag 'di ni yi ge brgyad po dpa' bo chen po zhes bya ba/gsang ba'i snying po'i bdag nyid yin te/ sangs rgyas nyid bzhin du rab tu nye bar gnas pa yin no/ /mdor na bya ba thams cad la yon tan gyi mtha' rgya chen po brjod par ni bskal pa bye ba khri phrag brgya stong du mar yang mi nus te/ 'dir phyag rgya yang stobs po che zhes par rnam par grags (5༄pa re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /spyan drang ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ he he ku mā ra (6stebi shwa rū pi tī/ sarba bā 7ril bhā ṣi (8༄ta pra bo dha ne/ e h+ye hi dzinabha 4 ga bān/ e h+ye hi ku mā ra/ gī 1gleḍa nut+pa 1gel dhā 1geri ṇi maṇ+ḍa la ma sgye tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ/ mā bi 7lo ba ku ru phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyi spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / sha za dang / srin po dang / 'byung po thams cad kyi'ang yin no/ /tsan+dan gyi chur byas te/ lan bdun bsngags lanas/ phyogs bzhi 88wa 409

dang ske/ steng dang / 'og dang / thams cad du gtor na sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa rang nyid 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad dang / sngags dang de bzhin du 'byung po'i tshogs dang sems can thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /na maḥsarba bud dhā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ oṃ dhu dhu ra dhu ra dhu ma bā si ni/ dhu ma ra tsi shi hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya ma nu sma 1)ra swā hā/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ /tsan+dan dang / ga pur dang / gur gum gcig tu byas te/ bdug pas bdugs na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / sems can thams cad bdug pas tshim zhing dgyes nas bzhugs par 'gyur ro/ /'dir yang (9phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes grags pa/ /thams cad 'gugs ①byed zhi ba yin/ /spyan drang ba yi sngags la yang / /pad+ma'i phreng ba bzang po zhes/ /bya ba'i phyag rgya 'di nyid do/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang /sems can thams cad byon pa la mchod yon dbul bar bya ste/ ga bur dang tsan+dan dang gur gum chu dang sbyar nas/ me tog ku su dang mā li rtsika dang /dbyar gyi me tog dang me tog pun nā (5)ga dang me tog ba ku la dang / me tog paṇ+ḍi phyi ta ga ru 'di dag gang yang rung ba'i me tog gam/ dus ci (7)lta ba'i me tog dri zhim po bcug (8 ste/ sngags 'dis mchod yon dbul bar bya'o/ na maḥsarba bud dhā māṃ/ a pra ti 91ha ta shā sa yi snanā māṃ/ tabya thā/ he he ma hā kā ru ṇi sgo nyaka bi shwa (rkir+sha pa dhā ra ni/ arnya pra tīts+tsha nyi pa ya/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha / maṇ+ḍa 'tshol ma sgye pra be sha ya pra be ski sha yas/ sarba bhu tā nu kai pa ka grot+na 88—410

grosna ①rgyu/ e ②ba ra bi tsā ri ṇi swā hā/ 'dir yang phyag rgya ni gang ba zhes bya bar grags pa sems can thams cad dang ②rjes su mthun zhing brtan pa'o/ /'dir yang dri'i sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā māṃ/ na maḥs man+ta gca ba bhā sa shri yebya/ ta thā ga tā ⑤ya/ tar+ya thā/ gadhe garnye ga na dh+yā de/garnya ma no ra the/ pra tīts+tsha pra tīts+tsha rma/ gadhe sa ma yitā nu tsā ri ṇi swā hā/ 'dir phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni lo ma zhes bya ba (7re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o / /'dir me tog gi sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā skyis nā rmāṇi/ na maḥyisi ku su mi ta rā dza su/ ta thā ga ta su/tabya thā/ ku su me ku su me ku su mā d+me/ ku su ma pū tunyar bā si ni/ ku su ma ba ti swā hā/ bdug pa'i sngags 'di nyid dang gong du bstan pa'i bdug 6)pas bdug par bya'o/ /sku ni rmad byung yi bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas thams cad phyag 'tshal te/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yi/ /gtor ma'i sngags ni tshebashad par bya/ na maḥsarba bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ tar+ya thā/he he bha ga bān/ ma hā sa twa sar+pā 8lo ki te i rma ba li gro: pa ya griṇ+ḍa pa ya tsheḥ hūṃ / sarba bi shwa ra ra ṭa ṭa s+pha ṭa /naswā hā/ 'dis ni tsho bshos dbul bar bya ste/'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma yang bya'o/ /'dir yang 4/phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni / /mdung zhes bya ba ma rungs pa/ /thams cad zlog ne )par byed pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ sarba ta mo ྅n+dha (1nokā ra bi dhan munas ( sterna/ na maḥs man+ta byo ti gan dhā ba (2 sabhā sa shri ye( ge/ ta thā ga tā (4ya/ tabya thā / he he bha ga bān/ byo ti ra smi sha sa ta sa ha sra pra ti maṇ+ḍi ( 8ta sha rī ra ( /ji kurba bi kurba ma hā bo dhi sa tā ce )sa man+ta dz+wa lod byo ti ta 5 /mūr sa ti khurda khurda/ a 88wa 411

ba lo ka 6)ya/ a ba lo ka ya mān / lo sarba/ sa tā ṭ+wāṃ tsa ②swā hā/ mar me'i sngags te ④'dis mar me dbul bar bya'o/ /kha bye ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya ni/sems can kun gyis mthong ba'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tabya (snyeb/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dz+wa lā ya dz+wa lā 6)ya/ hūṃ bi bho da ka ha ri kroṇ+ḍa 4)piṅga la swā hā/ me'i bya ba byed pa'i sngags so/ /'dir yang phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni/ /sems can kun la 'od gsal byed/ /kha sbyar zhes byar 'jig rten grags/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyir(mi/ /thub pa mchog gis 6)sngon bshad pa'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la smras pa gsang ba pa'i 1 tshobadag po sngags kyi tshig 'di ni gsang ba dang bcas shing mchog tu gsang bar bya ba yin te/ khyod bu 'jig rten rnams 37grags pa'i/ /mi bzad pa ni gang yin pa/ /sngags rnams dag ni thams cad kyis/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrubs pa ste(gle/ /spyi bo'i gdu bu zhes grags pa/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs kyang 1)yin/ /de ni rnam par gzhig bya'i ⑫phyir / /rig pa 'di ni yang dag brjod/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā rnal/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ oṃ ka 7ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma kār+ya bhañdza bhañdzaX)/sarba bisna 1shed ha da ha 67sarba badz+ra bi nā ya kai mū ga ṭaṃ ṭī bi 9 )tān+ta ka ra ma hā bi kṛ 81ta rū pa dhā 9 2ri ṇi/ pa tsa pa tsa sarba duṣ+ṭa ( sten/ ma hā ga na pa ṣ+ṭi dzī bi tān+ta ka ra ban dha ban dha sarba gra hān 7/ ṣaṭa mu kha 6sheṣaṭa bhu dza/ ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa ru dra mā na 7ya/ birgyu mā na ( tshoya bra d+mā ( 8bya de ba mā na 39ya mā bi lo ba/ la hu la hu maṇ+ḍa la ma d+me pra be sha ya/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ s+pha ṭa s+pha ṭa (steswā hā/ gsang ba pa'i 2bdag po 'di ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i 88wa 412

mchog tu gsang ba'i sngags chen po gdong drug pa zhes bya ba yin te①/ khro bo'i rgyal po bgegs thams cad 'jig ②par byed pa ste/ 'di brjod pa tsam gyis sa bcu'i dbang phyug ①la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang 'jigs 0par byed pa yin na/ bgegs ma rungs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos 'di brjod pa tsam nyid kyis srung (nyab chen po byas par 'gyur ro/ /'dir yang phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni / /nag po chen po zhes bya ba'i/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'jig yibyed pa'ol/ /'di nyid kyi khro bo'i rgyal po'i snying po ni/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥgabi kṛ nitā na na hūṃ sarba sha r+ghaṃ 5)nā sha ya s+t+waṃ bha yiya phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'di brjod pas dgra thams cad zug gzer chen po dang / nad chen po dang nyin bzhi pa'i rims kyis thebs par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu dga' ba med pa dang / byams pa med pa dang 6gle/ snying rje'i sems thob par mi 'gyur te/ bzlas pa tugezin gyi bar du grol bar mi 'gyur zhing 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa byed pa dag la bya'i rte/ zhi ba'i sems yod pa gzhan dag la ni ma yin no/ /phyag rgya ni rtse gsum chen po zhes bya ba sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dir nye ba'i snying por 'gyur ba ni/ oṃ tri likā la rū pa hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ phyag rgya ni rtse gsum chen po zhes bya ba nyid sbyar bar bya'o/ /ma rungs pa thams cad la gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur ro/ /snying po'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'byin gyis brlabs pa'i yiyi ge gcig pa zhes bya'o/ /hūm̐/ 'di ni las thams cad byed pa'o/ /phyag rgya yang rtse gsum chen po zhes bya bar sbyar bar bya'o/ /phung khrol thams cad zlog yi par byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad dbang du byed pa ste/she/ mdor na khro bo'i rgyal po 'di ni las thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus ——413

su bzlas pa byas na grub pa'i dus su khyad par du 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /'dir gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ na maḥsarba bud dhā ①〈/a 0pra ti ha ta shā las nā 'du/ tar+ya thā/ dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka bi shwa rū pi ṇi gats+tsha dusarba bud sa:/ bi sadz+dza ⑥ya sa pa rī rgya'i raṃ swa duṅgā ba ⑨ṭ+wāṃ tsa pra be sha ya sa ma ya ma nu sma ra sar+pā 'byu me sid rgyas man+t+ra pa da ma no ra tha:tshul/ me pa ri pū yir yan+tu swā hā/ 'di ni gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags te/las thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni bzang po'i gdan zhes bya ba yin tetunye / 'dis gdan la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /yid kyis bzlas pa bdun byas te gshegs su gsol lo/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags dang sngags grub 6)pa dag dang / dam tshig dang /bzlas pa dang / dus dang nges par sdom pa dag la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la yang bltas te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang / rang gi rig pa'i 8tshogs kyi sngags kyi khule'u rab 'byam 7smras so/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta gā tā shā/ tre/ o ri ṭi ni swā hā/ 'di ni 'jam dpal gyi rjes su 'brang ba skra (shecan ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa/ las thams cad byed pa/ phyag rgya chen po gtsug phud lnga zhes bya ba dug gi las thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /na maḥsarba bud+dhā māṃ / a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā rmā/ oṃ ni ti ṭi67/ 'di ni nye ba'i skra ( )can ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa yin te las thams cad byed pa'o/ /phyag rgya ni kha bye ba zhes bya ba gza' thams cad kyi las la sbyar bar bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā māṃ/a pra ti ha ta ga tī māṃ/ lo 27ni/ rig pa 'di ni pad+ma can zhes bya ste/ las ——414

thams cad byed cing dge ba'o/ /phyag rgya bzang po'i gdan zhes bya ba dang ldan pas gnod sbyin mo nges par dgug par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā māṃ/ a tsin cad ①lhu ta rū r+pā ②'o②/ o ñtsa sne ④snya hā/ phyag rgya mdung ni bsdam 0pa yis / mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'joms par byed/ /sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad kyis/ /thams cad gzugs can rab bsngags ⑥pa/ /rig pa thod can zhes bya ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bshad pa yin/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/a pra gti ha ta tsa rī du'o⑨/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ ba ra de swā hā/ phyag rgya gtsug phud gsum nyid ni/ /dpal sbyin byed pas sbyar bar bya/ /gzugs mnga' ⑩'chang ba lha mo ni/ /myur du longs spyod sgrub yibyed pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/a tsin 7r+sād bhu ta rū r+pā (steshā/ oṃ bhu ru cig hā/ phyag rgya mdung rtse yang dag sbyar / /rims nad thams cad rnam 'jig yin/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā 〉tso/a tsin t+yād tsobyu ta rū r+pā ⑩〈/ oṃ tā re swā hā/ rig pa phug ron zhes bya ba/ /las rnams kun la rab tu bsngags(she/ /phyag rgya mdung dang ldan pa yis/ /bgegs ni 'joms par byed pa yin/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a tsin t+yād bhu ta rū r+pā 47shā/ tabya thā/ oṃ bi khri )lo ki ni swā hā/ rig pa snang ldan zhes bya ba / /'jig rten thams cad dbang du byed/ /bde ba thams cad sbyin byed pa/ /gdong gi phyag rgya sbyar bar bya/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a tsin ( stecad bhu ta rū r+pā ru shā/ tabya thā/ oṃ bi shwe bi shī saṃ bhā be bi shwa rū r+pā ṇi zhugeka ha ka ha ā be shwa be sha ( )sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ru ru tiṣ+ṭha swā hā/ rig pa chen ( snyepo stobs chen 'di//'jig rten 'dren pas bstan pa ste( sgo/ /mche ba'i phyag rgya ldan byas na(na/ /sems can thams cad 'bebs shing dge/ /'byung po kun la mchog sbyin pa/ /——415

rdzogs byed/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ lo kā gā dhi pa tī 0)dzā/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ ku mā ra ma hā ku mā ra kri ḍa kri ḍa(mi/ shaṃ mu kha bo dhi satā 6)nu dz+nyā ta/ ma yu rā sa na/ shasto bya ta pyi'i ṇizhu)/ ra〉 ga rak+ta gan yiṅgā nu le pa na pri ④yal/ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ mṛ t+ya mṛ 5)kya/ rak+ta lipuṣ+ka rtsi ta mūrti yis ma ya ma nu sma ra8/bhā ma bh+ra ma/ bhā ma ya bhā yinam ya/ lā bohu rmukhā hu mā bi lasba sarba kāt+yā skya'i 0me ku ru ku ru/ bi tsi tu tra rū pa dhā ri ṇ+ḍaṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ sarba bud dhā nu dz+nyā ()ta swā hā/skyob pa byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /'jam pa'i ( )dbyangs kyis bshad pa na/ /sa rnams ma lus rnam drug tu/ /kun nas yongs su rab tu g.yos/ /sems can kun gyi don phyir dang / /ma rungs sems can zlog 31pa'i phyir/ /mi bzad dbang phyug bu'i zhu gzugs su/ /gdul ba'i don du 'dir ston zhu te/ /skem ( stebyed dang ni mig dmar gyi/ /phyag mtshan gyis ni mtshon pa ste/ /snying rjes thugs ni brlan pa yis ri/ /'jam pa'i ngag gis gsungs pa yin/ /sems dpa'i nang na bdag nyid che/ /byis pa rnams la phan byed gang / /sems can spyod phyir brtson pa ni/ /'gro ba kun la rnam par spyod/ /phyag rgya mdung dang ldan pa yis/ /bdag nyid chen pos sbyar na ni/ /tshangs pa ri 4sogs pa'ang 'gugs byed na/ /mi rnams la ni smos ci dgos/ /gzhon nu'i sems su mtha' dag ni/ /bsdus nas yongs su bshad par bya/ /smin drug bu dang 'jam dpal gyi / /sngags su 'di ni yang dag bstan/ /sems can rjes su gzung ba'i naphyir/ /byang chub sems dpar 'di /ston to/ /yig gsum zhes bya'i snying po ni/ /'di yi sngags su brjod pa yin/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'o ngas spyod 'dren pa'i mchog de yin/ /phyag rgya mdung dang ldan ——417

pa yis/ /bkod na 0)las kun byed pa yin/ /oṃ hūṃ dzaḥ sngags 'di mdo ①ru bsdu byas na/ /mi rnams kyi ni don byed do/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā māṃ/ sa man+ta byo ti ta mū bhā ④rna/ oṃ bi kṛ (snyeta gra ha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di yang nye ba'i snying po ste/ /de bzhin phyag rgya mdung ldan pas/ /'byung po thams cad 'gugs byed cing / /de bzhin gza' dang ma mor bcas/ /phyag rgya kun gyis phyag rgya la/ /bkod na 'bras bur bcas par 'gyur/ /'byung po rnams ni dngangs dubyed cing / /ma rungs 'jug pa zlog 6)par byed/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di'i gdong drug gi bu zhes bya ba'i 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i (kyirjes su 'brang ba ste/ las thams cad byed pa yi)ste/ bzlas pa tsam kho nas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /'byung po thams cad dngangs ⑩par byed pa dang / skrag par byed pa dang / 'gugs (nyapar byed pa dang / dbang du byed pa dang skem par byed pa dang / 'jig 7par byed pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa ji ltar 'dod pa de thams cad sgrub par byed pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā māṃ/ a pra ti 0ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tabya thā/ oṃ brah+ma brah+ma bar tsa sa shān+ti ku ru swā hā/sngags 'di tshangs pa chen po ste/ /byang chub sems dpas bshad pa yin/ /'byung pos zhi 7gyur rab tu thob/ /skad cig nyid la bsil bar gyur/ /phyag rgya gtsug phud lnga sbyar na/ /myur du dge legs thob par 'gyur/ /mngon spyod dag ni thams cad la/ /srid 'asrung gi ni rig byed 'dod/ / 'di ni mdor bsdu 7bstan pa ste1 / /'di yi cho ga bsdus pa yin/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tar+ya ba(snye/ oṃ ga ru ḍa bā ha na tsa kra pā ṇi/ tsa tur bhu dza hūṃ hūṃ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ bho hu)snyi satwa 3 ko.ā 5nyadz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ 'jam ——418

pa'i dbyangs kyis bka' stsal pa/ /zhi ba'i don ni myur byed yin/ /'byung po rnams ni rnam 'jig cing / /khyab 'jug gzugs kyi lus can yin/ /phyag rgya gtsug phud ①gsum sbyar (snyen/ /las rnams kun byed brtan pa ①yin/ /gang dag khyab 'jug rgyud la ④ni/ /bya ba rgya cher bstan pa dag /thabs kyis gdul bya'i sems can la/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bshad pa yin/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tar+ya thā/ o ma hā ma he shwa ra bhū tā dhī ⑤pa ti bṛ ṣa ༷bha dh+wa ⑦dza pra yaṃ ba dza ṭā dza ṭa 6)mu ku ṭa dhā ri ṇi/ si ṇita bhasma dhu sa ri ⑩ta mūrti hūṃ hūṃ 7phaṭa phaṭa bo dhi sa twa ādz+nyā 8pa ya ti swā hā/ sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /sngags 'di bdag gis smras pa ste/ /phyag rgya mdung rtse gsum sbyar na/ /'byung po thams cad rnam 'jig pa'o/ /bdag gis sngon ni gang bstan pa/ /'di yi cho ga sngon byung ba/ /sems can sa steng gnas pa la/ /zhi ba pa zhes brjod pa ste/ /yon tan sna tshogs rgya che ba/ /zhi ba'i rgyud las ⑫nga yis bstan/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ tar+ya thā/oṃ shā ciku na ma hā shā ku na/ pad+ma bi dā ta pa k+ṣa sarba pan+da ga na shā snyig kha kha khā hi khā hi sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha bo rnyi sa twa ā dz+nyā 7pa ya ti swā hā/ sngags 'di'i ⑩mthu ni chen po ste/ /nam mkha' lding zhes rnam par grags/ /gdul dka' 'dul byed rnams kyi mchog /gdengs ka can gyi dug rnams 'joms/ /phyag rgya che dang sbyar byas yi na/ /phung khrol shin tu mi bzad 'joms/ /gnas dang 'gro ba'i dug dag ni/ /gso bar byed la tshonathe tshom med/ /sems can gdul bya'i 6 )thabs su ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag bka'4nya/ /nam mkha' lding gzugs sa la spyod/ /'dab chags dbang po 'od chen ldan/ /ci srid ——419

nam mkha' lding rgyud du/ /cho ga ①rgya cher bstan de sridag /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /thams cad nga yis bstan pa ste/ /byang chub ①sems dpa' nam mkha' lding / /dul duba'i don du 'di bstan to/ /gdengs can dug ni gzhom bya'i phyir/ /'dab chags tshul gyis rnam par rgyu/ /'jig rten sngags ni ji srid pa/ /cho ga 'di ni bstan pa na/ /sems can gdul bya'i don du ni/ /de lta de ltar rnam par rgyu/ /gang yang de bzhin gshegs sngags dang / /rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs (snyedag kyang / /nga yis cho ga rab 'byam yidang / /mdo dag kyang ni bstan pa yin/ /ji ltar ma mo mang po ni/ /'bad pas byis pa rnams gsung ba / /de bzhin byis pa'i 2blo can la/ /sngags kyi tshul gyis 6)nga yis bshad/ /sngon ni stobs bcu ldan ⑩pas bstan/ /da ni nga yis lhonyebastan pa yin/ /sngags rgyud don ni ma lus pa/ /'od chen gzhon nus bstan pa yin/ /rgyal ba mchog gis gang gsungs dang / /stobs bcu ldan pa'i sras gsungs dang / /rmad byung bsam mi khyab tshul gyis/ /'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs de dag go/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas thams cad dang yo ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la gzigs nas/dam tshig thams cad 6)yang dag par bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gang du ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na sems can mtha' dag gi sgrub pa'i spyod pa sems la rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang nor bu rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan bkod 〉pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing rmad du byung ba'i ——420

byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa 6)rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang /'phags pa nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa' ②spyod pa la zhugs pa dang /sa bcu'i dbang phyug la gnas pa dag gis kyang dkyil 'khor de bri ba'am 'drir gzhug ①par mi nus na so so'i skye bor gyur pa'i sems can gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos / 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor bzang po de grub pa'i gnas skabs la gnas pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la rab tu gnas pa/rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba thams cad dang / spyod pa la zhugs pa thams cad ④dang ske/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa thams cad 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i byin gyis brlabs (5)kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i (6)mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyu mthun pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyi thugs las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor (7la zhugs par bdag nyid kyis yang dag par shes par gyur to/ /sems can so so'i skye bo'i yid kyis kyang de dmigs par mi nus na bri ba'am 'drir 'jug (kyepa lta smos kyang ci dgos/de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dkyil 'khor chen po bzang po de la rab tu zhugs pa'i sems can de dag la smras pa/ grogs po dag nyon cig 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'da' bar bya ba ma yin na(9)/ sems can gzhan 'phags pa dang / 'phags pa ma yin pa rnams kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gsang ba pa'i skyobadag po phyag na rdo rje la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras mi las ——421

'das pa'i dkyil 'khor dam pa/ yid las byung ba ni bstan to/ /mi rnams kyi 0)dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'das na'ang / sems can rnams gang du yang dag par zhugs na②/'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur rol/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i 'a)bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la smras pa/ rgyal ba'i sras gang de dus la bab par shes na gsungs shig gsungs (7shig /shākya seng ge mgon po ni/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das 'og na/ /sems can rnams kyi 57sangs rgyas nyid/ /sa steng khyod kyi dkyil 'khor byed/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'jig rten na/ /sngags ni rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /mi shes cho ga nyams pa'am/ /dam tshig bdag por ma gyur na(6)/ /bdag nyid chen po tshangs pa yang / /sngags rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags la dad pa med pas ni/ /'bad pa du ma byas gyur kyang / /sngags rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur bas/ /ma rungs dam tshig mi bstan to/ /dam tshig sbyor ba nyams pa ni//rab 'byam 7rabargya byin yin na yang / /sngags rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur na/ /mi rnams smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /dam tshig bstan bcos (nyade nyid shes/ /las kyi spyod pa sgrub pa la/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /sngags rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dzi)dkyil 'khor ni / /las kun byed la rab zhugs na/ /bstan pa la ni gzhon nu bzhin/ /sngags rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes sems dpa' chen po de la gsol ba btab pa/ kye sems can chen po sems can gyi don gyi phyir mdor bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs shig ces so/ /——422

gsang ba pa'i bdag pos de skad ces smras pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas sems can gyi don gyi phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga smras pa/ re zhig ①dang po cho 'phrul gyi ⑤zla phyed dam dpyid zla 'bring po'am dpyid zla tha chungs ①sam zla ba yar ngo'am/ nyin zhag dge ba dang gza' bzang po bltas te/ rgyu skar bzang po dang ldan pa yar ngo'i tshes gcig dang / zla ba nya ba'am ④dus gzhan la dbyar gyi dus (gespangs la/ snga dro sa byin gyis brlab (nyapar bya ste/gang du grong khyer chen po la brten ( )pa'am/ dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon rang nyid 'dug par bya'o/ /rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa'i gnas sam/ rgya mtsho'i ngogs dang nye ba'i dzoXgrong khyer chen po'i byang shar gyi poraphyogs su ha cang yang ⑩ mi ring ha cang yang 47mi nye bar dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon song ste lo ma'i spyil bu byas pa la zhag bdun nam zla ba phyed kyi bar du gcig pu rab tu gnas par bya ste/gang gnas de dag tu'ang 7gtsang ma'i sa phyogs rdo ba med pa/ gyo mo dang thal ba dang sol ba dang / /phub ma dang rus pa spangs pa shin tu gtsang ba shin tu yongs su sbyangs pa'i (stes phyogs su 4)srog chags med pa'i chu la ba'i rnam lnga'am/tsan+dan dang ga pur dang / gur gum gyi chus bsres pa khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ gtsug phud lnga'i phyag rgya tsochen po dang ldan pas sa phyogs der phyogs bzhi dang steng dang / 'og dang thad ka dang phyogs mtshams tsothams cad du bsang gtor 7bya'o/ /de nas phyogs der kun nas gru bzhir khru bcu drug gam khru bcu gnyis sam khru brgyad pa bya ste4she/ de la chen po ni //khru bcu drug pa'o/ /'bring ni khru bcu gnyis pa'o/ /chung ngu ni khru brgyad pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni rnam pa gsum/ /thams cad gzigs pas gsungs pa yin//88wa 423

rgyal po 'dod pas chen po ste/ /'bring ni longs spyod 'phel byed pa/ /chung ngu'i ①dam tshig yang dag srung / /las rnams kun byed zhi ba yin/ /de dag las yid la gang 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba ni de la sa phyogs der khru do tsam brkos la/ der rdo ba dang sol ba dang thal ba dang rus pa dang skra la sogs pa (snyedang ske/ srog chags kyi rigs rnam pa sna tshogs gal te mthong na/ sa'i phyogs gzhan du brko ba byas na gnod pa med pa dang 'tshe ba med par 'gyur ro/ /ri bo'i rtse mo dang chu bo'i ngogs dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang chu bo chen po'i ngogs su bye ma'i phung po chen po rnams 'bad pas/ shin tu so sor brtags te/ shin tu gtsang ba dang srog chags med par byas la bri bar bya'o/ /sa phyogs de yang srog chags med pa'i chu la ba'i rnam 98)lnga bsres te/ chu bo'i klung gis gtsang ma'am / grog sa)mkhar gyi sa gang du srog chags med pa'i sa des dgang bar bya'o / / bkang nas (5)kyang legs par brdungs te kun nas mnyam par ⑥byas la dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum gang 'dod par (/7bya'o/ /seng ldeng gi phur ba bzhi la khro bo'i rgyal po'i sngags lan bdun bzla zhing phyogs bzhir gdab bo/ /tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la khro bo'i snying po lan bdun bzlas pa byas te/ dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi kun nas bskor bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dbus kyi gnas su nang du yang zur bzhir bya'o/ /dbus na gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis rang gi rig pa rtsa ba'i sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzla 85bar bya'o/ /gtsug phud lnga'i phyag rgya chen po bcings nas rtsa ba'i sngags kyis grogs po dang / bdag nyid bsrung (9)bar byas la/ sngags zlo bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu byung ste/dkyil 'khor de la g.yas su bskor ba byas nas kha shar phyogs su bltas (1 )te/glu 424

ku sha'i stan la 'dug par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yid la byas te/ dkyil 'khor de'i gru bzhi 6)kun du ku shas bskor zhing dgram par bya'o/ /de nyid kyi phyi rol du yang ba (snyernams zhag gcig gnas pas bsnyal (gezhing dbyung bar bya'o/ /de la dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis sngon du bya ba rnams byas nas rang gi rgyud kyi sngags la mkhas pa dang / sems can gyi don gyi thabs kyi phyir theg pa chen po la mos pa dang / zhag gcig smyung bar ④byas pa dang grogs bzang po dang ldan pa dang / bstan bcos sna tshogs kyi (5)las mthong bas/ tshon sna lnga'i phye ma zhib mo shin tu gsal zhing legs par sbyar bar (6)byas la/ yi ge drug pa'i snying po mngon par bzlas 6)pa'i phye ma dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhag 50par bya'o/ /phyi rol du yang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng (9rab dang rta babs bzhis brgyan sna )pa chu shing 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis g.yur za ba dang rnga bo che dang rdza rnga brdung /1ba dang dung gi sgra dang dga' ba dang /bkra shis pa'i sgra sgrogs pa dag bya'o/ /zur bzhi nas chos mnyan hu)pa dag la yigebashad par bya'o/ /phyogs bzhir theg pa chen po'i mdo sde bklag rdzipar bya ba la 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lho phyogs su bklag tshepar bya'o/ /'phags pa zla ba'i sgron tshama'i ting nge 'dzin nub phyogs su bklag tsho par bya'o/ /'phags pa sdong pos brgyan 4shepa byang phyogs su bklag nyurtepar bya'o/ /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde shar phyogs su bklag sgi )par bya'o / /glegs bam dag ri 1med na mdo sde bzhi po shes pa'i gang zag chos 'chad pa po ( gel chos mnyan pa'i 22phyir bskul bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon langs nas tsan+dan dang ga pur dang gur gum ( zhibasres pa'i me tog dri zhim ——425

pa dkar po la rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor de ①thams cad du chal ②par dgram par bya'o/ /mngon par bkram pa byas nas phyi rol tu byung ste/zhag bdun gyi bar du cha'adod pa'i kha zas bsten pa'i ri mo mkhan gnyis sam gsum byang chub tu sems bskyed (4)pa gso sbyong nye bar bsten (snyepa mkhas pa dag bcug ste/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis gtsug phud bcing ba byas la/ de nas gser dang dngul dang zangs dang rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las tshon sna lnga (7shin tu mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba'i phye ma zhib mo rab tu blangs te longs spyod chen po dang ldan pa dang chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po dag 'drir gzhug ⑦pa byas na/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis nges par byang chub 'thob pa yin na/ sngags sgrub (kyepar byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ shākya'i skyes mchog 'das gyur nas/ /sems can bsod nams chung ba la/ /'di 'dra'i longs spyod ga (9)la yod/ /de bas micho ga 'di bstan bya/ /'jam dbyangs 'od chen ldan pa yis/ /skye bo phongs par gzigs nas ni/ /nyung zhing dkyil (1bsdus dkyil 'khor ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bstan pa yin/ /'bras sā yi lu dang thug po che'i phye ma shin tu zhib pa'i tshon sna lnga bzang po/ /dkar ba dang ser ba dang dmar ba (snyedang nag po bodang ljang gu skedag gis bsgyur te/ sngar bzhag pa'i tshon gyi phye ma slob dpon rang gis blangs nas/ gtsug phud lnga'i phyag rgya chen po bcings te/ci rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bzlas pa byas nas phye ma de la phyag rgya bcing 7ngo / /sgrub pa'i grogs 3 tshomachog gi 18slob dpon gyis 69dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol shar lho mtshams ru )kyi phyogs su cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis thab khung bya ste/ rgyar khru do la zabs su khru gang ba kun nas 'khor bar pad+ma'i ze ba 'dra ba/ phyi rol yang pad+ma'i ze ba 'dra ——426

ba shing pa la sha'i yam shing gis me sbar bar bya/ shing bil ba'i yam shing stimatho gang tsam rlon pa la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar la btags pa ②la rtsa ba'i sngags 'bru drug pa'am snying pos khu tshur gyi phyag rgya bcings te me lha spyan drang bar bya'o/ /spyan drangs nas sngar bstan ②pa nyid kyi rtsa ba'i sngags yi ge gcig pa'i snying pos phyir yang brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg ④bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis cod pan dang 'tshog chas byas phyinas bdag nyid dang ri mo mkhan yang rtse gcig par byas nas sbyin sreg byed du gzhug (6)go/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams yid la byas te(pe/sngar bstan pa'i bdug pas bdugs nas thal mo sbyar te (kyebyang chub sems dpa' thams cad la rab tu btud nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la yang phyag byas te/ tshon gyi kyi)phye ma blangs nas sku'i gzugs kyis skrubacad pa la/ ri mo mkhan gyis (7yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /cho ga 'di dag gis dang por sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang na chos ston cing bzhugs pa bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon ri mo 'dri yo ba na 'dir sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis slob dpon bdag nyid bsrung yi ba'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma gtang libar bya ste/ phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi dang steng dang 'og dag tu gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas khrus byas te thab khung gedu nye bar song nas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ gtsang sbra tsodang sung tsoba'i cho ga byas nas gur gum dang bsres pa'i mar gyi sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad bya'o / /de nas ku sha'i khres /shel 'dug nas bzlas pa bya ste/ge/ de nyid du ——427

gnas par bya'o/ / yungs kur tunyel khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mngon par bsngags (gel kham phor kha sbyar gyi phyinang du gzhag ④par bya'o/ /bgegs kyi rnam pa 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs can mi bzad pa'i sgra rnam pa du ma rlung dang char dang yul ngan gzhan dang gzhan gang (geyang rung ba mthong na/ khros pas yungs kur kham phor nas phyung la (7chang (7par bcangs ⑧te lan bdun sbyin sreg byas pa des ni bgegs rab tu 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i bgegs la ni lan lnga chang pa nas sbyin sreg byas na skyes bu de rengs par 'gyur ba'am/ nus pa med par 'gyur ba'am/ 'chi bar 'gyur ba'am/skad cig de nyid la mi ma yin pas zin par 'gyur ba la nams kyang the tshom med de / brgya byin yang 'chi bar byed na ma rungs pa'i sems (9)dang ldan pa'i mi'am/bgegs tha mal pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi 'jigs pas 7bgegs rnams phan tshun du 'bros shing mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis de nyid (1du ku 12sha'i khres la gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed kyi bzlas pa byed cing gnas par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku gzugs kyi g.yas ngos su/ rang sangs rgyas nyid 3 pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bya'o/ /de gnyis kyi 'og tu nyan thos chen po gnyis chos nyan par mi)bya'o/ /de dag gi yang g.yas su bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ston sha'i 'dam bu'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs 7pa/ phyag g.yon pa na pad+ma bsnams 7pa/ phyag g.yas pa na yonyemachog sbyin pa/ de'i yang g.yas na bcom ldan 'das ma yi yum gos dkar mo ——428

phyag g.yon pa na pad+ma bsnams ①pa/ phyag g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal ba pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ②gser gyi cod pan 'chang ba dar la chadakar po'i na bza' mnabs pa/ ④thal ba nag pos thig le gsum byas pa de bzhin du sgrol ma dang / khro gnyer can yang rang rang gi gnas su spyod lam dag gis gnas par (9bya'o/ /de dag gi steng du ni bcom ldan 'das yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yidang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan dang gtsug tor gyi rgyal mo rnams bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug bya ba la 'di lta ste/ kun tu bzang po dang / sa'i snying po dang / nam mkha' ⑦mdzod dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / ngan song rnam par sbyong ba dang / byams pa rnga yab lag na thogs shing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la blta (8)ba dang / dri ma med par 'gro ba dang / dri ma med pa'i tog dang ske/ nor bzang dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / dri ma med par grags pa dang /nad thams cad gso bar byed pa dang / chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po dang / 'jig rten 'gro ba dang / blo chen po dang / blo bzang po ste/sems dpa' chen po 'di dag ni 6)lus shin tu zhi ba dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bri bar bya'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i gtso bo dang / rig pa'i rgyal mo ⑩ dang pad+ma'i rigs gzugs dang phyag rgya lung ci lta ba bzhin du (nyaganas ci lta ba ma lus pa dag tu bri bar bya'o/ /mtha'i gru bzhi'i gnas dag tu ni yiganas rnams gzhag par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i me tog legs par byas pa dang rig pa'i lha gang dran pa yang de dag tu gzhag par bya'o/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs su bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang rang sangs rgyas gnyis ni/ ri spos kyi ngad ldang ba la ——429

bzhugs pa bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi shar ①du bdag nyid blta ②ba dang / thams cad la yang 'jug pa'i sgo rnams bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i g.yon gyi ③phyogs su rang sangs rgyas gzhan gnyis te/tsan+dan dang grub pa zhes bya ba gnyis bri bar bya'o/ /de gnyis kyi 'og tu nyan thos gnyis ni 'od srung chen po dang kā t+yā ④ya na chen po ⑤byi bar bya'o/ /de dag gi'ang g.yon du 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje ut+pa la ltar mdog sngo bsangs gzugs shin tu mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas pa na rnga yab thogs pa/ g.yon pa khro bo'i lus kyis gnas pa rdo rje khu tshur ma rdo rje lcags kyu ma rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma dpung bzang ma rdo rje sde ma cha byad ci lta ba bzhin du bgegs kyi gdan la gnas pa/ rig pa'i rgyal po thams cad dang rig pa'i rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa bzlas pa dang / phyag rgya dang ldan pa ji 6)ltar shes pa bzhin bri bar bya'o/ /de dag gi yang g.yon du zur bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyag rgya bri bar bya ste(77/ bris nas kyang gnas gang du rig pa'i tshogs ma dran pa'i gnas de dag kyang 'dir (7bzhugs shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /de'i steng du pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bcom ldan 'das yum mā ma tī 6)bri bar bya ste rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzugs shin tu mdzes par bya'o/ /de dag gi steng du gtsug tor gyi rgyal po brgyad kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas rang rang dag gi (7'khor los sgyur (1ba'i rgyal po chen po'i gzugs su bri bar bya ste/ gser gyi mdog can dbang po shin tu dul la yi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la zur gyis blta (nyab dag la/ 'di lta ste/gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang / gtsug tor mngon par 'phags pa dang /——430

gtsug tor gdugs dkar po dang / rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / pad+ma'i gtsug tor dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang /① gzi brjid phung po'i gtsug tor dang / gtsug tor mthon po ste/ brgyad po 'di dag ni gtsug tor gyi rgyal po rnams so/ /g.yon du bri ba ni rang sangs rgyas rnams so/ /'jug pa'i phyogs kyi sgor ni byang chub sems dpa' gnyis bya ste/ g.yas phyogs su ni 'jig rten las 'das par 'gro ba zhes bya ba ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ lus zhi ba (kyelag pa g.yas ③pa mchog sbyin pas phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lag pa g.yon pas spyi (4)blugs 'dzin cing sgo la mngon du phyogs pa bzhin cung zad khro gnyer dang (gebacas pa bri bar bya'o/ /'jug pa'i sgo'i g.yon phyogs su ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba zhes bya ba bri bar bya ste/ lus rab tu zhi ba ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ lag pa g.yon pa na dbyig pa dang spyi 6)blugs 'dzin pa/ lag pa g.yas pa na (7)mchog sbyin pa (shephreng ba 'dzin pa bzhin cung zad khro gnyer dang ldan pa sgo la mngon du 5)phyogs pa bri'o/ /seng ge'i khri'i 'og tu chos kyi 'khor lo kun tu 'bar bas khyab pa/ de'i 'og tu rin po che'i gzhal med khang de la gnas pa bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhin nur gyur pa/ gzhon nu'i gzugs can sku mdog dmar skya zhi ba'i gzugs dang / mdzes pa'i gzugs can cung zad zhal 'dzum pa/phyag g.yon pa na ut+pa la sngon po bsnams pa phyag g.yas pa na 7thal ba bsnams pa/byis pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gtsug phud lngas (1)nye bar mdzes par gyur pa mu tig gi tu phreng bas mchod phyir thogs pa dar la'i stod g.yogs mnabs pa dar gyi yi na bzas smad g.yogs mdzad pa 'od kun nas 'phro ba 'bar ba'i ——431

phreng 3)bas kun nas khyab pa pad+ma'i gdan la nye bar bzhugs pa khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje (migashed la tshigazigs pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sgo la mngon du phyogs pa blta na sdug pa bri bar bya'o/ /de'i g.yas phyogs kyi ngos kyi pad+ma'i 'og tu khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje 4gshed bri bar bya ste/ mi sdug pa chen po'i gzugs can kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa/ bka' len cing 'dzin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i phyogs su lta ba'o 55)g.yon phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'og tu gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu'i 56)gzugs can/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga bri bar bya ba la 'di lta ste/ shin tu dri med dang shin tu dul ba dang dag pa dang mun sel dang kun tu snang ba'o/ /de dag thams cad kyang gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang na 'dug pa/ rin po che du ma 'bar ba'i rdo'i steng dang 'dra ba kun nas 'bar ba me tog sna tshogs kyis gcal 977bkram pa shin tu mdzes pa bri bar bya'o/ /phyi rol 'khor nayug tu zur bzhi'i rnam par byas te/ rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa phyogs bzhi nas rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i tshon sna lnga 9)gsal bas ri mo shin tu drang ba dang ldan pa nang gi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /shar gyi bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i steng du ri mo'i 1 tshodabus su me tog kun nas skyes pa'i rgyal po'i dbang po 11pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs cung zad chung bar bya'o/ /'od kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng (1gebasakhyab pa/mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ skyil mo krung 1 gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i phyag rgya bri bar bya'o/ /sa)g.yon du ni gzi thubarjid phung po'i phyag rgya bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyi steng du ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya bri bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan tsho 432

'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi steng dang 6)/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i (gephyag rgya'i g.yas su bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa rtside bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs can bya ste/ phyag ④mchog sbyin pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs (de)pa kun nas 'od 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa/ de'i yang g.yas phyogs su ni (6)lhung bzed dang chos gos kyi phyag rgya bya'o(7)/ /de bzhin du mthar gyis 'jug pa'i gnas la ni pad+ma'i phyag rgya bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das me tog yang dag par skyes pa'i rgyal po'i (85dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i g.yon phyogs su gtsug tor gzi (9)brjid phung po'i phyag rgya bri ste kun nas 'od 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa/ de'i g.yon phyogs su de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog bya ste/ rin po che'i ri bo'i steng du chos ston cing bzhugs pa/ be+e ḍūr+ya ⑩sngon po dang margad 31 dang pad+ma rā ga rnam pa sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od 8'phro ba'i kun nas 'od dang ldan pa bri bar bya'o/ /de'i yang g.yon phyogs su rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas nyustekhyab pa bri'o/ /de'i yang g.yon phyogs su chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya kun nas 'bar ba dang ldan pa bri'o/ /de'i yang g.yon phyogs su 'khar ris gsil dang / spyi 1nadrugs dang phreng ba dang bzang po'i gdan gyi phyag rgya bri'o/ /mthar gyis sgo'i gnas su rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis ka yil yang kun nas 'bar ba bri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i 'og tu phyag rgya chen po gtsug phud lnga zhes bya ba dang / ut+pa la'i phyag rgya kun nas 'bar ba 'di gnyis phan tshun 'brel ba bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor kun nas sgo bri bar bya'o/ /sgo dag ni rgyab kyis lta ba dang / 'jug pa na ni mdun gyis blta nyu bar bya'o/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 51 du 88—433

'gyur ba yang kha dog lnga'i tshon shin tu gsal ba sna tshogs blta na sdug pa/ zur bzhis rnam par 'byes 6)pa/ rta babs bzhi'i rnam pa phyogs bzhir khru gnyis tsam nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi shar phyogs su tshangs pa chen po bri bar bya ste / gdong bzhi pa gos dkar po bgos pa la ②stod g.yogs gos dkar po dang —/ tshangs skud dkar po thogs pa/ kha dog gser 'dra ba/ ral pa'i cod can ①'dzin pa/ lag na dbyug pa ④dang / spyi ()blugs 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs su 'od gsal gyi lha'i bu bya ste/ mdog gser 'dra ba bsam gtan khyad par can gyi gzugs can/ dar la'i gos bgos pa dar la'i stistod g.yogs byas pa/ bzhin shin tu gsal ba ral pa'i cod can ⑦'dzin pa mchod phyir thogs dkar po can/ skyil mo krung ④gis 'dug pa lag g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs su 'og min gyi lha'i bu bya ste/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan (9)pa/ lus rab tu zhi ba bsam gtan gyi rnam pa'i cha byad can/dar la'i gos bgos pa dar la'i gos kyis 7stod g.yogs byas pa/ skyil mo krung shegis 'dug pa lag pa g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa/ mchod phyir thogs dkar pos byas pa/ de'i rim gyis dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / 'thab bral dang / brgya 6)byin la sogs pa'i lha'i bu bri bar bya ste/ go rims (steji lta ba dang cha byad dang dbyibs/ lta ba bzhin du'o/ /brgya byin gyi 'og tu rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris yil rtag tu myos dang ske/ phreng thogs dang / lag na gzhong thogs dang / pi bang skiganyis pa dang sa bla'i lha'i bu dag go rims ⑩ji lta ba dang / cha byad ji lta ba bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs su mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang shin tu ——434

mthong ba 6)dang gya nom snang phyidang / dge chung dang bsod nams skyes la sogs pa'i lha'i bu cha byad dang dbyibs ci lta ba bzhin bri bar bya'o/ /nub phyogs dang byang phyogs su yang de bzhin te/ de dag ni rim pa 'og ma gnyis la brten te bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi phyi rol du dkyil 'khor gsum par 'gyur ba la / mthar gyis phyogs bzhir ①rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ byang phyogs nas 'jug pa'i g.yas ngos su gter nye bar gnas pa la/ nor sbyin ④rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gtsug phud cung zad 'dud pa gnod sbyin gyi gzugs can / de'i g.yas su nor bu bzang po (snyedang gang ba bzang po gnod sbyin gyi bdag po gnyis bri'o/ /de bzhin du mthar gyis gnod sbyin ma zhuchen mo 'phrog ma yang pyabri'o/ /de bzhin du mthar gyis nub phyogs su chu lha lag na zhags pa thogs pa dang / klu dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / 'jog po dang /nor rgyas la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad po ②bri'o/ /de bzhin du rim pa gnyis la gnas pa'i mthar gyis gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi 'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po dang / drang srong dang / grub pa dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang / nam mkha' lding dang mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa dang / sman dang nor bu rin po che'i bye brag dang ri dang chu bo dang gling dang mthar gyis gtso bo thams cad bri bar bya'o/ /lho phyogs su spuni gshin rje ma mo bdun gyi 'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /shar lho mtshams 7su me kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa/ dbyug pa dang spyi 4)blugs dang phreng ba lag na thogs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin pa/ gos dkar po bgos pa/ dar la'i stod g.yogs byas pa/ mchod phyir thogs /gyedakar po thogs pa/ mdog ——435

gser 'dra ba thal ba'i thig le gsum byas pa/ de bzhin du rgyan dang mtshon cha dang cha byad yo)dang dbyibs dang kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs pa rim pa gnyis pa la brten ②te bri bar bya'o/ /thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sgo'i phyi rol du dka' zlog ①gi bdag po khyu mchog la zhon pa/ lag na mdung rtse gsum thogs pa lha mo dka' zlog ④ma kha dog sna tshogs pa 6)rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa / smin drug gi bu rma bya'i stan (6)la 'dug pa mdung thogs pa/ gzhon nu'i gzugs can gdong drug pa lus dmar por snang ba/ gos ser po bgos pa/gos ser po'i stod g.yogs can lag pa g.yon pa na dril bu dang ba dan dmar po thogs pa/ mthar gyis jing ⑦gi ri ti shin tu rid pa 'dra (7ba dang / tshogs kyi bdag po chen po dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang nag po chen po dang / ma mo bdun po rgyan dang mtshon cha dang kha dog dang dbyibs ci lta ba bzhin bri bar bya'o / /nor lha brgyad dang drang srong bdun dang khyab 'jug lag pa bzhi na 'khor lo dang dung dang ga dā dang ral gri thogs pa/ gdan nam mkha' lding rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gza' brgyad dang rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun dang /gang yang nye ba'i gza' brgyad sa steng gi dkyil 'khor na rab tu rgyu ba yang bri bar bya'o/ /mthar gyis tshes grangs bcwa 6)lnga dang yar ngo dang mar ngo'i phyogs dang / khyim bcu gnyis dang dus drug dang zla ba bcu gnyis dang lo tshigs dang /sring mo bzhi gru la zhon pa dang ming po lnga gru la zhon zhing tu )chu la gnas pa ste/mdor na phyag rgyar gzhag par bya ba yang yin no/ /lha mo de dag mthar gyis rim pa gnyis pa la brten 37te bya ba yin no/ /slob dpon bdag nyid phyi rol du byung nyanyanas dkyil 'khor de la g.yas phyogs khri nisu bskor ba byas te/ mdor na ——436

dkyil 'khor gsum yang dkyil 'khor la brten 6)cing bri bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gsum char (miyang gru bzhir rnam par gnas par bya ba yin no/ mdor na 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams kyi mgon po ni nges par bri bar bya'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang nges par bri bar bya'o/ /rdo rje'i rigs 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje'ang nges par bri bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gtso bo 'phags pa kun du bzang po'ang nges par bri bar bya'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'ang nges par bri bar bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni ji ltar rnam par bzhag pa bzhin phyag rgya bri bar bya'o/ /'di ni nang gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor bar ma la rtsiyang shar phyogs su ni mi mjed ④kyi bdag po tshangs pa bri bar bya'o/ / bode bzhin du 'od gsal ba ni lho phyogs su'o/ /'og min gyi gzugs can rnams lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par ro/ /'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi bar ni brjod par mi bya'o/ /byang phyogs su brgya byin lha'i rgyal po dang / rab 'thab bral dang / yongs su dga' ldan dang / rab 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / 'od chung la sogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams nges par lha'i rgyal po re re bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni phyag rgyar gnas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gsum par yang byang phyogs su 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan dka' thub zlog 5)ma dang bcas pa nges par bri'o/ /'jam dpal gyi sgo gnyis pa'i ma(5)sgo'i drung du ni smin drug gi bu rma bya'i stan yod pa lag na mdung thogs pa/lus kyi kha dog dmar ba/ gos ser pos stod g.yogs dang gos byas pa lag pa g.yas pa na dril bu dang ba dan thogs pa/ gzhon nu'i gzugs can gyi ji zhi'akhor ——437

la lta ba'o/ /shar phyogs su ni nam mkha' lding 'dab chags kyi gzugs can dang 6)/ drang srong gi nang nas mar ka ṇa (miḍa nges par bri bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ni ji ltar gnas pa bzhin phyag rgyar bri bar bya'o/ /shar lhor (0ni gzhon nu ma bzhi dang / ming po gzhon nu dang bcas pa/ gru'i bzhon 6)pa la gnas pa/rgya mtsho chen po la rnam par rgyu ba dang / me lha'i rgyal po yang nges par bri bar bya'o / /de bzhin du lho phyogs su ni srin po'i bdag po las ni grong khyer lang (snyeku'i bdag po bi (ne bhi sha na shing pi tsu marda la gnas pa dang / dzam bha la chu dbang zhes bya ba gnod sbyin gyi gzugs can byang chub sems dpa' nges par bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du mthar gyis gshin rje'i rgyal po yi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen po nges par bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du sha za'i rgyal po rnam par g.yengs byed ces bya ba nges par bri bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ni ji ltar gnas pa bzhin phyag rgyar ( ribri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du lho nub kyi mtshams (shesu ni klu'i gtso kyi)bo dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo nges par bri bar bya'o/ /gza'i gtso bo nyi ma bri bar bya'o / /nub phyogs su ni drang srong thub pa'i mchog gcer bu pa mu stegs kyi mchog gcer bu'i gzugs bri bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ni ci ltar gnas pa bzhin phyag rgyar bri bar bya'o/ /nub byang mtshams dhisu ni gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po mchog sbyin dang / dri za'i rgyal po gtsug phud lnga pa /stodang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa nges par bri bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ni gnas ji lta ba dang / dbyibs ci lta ba bzhin du phyag rgyar bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po 1)phyi rol du ri mo (9lngar bkod de/ phyag rgya'i phreng bas nye bar mdzes par byas pa/ zur bzhi nas rta babs bzhi dang rgyal po chen po bzhis brgyan 7pa ci ltar gnas pa la 'di ——438

lta ste/ phyag rgyar 'gyur ba 6)ni sgor 'jug pa la ut+pal sngon po bri'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi ③phyogs su ni pad+ma rdo rje dgra sta/ ral gri mdung dang mdung rtse gsum pa dang / ga dā dang 'khor lo dang swa sti (bka dang / bum pa dang / nya dang ske/ dung dang / gdub kor dang / spyi ༷blugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan dang / zhags pa dang / dril bu dang / chu gri dang / gzhu dang /tho ba dang / 'di dag rnam pa 'di dag 'dra ba'i mtshon cha'i mchog gi phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su ⑤kun nas khyab par bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir rgya mtsho chen po gzhag par bya ste/ byang phyogs su ni dkyil 'khor gru bzhir bya steyi/ sna tshogs rdo rje rtse gsum yod pa kun nas 'bar ba bya'o/ /shar phyogs su ni dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can byas te bzhag la kun nas 'bar ba'i pad+ma'i phyag rgyas mtshan pa'o/ /lho phyogs su ni dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa 57)byas te kun nas 'bar ba'i lhung bzed kyis mtshan pa'o/ /nub phyogs su ni dkyil 'khor kun nas zlum por byas te/ ut+pa la sngon po sdong bu dang 'dab (kyem dang bcas pa kun nas 'bar bas mtshan pa'o/ /phyogs mtshams tshonabazhir yang phyag rgya bri bar bya ste7/ nub byang gi phyogs su ni dkyil 'khor zlum po bya ste/ zhags pa kun nas 'bar bas mtshan pa'o/ /lho nub mtshams 6nyasu ni dkyil 'khor gzhu 'dra ba bya ste dbyug pa yi kun nas 'bar bas mtshan pa'o/ /shar lho mtshams kyi su ni sna nodakyil 'khor gru gsum pa bya ste/ste/dgra sta 'od zer kun nas 'bar bas 7mtshan pa'o/ /byang shar gyi mtshams tu su ni ral gri 'od kun nas 'bar ba gzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar thams cad bris nas steng dang 'og dang thad kur phyag rgya gsum dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol sgo dang nye ——439

bar phye ma dang bri bar bya la 'di lta ste/ na bza' dang rnga yab dang lham 6)'od zer kun nas 'bar ba bri bar bya'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni blo can gyis/ /sems can rnams la phan bzhed (minas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga rnams/ /'dir ni mdor bsdus bstan pa yin/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis dang po nyid du slob ma gzung ( bar bya ba la/ dbang po ma tshang ba (4)med pa dang yan lag thams cad mdzes pa dang / bram ze dang rgyal rigs dang rje'u rigs dang dmangs (5)rigs dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / theg pa chen por zhugs pa'i rang bzhin can dang theg pa dman pa mi (6)'dod pa'i ngang tshul can dang / sems dpa' chen po dang dad pa dang ldan pa dang / dge ba'i chos can dang rgyal po chen po mngon par 'dod pa dang longs spyod chung ba la smod ⑦pa dang / longs spyod chen po mngon par 'dod pa dang ldan pa dang / bzang ba dag dang dul ba dang ldan pa dang / tshul khrims dang ( ldan pa'i dge slong dang dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma rnams yang dag par sdom pa la nges par gnas pa dang / gso sbyong la nye bar gnas shing sdom pa la gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po la zhe mi sdang ba dang / phyogs chen po dang rigs mthon po dang rang bzhin nyid kyis chos spyod pa dang zhag gcig smyung 9ba byas pa dang / gos gtsang ma bgos pa dang skra dri zhigapa dang /dus gsum du khrus byed pa dang / de'i nyin zhag la ga pur yi )dang gur gum dang li shi la wang ga'i 17dri zhim pos dri zhim par byas pa/ rtag tu nye reg dang ldan pa dang / ku sha'i khres la 'dug pa dang srung ba'i cho ga byas pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa dang bden pa dang ldan pa dang dus mtshams kyi las rgyal ba'i yi dkyil 88wa 440

'khor gyi phyi rol de nyid du ha cang yang mi nye ha cang 0)mi ring bar gzhag par bya'o / /shin tu gtsang ba dang shin tu gtsang sbra dang ldan pa gcig nas brgyad kyi bar te de las gzhan ma yin pa de dag kyang phan tshun gnyen du 'brel ba/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po dag gi bu gzhon nu ma'am ②gzhon nu ma (bgrong gi chos mi shes pa'o/ /de zhugaci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gzhon nu'i gzugs can byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal ni byis pa'i skye bo dga' bar byed pa/ gzhon (5)nu'i rol pa la dgyes pa des na dang po nyid du gzhon nu snonang du gzhug par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po mngon par 'phel ba dang tshe dang nad med pa dang / dbang phyug dang skal ba chen po mngon par 'phel ba yin te/ khyad par du byis pa rnams la nges par sngags grub pas kunagrub pa gnas pa yin te/ de dag sngar bzhag pa byas nas/ grogs po bag yod pa bzang po dang ldan pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis ri steg pur gyi bdug pas bdugs te/ rgyab kyis 59phyogs pa ma yin pas phyi rol du byung bar bya ste/ byung nas dus dang ci ltar mthun pa'i chu legs par gtsang sbra byas pa dang / srog chags med pa la rtsa ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas te / gtsug phud lnga'i phyag rgya chen pos phyag rgyar byas pa'i chus khrus byas la nye reg byas nas/ gos gtsang ma bgos pa'i gtsang bas me thab 57kyi drung du song ste / ku sha'i khres la 'dug nas byang shar gyi phyogs su mngon par bltas te/mar gyi sbyin sreg tsho meg pur dang gur gum dang / tsan+dan dang bsres pas 4)stong rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /sngar bshad pa'i cho gas spyan drang ba dang gshegs su gsol ba byas tetshoge/ yang dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o/ /nges par yang bum pa gang ——441

ba brgyad hunyeras gtsang ma'i gos dang ldan pa/ shing a mra'i lo ma dang 'bras bu dang ldan pa gser dang / dngul dang rin po che dang / 'bras dang 'bru nang du bcug pa gcig bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la dbul lo/ /gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad la'o/ /gsum pa ni rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang 'phags pa nyan thos la'o/ /bzhi pa ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad ②la'o/ /lnga pa ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal la'o / /drug pa ni lha thams cad la'o(sne)/ /bdun pa dang brgyad pa ni dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i sgo khang ④la gzhag par bya ste/ /gcig ni 'byung po thams cad la'o/ /gcig ni sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur par bsngos nas gzhag par bya'o/ /de bas na sngar bshad pa'i cho gas spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang / mar me dang lha bshos kyang sngar bstan pa nyid kyi las kyis dbul bar bya ste/ thams cad kyi thams cad du go rims (57bzhin du bya'o/ /mar me 'dzin pas (5)mar gyi mar me gzung stibar bya'o//'phags pa dang 'phags pa ma yin pa thams cad la lha bshos zhes smos pa ni/'bras sā (8)lu'i chan zho dang bcas pa dang sbrang rtsi dang ldan pa'i 'o thug khyad par can gyis nye bar sbyar 99)ba'i mar la btsos pa'i snum khur gyi 7'breng bu la sogs pa dang / khaṇ+ḍa (1nyal sogs pa'i bza' ba thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dbul bar bya'o/ /mar gyis gang ba dang tsan+dan gyi thang chu sbrang rtsi'i snying po dang 'o mar btsos pa'i bza' ba ni rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang /'phags pa nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang 'phags pa'i lha thams cad la dbul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du gcod u lo pi ka ri ka dang /——442

khyad par du snum khur gyi yo byad 'byung po 6)thams cad dang / sems can thams cad la sngags dang ldan pa'i cho gas sbyin par bya'o/ /de bzhin du me tog dri zhim pa sna (snyema'i me tog dang rgya spos dang / klu'i me tog dang me tog pun nā ①ga la sogs pa sngar bstan pa sangs rgyas dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang 'phags pa dang 'phags pa ma yin pa'i lha thams cad la dbul ④bar bya'o/ /khyad par du ni ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la ni sna (nyama'i me tog dang / pad+ma'i rigs la ni me tog pad+ma dang / de bzhin du rdo rje'i rigs la ni me tog ut+pal dang /lha gzhan dag la ni gzhan gang yang rung bas dbul bar bya'o/ /ga pur (7gyi bdug pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'o/ /tsan+dan ni pad+ma'i rigs la'o/ /de bzhin du gu gul ni gsang ba'i (8rabadag po phyag na rdo rje la shes par bya'o/ /lha gzhan thams cad ni bdug pa tha mal pas bya'o/ /mar gyi mar me 'phags pa rnams / /thams cad la ni dbul bar bya(9ra/ /'phags min ⑩lha ni thams cad la / /dri zhim 'bru mar dbul bar bya/ /cho ga ji bzhin rim pas ni/ /bdug pa mthong ba'i rgyu yis so/ /de ltar gsungs pa de bzhin dri/ /sngags rnams kun la rtag tu bya/ /spyan ras gzigs la gang gsungs dang / /gang gsungs phyag na rdo rje la/ /rang rang gi ni sngags dag gis/ /sngags spyod don du bsgrub yinapa'o / /cho ga gcig pu blta bya ste/ /rtag tu rjes su mthun par bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nyugeslob dpon gyis sngar mthong ba'i cho gas spyan drang ba dang /mchod pa dang bdug pa la sogs pa byas nas/ gtsor mthun pa'i bya ba byas te de'i 'og tu sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis mkhas pa dang / myur bas 'byung po ——443

thams cad pa'i gtor ma sha med pa/ kun nas rnga pa ṭa ha dang dung gi sgra dga' ba'i sgra sgrogs pa la sogs pa des bdug pa dang spos dang me tog dang phreng bas brgyan 6)pa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams ②brgyad steng dang 'og dang thad ka thams cad du dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bskor ba ①bya zhing / 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma rgya cher gtong bar bya'o/ /de nas khrus byas te yang zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis bsgos pa'i sā ④lu dang / 'bras thug po che'i sbyin sreg rtsa ba'i sngags yi ge drug pa dang snying pos stong rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /sbyin sreg byas nas dkyil 'khor la rjes su bcug cing sngar (snyebazhag pa'i sems dpa' chen po la srung ba byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyi (7)slob ma nyid du khas blangs pa / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gso sbyong byas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la bdag nyid kyi lus phul ba/ dngos grub kyi phyir gsems can thams cad kyi nye bar longs spyod pa dang yongs su longs spyod pa thun mong du gyur pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po gnon par bya ba dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sangs rgyas thob par bya ba la dkyil 'khor bstan bar bya'o/ /bsnga na pa tsam nyid kyis sdig pa'i rnyog pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur te/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa'i skye bo yang de ma thag tu grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis ras ma nyams pa tha ga mas btags ma thag tshon pa skra med pa la/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis lan gsum bzlas te/ dri zhim po'i tsan+dan dang gur gum gyis bsgos pa'i ras kyis gdong g.yogs 97par bya'o/ /dang por byis pa lo gsum nas lo bcu drug pa'i bar zur phud lngas nye bar mdzes pa'am/ gtsug phud gcig gis nye bar mdzes ——444

pa'am / gtsug phud gsum gyis ①nye bar mdzes pa skra dang ldan pa/ rgyal po'i bu spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'am/ rgyal rigs kyi bu'am gzhan bdag nyid chen po rgyal po chen po 'dod pa dkyil 'khor du gzhug ②par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la phyin pa na gdong g.yogs ②par bya ste/ ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcings nas / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i phyirtsa ba'i sngags lan cig brjod du gzhug ste/ me tog ⑤dri zhim po tsan+dan dang gur gum (nyadang bsres ⑦pa shin tu gtsang bar (kyebyas pa/ lag pa gnyis su byin la me tog 'dor du gzhug 6)go/ /gang du de'i me tog babs pa der de'i sngags sbyin par bya ste/ sngags 'di ni de'i yin par bstan te/ skye ba brgyud pa nas de dang rjes su 'brel pa yin te/de nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub kyi snying po la gnon pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa'i don du mngon par sgrub par byed pa/ longs spyod chen po dang rgyal po chen po dang grags pa chen po dang / gang zag rtse gcig par mngon par sgrub pa yin no/ /tshe 'di nyid la yang chos thams cad la yang 'othe tshom med par bsgrub par bya ba 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mthar gyis dngos grub 'dod pas brgya rnyed (7kyi bar du bya ste gzhan la ni ma yin no/ /gzhan dag la ci ltar sdig pa spang ba'i phyir dam tshig tsam sbyin par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis dbang bskur na/ dang por re zhig dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol dhiha cang yang mi nye ha cang yang mi ring bar byang shar gyi sna phyogs su rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dag par byas pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /rgyal po dbang bskur ba bzhin du bdag nyid sems pa dang gcig tu sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la dad cing dad pa ——445

dang —/ spro ba chen po dang ldan pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral 6)ba dang —/ theg pa chen po la zhugs pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la phan par byed pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang ma smad pa dang / tshe 'di nyid la sngags grub ②par 'dod pa dang / bsam pa bzang po ⑧dang sngags kyi spyod pa la spro ba dang / blta bar 'dod pa'i rang bzhin can dang sad par 'dod pa'i phyir yang sngags kyi don la rnam par rtog pa med pa dang / der gtad ④pa'i yid dang gcig la sogs pa nas lnga'i bar du dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ni spang bar bya'o/ /shes rab can dang spyod pa la rmongs pa med pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa la dbang bskur bar bya'i(5)/ gzhan dag ni ma yin no/ /de nas rgyal po thams cad dbang (67bskur ba bzhin du yo byad thams cad bsogs te/slob dpon mkhan po mnyes na/ de nas bla re chen po bres te/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan mthon po bsgreng 977zhing gdugs dkar po dbu la 'dzin pa dang /rnga yab dkar pos g.yob pa dang / bkur (kyisti chen pos dung dang / rnga bo che'i dga' ba'i sgra sgrogs shing rgyal ba'i sgra dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bde legs dang rab tu bsngags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ rgyal bas po)gsungs pas mngon par bstod pa dang / dkyil 'khor de la bskor ba byas teyi /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yinyal phyag byas nas/ gu 'di skad du slob dpon bdag ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sngags kyi spyod pa sgrub pa la yang dag par 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten pa 7thams cad las 7yang dag par 'das pa'i gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor la yang dag par 'jug pa dang / chos kyi rgyal srid thams cad kyi sangs rgyas nyid ——446

rtogs par 'dod pa dang / mdor na sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bar bya ba'i 6)phyir ro zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas ku sha'i khres la 'dug ste/ shar gyi ②phyogs su phyogs te dkyil 'khor la blta ①zhing / dang por re zhig rig pa'i dbang bskur ba ④byin te phyag rgya chen po gtsug phud lnga 'ching du gzhug par bya'o//de nas rang 'dod pa'i sngags gang dang gang la dga' ba gro ga'i zhu)'dab stim la gi tshuwang gis bri bar bya stephyi/ bris nas kyang tsan+dan dang gur gum gyi chus lag pa dang kham por 6)kha sbyar bkrus la/ de nas gro ga'i kyi'adab tunyem de kham por kha sbyar ba'i 7nang du gzhag par byas pa dkyil 'khor gyi nang du byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyi zhabs drung du gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas ku sha de la gnas nas rig pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad snga ma nyid du bzla bar tsobya'o/ /de nas ku sha'i khres la 'dug pa la dbang bskur skibar bya ste/ phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor la gang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyur pa'i bum pa gang ba sgo dang nye bar sngar 'bazhag pa blangs te/ slob dpon gyis rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /gzhan dag la ni ci ltar 'dod pa'i chus so/ /de nas kham por tsokha sbyar de de la sbyin par bya ste mar me la klog tu gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te de nyid yin na ni rim gyis 'bad pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /yang na ci ste gzhan na ni sngags bzlas pa kho nas 'grub par 'gyur ro / /yang na yi ge'i yan lag nyams pa'am/ lhag pa byin na ni dang po sgrub pa kho na la 'grub par the tshom med do/ /de ltar slob dpon gyis sngar bris pa'i ⑩sgrub pa gsum gyis nges par 'grub par the tshom med do/ /de bzhin du dang pos ni rig pa'i dbang bskur ba sbyin par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la dbang ——447

bskur ba ni gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor du lha thams cad la bstabs pa'i sngar gyi bum pa des dbang bskur bar 6)bya'o/ /spyi bo la sngar gyi cho ga ci lta ba de nyid kyis byas na sdig pa'i rnyog pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis gnang zhing / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang / dkyil 'khor dang sngags dang phyag rgya thams cad sgrub pa la byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur zhing / slob dpon du dbang bskur ba sbyin no / /dkyil 'khor gsum pa la ni rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / nyan thos thams cad la phul ba'i bum pa gang ba de nyid kyi cho gas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa thams cad kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi sngags rgyud dag 'don pa dang / dkyil 'khor bri ba dang ston pa dang phyag rgya dang spyod pa ston pa dang rang nyid spyod cing ston par khyod la rjes su gnang zhing brjod par bya ba yang tshe 'di nyid la yin la/ phyi nas skye ba brgyud pa dag la (mini sangs rgyas nyid thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de bzhin du rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang bskur ba yang sngar bstan pa'i cho gas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la sngar phul ba'i bum pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la phul ba'i bum pa gang bas kyang de bzhin du dbang bskur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang / nyan thos rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du brjod par bya zhing khyod la rjes su gnang ba yin no/ /'byung po thams cad kyis rab tu thub par dka' zhing lus can thams cad kyis grang448

mi pham pa dang sngags pa 0)thams cad las khyod rgyal ba dang ci ltar 'dod pa sgrubs ②shig pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis re re la yang ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dbang bskur ba lnga sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can rnams la yang ( )lnga po nyid kyis (4)bya'o/ /de dag mthar gyis dkyil 'khor la bcug ste/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid phul nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan rigegasum byas te slar gtang (6)bar bya'o/ /de las gzhan pa'i nyin zhag la mthar gyis sngags kyi spyod pa la bslab par bya zhing sbyar bar bya'o / /skad cig de nyid la bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la sngar phul ba'i bum pa gang ba blangs nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa de dag la chu khyor ba gsum shar du mngon par blta bar byas la blud ( rapar bya'o/ /'di skad du brjod par bya ste(8na/ kye byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i gsang ba'i dam tshig las 'das par gyur na (9)bsod nams rdzim yin pa mang po skye bar ma byed cig /sngags thams cad kyang dzina'ador bar ma byed cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dag kyang slu bar ma byed cig /bla ma mnyes par gyis shig /gzhan du dam tshig las 'das par gyur na sngags 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /gebasod nams ma yin pa mang por 'gyur ro/ /zhes de ltar smras la gtang tu bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis kyang 1 cizhi dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags pa'i sā 15lu dang 'bras thug sapo che'i sreg 1 blugs kyis yi ge brgyad pa'i snying po dang /8sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas langs nas dkyil 'khor gyi 19dbus su zhugs te/ sngar bstan pa'i me tog gis/ sngar ri bstan pa'i cho gas lha thams 88wa 449

cad yid la byas te 6)mchod yon dbul (milo/ /bdug pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srin po dang /sha za dang / 'byung po dang / rnal 'byor pa dang grub pa dang / drang srong rnams dang sems can thams cad yang dag par bdug ①nas me tog gtor ④te/tsan+dan dang gur gum gyis bsangs la sngar bstan pa'i cho gas slar gshegs su gsol bar bya ste/ sems kyis thams cad btang (9ba yin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis bshos dang gtor ma dang / sa tshon thams cad chu bor dor bar bya ba'am/ srog chags sdug bsngal ba rnams la sbyin par bya'o/ /sa phyogs de legs par byugs (6)shing 'jam par byas te/ legs par phyag pa 9)byas nas ba lang gi lci bas byug tu gzhug pa'am/ chus byug par bya ba'am/shin tu gtsang ba'i 98)sas byug pa'am/ bye mas gtor bar byas la/ de nas ci ltar 'dod par 'gro bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor la zhugs pa des bdag nyid 'o ma dang / 'bras chan gyi (9)zas sam/ lha la dbul ba'i kha zas bza' bar bya'o / /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod cho ga zhib 7mo'i rgyal po'i dbang po las/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa byang chub semasasgyudapa'i le'u rab 'byam 1lhalas/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bstan pa nyunyaste le'u gnyis pa rdzogs so/snye// //de nas gzhan yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gnas gtsang ma'i 88—450

gzhal med khang gi 6)'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dus pa la gzigs nas/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal te/ yi ge gcig pa mchog tu gsang ba dug thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ las thams cad byed pa sngags dang dkyil 'khor chung (7ngu sgrub pa'i thabs dang / las phran tshegs ①thams cad la nye bar sbyar bar bya ba smras so/ /de yang gang zhe na/na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ tabya thā/ o dza/ grogs po dag 'di ni 'byung po thams cad nyon cig /sngags 'di nyid ni yi ge gcig gi dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i cho ga ④thams cad du dgos pa/ khru brgyad dam khru bzhi sa'i phyogs yang dag par byas la tshon sna lnga'i phye mas rang nyid kyis bri bar bya ste/ gzhan gyis ni ma yin te/ gang de dang de dag tu yang 'dir ni nges pa med do/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi mnyam pos nye bar mdzes pa/ gtsug phud lnga'i phyag rgya chen po dang por zhi)re zhig bri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i ut+pa la'i phyag rgya dang / mche ba'i phyag rgya dang zhal gyi phyag rgya dang dbyug ⑥pa'i phyag rgya ste/ phyag rgya 'di dag dkyil 'khor gyi nang du shar gyi 4 )char bri bar bya'o//de nas pad+ma dang rdo rje dang ut+pal dang phyag mtshan dang ba dan dang gdugs dang rta babs dang / shing rta dang glang po che dang rta dang glang dang ma he dang /swa sti ka dang rma bya dang ra dang lug dang / skyes bu gzhon nu'i gzugs can phyi rol gyi sgo'i rtsa bar bri bar bya ste/ mthar gyis rim pa la brten nas bris te/dkyil 'khor gsum la brten nas de ltar bri bar bya'o/ /de nas yi ge gcig pa'i sngags nyid kyis shar lho'i phyogs kyi char me'i las bya ste/ shing a pa marga'i yam shing zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar la btags pas (8)stong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg ——451

bya'o / /de nas me tog gi mchod yon dbul lo/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sngags ①kyis ci ltar 'dod par gtor ma dang lha bshos dang mar me dang bdug pa dang spyan drang ba dang gshegs su gsol ba rnams bya'o/ /de nas rgyal srid 'dod pas ni grong khyer gyi dbus su bri bar bya'o/ /longs spyod 'dod pas ni shing a mra'i drung du'o/ /bu 'dod pas ni bo de tse'i shing gi drung du'o/ /chung ma dang glang po che dang rta 'dod pas ni glang po che'i bres skyu'am/ rta'i bres skyur ro/ /chu 'dod pas ni mtsho chen po'am klu'i gnas su'o/ /nyin bzhi pa'i rims sam/rtag pa'i rims sam/ rims thams cad la rtag tshirgecig pa'am/ grong gi ⑧g.yas phyogs su'o/ /srin pos zin pa lini dur khrod dam khang pa stong par bya'o/ /yang srin pos zin pa la ni ba ru ra'i (nyeshing gi drung ngam(5)/ e raṇ+ḍa'i 9)shing gi drung du bya'o/ /ma mo thams cad kyis zin pa la ni bzhi mdo'am shi ba'i khyim dang bu btsas pa'i khyim du nye bar bya'o/ /tshangs pa'am (0srin pos zin pa la ni ṇita la'i shing drung 7du'o/ /sbyar ba'i dug 'byin (7pa la ni yi ge gcig pa'i sngags kyis 7chu la lan gsum bsngags pa byas te(ste/ dkyil 'khor de nyid du blud pa byas na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du bud med dam skyes pa grags pa 'dod pa la ni bzhi mdo'am bram ze gnas par bri bar bya'o/ /bu shi ba la ni shing 'bras bu can nam 'o ma can gyi 7shing drung 7du'o/ /'bras sā (7lu sminapa'i sa dang zhing gi dbus su ni bu med pa la bri bar bya'o/ /nad rnam pa gsum bdag gir byas pa dang gzhan gyis tu nyams pa la ni 'jug ngogs la sogs pa la'o/ /nad chen pos btab 1nyapa la ni dkyil 'khor chu bo'i ngogs dang 'gram du bya'o/ /nad thams cad kyis thams cad du btab pa la ni ri'i rtse mor bri bar bya'o/ /88wa 452

mkha' 'gro mas byas pa la yang bram ze'i ldum ra'am/ khang pa stong pa'amacha/gnas dben par ②gzhol ba'i sa phyogs su bya'o/ /de bzhin du las thams cad la nam phyed dam dus thams cad du mngon par bri bar bya'o/ /yi ge gcig pa de nyid kyi sngags kyis me tog gi mchod yon phul te gshegs su gsol lodu/ /dkyil 'khor la chus gtor ba byas na nad thams cad bsrung ④ba chen po ⑤byas par 'gyur te nad thams cad las grol bar yang 'gyur ro/ /bu med pas ni bu rnyed cing / /skal med rnams kyang skal ldan 'gyur/ /dbul po rnams kyis nor 'thob ⑥pa/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis so/ /skyes pa'am yang na bud med kyang / /thos nas the tshom med byas na/ /ci 'dod rnam pa sna tshogs ni / /thob 'gyur rtag tu phun sum tshogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi cho ga rab 'byam ⑦las/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rtsa ba las kyi ⑧dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i le'u ste gsum pa rdzogs sodzi )// //de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma la gzigs nas/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der 'dus pa la yang gzigs te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i zhabs gnyis la btud nas zhal 'dzum pa dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir sngags kyi spyod pa'i cho ga'i 0sgrub pa'i rgyu mthun pa/ chos kyi char ci ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu sgrub pa'i cho ga rab 'byam tshospelas ras kyi ri mo'i cho ga bsod nams bla na med pa skyed yi pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon mngon par sgrub ——453

par byed pa/ mdor na bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa sngags thams cad kyi 'bras bu la rab tu sbyor zhing 'bras bu dang bcas par byed pa/don med pa ma yin pa grub cing sgrub par byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i go cha bgos pa/ bdud thams cad kyi stobs zil gyis mnan cing rgyab kyis phyogs par byed pa bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i phyir de legs par bshad du gsol/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas de skad ces gsol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i phyir gang khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di 'dri bar sems pa ni legs so legs so/ /de shin du legs par nyon la yid la zung 0)shig dang / ngas bshad par bya'o/ /khyod kyi ras ris 9 kyi cho ga rab 'byam (5)sngags thams cad sgrub par byed pa la rab tu 'jug pa mthar gyis ngas bshad par bya'o/ /sngon yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bstan te da ltar yang ngas bshad par bya'o / /dang por re zhig sa'i phyogs gtsang ba (41rdul med pa las ras bal yang dag par blangs la/ dam tshig la zhugs pa'i sems can rnams kyis rasa'i bal de yang dag par (57byas te/ yang sngags 'dis dkyil 'khor gyis brgya rtsa 6)brgyad tu bsngags 7par bya'o/ /na maḥ sa man+ta 9kyibud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ bo dhi 99)sa twa 1 )a pra ti ha ta ga ti ma ti pra tsā ri shā1sku/ na maḥsi shodha na duḥ(14kha pra sha ma nen+d+ra (1 rā dzā ya/ta thā ga tā ya tsho.arta te samyakle 7bud dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ya saṃ sho dha ya/88wa 454

sarba bisne gha dhita ka ma hā kā ru ṇi ②ka ku mā ra rū pa dhā ri ṇi / bi kur+sha bi kur+sha/sa ma yam nu sma ra tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas grong gi chos mi shes pa'i gzhon nu ma/ bram ze'i rigs dang rgyal rigs su skyes pa dang / rje'u'i rigs su skyes pa dang lirigs ngan pa'i skyes (snyeganas yongs su spangs pa/dbang po ma tshang ba med pa/ yan lag thams cad mdzes pa pha dang mas rjes su gnang ba/ gso sbyong byas pa/ byang chub tu sems bskyed ⑥pa/ snying rje dang ldan pa/ bzhin dkar ba/ kha dog gzhan rnam par spangs pa/ mdor tson bud med kyi mtshan nyid rab tu zhi ba'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshan pa/ shin tu nyin zhag shis pa dang / zla ba yar ngo dang gza' bzang po bltas te/ du ba dang khug rna med cing sprin dang bral ba rlung med cing gtsang ba'i sa phyogs su sngar bstan pa'i gzhon nu ma khrus byas shing gos gtsang ma bgos te/ gos kyis 6)legs par bkab 5)pa byas pa la sngags 'di phyag rgya chen po dang ldan pas bsrung bar bya steyi/ tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum nyu1srog chags med pa'i chu dang sbyar bas ras bal de dang bu mo de sngags de nyid kyis yang dag par sbyangs te gtor la/ tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum gyi chus steng dang 'og dang phyogs bzhir yang gtor bar bya'o/ /tsan+dan dkar po dang gur gum dang ga pur tsogacig tu byas pa'i bdug pas bdug tsho par bya ste/ rang nyid kyis sbyin pa'am/sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gi slob dpon gyis sbyin par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang sa bcu'i dbang phyug la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bochen po rnams/ ras kyi dog pa 'di la lhag par gnas par mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub 88—455
