ma lus 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg las la yang dag bsten/ /gzhan yang la nye bzang po dang / /'dab chags dge ba'i sgra dag dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs nges pa'i sgral/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags pa dang / /bkra shis bzang po rab bsngags ①dang ske/ /rnam pa sna tshogs yid 'ong sgra/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /de bzhin mchod yon bum pa gang —/ /mthong na 'grub (kyepa'i rgyu rnams yin/ /rnam pa du ma'i kha dog gam/ /'jig rten gyis mchod rab bsngags pa/ /de dag mthong na 'grub ②'gyur ba/ /sngags rnams du ma'i spyod yul yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga bcu gsum pa ste/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'byam ④rdzogs sol// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gzhan yang gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal khyod 6)kyi gsang ba'i rig pa yod de/ sngags thams cad kyi sgrub pa po'i thabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis stiyang dag par rjes su gnang ba/chos kyi mdzod las byung ba/ chos kyi sprin gyi rjes su zhugs pa/ nam mkha'i ⑧ḍā bo nyid 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sngags thams cad kyi mnga' bdag shin tu gtso bor gyur pa/ gzhon nu ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can thams cad kyi mchog tu brjod de/ shin tu gtso bor gyur cing dam pa yin la/ lha dang mi rnams kyi skyes bu khyu mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin no/ /gzhon nu de bzhin du rig pa'i rgyal po 'di ni sngags thams ——554

cad kyi mchog tu bstan ①cing shin tu gtso bo yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das brjod du med pa dag gis sngon gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gi snying po mchog ②tu gsang ba kun nas bkra shis par 'dod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ④yang dag par bstod pa rab tu bsngags pa sems can thams cad yang dag par dbugs (ge'abyin pa sdig pa thams cad rab tu 'jig ⑥par byed pa 'dod pa thams cad sbyin par byed ④pa re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa de yang gang zhe na / bar (kye'adir bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas smin mtshams hu)kyi mdzod spu nas sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par bskul tu )ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung bar gyur to/ /gang 'di phyogs bcu steng 'og thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing snang bas khyab par mdzad de/ sems can thams cad kyi yid tshim par mdzad nas slar log ste/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i dbu'i gtsug tor (1du nub par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor nas kun nas 'bar ba'i 'od dang 8ldan pa'i lus can blta bar mi nus pa/ sems can thams cad kyis mi thub pa 'od chen pos yang dag par 'phags pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis lus brgyan pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gzugs dang ldan pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i gzugs can rig pa'i rgyal po yi ge gcig pa zhes bya ba byung bar gyur to/ /byung nas nam mkha'i dkyil thams cad snang bar byas te/ rig pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyis yongs su bskor ba rig pa du ma bye ba 'khri phrag brgya stong 'byin par byed pa/ yi ge gcig pa'i sgra 'don cing 'od zer chen po 'bar ba rab tu 'byin pa steng gi phyogs nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 88—555

mngon du blta ba dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po yang snang bar byas nas bar snang la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas yi ge gcig pa ①rig pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog ces bya ba'i snying po mchog tu rab tu ②gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las labacom ldan 'das rin chen tog gis yang dag par thob pa/ sā ④la'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang 'od dpag med dang bsnyen par dka' ba dang spyan bzang dang tog bzang dang me tog dbang po dang gnyid mthar phyin dang 'jig rten thub pa dang / gser thub la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de (snyedag gis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba dang 'das pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs (6)rgyas thams cad kyis kyang gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba de yang gang zhe na/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ rgyug/ 'jam dpal 'di ni snying po dam pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog sngags thams cad kyi rig pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba yi ge gcig pa zhes bya ba dag byed chen po 'di yang dag par bsgrubs po)na sngags thams cad 3)'grub ⑩par 'gyur te/ gcon nu gang yang khyod kyi cho ga'i rgyal po'i yolhamachog la sngags thams cad dang rjes su mthun tu)pa/mchog tu gsang ba'i mchog yang dag par rjes su gnang ba las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yang dag par sbyong bar kyi byed pa/ dang po re zhig sgrub pa pos nges par 'bum phrag gsum bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas las rnams sngags dang bcas pa 'dir gzhon nu khyod kyi bocho ga'i rgyal po la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sngags dang rgyud rnams bsgrub par bya'o/ /'dis bsrung skib byas na 88—556

'byung po thams cad kyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bgegs thams cad kyis zil gyis non ①par mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas de gsungs ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur te/sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du yang snang bas khyab cing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor der 'dus par gyur te/ gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang du 'khod par gyur to/ /sa bcu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa'i sems can thams cad dang rig pa'i rgyal po rnams 'od zer gyis yang dag par bskul nas lhags par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag na rnam par gnas pa'i sems can mang po dbang du gyur to/ /dmyal ba dang dud 'gro dang yi dgas kyi ngan 'gro la gnas pa rnams 'od zer chen po'i snang bas reg cing snang bar byas pas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba'i rgyun la gnas pa yid shin tu bde bas tshim zhing skyo ba med par gyur te/nges par theg pa gsum la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas 'khor gyi dkyil ②'khor de la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' 5nyestsal pa/ 'jam dpal nyon cig rig pa'i rgyal po 'di rdzu 'phrul che ba dpa' bo gcig pu las thams cad byed pa/ rig pa thams cad kyi rgyal po 'khor los sgyur ba/ sems can thams cad kyi libasam pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa cho ga zhib mo thams cad yongs su rgyas pa/ khyod kyi sngags ——557

dang rgyud dang / cho ga rab 'byam la yang dag par zhugs pa/ sngags thams cad sgrub par byed pa/ thun mong du gyur pa/ grags pa che ba dang / spro ba che ba dang / sems can sgrub pa po'i khyad par gyi thabs dang shes rab la mkhas pa byang chub kyi lam thams cad yongs su sbyong bar byed pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa la rab tu 'jug par byed pa/ bdud zil gyis gnon par byed pa/ byang chub kyi snying po la gnas par byed pa/ dge ba'i tshogs yang dag par 'byung bar byed pa'o/ /'di nyid mdor bsdu 0)na/ cho ga zhib mo rgyas pa ras ris kyi cho ga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ sngon gyi sngags kyi spyad pa rjes su spyod pa/gang la rab tu gnas na sems can gyi rig pa'i rgyal po 'khor los sgyur ba chen po sgrub par 'gyur te/ rmad du byung ba chen po sngags thams cad kyi dbang phyug dam pa/ 'od byed pa/ thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/rnam par 'dren pa/ 'gro ba thams cad la phan par byed pa/ sangs rgyas bzhin du mngon sum du nye bar bzhugs pa rang byung du gyur pa mchog dang bar ma dang tha ma'i las thams cad byed pa shin tu bde ba dam pa shis pa dang zhi bar byed pa sdig pa thams cad rab tu 'jig par byed pa'o/ /lha rnams kyi yang lha nyid de/ /thub pa rnams kyi thub pa mchog /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen gyur pa/ /dag pa 'jig rten rnam par grags/ /chos kun rang gi ngo bo mkhyen/ /yang dag mthar gyur ( rnyog pa med/ /de yi cho ga mchog bshad bya/ /'byor pa 'dod pas mnyan 957par gyis/ /re tsho4)zhig dang por (5)ras bzang po/ /skyon rnams dang ni (tshim 'dres pa/ /sar pa phra ba'i khyad par ldan(pe/ /kha tshar dang bcas 98nyid la bri// /chur ni khru do'i tshad yin la/ /zheng du khru gang tshad du bya//88wa 558

de 'dra'i bzang po kho na la/ /dri med blta na sdug pa dang / /bcos bu dkar po de bzhin du/ /phra dang legs bkrus ras ①bal spangs/ /phyag dar dri ma med pa yi/ /du gu la yi ②ras nyid la/ /rgyu ni shing kun nyid dang ni/ /dag la ①rgyud ni rnam spangs pa/ /chu ngan ④las ni bkrus min dang / /skye bos zhal mthong phul ba'ang min/ /ma bgos ⑤pa dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan yang cung zad dam pas bsngags/ /de 'dra'i ras ni bzang po la/ /gzhal med khang ni bri bar bya/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor phreng ba can/ /ston pa'i gzugs ni yang dag bri/ /de bzhin gser gyi mdog can ni/ /'od zer phreng ldan bri bar bya/ /gcig pu phug na bzhugs pa ni/ /ri bo la gnas grags pa che/ /dar la'i bla re bre ba ni/ /rin chen phreng ba 'phyang ba'o/ /steng du lha ni gnyi ga yang / /'dzin pa dag ni yang dag bri/ /ri rnams kyi ni steng dag tu/ /rin chen phreng ba rab tu bya/ /bla re'i 'khor yiyug mu tig gi/ /dra ba dra phyed ⑦dag gis brgyan(kyil/ /ri rgyal steng du 'bad pa yis/ /'di dag thams cad bri bar bya/ /ri bo dag gi rtsa ba yang / /rgya mtsho chen por nub 6nyepar bya/ /ras ris mthar yang me tog ni/ /kun nas 'khor bar yang dag bri/ /nā ( )ga ge sar phun ()nā tu gtunye /ba ku la dang zhu ti ka /sna ma'i yime tog pri yang kutso/ /de bzhin ku ra ba ka dang / /ut+pa la dang dri mchog dang / /de las gzhan yang pad+ma dkar/ /me tog rigs ni sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin gzhan yang drir ldan pa'i/ /me tog dag ni 'di dag nyid/ /gang yang rung ba rtag blangs nas/ /ston pa la ni mchod don du/ /yid du 'ong ba'i mchod yon dbul/ /sngar bstan cho gas ras ris ni/ /mchog dang de bzhin gzhan dag kyang / /dog pa tha lig pa dag 88—559

dang / /ri mo mkhan yang de bzhin 'dod/ /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed kyi/ /nyi ma dge ba dag la ni/ /dus ni de ltar gyur pa la/ /bzlas pa nyid kyang bya ba yin / /'di la sems can thams cad kyis/ /sngar bstan bzhin du yang dag spyad / /tshon gsal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /ston pa'i gzugs ni bri bar bya/ /rnam pa du mar ldan pa yi/ /dong ku'i me tog mdog 'dra dang ①/ /tsam pa ka yi ②mdog 'dra dang / /gser gyi mdog dang ①'dra bar bri/ /de lta'i rnam pa ldan pa yi/ /rin chen rigs skyes thub pa brirtsi/ /chags pa chen po rin chen tog /gtso bo thub mchog dam pa ni/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs thob pa'i / /sangs rgyas dkon mchog de bri bya/ /rin chen ri bor gnas pa dang / /rin chen phug gis nyer mdzes shing / / skyil krung ⑤gis ni bzhugs pa dang / /chos ni rjes su 'chad cing stsol/ /cung zad 'dzum zhing brtan ⑥pa dang / /thugs ni bsam gtan la dmigs dang / /phyi rol phug ni yang dag bri/ /'og dang de bzhin 'khor yug tu'o/ /ras mtha'i zur du sgrub pa pos/ /pus ⑦mo'i lha nga yang dag btsugs/ /bdug spos lag na thogs bzhin du/ /lus ni cung zad 'dud pa dang / /bla gos gcig tu byas nas ni/ /cha byad ji lta bzhin (kyedu yang / /bcom ldan 'das kyi 6)g.yas phyogs kyi/ /'og gi rgya mtsho che steng du/ /sngags pas dge boba'i don gyi phyir/ /sdom brtson 7rtag tu bri bar bya/ /las kyi cho ga 'di dag ni/ /'jig rten gyi sngags tu bstan pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor de yi lha dag kyang / /da ni rab tu brjod par bya/ /de tshe sngags pas rig pa'i sngags / /de tshe sngags ni rig pa des/ /sngags la rtag tu bsnyen byas dang / /bzlas pa phun sum tshogs mngon shes/ /'jam dbyangs cho ga 'di la ni/ /de 88—560

tshe sngags pa dbang bskur ba/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa la mkhas ①shing / /rtag tu gtsang sbra byed pa dang / /sngags rnams kun la dbang bskur dang / /dkyil 'khor 'di la 'jigs ②pa med/ /rig pa'i sngags dang sngags bcas dang / /bdag nyid bsrung sridang phan 'dod ④dang / /grogs kyang ⑤de bzhin bsrung ⑥shes dang / /yongs su legs brtags 'od chen ldan/ /slob dpon legs par yang dag rtsomatshu/ /rtsom zhing sbyangs yon bsten ⑧pa dang / /shes rab che zhing legs 'jam dang / /dpal ldan snying rjer ①rtag tu ldan/ /grogs po dag ni thams cad kyang / /mtshan nyid de bzhin kun tu bstan/ /gcig gnyis gsum dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan yang de bzhin brgyad kyi bar/ /slob ma legs par sbyang bar ⑩bya/ /mang po dag ni spang bar bya/ /sngar bstan cho ga ji lta bar/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la'ang yang dag spyad/ /stobs bcu ldan pas dang por yini/ /dkyil 'khor gang dag rab bstan pa/ /'jam pa'i (byedabyangs las gzhan min dang ske/ /rgyu gzhan dag gis bri mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'od chen ldan pa yi/ /tshad ni rab tu bstan par bya/ /khru bzhi'am khru ni gnyis pa dang / /de bzhin gzhan yang khru brgyad par/ /gtsang ba'i phyogs sam chu klung ngam/ /khyad par du ni ri bo'i rtser/ /tshon sna lnga yi phye ma dang / /sngar bstan pa yi las kyis so/ /gru tunyebazhi sgo ni bzhi pa dang / /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa dang / /zur bzhi mnyam zhing bzang ba dang / /lha yi rnam pa 'dra ba'i mdogatso /tshon rtsi gsal ba sna tshogs dang / /mdzes pa'i kha dog legs mdzes dang / /dri zhim bzang dang gzugs bzang dang / /grogs bzang dag gis yang dag brtsam/ /thub pa'i brtul 7zhugs yang dag spyad/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i brtul zhugs ——561

bsten0) / /nyon mongs med sems zas tshod rig /chos ldan rtag tu zlos pa ②byed / /sdig med las dang yongs srung byed/ /de bzhin zhi dang rgyas pa shes/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus zhugs nasal/ /bstan bcos las gsungs ④bzhin du bri/ /rin chen lha tshogs kyis brgyan (7pa'i/ /ri mo (5)dang por bri bar bya/ /der bzhugs (megazi brjid chen po ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog / skyil krung gis ⑧ni legs bzhugs pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rjes bskor ba'o/ /ras ris la ni ji lta bar/ /bstan bcos la 6)sngags thams cad bri/ /ri mo'i phreng ni gsum dag dang / /phyag rgyas rab tu brgyan kyis dang / /gser mdog rim pas khor dzo/1yug tu/ /yongs su bri bar bya ba yin/ /gsal dang yongs su rdzogs popa dang / /drang po de yi rnam pa'o/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i bdag po che / /de yi dbus su bya ba yin/ /nyi ma 'char ka 'dra ba dang / /gur gum rnam pa 'dra mdog can/ /'khor lo chen po'i rjes 'brang ba/ /'bad par gnas pas kun tu bri/ /rgyal po chen po mnyam 'dra ba/ /gzhal med khang bcas rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sems dpa' chen po'i cod (9pan can/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu brgyan/ /dar la mdzes pa'i smad g.yogs 8can/ /sna tshogs dar las stod g.yogs shing / /phreng ldan zhi ba'i kha dog 'od/ /gos dang phreng bas brgyan skipa dang / /me tog phreng ba bsku 7la/ /lag pa ⑩gzhos pas snoms yi par byed/ /bzhin 17ni cung zad 'dzum pa'i lha/ /mthu chen 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /gzugs bzang gzugs ni mdzes pa dang / /byis pa rgan po rnam par spangs/ /lag pa g.yon na 'khor lo ste/ /'bar ba'i 'od kyi phreng ba can / /de ni yongs su bskor ba dang / / skyil krung phyed kyis ( )gnas pa bri/ /——562

gzugs bzang gzugs la bsten 0)nas ni/ /lha yi gzugs 'dra bri bar bya/ /ri bo 'od chen ldan pa'i steng / /rin chen du ma'i ②steng du gnas/ /sngags rnams kun la che ba dang / /rtag tu mchog sbyin la 'jug byed/ /'bar ba'i me dang 'dra ba dang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes pa/ /rlung gis gasbar ba'i me bzhin du/ /kun nas me ni 'bar ba'o/ ri /de bzhin sngags kyi sbyor ba yis / /khyab bdag me yis 'bar bar byed/ /stobs chen de dang 'dra ba yi/ /sngags kun rab tu sgrub byed pa/ /gang gis rgyabadag nyid chen po mthong / /sdig pa kun las yongs su grol/ /mtshams (5)med lnga po byed pa dang / /tshul 'chal blo ni chung ba dang / /sdig pa kun la 'dzud byed pa/ /khyab bdag mthong ba tsam gyis grol/ /lha yi lha ni 'khor lo'i bdag /dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /gzhan yang sdig tu yongs bstan pa/ /de yi mod la grol bar 'gyur / /sngags pas rtag tu khyab bdag gi(5)/ /de nas shar sgo yang dag sbyar/ /rta babs kun nas yongs bsgreng 57 ste/ /ba dan dag gis nyer mdzes 57bya/ /mtha' dag gzugs ni mdzes pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su gsal byas nas/ /bshos dang bdug pa dri dang ni/ /rtag tu phreng ba bzang po yis/ /cho ga snga ma kho na ltar/ /de dag thams cad gus par bya/ /dbus kyi bum pa gang ba ni/ /'khor lo can gyi mdun du dgod/ /de'i 5)bum rnam par rgyal zhes bya/ /sngags shes pas ni de mi btegatso /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis ni/ /me thab snga ma bzhin du bya/ /sbyin sreg cho ga yang dag brtsam/ /cho ga sngags ni gzhan tsho1pas min / /sbyin sreg kyang ni brgya rtsa brgyad/ /seng ldeng bud shing me la ni/ /pa la sha dang bil ba'i shing / /bil ba u dum arka tsho dang / /'bad pas las rnams 88—563

kun la ni/ /a pa 6)margas sbyin sreg bya/ /til la mar gyis btags ②pa 'am/ /zho la sbrang rtsis bsres ①pa yis/ /las rnams kun la sbyin sreg ni/ /stong rtsa brgyad ni rtag tu bya/ /dus gsum dus 0ni kun bstan pa/ /khrus dang gos ni brje ba dang / /dkar gsum rgyu skar bzang po ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis ⑤bstan pa yin/ /las rnams sngar ni bstan pa yi/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg de bzhin gzhan/ /sngags dang yang dag ldan pas sam/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs kyis bya/ /las rnams dag ni kun la yang / /yi ge gcig pa'i sngags kyis bya/ /de ni mthu chen don ldan te/ /dpa' bo gcig pu rtag pa mchog /de la rtag tu zlos byed pa/ /sngags rnams kun gyi cho ga spyod/ /'jig rten pa yi 'jig rten 'dod/ /cho ga thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i brtson 'grus che/ /rig pa'i rgyal po dka' thub che/ /sngags kun 'grub par 'gyur ba ni/ /cho ga 'di las gzhan pas yimin/ /thub pa rnams kyis sngags gsungs dang / /de bzhin stobs bcu ldan sras dang / /'jig rten skyong ba brgya byin sogs/ /khyab 'jug dbang ldan tshangs pa dang / /zla ba nyi ma de bzhin gzhan/ /gnod sbyin dbang po srin po dang / /lto 'phye che dang mi 'am ci/ /de bzhin sa steng drang srong mchog /nam mkha' lding dang rlung lha dang / /sems can ming ldan 'jig rten gzhan/ /gang gis bshad pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /'dir yang 'grub (7)par 'gyur ba yin/ /sngags rnams kun la 'gugs byed dang / /las rnams kun la ston byed dang / /'byung po kun gyi sngags rgyud ni/ /rgyas dang bcas pa dbang du byed/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sngags 'di ni/ /sngags pa kun gyi rab byed pa/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis 6)don ldan te/ /——564

lha rnams kun ni 'gugs byed la/ /cho ga rnams ni dbang du byed/ /yi ge gcig chen bdag po yin/ /dam pa rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa yin/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i sngags/ /yang dag sbyar na sgrub par byed/ /ma lus mthong na mdzes pa yi/ /ras ris gsal ba byas nas ①ni/ /gtsang ba'i phyogs dang 'bab chu'i ngogs/ /ri bo'i rtser yang gzhag par bya⑤/ /snga ma'i las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /nub kyi phyogs su rtag tu bstan / /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis ni/ /sgrub pa po ni shar du blta/ /drar ⑧ba'i khres la 'dug nas ni/ /'du 'dzi med par bzlas pa ④bya/ /sgra ni drag ⑤min ngal bas min/ /gzhan la ngan sems med gyur na/ /sangs rgyas ma lus kun gyi yang / /'di la myur du 'grub pa yin/ /rtag tu 'jig rten byams sems dang / /sdug bsngal can la snying brtser ldan/ /mgon med sems ni dman pa dang / /phongs pas nyam (7thag stobs chung dang / /mi bzad 'khor bar ltung ba la/ /snying rje'i sems ldan 'grub par 'gyur/ /'bad pas ras ris mdun dag tu/ /mchod pa chen po rtag tu gzhag /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /bzang po sems las byung ba dang / /rgyal dbang gzugs kyi ri mo ni/ /bsam pa'am yang na bya ba yin/ /de nyid kyi ni cho ga yis/ /de nyid du ni me thab bya/ /me ni shin tu 'bar ba la/ /sgrub pas sreg blugs sbyin sreg bya/ /tsan+dan dkar dang ga pur dang / /gur gum gyis bsres 57༄mang po ni / /brgya ni rtsa brgyad sreg blugs (8)kyis/ /sngags rig me 'bar sbyin par bya/ /seng 6)ldeng blag ⑩sha n+ya grodha/ /pa la sha ni gang yin pa/ /de dag las byung shing dag gis/ /me chen rtag yonyetu sbar bar bya/ /shing de dag ni med gyur na/ /——565

shing gzhan yongs su gzung ①bar bya/ /pi tsu mar da tsha ②dang skyur/ /po son cha ①las byung ba'i shing / /tsher ma can sogs spang bya ste/ /sdig pa'i las la rab tu bsgrags/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sngags nyid kyis/ /zhi dang rgyas pa byas gyur na/ /de ni myur bar 4)'grub par 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i las ni spyad mi bya/ /sngags mchog kun kyang 'di la ni/ /las rnams cho ga rgya chen kun/ /rnam rtog med pas rab sbyar na/ /rtag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /de tshe sngags ni 'grub 'gyur zhing / /mchog sbyin nyid du'ang 'gyur ba yin/ /yam shing blag (snyesha u dum bar(5)/ /yang na blag tso)sha n+ya gro dha/ /mar gyis btags (snyedang sbrang rtsir ldan/ /zho dang ldan pas mnyam bzhag nas/ /sa steng rgyal thabs 'dod pa yi/ /sngags pas dus kun sbyin sreg bya/ /lha yi rgyal po 'dod pas ni/ /gur gum tsan+dan sbyin sreg bya/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i lha dag gi/ /bdag po nyid ni 'dod gyur na/ /pad+ma'i sbyin sreg 'bum phrag ni/ /sum cu rtsa drug ge sar po)bcas / /sbyin sreg mthar ni mchod yon yang / /bstan ⑩bcos las byung (mebazhin du dbul/ /rgyal bas bsngags ⑩pa'i (steras ris mchog /der lini kun nas yongs su 'bar/ / de la 7reg pa tsam gyis ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dag dang ni/ /'og min gyi tshani bar dag gnas1na/ /yang na sa 'og rim par 'gro / /bar skabs 'dir ni grub rnams kyi/ /der 3steni rgyal por rtag tu 'gyur / /stobs chen brtan nyurtezhing pha rol gnon/ /'byung po rnams ni 'byer bar byed/ /rtag tu rig 'dzin rgyal por 'gyur/ /las rnams yongs su sbyong bar 5nyabyed/ /de ni yun ring 'tsho 5nya'agyur te/ /bskal pa tsam du'ang gnas pa yin / /gang tshe lus ni shi 'phos nas/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /——566

gzhan yang las ni 'di dag kyang / /mdo dang rgyas pa bstan par bya/ /pad+ma dkar po yongs blangs nas/ /tsan+dan dkar dang ldan pa yi/ /sbyin sreg 'bum phrag brgya byas na/ /des ni rin chen tog mthong 'gyur/ /rgyal ba dam pa de mthong na/ /de tshe mngon shes lnga thob 'gyur/ /bskal pa chen por ring 'tsho zhing / /sangs rgyas rjes su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mtha' yas phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas de nas mthong bar 'gyur/ /de dag la ni rtag mchod cing / /de dag nyid dang lhan cig gnas/ /rin chen ldan zhes 'jig rten khams / /gcig na bcom ldan de bzhugs pa/ /thub gtso mchog ni dam pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /de la de ni rtag gnas te/ /sngags kyis dag par the tshom med/ /gzhan yang las ni 'dod pa dag /gang zag mchog gis gsungs pa ni/ /nā ga ge sar ga pur dang / /tsan+dan gur gum cha mnyam pa / /sngags pas de tshe gcig byas nas/ /sbyin 6)sreg 'bum phrag bdun cu brgyad / /de tshe lha ni sbyin sreg mthar/ /'khor lo can de 'dir byon nas/ /rtag tu dgyes (nyanas mchog stsol te/ /sgrub byed spyi bor byug ①par mdzad/ /de tshe reg ④pa tsam gyis ni/ /sngags pa sa bdun (snyebadag por 'gyur/ /rgyal sras thugs las skyes pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpar de (6)brjod do/ /nges pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang / /de ni lung bstan 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas brtsams nas cung zad gang / /shes dang shes bya rgyal ba'i sras/ /shes 'gyur sngags rnams ma lus ni/ /rtogs pa'i bdag nyid cher rgyas yin/ /de la reg pa tsam gyis ni/ /mngon shes lnga ldan sngags rgyal 'gyur/ /rtag tu bdag dang gzhan bdag nyid/ /rnam pa sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /rnam pa kun mchog 88—567

ldan pa yi/ /mchod pa'i las la rtag tu dga'/ /skad cig de nyid kho na la/ /byang chub las la brtson par 'gyur/ /de tshe skad cig tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas zhing der 'gro/ /'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /thams cad du yang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /de tshe spyod bcas mthong bar 'gyur/ /de las chos ni thos pa dang / /mchod pa'i las la brtson par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba 'khor los sgyur gsungs pa'i/ /'dir ni las rnams gzhan yod de0)/ /mar me yon du dbul ba ni/ /mar bcas snying po gtsang ba ni/ /gser dang dngul gyi snod dag dang / /zangs ma sa dag (snyenyid yin na/ /der 97ni mar me rab sbar te4)/ /skyes bu grangs ni 'bum dag gis / /grangs kyi tshad tsam nges bzhag ste/ /brgya phrag stong las lhag pa min/ /bud med spangs pa'i skyes pa yis/ /kho ra khor yug mar me 'dzin/ /mchod pa'i las kyi don du ni/ /ston pa'i ras ris sku la dbul/ /sngags rnams re re'ang 'dod (debazhin du/ /thams cad mnyam par rab zhugs (6)nas/ /ston pa la ni 'bul (77byed na/ /de yi mod (gul grub par ston/ /kun nas sgra ni sgrogs byed cing / /rnga bo che yi sgra yang sgrogs/ /gang phyir lha tshogs du ma ni/ /legs so zhes pa'i sgra rab 'don/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 57sems dpa' yang / /de tshe nam mkha' la bzhugs nas/ /shes rab can khyod legs so legs/ byu /legs 7byas las ni yongs su byas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa dang / /sdug bsngal yang ni mthong mi 'gyur/ /bde dang zhi ba mya ngan (1'das/ /'jigs med sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob1ste/ /lam ni dge dang dri ma med/ /yan lag brgyad la legs par spyod/ /yi ge gcig pa mnyes byas nas/ /88wa 568

sngags kyi ngo bo'i mgon po mnyes/ /gzhan yang las ni 'di yod de①/ /dam pa'i 'gro ba la gnas nas/ /mthu chen por ni rnam shes pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /nim pa'i rang bzhin shing blangs nas/ /rtse gsum rdo rje gnyis mthar byal/ /dbus kyi phyogs su bya ba ni/ /rdo rje rigs te mi bskyod pa/ /de nas sngags kyis dag byas nas/ /de ni ras ris sngon ③du bzhag /de nas sngags pas lag reg nas/ /sngags ni mnyam par bzhag nas bzla/ /rtsa brgyad 'bum phrag bcu drug ni/ /yongs su rdzogs nas grub par 'dod/ /de nas rdo rje gcig 'bar te/ /kun nas de ni rab tu 'bar/ /de nas rdo rje de blangs nas/ /'di ltar de ni steng 'gro'o(pe/ /de nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nam/ /gzhan yang lha gnas gang 'dod 'gro/ /de nas nam mkhar 'gro 'gyur te/ /grub pa kun gyi sngon du 'dren/ /grub pa'i rig (nya'adzin la sogs kyi/ /bdag po nyid kyang byed par 'gyur/ /lha yi 'dus pa mang po yi / /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /bdag nyid kyi ni spyod pa yang / /rnam pa sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /bar gyi bskal pa bcu yi bar/ /yun ring gnas te bar chad med/ /bde ba la brten 4)rtag tu mchod/ /rtag tu skyes bu dam par ldan/ /byang chub sems kyi (7)yang dag spyod/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal rnam par spangs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug 'gyur ba ste/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /de las (8)shi 'phos mir skye zhing / /bde ba mang la rab tu gzhol//'gro ba ma lus skyo (9)byas nas/ /byang chub yang dag gzhol bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las mtha' yas/ /mang po 'jig rten don mchod pa/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'dir brjod 7pa/ /cho ga rgya chen cho gar bcas/ /sa bdag brgya 5)byin 88—569

nyid dang ni/ /'khor los sgyur nyid yang dang yang / /rig 'dzin rnams dang de bzhin du/ /lha nyid dang ni bdag po'ang byed/ /rnam pa du ma'i ngo bo 'am/ /las ni gang dag 'di gsungs pa/ /thams cad grub pa thob 'gyur te/ /sngags pa legs par sbyor byed na'o/ /mtshan mo skyil mo krung ①bcas te/ /sdom can don yod bzlas byas na/ /tho rangs 2grub pa thob 'gyur te/ /zlos pa mngon shes lnga thob 'gyur/ /dur khrod ro la 'dug nas ni/ /sdom can 'gul med zlos pa ni/ /yi ge gcig po don chen te/ /tho rangs gagrub par 'dod pa yin/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /gal te dur ①khrod gnas nas bzlas(snye/ /zla ba drug gis grub thob ste/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu byed / /gang yang rung ba'i gnas dag tu/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po zlos byed na/ /der gnas grub pa thob 'gyur te/ /sngags pa legs par sbyor byed pa'oyi/ /gdugs dkar de bzhin ral gri dang / /nor bu'i lham dang gdub kor ⑦dang / /mu tig phreng ba dpung rgyan dang / /gdu bu dang ni sor gdub (7dang / /'og pag (1)dang ni de bzhin gos/ /so shing dang ni spyi 0blugs dang / /mchod phyir thogs dang zhwa dang ni/ /khrab dang go cha nyid dang ni/ /g.yang gzhi tu)dang ni ril 7ba dang / /phreng nye ba dang ni mchil lham dang / /'jig rten gnyis na 'dod pa yi/ / rgyan gyi 7gtso bo thams cad de/ /lha dang mi dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan yang rgyan 'gyur 'di la brgyan/ /de dag thams cad thob 'gyur te/ /ras ris mdun du 7chos byed la'o/ /rdzas rnams kun dang 'byung khung dang / /rgyan dang nor bu rnams dang ni/ /mtshon cha thams cad du ma ni/ /ras ris mdun du bzhag nas ni/ /dag byas cig car bzla 7bya ba/ /'bum phrag ——570

brgyad kyis g.yo ba dang / /thams cad bcas te 'bar ba dang / /zlos pa reg pas gyen du 'gro/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs ldan pa/ /sems can rang bzhin yin yang rung / /rgyan dang mtshon cha yin yang rung / /ngo bo nyid dam sa rang bzhin/ /rang tshul spyod dam bcos ma dang / /'dab ⑨chags sna tshogs tshogs kyang rung / /gang dag 'byung po kun la grags/ /bcos ma'am bcos ma ma yin pa②/ /'du shes can nam 'du shes med/ /sngags pa mchod pas grub gyepar 'gyur/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rdzas bzhag dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs khams las byung ④/ /rang byas byed du bcug pa dang / /'gro ba'i skye duganas dag na bsngags/ /sngar bstan cho ga bzhin du ni/ /ras ris mdun du rnam par gzhag /lan 4)ni drug gam bdun dag gis/ /sngags pas reg nas ⑦bzla bar bya/ /bzlas mthar de dag rab 'bar te/ /grub pa rgyas pa thob par 'gyur / /de ni de la reg tsam gyis/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni lha yul thob nas ni/ /ring du 'tsho zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po rig rgyal la/ /ji lta ji ltar rab sbyor ba/ /de lta de ltar dga' 'gyur zhing / /rtag tu mchog kyang ster bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang las la rab sbyor ba//las rnams dus ni yun ring ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /de nyid kyis ni myur 'grub 'gyur/ /gtsang zhing sems ni gtsang ba dang / /gtsang ba'i las la rtag tu dga'/ /gtsang ba'i phyogs dang sngags shes pa/ /gtsang ba'i grub pa thob par 'gyur/ /las gang byed pa de 'bras thob/ /mchog gi mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / /'bring gi las kyi (mi'abring du 'gyur/ /tha mas 5dkyang ni tha mar ro/ /ma bsgrubs las kyis 7grub pa yang / /cung zad tsam gyis 'bras ——571

'byin te/ /bu mo'am nor ni mang po dag /yang dag spyod pas byed par 'gyur / /rtag tu bzlas pa tsam gyis ni/ /longs spyod che zhing stobs kyang che/ /rgyal po dga' zhing blon po nyid/ /rtag tu bzlas pas byed par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi rgyal po lan cig bzlas/ /de yis 6)sdig pa rab tu 'jig /gnyis su bzlas sam ②bdun bzlas pas/ /bdag nyid srung ba chen por 'gyur/ /lan brgyad de ni bzlas pa yis/ /grogs po thams cad srung bar byed/ /gos la lan gnyis mngon bsngags ①na/ /sngags pa dag ni rtag tu yang / /nad rnams kun las shin tu grol/ /gos ni gnyis ka ④la bsngags ⑤nasayi/ /gos dag la ni reg byas na/ /lus can nad ni med par 'gyur/ /gdong dang mig gnyis dag la ni/ /'bad pas mngon par rab bsngags skyon/ /khros pa rnams kyi khro ba ni/ /sngags pas bltas pa tsam gyis 'jig /gang yang 'byung tshogs ma rungs pa/ /'tshe byed sdig pa'i las can la/ /sngags rgyal sum cu rab bzlas te / /de dag gdong la blta ba 'am/ /rang lag nyid la yang dang yang / /mngon par bsngags (8)pa byas nas ni/ /de dag thal mo brdabs na ni/ /lus can kun ni grol bar 'gyur/ /byis pa la ni rtag bya ba/ /khrus dang bza' dang btung ba la/ /sngags mchog drug cu bzlas nas ni/ /lha yi dam pa mchod byas na(she) / /sha za ma mo dag gi gdon/ /ma rungs kun las grol bar 'gyur/ byu /sngags kyi 'jigs (7pas 'jigs byed cing / /rtag tu byis pa gtong bar byed/ /de ltar rnam pa du ma'i las/ /sa steng myur du rtag 'jig (men/ /mi rnams la ni de bzhin byed/ /gang dag 'byung po sdig sbrul ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gnas 'gro 3 ba/ /dug bcas dug ni med pa nyid/ /sngags kyi mthu yis 'jig par ——572

byed / /gang dag sdug bsngal sna tshogs dang / /gang dag 'tshe ①ba thams cad ni / /sngags kyi rgyal po bzlas pa yis/ /myur du zhi bar rab tu 'gro/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gnod ②sdug bsngal/ /mang po 'chi ba 'go ba'i nad/ /sngags kyi rgyal po drug brgya bzlas/ /myur ba nyid du sel dubar 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg las ni bya ba la/ /zho dang mar gyis thams cad bsre/ /ut+pal sngon po godri bzang ni/ /rtsa brgyad stong gis bzlas 0pa bya/ /zhi zhing 'byung po rnam ⑥song nas/ / 'gro ba ⑦rnams ni bde gnas thob/ /de ltar rnam pa du ma ni/ /mang po'i las ni yang (shedag 'byung / /sngags pa legs par rab sbyor na/ /myur du thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis byed pa ni/ /dgra rnams kyi ni khro ba sel / /sngags 'di don dang 6)ldan gyur pas7/ /cho ga mang po rgya che ba/ /de dag cho ga mthong ba yisayi/ /de dag 'dir ni grub pa yin/ /'dir ni sngags rnams zlo 8byed pa/ /phran tshegs las kyang don yod 'gyur/ /thams cad la yang ⑩bzlas pa yis/ /myur du don rnams rtag tu byed/ /'byung po rnams ni dbang byed 'dod/ /dus gsum du ni bzlas pa yin/ /rtag tu sna ma'i me tog gis / /sbyin 8srog las kyang bya ba yin/ /tsan+dan dkar dang ga pur dang / /gur gum gyis kyang bya ba yin/ /bzlas nas sngags pa mchog sbyin zhing / /rtag tu 'bras bcas byed par 'gyur/ /rtag tu zlos pas sbyin sreg byasatso/ /yid la 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed/ /ga pur la sogs ldan pa yis/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg rab tu brtagatso /ji ltar 'dod par yongs brtags tu pa'i/ /rnam pa sna tshogs cho ga bsgrubatunye/ /tha ma las ni tha ma dang / /chen po las ni chen po 'byung / /bar ma bar ma'i las dag las/ /rtag tu grub par bstan pa yin/ /——573

de bas las rnams kun la ni/ /khyad par du ni sbyin sreg bya/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga las/ le'u bcu bzhi pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i ras ris kyi cho ga'i 6)dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs rab 'byam rdzogs sophyi// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje 'khor gyi nang der 'dus shing 'khod par gyur te②/ 'dug pa de stan las langs nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la ④'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /legs par rab tu bstan pa dang / mchog tu legs par gsungs pa'i rig pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi sbyor ba/ chos chen po'i sprin las nges par byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po/ rig pa chen po'i rgyal po 95'khor los sgyur (67ba/ cho ga chen po rgya che ba don thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa sgrub par byed pa/ byang chub kyi lam bla na med pa/ bya ba'i bye brag yang dag par sdom pa dang bzlas pa dang sbyin sreg dang / rig pa dang spyod pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams 99)kyi lam 'bras bu brten tsho pa'i las kyi rkyen skyed (9pa'i rgyu dang mtshan ma/ rmad du byung ba'i stobs bcu / nod par r+sha/byed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ byang chub kyi snying po nod (nyapar byed cing / nges par pha rol du 'gro bar byed pa de bcom ldan 'das de ni legs so/ /sngags sgrub par byed pa dang / rjes su mthun yi pa'i rmi lam na mthong bar byed pa'i mtshan ma de ston pas bshad du gsol/ gang gis rig pa ——574

thams cad sgrub pa'i rjes su dpyod ①pa'i sems can grub pa'i mtshan ma'i las rtsom par byed par 'gyur ba dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rig pa thams cad kyi mtshan mar 'gyur ba'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gnod sbyin gyi bdag po khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo mang po la bde ba dang 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i don dang phan pa dang bde ba dang ②rig pa thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i sems can rnams ③kyi don gyi phyir legs so legs so/ /de legs par rab tu nyon la zung ④shig dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /dang por (gere zhig las thams cad kyi sngar 'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas su song ste/ ri'i 4)rtse'am chu bo'i 'gram mam ⑦phug gi nang ngam gtsang (nyeba'i phyogs su lo ma'i spyil po byas la/ de nyid kyi cho ga snga ma bzhin du ras ris gzhag cing mchod pa chen po byas la/ las thams cad la yonyeyar ngo'i zla yiphyed dam/ cho 'phrul chen po'i zla (1phyed la nges par nyin 8zhag bzang po'i mtshan mo'i yinathun dang 8po la/ tsan+dan dkar po dang gur gum dang ga pur gcig tu byas la/ tsan+dan gyi shing gis 8me rab tu sbar zhing / ras ris kyi mdun du khru bzhi'i tshad tsam gyi 8me thab la du ba dang sol ba med pa'i me la sreg blugs stong rtsa brgyad kyis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas yang sbyin sreg gi mthar pad+ma'i me tog tsan+dan dkar po'i chus bsang yi gtor byas pa /shestong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi mthar yang bzang po'i gdan dang gdong bkab la rang gi lha la rang gi yi/sngags kyis ru )spyan drang bar bya zhing / sngags 'dis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /na maḥsarba bud dhā dzā(spe/ a pra ti ha ta shā ( ges nā māṃ/——575

tar+ya thā/ oṃ ku mā ra rū 0)pi ṇi dar+sha ya dar+sha ya/ ād+ma no bhu mi musnro ba swa ②sdi me ni be da ya wā ཿbhu haṃ/ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'dis sung ba byas shing sbyin sreg gi las thams cad la las bya'o/ /de nas ku sha'i rtse mo gnyis ka ④phyi rol du bstan te bting la ku sha'i khres kyi sngas (nyebyas te mgo shar phyogs su bstan ⑥la ras ris kyi mdun nas ha cang yang mi ring ha cang yang mi nye bar nyal bar bya'o / /thun dang po la mi nyal ba'i (7)sbyor bas rjes su brtson par byas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag byas nas sdig pa rnams so sor bshags te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la bdag nyid phul la/ de nas ji ltar bde bar gnyid (7kyi dbang du 'gro bar bya'o/ /dang po'i thun gyi rmi lam gang / /bad kun las byung shes par bya/ /gnyis par gang byung mkhris pa ste/ /'jig rten la yod smad pa yin/ /gsum pa rlung byung shes par bya/ /bzhi pa bden par 'byung lho1ba yin/ /bad kun rmi lam dang po ni/ /'di 'drar 7rtag tu mthong ba yin/ /nor bu shel gyi khang pa ni/ /kun nas mu tig phreng ba can/ /a mra'i 37shing tshogs rab mang po/ /bdag nyid chu nang 'bying bar mthong /kun nas 'bab chus khyab pa dang / /rgya mtsho chen pos (nyakhyab pa dang / /gang du bdag gi lus gnas pa/ /de nyid du ni mthong bar byed/ /gang du phyogs der rdzing dag gis/ /kun nas yongs su khyab pa dang / /gru dang chu ni 'thung ba dang / /btung 1rtaba'i khang pa khang pa dang / /kun nas yongs su 'khor bar ni//chu chen gyis ni khyer 'bar mthong / /kha ba can ni byis pa dang / /chu bo chen por shel gnas pa/ /shing dang ri yi rgyal po dang / /shel gyis yongs su bcings pa dang / /mu tig dra bas legs g.yogs dang / /mu tig phung po ——576

mthong ba dang / /char chen 'bab dang 0)chu yi tshogs/ /mthong na bad kun las gyur yin/ /gdugs ni dkar po dag dang ni/ /rgyan rnams kun kyang dkar ba dang / /ban 0glang dag ni dkar po'i gzugs/ /bad kun rmi lam dag tu brjod/ /rnga ①ma dkar ram skyes bu 'am/ /yang na gos dag ④mthong ba 'amal/ /lan tshwa la sogs reg pa ni/ /kun du gal ⑤te mthong ba ni/ /ras bal btso ma'i gos dag gam/ /ra gan dngul dang a ga ru/ /reg dang za bar byed pa nyid/ /bad kun mi lam dag tu 'dod/ /mon sran gre'u za ba dang / /til btags bu ram 'bras can 6)dang / /mon gsun rnam mang za ba ni/ /bad kun rmi lam dag tu 'dod/ / swa sti ka chadang u lo piṇi/ /kri sa ra dang 'o thug dang / /de dag za byed rmi lam ni/ /bad kun rmi lam bya ba yin/ /'breng bu sa bcud bza' ba 7sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs snum khur ni/ /reg dang za bar byed pa nyid/ /bad kun 'phel ba'i rmi lam yin/ /snum khur rnam pa du ma ni / /bza' dang spyad par rjes 'dod dang / /zos dang reg par byed de dag /bad kun rmi lam shes par bya/ /gnas dang gnas mal theg pa dang / /bzhon (stepa sems can las byung ba/ /reg dang 'dzeg dzinyepar byed pa nyid/ /dang po'i thun la mthong ba nyid/ /gal te rmi lam mthong tu gyur na/ /thams cad bad kun can du brjod/ /rnam pa de lta'i rmi lam dang / /chu la 'byung dang spyod pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs bza' la spyod/ /mthong na bad kun can du brjod/ /de dag rmi lam dag tu mthong / /bad kun can gyi spyod pa yin/ /rmi lam ma lus du ma ni/ /'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pa yin/ /gnyis pa'i thun la lus can gyi/ /rmi lam mkhris skipa can gyi yin/ /'bar ba'i me yi gzugs 88—577

mthong dang 6)/ /sna tshogs rin chen mthong ba dang / /mes tshig skar mda' ltung ba dang / /ri dang phyogs ni rab 'bar ba/ /skye bo gang gis rab mthong ba / /de ni mkhris par gyur pa yin/ /rin chen pad+ma rā ga dang / /gzhan yang rin chen gang yin pa/ /gang du rmi lam mthong na ni/ /lus can mkhris pa las gyur yin/ /me dang tsha ba sten (7pa dang / /reg dang za bar byed pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs kha dog ser/ /rmi lam mkhris pas brgyal ba yin/ /rtag tu tsha ba'i nyi ma dang / /nyi ma rtag tu 'de (7bar ni/ /gang gis rmi lam mthong gyur na/ /lus can mkhris pa las gyur yin/ /nam mkha' gser gyi mdog gyur dang / /sa yi steng ni kha dog ser/ /rmi lam na ni gang gis mthong / /mkhris pa las gyur na (geb yin/ /me ni kun nas 'bar ba yis/ /nam mkha'i ngos nas (gerab gsal bar/ /rmi lam dus su mthong ba ni/ /mkhris pas gnod pa'i lus can yin/ /sa dang de bzhin ri bo dang / /brag ni mthon po'ang gser gyi mdog /shing chen de bzhin theg pa ni/ /rtag tu thams cad gser rang bzhin/ /rtag tu rmi lam gnas mthong na/ /mkhris pa las gyur rmi lam yin / /theg pa rgyan dang bzhon (phyi pa dang / /snod rnams gser gyi rang bzhin dang / /stan rnams dang ni gnas mal rnams/ /sa le sbram gyi rang bzhin la/ /reg dang 'gro bar byed pa nyid/ /rmi lam mthong na mkhris gyur yin/ /phreng ba ser po thogs pa dang / /ser po'i gos kyis (7)nyer mdzes dang / /ser po'i 'od dang dri yis byugs(8/ /ser po'i (9)mchod phyir thogs pa dang / /bdag nyid ser po'i rnam pa dang 7/ /gang gis rmi lam la mthong ba/ /gnyis pa'i thun du mthong na ni/ /mkhris pa las gyur shes par bya/ /de bzhin rnam pa sna ——578

—tshogs pa'abye/ /gang gzhan ②mi lam dag tu brjod/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ser por snang / /rmi lam mkhris las yang dag byung / /mkhris pas lus can rab gnon pal/ /sanyis pa'i thun la bstan ①pa yin/ /rnam pa du ma'i gzugs can ni/ /ser por stisnang ba yang dag 'byung / /'jig rten gtso bos gsungs pa ni/ /rmi lam mkhris las yang dag byung / /gang yang rlung byung rmi lam ni/ /gsum pa'i thun du bstan pa yin/ /'khor (geyug tu ni 'od 'phro ba/ /phyogs rnams kun du rab tu snang / /nam mkha' la ni 'gro ba dang (9)/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thad drang ⑦'gro/ /bar snang nam mkha'i dkyil du ni/ /kun nas 'khor bar zhu)rtag tu 'gro/ /rlung byung rmi lam zhes bstan pa/ /'di lta bu la bya ba yin6)/ /rgal dang mchong dang de bzhin du/ /shing rnams la ni mngon par 'dzeg /bstan bcos ma lus 'don pa dang / /khyad par du ni sngags rnams dang / /bshad dang brjod tipar byed pa dgatuskye /phal cher yang ni rlung las gyur/ /shing rnams tsher ma can 'dzeg dang / /'o kha ba dag kyang za ba dang / /bza' ba ma lus tsha 4)dang skyur/ /zos pa rlung las gyur pa yin/ /gtsor yang rlung ni yang dag 'byung / /shing thog rlung 7ni rab bskyed 8pa/ /de dag za bar rmi lam mthong / /rlung las byung bar 9yang dag bstan/ /dngos rnams rlung ni skyed pa yi/ /bza' dang bca' ba khyad par ldan/ /de bzhin skye bo sems 'khrugs dang / /reg par byed dang smra bar byed/ /'byung po rnams ni gar byed dang / /bdag nyid kyang zha ni gar byed pa/ /gang gis rmi lam mthong na ni//de 'dra rlung nad can du shes/ /rnam pa sna tshogs spyod tsho pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs 'khyud nyunyedang smra/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mi bzad gzugs/ /rmi lam rlung 88—579

nad can gyis mthong / /de la sogs pa'i mi lam ni/ /'jig rten mchog gis —gsungs pa yin/ /rnam gsum sbyor ba rab ldan pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug yin/ /chags can bad kun can shes ①bya/ /zhe sdang las byung ②mkhris pa can/ /rmongs pa rlung las gyur pa yin/ /'dres pa'ang ③rnam par 'dres pa'o/ /grong gi chos ni mthong ba las/ /rmi lam chags pas sa bon byung ④/ /der ni bud med la chags pa/ /bad kun las byung rmi lam yin/ /rtsod bcas dang tshul zhe sdang can/ /mkhris pa las byung rmi lam yin/ /ma rig las byung rmongs rnam pa(snye/ /dran pa nyams par mthong ba yin/ /rnam 'dres ⑥rnam par 'dres pa ni/ /rmi lam na ni rtag tu mthong / /de bas rnam pa thams cad kyis/ /rmi lam zhes bya yod pa spangs/ /bya ba dus kyi rim pa nyid/ /de nyid gzigs pas bstan pa yin/ /sems can bad kun can gsungs pa/ /mdog ldan snyan par smra ba dang / /tshe ring yid ni gzhungs pa dang / /kha dog snum zhing 'jigs pa med/ /bong tshod ring zhing dkar ba dang / /bud med la phrad rtag tu dga'/ /chos ldan rtag tu dpa' ba dang / /btung ba mang la rtag tu dga'/ /rgyal rigs su ni bstan pa yin/ /ser sna ldan zhing mtshon pa med//de bzhin sa yi bdag po dang / /dmag dpon don du gnas pa ste/ /longs spyod chen po skye 'gyur zhing / /rang gi las kyis gnye bar 'tshe/ /rang gi las 'bras bstan pa ni/ /las kyi sngags ni spang ba min/ /las min sngags ni gtso bo zhes/ / 'jig rten (8)'dren pas gsungs pa yin/ /de bas sems can bad kun can/ /sa steng grub pa byed pa ni5)/ /sa bdag 'dod pa byed pa la0/ /de la grub pa thob par 'gyur/ /zlos pas bad kun can gyi zas/ /ma lus ——580

bsten par mi bya'o/ /gang phyir shin tu bsten ①gyur na/ /rmi lam don gyis stong 'gyur bas/ /grub pa'i don du ma brjod pas/ /sngags pas de tshe de mi bsten / /mkhas pa rigs ②pa ldan pa yis/ /de yi dus su gnyid log min/ /mkhris pa can gyi gsems can gyi/ /rtag tu spyod pa brjod par bya/ /zhe sdang gis ni rnam 'khrugs na/ /kha dog nag dang stobs chung dang / / drag pa ④drag pa'i las dang ni/ /rtag tu yon por byed pa yin/ /dpa' dang bab col ⑤rtag tu byed/ /stobs dang blo dang ldan pa dang / /mang du smra zhing grogs po mang ⑥/ /bstan bcos ting 'dzin mang po rtogs/ /chos ldan las kyi mtha' brtan zhing ⑦/ /zhe sdang slong ba rjod par byed/ /yid ldan dgra ni mang ba dang ske/ /zhe sdang mtshon pa skye bar 'gyur/ /nor mang dpa' bo la sdang dang / /'jig rten shes shing mthong na dga'/ /des grol chags pa med pa dang / / brtan cing (misdug bsngal rtag tu bzod/ /nga rgyal phrag dog ma rungs pa6)/ /bud med rnams la dga' bar byed/ /spro chen brtan yidang blon po dang / /longs spyod chen por skye bar 'gyur/ /shes bzhin las kyis tunyenyer spyod pa'i/ /sems can zil gyis mnan nas spyod/ /sngags ni srog la gnod byed pa/ /de ni de la myur 'grub 8'gyur/ /mi bzad thub pas spangs pa'i don/ /myur du sgrub par byed pa yin/ /sems can gnod phyir byed pa'i las/ /lus can de la grub par 'gyur/ /cho ga sbyar ba'i chos rnams gang / /sngags pas thams cad rab sbyar na/ /spyod pa des ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /gzhan las sems can de la 5nyemin/ /sngags pa zhe sdang can dag la/ /sems can gzhan la gnod pa dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyi sngags gcod pa/ /sems can khro ba la grub 'gyur//——581

gzhan gyi 0)rdzas ni 'phrog don ②dang / /gzhan gyi srog ni gcod pa la/ /khro ba'i ①sngags kyis grub 'gyur te/ /sngags gzhan dag la sbyar mi bya/ /zhe sdang rigs kyi ④sems can 'di/ /bdag po nyid kyang byed par 'gyur/ /mdog nag pa 'am sngo bsangs sam/ /dkar ba'am yang na 'dres pa yi/ /mi ni khro ldan gser gyi mdog /rnam par spangs pa skye bar 'gyur/ /mi ni rtsub (snyemadog du ba'i mdog /ser skya'i mdog tu'ang skye ba yin/ /dpa' dang de bzhin drag pa dang / /'dab chags (0sdig pa'i khyim las skyes/ /gza' ⑦ni mig dmar zhing bdag gnas/ /bad kun can la phur bu'i bdag /skye 'gyur nyung ngu za ba dang / /tsha dang skyur ba'i ro bsten (7cing / /de yi tshe ni ring 'gyur zhing / /dran dang ldan pa skye bar 'gyur/ /spyod pa dang ni rjes spyod pa/ /rlung nad can gyi bshad par bya/ /mdog mi sdug dang rtsub mdog dang / /bong tshod med cing shin tu rjud/ /blo nyams shes rab med pa dang / /mi brtan (1)gnas pa med pa dang / /lus ni 'gul dang 'khor ba dang / /skyug cing bshang gci mang du 'byung ske/ /mang du za zhing rtag par za/ /de dag gang phyir nad mang 'gyur/ /'jig rten rigs ⑩dang mi mthun zhing / /dgra ni mang po skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni sa steng 'di dag tu/ /tshul 'chal sdug bsngal skye 'gyur te/ /mi snang ba yi sngags dag ni/ /de la 'grub par bstan pa yin/ /gang zhig rlung nad 'khrug byed pa'i/ /zas la de ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /zlos pa las ni grub 'dod pas//de ni yongs su bsten mi bya/ /sems can rlung nad 'khrug pa la/ /gti mug nye bar zhi ba dang / /rmongs pa'i rigs can la gsungs pa/ /rmongs pa'i sngags ni rab sgrub pa/ /rtag tu de dag rmongs pa la/ /rmongs pa dag ni 'grub 61par 88—582

'dod / /rgyu skar khyim ni chu skyes dang / /gza' 6)ni bdag po spen par blta / /rlung nad skyes pa'i sems can ni/ /dge ba'i las la mi spyod de/ /'byung po dbang dang 'gugs ①par byed/ /de bzhin rmongs dang rengs ④pa'o/ /rlung nad ⑤can gyi sems can la/ /gti mug can de sdig pa ⑨byed/ /rmi lam bden par mthong ba ni/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag gsungs pa ni/ /sems can rnams kyi don sgrub pa/ /thub pa rnams kyi 6)sngon gsungs pa'o/ /lug glang (gyidang ni sbyor ba dang / /sbal pa seng ge nyid dang ni/ /srang po)dang bu mo sdig pa dang / /de bzhin gzhu dang chu srin dang / /bum pa nya dang glang po dang / /lha dang spre'u lha ma yin/ /grub dang dri za gnod sbyin sogs/ /mi rnams gang gis rab bsgrags pa7/ /sems can rnams kyi khyim mang po/ /gang zag mchog gis gsungs pa yin/ /rnam pa mang po sna tshogs don/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las bstan pa/ /de dag las ni thams cad la/ /yon tan rgya cher sman yi nyepar 'gyur / /las las gol ba (rtemed par ni/ /lus can yon tan mi smin te/ /yon tan kho na las ldan pas/ /skye bar yang ni byed pa yin/ /yon tan chos don ldan pa ni/ /sngags la 'grub dzinapa skye bar 'gyur/ /zlos pa sems can yon tan shes/ /yon tan yon tan min las 'ching tu )/ /yon tan med la bya min gang / /de yi las ni bya ba min/ /gang phyir bya ba las byed de/ /bya ba yon tan med ma tsoyin/ /bya ba las dang yon tan nyid/ /yang dag ldan pa sgrub par 'gyur/ /cho ga sngon 'gro bya ba'i las/ /stobs bcu ldan pas sngon bstan to/ /rdzas dang sems can spyod pa gzhan/ /bya ba las dang yon tan yin / /rnam pa sna tshogs rmi lam tshul/ /las las 'byung bar snang ba yin/ /——583

de ①bas rmi lam mtshan ma yis/ /rgya che las la rab sbyar bya/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa dang / /yid 'ong blta phyin sdug pa dang / /bgegs kyi gzugs dang gzugs med pa/ /rmi lam rgyur ②ni snang ba yin/ /mthu che spro ba che ba ni/ /mi ni grub pa 'dod pa yin/ /mchog dang tha ma 'bring dag ni/ /de dag la ni grub par brtag /drag cing ma rungs las rnams ④ni/ /rmi lam rtag tu 'phral du smin(nya/ /bzang po brtan (7pa'i las dag ni/ /yun ring dus su grub phyir rol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das rnams kyisasti/ /yon tan skye bar ⑧yang dag 'byung / /rmi lam rnam pa sna tshogs snang / /zlos pas po)sngags rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /mi 'grub don du sngags rnams ni/ /gnyid dang snyom ⑩pa rab tu brtag /bgegs 'joms byed pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /de yi dus su rab tu brtag /de tshe sngags ni rigs tshul gyis/ /zlos pas de tshe rab tu sbyar//khro bo chen po phyag drug dang / /zhal drug nyid du brtag par bya/ /sngags chen yi ge bzhi pa ni/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs la gnas pa yin/ /drag po'i tunyagazugs ni gzugs chen po/ /phag gi rnam par yang dag 'byung / /bgegs kun rnam par gzhig bya'i phyir/ /dus mtshan de ni lha yi 7rgyal/ /stag gi pags tu pa'i sham thabs can/ /sbrul gyi cigadengs ka rnam par 'phyang / /lag na ral gri sems dpa' che/ /gzi brjid chen po gshin rje'i gzugs/ /bgegs rnams kun la gtse bar 7byed/ /log 'dren rnams kyi srog 'phrog byed/ /'byung po kun ni rab nyon cig /mi bzad sngags ni bshad par bya/ / cho 'phrul chen po bgegs rnams kun/ /⑩ma rungs yonyesems can 'jig par tunyebyed/ /sngags rnams kun ni sgrub byed pa/ / lha yi 67tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /na maḥs man+ta ——584

bud dhā ①rna/ a lapra ti ha ta shā dus nā māṃ/ tar+ya thā/ he he ma hā kro dha ṣa ṇa mu 'ji 0tsa ra ṇa/ sarba bigha na bibhā na bhā ⑤te ka hūm̐ ju/ kyi: spyir ya si bi nā ya ④ka dzī bi tān+ta ⑧ka ra duḥswasna me nā yo)sha ya/ la dhihu la hu sa ma ya ma nu sma ra phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ khro bo'i rgyal po chen pos 'di gsungs ma thag tu bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'jigs shing nyam thag nas/ snying gas te yid shin tu skrag nas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal bar byed cing dam tshig la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas (7thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye kye lha'i tshogs chen po dag khro bo'i rgyal po 'di ni/ 'jig rten dang tso'ajig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi sngags rnams 'don par byed pa na gang zhig ma rungs pa'i sems can gyi gzugs can gyis rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa de la/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'dis ni rigs rgyud thams cad 'dul bar byed cing / srog kyang 'dzin par mi byed de/ yongs su gdung bar byed cing /yongs su skem par byed pa'i rnam par gzhag par bya ba la tunye'ajog par byed cing / zlos pa dag la yang srung ba dang sba ba dang sbed pa la gnas par tso'ajog par byed cing / rjes su 'phel bar byed pa dang gang zhig dam tshig 'di las 'da' bar byed pa dang khro bo'i rgyal pos sgrub pa po sung bar 'byas pa la rnam par tho 'tsham 9par byed na/ mgo bo a rdza ku'i dog pa bzhin du rnam pa bdun du 'gas par cha'agyur ro/ /thub pa mchog gis de (/shegasungs nas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs yi/la de tshe gsungs/ /gzhon nu khyod kyi sngags rnams la/ /ma lus ——585

don ni rgya chen don/ /sngags rgyud don dang ldan pa dang / /sgrub pa rnams la khyad par du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms pa yi/ /rgyud la khro rgyal bstan pa yin/ /'jig rten mgon gyis sngon 'di ni/ /de bzhin du ni yang dag sbyar//ma lus bgegs rnams 'jig bya'i phyir/ /dgra rnams kyi ①ni khro ba sel/ /zlos pas rtag tu 'don byas na②/ /sems can rnams ni srung don dang / /rmi lam ngan pa sel bar byed/ /sngags rnams cham lus sgrub pa la/ /'jig rten mchog gis gsungs pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /skyes ④bu'i mtshan nyid bzang po yin/ /gang la sngags rnams 'grub ⑤'gyur ba/ /mchog dang tha ma bar ma'o/ /gzi brjid ldan dang shes ldan dang / /gser mdog gsus pa che ba dang / /dkyus ring mig dang snum pa dang / /chags chung khro ba rnam par spangs / /mig mtha' (6)dmar zhing snyan ⑦par smra/ /de la grub pa mchog tu 'gyur / /pags (nyepa srab po)cing sngo bsangs mdog /ha cang ring min yan lag phral/ /spro ⑩ba che zhing gzi brjid che/ /chog shes kun nas dge ba byed/ /skye ⑩gnas bzang po dag pa dang / /'dod pa chung zhing cung zad dge/ /las rnams kun du 7snang ba ni/ /de la nges par grub ()pa mchog /yan lag thams cad ma tshang med/ /drur chab sngo sangs 'gazi brjid che/ /nyon mongs med ⑩sems shes pa can/ /rtag tu gtsang zhing tshangs par spyod/ /phra ba'i gos la rtag tu dga'/ /chos kyi ngang tshul 'jig rten shes/ /grogs mang rtag tu gtong ba dang / /zas tshod rig dag rtag gtsang ldan/ / shes nyen 4)tshul khrims spyod pa dang / /gtsang ba'i spyod la rtag tu dga'/ /bden par ⑩smra zhing snying rje can/ /de la grub pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /yon tan rgya che yan lag ——586

tshang ske/ /rigs ldan rtag tu chos dang ldan/ / ma dang pha 6)la gus pa dang / /bram ze la ni mchod pa byed/ /shin tu snying rje ldan zhing brtan②/ /de la'ang grub pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /sngo sangs ①dkar dudang snum pa dang / /rtag tu gtsang zhing nyung ngu smra/ /bsod ⑤pa'i kha zas la dga' zhing / /gtsang ba'i spyod pas mngon par 'gro/ /mang 'dod sems can 'jig rten shisaX/ /de la'ang grub pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /ha cang mi thung ring ⑦ba'ang min/ /sku ni mig sman bzhin du gnag⑧ /mig dang mig 'bras rab tu snum/ /gtsang zhing rtag tu khrus la dga'/ /dkon mchog gsum la shin tu dad/ /de yi grub pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /mchog gi las ni rab ston cing / /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa shes/ /bzod ldan snyan par smra ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras la rab tu dga' / /de tshe 'jig rten 'das pa grub/ /de la 6)'bras bcas 0grub par 'gyur / /sems dpa' che zhing brtson 'grus che/ /gzi brjid che zhing brtul zhugs tunyeche/ /longs spyod che zhing sngags rnams shes/ /sngags rnams kun la de nyid rig /rigs kyi mchog ni rgyal rigs sam/ /bram ze shes dang ldan pa dang / /bud med la brten 7/rnyede la chags/ /de bzhin gser gyi mdog dang ldan / /bong tshod che zhing dkar ba dang / /sna ni mtho zhing lag pa che/ /dpa' zhing lag pa ring ba dang / /rgyal po che la mngon par 'dod/ /rgyal ba'i sras la dad pa dang / /bud med mig / ldan lha la mchod/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus pa dang / /byang chub sems kyis brgyan rdzipa yin/ /lhag par snying rje brtan pa dang / /cung zad khro zhing cung zad rmongs/ /longs spyod che zhing gtong ba che/ /gzi brjid che zhing thul bar dka'/ /bud med rnams ni 88—587

dga' dang ①dpa'/ /de yi grub pa'ang mchog yin no/ /shin tu btung dang dga' dang ②dpa'/ /rtag tu bud med la chags dang / /gser gyi mdog dang byin pa phra/ /rked pa che zhing gtsang ba dang / /brtse dang snying rje ldan mkhas pa/ /yon tan mang 'dod 'jig rten shes/ /rtag tu sngags rnams zlos ①la gus/ /rgyal ba la ni srog kyang gtong / /de bzhin nyan thos sras rnams dang / /bse ru la yang rtag tu gtong / /stobs ldan rtsi'ajig rten gtso bo dang / /rigs ni gnyis pa bzang po yin/ /yan lag thams cad ma tshang med/ /ma rungs rtag tu bab col ⑤byed/ /gtong ldan tshul ldan dgra las rgyal/ /chos dang chos min rnam dpyod byed/ /ha cang sbom min rjud ⑥pa'ang min/ /ha cang ring min thung ba'ang min/ /bar ma'i mi ni mchog yin te/ /de yi grub pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /sen mo zangs lamadog legs snum dang / /lag mthil dmar dang gtsang ba dang ske/ /rkang pa'i mtha' 6)dmar snum pa dang / /'khor lo swa sti gas brgyan 6)dang ske/ /rgyal mtshan rta babs nya dang ni/ /ba dan pad+ma tho ba dang / /mi gang rkang pa lag pa la/ /mtshan ni 'di dag yod gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i skyes bu dam pa la/ /grub pa mchog tu brtag par bya/ /mche ba dkar zhing bzang ba dang / /mtho ba'i ri bo dang 'dra dang / /sna bzang mtho 7zhing mig dkyus ring / /smin ma stug 11cing kos ko (nyabazang / /ba yi rdzi ma 'jig rten mtshan/ /nag pa'i lta ba'i na mig 'bras mtshan/ /dpral ba'i dbyes gang rgya che zhing / /mgo bo gdugs 'dra'i rnam pa bzang / /mgo bo gtsug tor yi'adra ba dang / /rna ba bzang ba dam 7pa yin/ /rtag tu seng ge'i 'gram 'dra dang / /ma mchu bem pa skismin 'dra'i mdog /gang gi ( lce ni rab snang ba/ /pad+ma 'dab (nyam dmar ——588

'dra'i mdog /mgrin ①pa bum pa 'dra ba dang / /thal gong rgyas shing yang dag 'phags / /mchan khung ②thong ka bzang ba mchog /de bzhin brla ②ni rgya che dang —/ /lte ba'i phyogs kyang chung ba dang / /rked pa rgya che bzang ba dang / /lte ba zab cing g.yas su 'khyil/ /kun nas dkar med ba spu ④dang / /lag ring lag ni che ba dang / /rked pa seng ge 'dra ba'i mtshan/ /gang gi brla ni zlum pa dang / /gru mo ⑤nyams med zlum pa dang / /byin pa e na ⑥ya lta bur/ /zlum pa'i nang ni zlum por grub⑦/ /rkang pa sha dang ldan pa dang / /sor mo rnams kyi niring ba dang kyi)/ /dmar zhing sen dmar snum pa dang / /sha rgyas pas ni snum pa yin/ /nang stong ma yin mthil mnyam gnas/ /dge zhing mthong na dga' ba dang / /'jam zhing kha dog dag pa dang / /rab bsngags 'jig rten bkra shis dang / /de dag gi ni steng dag tu/ /rtsa yi dra ba mngon pa med/ / bshang ba ⑩'byung ba'i lam dag tu/ /ri mo zab (nyecing g.yas su 'khyil/ /mchig pa rab bsngags shin tu chud/ /rtag tu zlum ⑩zhing dge ba yin/ /ma 'brel dum bu ma yin dang / /gcig min nyid du bstan pa yin/ /gang tshe skyes dbang gtsang ba dang / /rtse mo dmar la yang dag gnas/ /skye bo nyal khar yi kha zas ni/ /ro ni rtsa skibar byed pa za/ / bshang ba 8kha dog sngo ba 'am/ /gal te dmar por tsorab snang zhing / /mang po ma yin snum pa dang / /dge ba'i mtshan gyi ⑩rab mtshan pa/ /de lta'i sems can gang yin pa/ /grub pa mchog tu 'dod pa yin/ /lan gsum bshang zhing sngags drug dran(she/ /gtsang sbra'i spyod dga' yongs su gtsang / /gang zhig thun ni tha mar yinyal/ /tho rangs ne )ldang ba'i skye bo rnams/ /de yi grub pa rtag tu mchog /las kun byed par snang 88—589

ba yin6)/ /'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /phun tshogs rnam pa mang po la /mi rnams rjes su 'dod pa yang / /mtshan nyid kyis ni mngon ②mtshan pa'o/ /rgyu skar dag ①la'ang skyes pa ni/ /rgyal dang nam gru gre dbo dang / /mchu dang lha mtshams ④dag dang ni/ /nag pa snar ma smin drug dang / /nus pa'i gza' rnams kyis mtshan pa/ /de dag la ni skyes mthong dang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char kha (5)ni/ /tho rangs (7dus ༅su gang skyes dang / /gang tshe de yi dus su skyes / /de la grub pa rab tu snang / /nyin phyed dang ni tho rangs (snyedang / /nyi ma'i mthar yang gza' bzang po/ /dkar ba zla ba pa wa dzinosangs ser ba gza' 7lhag phur bu yin/ /skye bo rnams kyis mthong na ni/ /'bras bu 'grub (nyaphyir nus pa yin/ /mi ni gang zhig dge las kyis/ /'di la skyes par gyur tu)pa yi / /sngags don ma lus sgrub 1)pa la/ /de dag 'bad med 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi ma phyed ni 'das pa dang / /rtag tu nyi ma nub pa na/ /lus can rnams kyi ⑫rtag de la/ /ma rungs 7gza' mthong gang yin pa/ /ma rungs nyi ma tsomig dmar dang / / mjug rings nyanasgra gcan spen pa dang / /gang yang gza' (3ni gtso bo dang / /las ni ngan 3)'joms skar mda' can/ /skar ma shin tu mi bzad ne )nyid/ /de bzhin nag po 'chi ltas dang / /dus min 'chi ba sa la ni/ /mi bzad de tshe snang ba yin/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /gza' nga nyalhag gis ni sa rnams mthong / /gnya' shing gang tsam nyi mas ne phyin/ /phur bus sa de mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nas pha rol gnya' ( steshing tsam/ /pa sangs nor spyan ( stegyis de mthong / /nyi ma phyed ni yongs rdzogs na/ /zla bas lus can ma lus mthong / /gza' 2 lhag dus su rgyal thabs thob/ /phur bus nor dang longs 88wa 590

spyod byed/ /pa sangs nor ni nges sgrub dang / /rgyal srid tshe dang longs spyod ldan / /zla ba de bzhin tshe ring zhing / /dbang phyug dang ni 'bras bu bcas/ /de bzhin nyin phyed nyi ma ni/ /nyi ma phyed du mnyam par mthong / /rtag tu nyin phyed rnam 'das na/ /nyi mas phyogs ni mthong bar byed/ /thung 'gyur ①nyi ma gnya' shing tsam/ /byed pa nyid du bstan pa ni/ /sgra gcan spen pa nyid dag yin / /mun pa dus dang dus mthar byed/ /de nas phar ni thung ba tshun/ /'chi ltas skar mda' sa 'gul byed/ /li khri nitshogs kyis mdog bsgyur ba'i/ /nyi ma nub kur zangs ma'i mdog /gza' ④yi gtso bo gang yin de/ /byis pa gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin cing / /lag na mdung thogs ma rungs pa/ /mig dmar nyid kyis mthong ba yin/ /de nas nyi ma gnya' shing 'das/ /dge ba'i gza' ⑤ni 'byung ba yinardziska/ /nyi mas mthong ba las skyes pa/ /ma rungs bab col byed par 'gyur/ /spen pa mig dmar las skyes pa/ /khro ldan skam (pezhing nga rgyal can/ /mjug rings 'chi ltas dud (nyarnams la/ /skyes pa nad ni yang dag 'byung / /dbul zhing nad btab glen pa dang / /de bzhin du ni rtag tu rmongs / /dus dang mun pa 'gul byed dang / /skar mda' can dang gza' ngan dang / /'gul byed sgra drag dmar ba'i mdog /gnam lcags nyid kyang rab rdung byed/ /de bzhin rdo rje 'chi ltas po)dang / /gzhan yang khyim sogs rab tu mthong / /skye bo kun gyis ⑩sgra gcan ni/ /mi bzad rab tu mthong gyur yin/ /dbul zhing mgon med tshul khrims 'chal/ /mi ni rtag tu sdig pa spyod / /mi ni sdug bsnga'/ skye 'gyur te/ /nad kyi yonagazhi ni skye bar 'gyur/ /mdze can nad ni mang ba dang / /long ba 'theng 4)bo shu bar bcas za ma ma ——591

ning mo sham dang / /bud med mtshan ni ngan pa dang / /skyes pa bud med de bzhin gzhan/ /gza' ①ni ngan pa mthong ba yin/ /de ltar skyes gyur skyes pa dang ②/ /'jig rten mang po skye ba yin/ /dkar dang ser ba'i gza' mchog ni / /de dag las skyes dge ba yin/ /mdog ni dkar dang ser ba dag /rgyal bas rab tu bsngags par gsungs/ /gza' ni gtso bo bzhir bshad pa/ /pa sangs zla ba bla ma lhag /zlos pa las rnams kun la ni/ /de dag mthong na 'grub ①pa'i don/ /sems can byis pa rnams la yang / /rtag tu de dag skye ba bzang / /lo ni kun la 'dod pa'ang ④zhes/ /'jig rten mchog gis gsungs pa yin/ /skad cig tsam la'ang (snyede bzhin du/ /mig 'byed mi 'dzum ⑥se gol gtogasaX / /'di ni mdor bsdus skye ba zhes/ /'jig rten mchog gis gsungs pa yin/ /'di tsam gyi ni tshad dag tu/ /gza' kun 'jig rten dgongs pa yin/ /de dag de bzhin rtag tu 'char/ /'di dag dus kyi de nyid yin / /'di dag dge dang sdig pa'i gza'/ /'khor lo bzhin du rtag tu 'khor / /'jig rten dge dang mi dge byed/ /de nyid 'jig rten gnas pa yin / /des na de dag gang cung zad/ /sdig pa'i blo yang skye bar 'gyur/ /sems can dge dang mi dge'i (nya'abras/ /mang po yang ni skye bar 'gyur/ /gza' rnams las la spyod pa zhes/ /des na 'di ni mthong zhes gsungs/ byu /myur ldan myur bcas 'od 'gyur (6)zhing / /myur bar 'ong bas myur ldan yin/ /mig gis 'omathong dang ma mthong ba'i/ /se gol gtogs 67pa'i myur 'gros yin/ /'di tsam gyi ni tshad dag tu/ /blo (nyamachog rnams kyis bstan pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /nges par yizlos pas rtag tu bya/ /yud tsam dag ——592

ni bcu gnyis dang / /dus dang dus min 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /grub 6)pa'i rgyu 'am ma yin pa/ /'gro ba ②min pa'ang bshad par bya/ /'jig rten la nye bzang ba dang ske/ /char dang char min yang dang yang / /yul 'khor 'jig dang mu ge dang ske/ /lo legs nyi ma gsal mthong dge/ /dus dang de bzhin dbang po'i gzhum/ /skye bo rnams la rtag zhi byed/ /mjug rings nis 'gul gnam grum ④dang / /skar mda' dang ni lho 'ur ⑤dang / /rgyu skar (nyagaza' dang skar rnams kyi / /spyod pa dge dang ⑦mi dge ba/ /'byung po rnams kyi spyod pa ni/ /dge dang mi dge'i ⑧spyod pa yin/ /sha za dang ni ma mo dang / /drag po ma rungs nyer 'joms byed/ /sha za rnams kyi spyod pa ni/ /de bzhin ma rungs sems can brjod/ /gang du lha la rab dad khyadang / /rin chen chos dang blo mchog dang / /dge ba'i las dang rtag tu ldan/ /byams kyisems brtse bar ldan pa dang / /legs par spyod pa'i don ldan blo/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag la sems / /sngags dang rig pa rnams kyis drangs/ /sman gyi don du kha zas spyod/ /gang du mtshan nyid la brten 47pas/ /spyod pa rgya cher bstan pa yin/ /gzhan gyi lus la gnas nas ni/ /mi lus brten nas gnas pa yin/ /lha ni mchod pa zhes bshad de/ /lha min nga rgyal can gyi tu rgyus/ /gnas der gnas pa'ang rnam pa gnyis/ /rim bzhin lha dang lha ma yin/ /de yang der ni rnam gnyis te/ /drag tu pa dang ni thun mong yin/ /de yang der ni rnam gnyis 'gro/ /dge dang mi dge 'gro ba lnga/ /der gnas rnam gsum 'gro ba ste/ /nyi shu sum cu grangs med pa'o/ /lha dbang dang ni 'og min par/ /go rims ji bzhin sa yimed pa'o / /'jig rten khams ni mtha' med pa/ /dge dang mi dge tso'ajig rten ——593

yin / /'khor spyod sems can ji snyed dang / /'phags pa nyan thos ji snyed dang / /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /de yi thugs las skyes sras dang ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che6)/ /sa bcu la ni rab gnas dang / /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyi/ /sems can skye gnas yang dag brten②ske/ /byis pa'i skye bo thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba'i skye gnas rten pa dang / /rtag tu 'phags rnams thams cad kyi/ /mtshan nyid dang ni spyod pa dang / /tshig dang brda ①dang de nyid kyang / /rgya cher rab tu bshad par bya/ /sngags dang rgyud ni rig ④bcas pas/ /'byung po kun ni dgug (9par bya/ /dbab dang dgug pa'i sngags shes pas/ /gzhan gyi lus la yang dag brtenayi/ /dge dang mi dge'i ⑦las shes zhing (kyi/ /bag yod rigs dzi)ni bzang ba dang / /mi blun spyod pa'i sems can dang / /tshar gcad kyirjes gzung spyod pa dang / /'jig rten sa steng 'gugs byed pa/ /mi ni sngags zlos byed pa dag /de dag grub pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /de nyid 7thams cad bshad par bya/ /mi rnams kyi ni mdor bsdu tunyan/ /de dag gi ni lus bzung nas/ /rtag tu shin tu chos don ()dang / /thar pa'i don du rnam par brtag /ma rungs rnams ni tshar gcad ⑫dang / /rnam dag rnams ni mchod pa ste/ /tshar gcad 8rjes gzung 7nyid la ni / /sngags dang rgyud ni rab tu brtag /rlung dang bad kun (nyamakhris can rna/ /rnam 1nyagasum dag la spyod pa'ang gsum/ /de dag zhi bar rab brtags ()la/ /rnam gsum nyid du rim par 'dod/ /mi rnams kyi ( )ni gso ba la/ /sngags dang rgyud kyis rtag tu bya/ /'byung ba chen por rnam brtags ( nyapa/ /'byung dang 'byung min la sogs shes/ /'byung ba min dang 'byung ba dang / /lhag par ——594

'byung ba de la ①brjod/ /skye bo gang tshe lhag 'byung zin/ /de tshe bde ba med par 'gyur/ /'byung dang 'byung min rnam pa ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su rab tu brtag /rtag tu sems can 'byung ba chel/ /sems can ma yin rab tu brtag /mkhris pa bad kun de bzhin rlung / /gang gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi dang ni/ /lnga pa dag ni nam mkhar ①brjod/ /chu dang me dang ldan pa dang / /sa dang rlung du yang dag ldan/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu yang / /sems can min pa'i grangs su bstan④/ /'jig rten mchog gi bdag po dang / /'od chen ldan pas gsungs pa yin/ /sems can ma yin grangs su bstan / /sems can grangs 'gro mi ma yin/ /blo mchog smra ba dam pa yis/ /mi rnams sems can nyid du gsungs/ /mi ma yin dang mi (5)dag kyang / /rtag tu sems can grangs nyid do/ /sems can rnams la dge don du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung yang yin/ /'das dang ma byon sangs rgyas dang / /de bzhin da ltar byung rnams kyis/ /dge ba'i las kyi las byung 4)phyir/ /las 'di dag ni yongs su gsungs( / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung (kyedag pa/ /las ni don med mi byed de/ /de yi rgyu mtshan rigs dang spyi/ /grub pa nyid du rab snang ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / /bde zhing zhi la rtag tu gtsang / /mthar thug dag dang bdag med dang / /don dam thar pa tsa)'dod pa ste7/ /de nyid chos ni btsal bya'i phyir/ /rgyud 'di yongs su bshad pa yin/ /rgyud dang sngags dang sman bzang po/1/ /bka' ni yang dag gsungs pa yin/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur da ltar gyi/ /bstan bcos thams cad legs bsngags ༷ dang / /'jig rten mchog dang chos bdag med/ /rtag tu zhi nyu dang shis miripa'i 88—595

gnas / /'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung ①/ /de yi go 'phang mchog gnas pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'byung / /ma 'dres rab tu brtags ②pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthu dang ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan dang / /sngags rnams kun gyi cho ga la/ /grub pa kun tu bstan pa yin/ /des na 'di nyid thub dbang gis/ /cho ga'i rgyal por gsungs pa yin / /lus can rnams ni (bsngags tshul gyi/ /'di nyid kyi ni lam gyis 'gro/ /zhi ba nad med phun sum tshogs/ /mya ngan 'das grong phyin par 'gyur/ /mya ngan med dang rdul med dang / /rtag tu byang chub gzhol zhing shis④/ /gang 'di bstan pa dag la ni/ /sngags kun 'don par byed pa na/ /kun mkhyen shes dang shes bya yi/ /las kyi rgyud (mini 'brel pa dang / /sngags zlos pa yi ched du ni/ /rgyud yirnams mtha' dag sa steng nyagasungs/ /sngags rgyud ma lus don dag ni/ /byang chub rnam gsum gzhol ba ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes dag /cho ga 'dir ni rab tu bstan/ /sems can rnams la'ang phan pa'i phyir / /'jig rten kun la rab tu bskor/ /gzhan la cho ga rab snang ba/ /cho ga'i rgyal po 'di la'ang yod/ /thub mchog thub pa'i sras dag gis/ /gzhan du cho ga gang bstan pa/ /sngags rnams thams cad 'di la yod/ /de (snyen cho ga rgya chen yin/ /de nyid phyir na thub dbang 6)gis/ /lus can kun la gsungs pa yin/ /gang du cho ga'i rgyal po 'dis/ /dbang 'gyur min dang bkug min pa / /sa steng ⑩'jig rten gsum 'di na/ /rig pa'i sngags rgyal de yod min/ /thub pa'i zla ba rab nub cing / /sa yi dkyil 'khor stongs 6nyapa na/ /cho ga 'jig rten 'dir skiganas pa/ /bstan pa'i don ni byed par 'gyur/ /'jam ——596

pa'i dbyangs ni rtag tu dge/ /'byung po yo)kun la gzhon nu ni/ /de tshe sangs rgyas mdzad pa ni/ /'jig rten bstan la byed par 'gyur/ /cho ga'i rgyal po ②mthu la ni/ /yun ring dus su 'dod pa rnams/ /lan cig thos kyang grol 'gyur ②te/ /rtag tu de la 'grub ④par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung ⑤dag ni/ /rtag tu dge ba don yod 'gyur/ /sngags rnams kun la sngags pa ni//bzlas dang sbyin sreg rtag 'dod ⑥pa'o/ /dus gsum dag tu shes bya la/ /mkhyen pa gang du rab ⑦'jug pa/ /de bzhin 'di la 'jug byed pa/ /cho ga'i rgyal po dam pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa ni/ /sngags su rab gnas de 'dir gsungs/ /sngags de rnam par mi rtog par/ /cho ga de 'dir gsungs pa yin/ /don dang don min sems can gyi/ /dge dang mi dge byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe 'gro ba blo bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun gyi dge mi dge/ /de nyid cho ga 'dir spros pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spros pa med/ /'jig rten 'das pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'jig rten phyir ni 'dir (nyagasungs so/ /las rnams kun la po)shin tu lhag /'jig rten las las rab tu 'das/ /chos rnams rnam pa sna tshogs byed/ /'jig rten kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /sngags rgyal las la brtson par byed/ /de bzhin sems can tshogs la phan/ /gzhon nu 'jam pa'i yidabyangs de ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de don yon tan nges grub yinadang / /'jig rten khams kyi dge mi dge/ /bag med ma bskul ma yin te/ /bskul nas ngas ni chos bshad do/ /sems can ma lus phan nyid phyir/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyi ni bshad pa yin/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang / /bshad cing ngas kyang bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas 88—597

gdung ni mi gcod ①phyir/ /bdag gis kyang ni bshad pa yin/ /sngags pa'i las rnams kun la ni/ /kun mkhyen ye shes 'byung don du'o/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rab 'jug la②/ /las rnams gcig tu bsngags pa yin/ /'jig rten sngon las bdag yin te/ /de ni da (kyeltar yongs su spyod/ /de bas las rnams rab tu bya/ /tshe 'dir dka' ④ba legs spyad cing / /las ldan tshe ⑤ni 'di la yang / /'bad pa med par sngags rnams 'grub/ /las ni 'di la'ang snang 'gyur na/ /skye ba 'di la sti'agrub par 'gyur/ /de bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis / /las ni gcig pu (perab tu bsngags(kye/ /las de cho gar ldan pa na⑨/ /de ni 'di ⑩la myur du 'grub(spre/ /sems can byis pa cho ga nyams/ /rab tu rmongs pa 'khor bar 'gyur/ /de bas rnam pa kun gyis ni/ /las ni gcig pu rab bsngags 7yin/ /cho ga las ni yang dag ldan/ /sgrub pa pos ni bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin cho ga nyams pa'i las/ /shin tu yun ring dag gis 'grub / /bsam gtan med par thar pa med/ /thar pa med par bsam gtan med/ /de bas bsam gtan thar pa ni/ /yang dag ldan pa byang chub brjod / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 6)phal po che theg pa chen 7po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ las thams cad kyi bya ba'i don gyi le'u rab 'byam bcwa 7lnga pa rdzogs so9// // byude nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gzhan yang gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa / blo dang ldan pa gnod sbyin gyi bdag po lag na rdo rjes ⑩nga la dris nas/——598

'jam dpal khyod kyi don thams cad ①bya ba'i las kyi le'u rab 'byam ②'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rgya cher sngar bstan pa yin no/ /sngags kun don dang ldan pa yi③/ /rmi lam dge dang mi dge yin/ /des na zhar la 'di kun ni/ /sngags kyi zlos ④pa bstan pa yin/ /gnod sbyin bdag po yid dga' nas/ /thal sbyar spyi bor byas nas ni/ /ston la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ /de tshe tshig ni 'di skad zhus/ /'jig rten rjes su gzung ⑤don du/ /blo mchog rnams kyis yigasungs pa dang / /bdag la'ang rjes su thugs brtse dang / /sems can rnams ni bde don du/ /zlos pa'i sngags ni thams cad la/ /rmi lam dge dang mi dge dang / /sems can mchog dang tha ma yig/ /spyod pa'i yon tan rgya cher bstan/ /bzang po'i 'gro ba'i skye gnas dang / /rgyu dang shes pa'i rnam pa spyod/ /'das dang ma 'ongs (kyishes pa dang / /dge dang mi dge da ltar gyi/ /thams cad kun 'gro'i shes pa dang / /kun mkhyen ye shes spyod pa dang / /snang med dmigs pa med pa dang / /spros med rab tu spros pa yin/ /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa dang / /shis yinapa zhi ba bstan pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu rnams ni/ /blo mchog gis ni bstan pa yin/ /khyad par du ni zlos pa la/ /sngags rnams don dang ldan par bshad/ /las dang las 'bras sems can gyi/ /bya ba dus dang de bzhin du/ /de bzhin snod dang gnas dang ni/ /cha byad rmi lam zhar la gsungs/ /gnod sbyin bdag po yithub mchog ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun pa la/ /gang zhig bskal (nyabazang sangs rgyas pa/ /shākya'i skyes tsomachog bdun pa 'di/ /shākya'i yonaseng ge dgra las rgyal/ /'di ni bdun par rab tu brtags/ / dus kyi yitha mar rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'jig ——599

rten mgon po 'od byed pa/ /brtson 'grus che zhing shes rab che/ /thub pa mthu ni chen po thob/ /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin bdag /byang chub sems dpa' 6)phyag byas te/ /rang gi gnas su 'dug gyur nas(kye/ /blo ldan de nas cang mi smra//de nas 'jam dpal shes rab che/ /de tshe thub pas dris pa ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la bskul ba ni/ /thub mchog dam pa tha ma la/ /legs so bcom ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /las dang shes pa rgya (micher bcas/ /bcas ④pa'i gza' ni gtso bo ste/ /dge dang mi dge legs tshul bshad/ /las dang shes pa rgyur bcas pa'i/ /sems can mang po'i spyod pa gsungs/ /mchog dang tha ma'i spyod pa dang / /dge ba'i don dang ldan pa dang / /chos pa grub pa'i mtshan ma dang //bsgrub bya sgrub min rnam par brtags/ /'byor pa 'dod dang de bzhin du/ /'jig rten dbang phyug longs spyod 'dod/ /rgyal po khyad par can 'dod dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa grub 'dod (5)dang / /thams cad kun 'gro'i (7ye shes kyis/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis gsol btab nas/ /thub pa mchog gis gsungs pa ni/ /blo ldan ka la ping ku'i skad/ /lha yi rnga sgra'i skad dang ni/ /brtson 'grus chen po tshangs pa'i sgra/ /'brug sgra yi ni sgra skad kyis/ /thub pa bdun pas tshig bshad nas(7)/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni dag pas gsungs/ /gzhon nu 'di ni dngos don khyab rgyur (8)cing / /ma byung 'jig rten phan 99)pa sgrub byed la/ /'gro ba kun la phan pa dge yo 7phyir ston/ /thar pa shes shing dag pa'i 37gnas su 'dug /bden dang brtse dang bzod pa phan sems dang / /gang zhig rtag tu byams dang sbyin la dga'/ /de dag rtag tu grub pa thob par byed/ /kye ma gzhan la'ang grub pa yod ma yin/ /rtag tu 88wa 600

sngags mchog la ni dga' dad dam/ /bstan dang 'khor lo 'dzin dang 'jam mchog dang / /de ni bdud 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'khor lo 'dzin par 'dir ni rigs pa yin/ /gang gi tshigasung ni bzang po yid 'ong zhing / /rtag tu byis pa'i skye bo rnam ②spangs yin/ /yid 'ong bzang po rnar ②ni snyan pa dang ske/ /dga' skyed snyan pa dang ni rjes su mthun④/ /sems ni tshim byed bde ba rab tu sbyin/ /'jam zhes bya bar sangs rgyas yang dag gsung ⑤/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyad par gyis/ /gang gis stimathu ni mkhyen par mi spyod de / /de dag gi sras de bzhin sar zhugs pa/ /'jig rten 'das pa de bzhin bcu yi grangs/ /khyod kyang lha yi 4)dbang phyug 'jig rten khyad par gyis/ /thub bzang shes par nus pa ma yin no/ /gzugs dang gzugs ⑧med de bzhin sa gnas dang / /'dod ldan lha dang mi ni yid las skyes/ /rnal 'byor grub pa thob dang 'jig rten na/ /khyad par can kun de bzhin mi yi gtso/ /de yi che ba gang gis 6)shes gyur pa/ /sems can gang de yod pa ma yin te/ /khyod ⑩kyi che ba 'di ni yongs shes pa/ /'jam zhes bya bar yirab shes sangs rgyas yin//'jam dpal zhes byar yongs su brtags tunyepa ni/ /khyod kyi ming ni sngon 'o gyi rgyal bas mdzad/ /khyod kyi ming du 'di ltar brtags byas pa/ /'das dang ma byon skod ltar sangs rgyas kyili/ /gzhan du ma yengs rtse gcig yid dag pas/ /khyod kyi ming ni 'khor gyi nang du thos/ /des ni 'di la shis dang zhi ba thobatso/ /srid mthar byang chub mchog ni khyad par thob/ /sngags rnams ma lus 'grub tu par 'gyur ba dang / /'gro ba'i skye gnas mchog ni rab thob cing / /rtag tu chos mchog la ni yang dag gnas/ /bgegs rnams rnam par spang 4)shing grub pa ——601

thobaske/ /'dod pa'i sngags rnams ma lus 'grub par byed/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du myur du 'gro/ /song nas byang chub mchog ni thob par byed/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'khor lo ①rab tu skor②/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i gtso bos yon tan gsungs/ /'jam dpal zhes ni khyod kyi ming dran pa/ /yon tan bsam mi khyab ces rgyal bas gsungs/ /rgyal ba'i gtso bo sngar gshegs thams cad kyis/ /rtag tu khyod kyi mthu ni bstan pa yin/ /gzhon nu dag pa khyod kyi ③sngags rtogs pa/ /bskal pa grangs med rtag tu'ang ston ④mi nus/ /'jam dpal khyod kyi sngags kyi spyod pa ni/ /sangs rgyas ma lus dag gis rab tu bshad/ /gzhin nu 'di ni thams cad kun tu 'gro//nga yi bstan la khyod ni mi mchog bstan6)/ /dag pa'i gnas la gnas pa'i skye bo rnams / /'dir ni ma lus mtha' dag zhi bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyi ⑤sngags ni nam yang 'da' ma gyur9)/ /khyod kyi sngags ni nam yang nyams ma ⑧gyur/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi po)rtsa ba'i cho ga /byang chub sems dpa'i 0sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u rab 'byam bcu drug pa rdzogs so(nya// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cadakyi rnam 1nyapar 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ smin mtshams ()kyi mdzod spu yinas 'od zer sngon po dang ser po dang dkar po dang le brgan dang shel gyi kha dog lta bu byung ste(spyo/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di 7thams cad kyang snang 88wa 602

bar byas shing / 'jig rten gyi khams ①gzhan dag kyang snang bar mdzad nas/gza' dang rgyu skar ②thams cad kyang yud tsam gyis zil gyis ②mnan te bkug par gyur to/ /bkug nas kyang rang rang gi gnas la yang dag par sbyar nas/'khor gyi dkyil 'khor der ④sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs ⑤kyis bkug nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzod spu de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /gza' dang rgyu skar dang skar ma thams cad kyi 'od med par byas nas nyam thag pa dang 'jigs pas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la skyabs su 'gro zhing thal mo sbyar nas 'dug par gyur te/ de ltar rab tu 'dar zhing yang dang yang sa'i steng yidu 'gyel bar gyur (7to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya (nyathub pas gza' dang rgyu skar dang skar ma thams cad la mkhas pa rnams dang / byis pa'i skye bo'i blo dang ldan pa'i sems can rjes su gzung 5nyeba'i phyir bka' stsal pa ni/ lha'i tshogs mi dang bcas pa'i grogs po dag khyed cag nyon cig /'jig rten sna tshogs ni las nyid la sems can rnams rnam par rten par byed de/ gang yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje'i sku yang mngon par grub la/ gang yang lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten yang 'khor zhing / 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa chen por rab tu zhugs la/ 'jig rten rnam pa sna tshogs kyi lus mngon par grub ⑩ste / thams cad kyang las dge ba dang mi dge ba dang 'brel ba las skyes (nyal/de la byed pa'i byed pa po'am dbang phyug gam gtso bo'am skyes bu'am grangs 7can gyis rab tu 'byin par byed pa ni gang yang med do/ /las las skyes pa ni ma gtogs te/ de yang las kyi rkyen gyis skyed tsho pa rgyu la ltos pa yin te/ de yang rgyu dang rkyen la ltos pa'o/ /de bzhin du rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rkyen ——603
