phan tshun du 'byung ①ba nye bar 'brel ba yin te/ lhag ma 'byung po rnams mngon par 'grub pa ni 'byung ba chen po las skyes pa ②yin te/ 'byung ba chen po de yang ma 'ongs pa'i phung po gzhan dag tu 'gro bar skye bar 'gyur zhing /skyes nas kyang 'gro ba dang / yul gzhan ①rgya che ba'i rnam par dbye ba dag tu skye bar 'gyur te/ dus gzhan na lugs las bzlog ste 'gag pa ④na ye shes kyi ⑤mes bskul te/ las kyis bsags pa'i bag chags mtha' dag mngon par bsregs yinas/ theg pa rnam pa phyagasum mnyam zhing spros pa med par yang dag par bsgrub ⑧par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po ni dus ring por nye bar chags pa'i las bdag gir byed pa dang / dus bar ma ni rang rgyal ba 6)bse ru lta bu rang byung gi shes rab rab tu 'byung ba dang / gzhan gyi ⑩sgra'i rjes su 'jug pa nyan thos ni dus thung ngus mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'o/ /chos gzhan la blo nyid 'jug par 'gyur ba ni ma yin te/ byis pa rnams kyi rnam par rmongs pa 7nyid dang ji ⑫ste yang 'jig rten sna tshogs gnas pa 'di ni las las skyes pa yin te/ phyogs dang cha byad zhig na nad med pa'i go 'phang mya ngan med pa/ rdul med pa las kyis ḍo/)'jig rten grub pa la ltos pa yin te/ dri ma med pa'i lam rnam par grol ba / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ shin tu bsil ba'i las nyid kyis byed de/las gzhan la ltos pa ma yin zhing las dang las cham yin pa las rnam par grolate/spros pa med pa la nye bar gnas pa yin no/ /theg pa rnam gsum rab 'jug lasal/ /zhi ba gzhan yang yod min te/ /sngags kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /rnam gsum las su yang dag bsgrags7/ /de las rnam zlos ⑩rnam gsum las/ /rnam pa gsum du rab tu snang / /rigs kyang rnam gsum gsungs pa ni/ /——604

sngags rnams kun gyi gzhi yang yin/ /rigs ①gsum rnam pa brgyad du yang / /rgyud dag la ni rab ②tu snang / /rnam pa gcig tu'ang rigs snang steg/ /sngags rnams kun gyi gnas kyang yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dag pa'i ༷thugs//rigs ni zhi ba mya ngan 'das/ /yan lag so so ⑤de nyid las/ /sngags rnams kun tu rab tu bstan/ /'jig rten skar mkhan yan lag ni/ /grub pa'i rgyur ni rab tu brtag⑥ /de nyid yan lag las yin te/ /rkyen gyi yan lag dag la 'jug /ji ltar sā lu'i ⑦'bru rnams ni/ /myu khrugus rnam par shes par byed/ /de bzhin grub pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam par shes/ /ji ltar kha dog dkar po ni/ /tha snyad kyis ni rnam par brtags0/ /de bzhin skar ma ldan pas ni/ /tha snyad don du rab tu brtag /thams cad du ni thams cad ldan/ /las ni gcig pu rab tu bsngags/ /las rnams med par mtshon pa med/ /gang na'ang lus ni yod ma yin/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni spyod pa dang / /skye ba dang ni rigs dang gnas/ /rtag tu la nye sna tshogs pa/ /las de las ni nye bar dmigs/ /las ni gang du'ang lus can min/ /nang na gnas shing mtshon pa med/ /kun nas skye bo rgas pa na/ /rnam par 'gyur las nye bar dmigasal/ /de bzhin lus la brten nas ni/ /las ni lus can dag la snang / /'bras bu dge dang mi dge'i rtags/ /skye bar yang ni rab brjod dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs la nye bzang / /las rnams sna tshogs dag las byung / /dus tshod de bzhin 'gro ba dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs srog chags sgra/ /grub dang ma grub mtshan ma ni/ /rkyen gyi don la ltos pa yin/ /rgyu mtshan spyod dang mtshan ma ni/ /rkyen la mngon par rab tu brtag /de bas rnam kun 'bad nas ni/ /rkyen la ——605

rag las bya ba yin/ /zlos pa'i sngags rnams rtag tu ni/ /grub pa rgyu la ltos pa yin/ /'di dag rkyen gyi yan lag ni/ /las ni bdag gir byed pas mtshon//mi mtshon sngags rnams thams cad ni/ /bgegs las shin tu mi bzad 'gyur/ /de bas 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /yan lag tu ni thub pas gsungs/ /sa ①dbang rgyal po thams cad mkhyen/ /byang chub snying por ting 'dzin thob/ /sngags ni yongs su gsungs ②pa na/ /bgegs rnams ma lus rab tu 'jig /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bzod par dka' ba'ang rnam par 'joms/ /kun mkhyen bdag nyid chen po yi/ /de thugs byang chub la zhugs (kyepa/ /ma rungs bdud kyi sems kyis ni/ /bgegs chen 'jigs ④par ga la 'gyur/ /de nas 'jigs pa chen po ni/ /des ni rgyu mtshan med par snang / /rnam pa sna tshogs 'jigs pa rnams/ /de la rgyu mtshan med par 'byung / /de (snyeni bsod nams stobs bskyed pa/ /yun ring dus su yongs su bsngags6)/ /de yi sngags kyi stobs kyis ni/ /de tshe bdud ni bcom par 'gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing brtson 'grus che/ /de ni tso'od chen ldan par gyur(kyi/ /de yi sngags kyis 6)mthu yis ni/ /byang chub dam pa thob par gyurayi/ /rmi lam ngan pa nyer 'jig pa/ /sngags de 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /gang dag sa la spyod pa yi/ /'byung po'i tshogs kun rab nyon cig /rmi lam ngan pa bzod dka' dang / /ma rungs sems can zlog (1byed pa/ /rgyal ba sā la'i dbang po yi(nya/ /sngon ni sngags rgyal yongs gsungs pa/ /lha yi tshogs dang gza' rnams dang / /rgyu skar skar mkhan rnams nyon cig /gza' bsnyedang rgyu skur eskar ma rnams/ /ma rungs tshar gcad lodon dang ni/ /'byung po rnams ni thams cad kyang / /zhi ba'i sems ——606

ni rab bskyed phyir/ /gang dag sa la spyod pa dag① /rkang med rkang mang ②dag dang ni/ /rkang gnyis dang ni rkang bzhi dang / /mdor na sems can thams cad nini/ /'gro ba dang ni gnas pa yiX/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /na maḥsarba bud+dhā ⑤nā/ a pra ti ha ta shā yis nā māṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi rtsu hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa phyal/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa dul/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ⑨ji 0phaṭa phaṭa yiswā hā/gtsug tor 8'bar ba zhes bsgrags pa'i/ /sngags 'di sngags rnams kun gyi mchog /gang zhig las rnams stong phrag ni/ /dgu bcu rtsa bzhi dag dang ni/ /bkra shis thams cad 'dod pa yi/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams byed/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /lan cig bzlas pas sel bar byed/ /las rnams gzhan yang byed pa ni/ /sngags rnams kun gyi bdag po yin/ /'byung po kun la dbang byed pa8/ /bla ma mnga' bdag sangs rgyas 'di/ /sngags 'di dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /sngags rnams ma lus rab tu semasayi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa lha yi lhabla/ /thub mchog gis ⑩ni de gsungs nas/ /yud tsam mi gsung ⑩bzhugs nas ni/ /cung zad dus ni bzhes tunyepar mdzad/ /de tshe gnas gtsang gnas pa yi4)/ /lha tshogs dag ( )kyang 'dug par 'gyur/ /lha rnams gtso bo thams cad ni/ /rgyu skar 6)gza' dang skar ma rnams/ /gtsug tor sngags kyi byin rlabs zhukyis/ /'jigs shing dam tshig la gnas phyir/ /gtsug tor (nyezhes bya mthu bo che/ /mthu mnyam mthu ni chen po ste/ /brgya phrag lnga 'am bzhi 'am ni/ /de bzhin bdun nam brgyad dang dgu/ /gnyis dang drug dang lnga dang bdun/ /gtsug tor dbang por zhusterab tu bsgrags/ /de ru ltar grangs dang grangs med ni / /gtsug tor rgyal po dge ba yin/ /de dag dang ni sngags 'di mtshungs/ /——607

sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis 6)bshad/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las / las bdag gir byas pa'i rkyen gyi le'u rab 'byam las bcu bdun pa rdzogs sol// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas rgyu skar dang gza' dang skar ma dang skar mkhan thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa dang /phyogs thams cad du ①rnam par gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa'i mchog rnams la bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag khyed cag nyon cig /gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad kyi mthu'i tshig khyed cag thams cad dag la yang stiston cig /khyed kyi sngags bya ba'i don thams cad kyang sgrubs shig /khyed kyis dam tshig la yang gnas par gyis shig /sngags kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis (snyebastan pa 'di grub na/ de nas gzhan cho ga'i rgyal po grub pa la yang khyed cag yid dad par gyis shig ces so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas/ gza' rnams kyi spyod pa sems can thams cad kyi don du gsungs te/ zlos pa (6)thams cad la phan pa'i phyir dang sngags kyi don yang rab tu bsgrubs pa'i phyir thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs so/ /tha skar dang ni (7bra nye dang /byu /smin drug 98)dang po'i rgyu skar te/ /rgyu skar 99)gsum po 'di dag la/ /mig dmar gza' ni bdag po yin/ /lug ni khyim du bstan pa ste(7/ /'di la grub pa yod ma yin/ /grub mchog bar ma tha ma nyid/ /grub pa yin par 'dod pa yin/ /las rnams kun tu'ang mi 'gro zhing / /ma rungs gza' ni rnam par zlogayonya /——608

snar ma mgo ①dang de bzhin du/ /lag tu rgyu skar ②brjod pa yin/ /rgyu skar nab ①so rgyal dang ni/ /skag tu'ang rab tu brjod ④pa yin/ /mchu dang de bzhin gre dang dbo/ /de bzhin me bzhi ⑤nag pa dang / /sa ri sa ga lha mtshams ⑥dang / /snren dang de bzhin snrubs ⑦dang ni/ /chu ni stod smad dge ba ste6)/ /zlos pa la phan rab tu bsngags/ /rgyu skar gro bzhin po)mon gru ni/ /drag po'i las la rab tu bsngagasakyi/ /mon gre khrums ⑩ni stod smad gnyis/ /rgyu skar grub pa'i rgyu yin no/ /nam gru las skye tsodapal dang ldan/ /'thab la dga' zhing 'jigs pa med/ /rgyu skar lhag ma gtso bo ni/ /dus kyi tha mar 'byung ba min/ / byi bzhin 8legs par spyod pa dang / /grub dang bsod nams tsorab tu bsgrags / /nye rgyal dang ni tha chungs tsodang / /'dod pa dag ni nyid yin no/ /yang dag bden dang 'jig rten dang / /snang bar yang ni brjod pa yinatshu/ /longs 8spyod sbyin dang dge sbyin dang / /ma 'gags pa dang 'gags pa nyid/ /grags sbyin gzi brjid rgyal po dang / /de bzhin rgyal po 'jig rten dang / /rgyu skar mang po gsungs pa ste/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /dus kyi tha ma 'di la ni/ /'di dag gi ni nus pa yod/ / cho ga dzishergyal 'di spre)bde don du/ /de tsam shes par gsungs pa yin/ /rang nyid 'od ldan sems can ni/ /de yi dus su rdzogs ldan yin/ /thams cad nam mkha' la 'gro zhing / /rga dang 'chi ba rnam par spangs( )/ /de yi dus su rgyu skar med/ /nyi ma zla ba skar ma med/ /lha dang lha min 'jig rten med/ /dang po'i dus ni dus mchog yin/ /ming med rigs kyang yod ma yin/ /tshes khrimadang skye ba'i skar ma med/ /smyung khri ba med cing sngags kyang med/ /dge dang mi dge'i las kyang med/ /'di dag rang ——609

dgar spyod pa ste/ /bza' 6)dang bza' bar bya ba'ang med/ /'di dag nad med dag pa ste/ /rtag tu sems can rnam ②mang po/ /de nas dus ni bri ①ba na//'jig rten snod dumin rab tu 'jug /sngon gyi las kyis drangs ⑤nas ni/ /de nas sa yi steng du 'gro/ /sa steng lha gnas gzhal med khang / /lha dang lha min yang dag byung ⑥/ /bar ma'i dus su phyin gyur nas③/ /mi yi lus la ⑧yang dag brtenayo)/ /bza' dang btung la brkam chags7pas/ /'od de dag ni rab tu nyams/ /lus ni sra ba nyid gyur cing / /dge dang mi dge rnam par spyod / /de nas nyin zhag zla ba dang / /gza' yi 'od ni byung bar gyurayi/ /de nas bzung 8nas gang cung zad/ /skar ma'i dpyad 8shes pa nyid dang / /sems can rjes su gzung 8bar brjod/ /ngas ni de dag bstan pa yin/ /sngon ni 'drang srong cha byad gyur⑩/ /blo ldan tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /dbang phyug chen po'i lus bstan tunyecing / /yang na khyab 'jug cha byad kyisatso/ /nam mkha' lding gi lus spyad dang / /gnod sbyin srin po dri za dang / /sha za dag gis ⑪lus nyid gyur/ /skye dang skye bar bdag nyid skyes/ /byang chub sems dpa' ⑥mkhas par sgonyani/ /de dang der ni skye ba la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod don phyir / /rtag tu skye ba'i dbang gis so/ /bdag nyid de tshe dus dag tu/ /sngon ni ( rtebyang chub sems dpar gyur/ /mi shes mun pas bsgribs 9 nyapa yi/ /bdag ni de tshe byis par gyur/ /'jig rten ji snyed yod pa yi/ /khyab 'jug gis byas gzo 9 )spyad dang / /lugs kyi bstan bcos sngon gyi rabs gye/ /de bzhin rig byed brda 87sprod pa/ /sdeb 6)sbyor skar ma'i dpyad nyid dang / /rtsis dang sgyu ( nyartsal 'dod pa dang / /log shes de bzhin shes (1pa dang / /de bzhin log par ——610

spyod nyid dang / /'jig rten bstan ①bcos thams cad ni/ /yun ring bdag gis ⑤sngon bstan to/ /zhi ba thub bdag ji lta chabar/ /ye shes bdag gis thob ma yin/ /byang chub rgyu ni grol don dang / /de bzhin du ni thar pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i btson ④rar rab bcings ⑤pas/ /las rnams (6)las kyang bdag ma grol / /zhi ba rnam rgyal sangs rgyas nyid/ /ma nyams rtsigo 'phang mya ngan 'das/ /yun ring don du mngon 'dod cing / /legs par yongs su btsal bas thob/ /de niltar bdag gis rig ldan pas/ /tshegs 0chung bya bas thob pa yin/ /rgyal bas sngon ni bstan pas na/ /rang byung ye shes thob pa yin/ /de 'dra'i gnas ni rab mthong ba/ /phyi 7rol lam gyis thob ma yin/ /byang chub rgyu ni rnyed dka' bas7/ /'khor ba'i dbon par 'khyams 8pa yin/ /bdag gi rang byung 'di 'dra ba/ /ye shes bdag gis thob pa min/ /rig (rtepa bzang po'i las dga' bas/ /da boni mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /bdag gis bstan bcos 'di dag ni/ /bsdus pa li'aba' zhig byas pa yin/ /las las grol ba med par ni/ /grub pa'i rgyu ni rnyed ma yin/ /'khor ba'i yun ring 7zhags pa 'disaX 7/ /las kyi 'ching bas nges par bcings(nye/ /de yi 'gro 'di bdag nyid che/ /dge dang mi dge'ang smin par 'gyur/ /rgyu skar gza' dang skar ma'i dpyad/ /mtshon par byed pa kho nar zad/ /chos dang mi ldan mi rnams dang / /gzhan la rtags ni snang mi 'gyur/ /de nyid kyis na gza' gsungs pa/ /dge dang mi dge'i rjes gzung phyir/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag dang / /khams ni bzhi po dag dang ni/ /chu dang sa dang rlung dang me(smu/ /nam mkhar yongs su bstan 2 )pa yin / /'byung ba yang dag bsdu ba'i phyir/ /'di dag 'byung ba chen po yin/ /——611

sems can yang dag bsdu ba'i phyir/ /bag med las kyis ①byas pa yin/ /de dag dus ②ni nges pa yis/ /sngags rnams grub par 'gyur ba ①yin/ /de yi skye ba 'bad pa yis/ /dge dang mi dge bsrung bar bya/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'jig rten gtso/ /lha yi dbang phyug brgya byin sogs/ /de yang de tshe de dus su / /dus kyi mthar ④ni yongs su brtagasaphyi/ /dus kyi tha 6)ma dag la ni/ /sngags rnams grub pa nges pa yin/ /de nyid kyis na thub dbang gisaspyi/ /gzhon (kyenu yongs su brtags ⑨pa ni/ /shes rab chen po 'jam pa'i yidabyangs/ /byis pa gzhon 7nu'i gzugs dang ldan/ /'jig rten 'dir ni kun tu rgyu/ /sems can rjes su gzung 8bar bzod/ /de yi (nyadus su grub pa ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni rab tu mthong / /rgyu skar skar ma'i dpyad shes pa/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun rgyu skar dang / /yud tsam dag tu rab tu bsgrags / /dus kyi tha ma de la ni/ /bcu gnyis khyim yang yod pa yin/ /rgyu skar tshogs la brten nas ni/ /de dag gza' ni rnam par dbye/ /thams cad so sor gyur pa ni/ /'jam dpal gyis ni so sor mdzad/ /skye ba dang ni spyod pa nyid/ /khyim rnams kun la rab tu gnas/ /skye bo rmongs pas khyab 'gyur tsol / /dge dang mi dge'i 'a'abras bu 'byung ⑩/ /de nyid las kyi 'ching ba yis/ /de dag khyim ni yang dang yang / /sems can rnams kyis (1grub pa tsam/ ji/dge dang mi dge rtog par byed/ /rgyu skar snar mar ldan par tunyeni/ /skye bar yongs su rab brtags pa/ /dpal ldan bzod pa phun sum tshogs/ /tshe ring bu ni mang ba dang / /rtag tu de tshe nor skal ldan/ /de ni dmag gi ()bdag po byed/ /'di ni khyu mchog khyim skyes ( )na/ /khyu mchog nyid la yongs su 'chi( rnya/ /mgo nyid ——612

la ni 'jig rten shes/ /chos ldan mthong na dga' bar 'gyur/ /smin drug char skyes rtag tu ni/ /sa bdag rgyal por snang ba ste/ /yang dag skye ba de la brten① / /rtag tu rgya mtsho gsum bdag 'gyur/ /phyogs gcig skyes pa bgrod dka' ba'i②/ /phyogs gcig rgyal por 'gyur ba yin/ /gza' ni bla mas mtshan pa yi/ /gal te skye bar 'byung 'gyur (gyen/ /sa ni khor yug ma lus par / /rjes su spyod par 'gyur ba yin/ /lo ni bcu dang lnga po nyid/ /de yi rgyal thabs byed par 'gyur/ /tha skar bra nye nyid dang ni/ /smin drug cha las ④skyes gyur pa/ /khyim 'di dag gi phyinas pa ni/ /tshong gi yidon gyis nor sgrub ⑦'gyur / /gal te skyes pa ⑧des byung yonyen/ /dbang phyug longs spyod phun sum tshogs / /rgyu skar 'di la skyes pa na/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyi ma nub pa na/ /de ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /ma rungs tsham tshom med pa dang / /bden par smra ba ma yin dang / /lus kyi lpags srab ⑩dmar ba'i mdog⑩ /sa yi steng na de snang ngo / /'di yi 'gro ba skad cig ni/ /mig 8'byed 'dzums su rab tu bstan/ /'di yi bar du gang skyes pa/ /rgya che yon tan de 'di yin/ /se gol gtogs 4snyeganas tsam du ni/ /'di yi 'gro ba rab tu bstan/ /des yin de dag 'gro ba nyams/ /gza' rnams kyis ni mthong ma yin/ /skye ba rnam par 'dris 'gyur pa'i/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs skye/ /'dres pa'i 'gro ba phun sum tshogs/ /'dren 7pa'i longs spyod ldan pa yin/ /de nyid kyis (rten mi skye ste/ /skye ba nyid na (/2brjod pa yin/ /skye ba'i skar ma sum cu ni/ /dge dang mi dge'i 4)'bras bu 'byung / /gza' ni mig dmar gyis mtshan pa/ /'di ni ma rungs skye bar 'gyur/ /gsus che lus ni snum pa dang / /88—613

mig dkyus ring zhing snyan par smra/ /gza' ni phur bus bltas pa ni/ /rtag tu brtan 6)ldan skye bar 'gyur/ /chu tshod zung tsam nyi ma dang / /zla ba'i lha ni rab bshad pa/ /de bzhin rtag tu nyin mtshan la/ /yang dag skye bar 'dod pa yin//phyin ci log pa'i skye ba gzhan⑤/ /phyin ci log tu'ang brtags ①pa yin/ /gza' ④ni mi dge (nyamathong ba dang / /mi dge'i skye ba dge mi dge/ /mi dge'i ⑥'bras bu grub pa dang / /yang dag skye ba bzang po 'byung / /'gro ba'i skye gnas la brten ⑦nas/ /khyim la skye bar gyerab tu gnas/ /gza' ni ngan spong bus mtshan pa/ /sbyin byed sems dpa' che ba ste/ /lag dang nab 7so dag dang ni/ /skag gi cha la rab tu brjod/ /'di dag la skyes gtong ba yi che/ /g.yo sgyu (1can ni bab col byed/ /don dang don med 'byor ba la/ /rtag tu brkam chag 4)bud med chags/ /gzhan gyi bud med mngon 4)'gro zhing / /de nyid nag po la spyod dang / /dud pa'i mdog 'drar 8skye 'gyur te/ /drag cing 'khrig pa la yang dga'/ /sbyor ba'i khyim la rab brten yinas/ /de ni spen pa dag la skye/ /nyin dang mtshan du yang dang yang / /der gnas spen pa rgyu bar byed / /de las skyes pa 7nyi ma phyed/ /sems ni stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de yi dus la gang skyes payo 7/ /de yi mtshan nyid brjod par bya/ /nor ni grub /stepar 'gyur ba dang / /dbang phyug gitsha ni legs mtshan pa'o(1/ /rgyu skar de bzhin rgyal dang ni/ /skag la yang ni gang skyes pa( )/ /'di ni sbal pa'i khyim yin te/ /dge dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul che/ /mdog ni ser po dang ldan zhing / /de ni skye ba mchog tu bstan( me/ /rtag tu de bzhin mtshan phyed du/ /'di ni skye bar bstan dzo )pa yin/ /de yi dus kyi so:tshad la ni/ /gal te sems can skye bar ——614

'dod / /cho ga mthong ba'i rgyu yis na6)/ /'di ni don rnams thams cad sgrubazhu / /de ni shin tu gzhon pa nas②/ /rgyal thabs byed cing nor rnams thob//mdog ni ser ④dang sngo bsangs ⑤ni/ /kha dog rgyas pa snang bar 'gyur/ /gtsang sbra'i spyod la dga' ba dang / /de ni dpal ldan 'jigs med skye4)/ /mchu dang de bzhin gre dang ni/ /de bzhin dbo yi cha dag ni/ /snang byed kyi ni zhing du 'gyur/ /seng ge'i khyim du bya ba yin/ /de la skyes pa ⑦dpa' bo che /sha yi kha zas de la dga'/ /ri yi rdzong la brten (8)nas ni/ /rgyal thabs dbang phyug byed par 'gyur/ /gal te der skyes khyithob gyur na/ /zhing la gnas shing des sdom rten⑩/ /de bzhin nyi ma 'char ba na/ /skyes pa 'di la brjod pa yin//rgyu skar dbo yi cha dang 7ni/ /de bzhin me bzhi nag pa nyid/ /rgyu skar de la skye ⑫gnas pa/ /mi ni yongs su dpa' bar 'gyur/ /sdom min gzhan gyi bud med 'gro / /de ni dmag dpon byed par 'gyur/ /gal te skye ba khri thob 'gyur na/ /nges par rgyal thabs byed par 'gyur/ /gang du skar ma de dag gnas/ /'di ni bu mo'i khyim du 'gyur/ /'di yi bdag po gza' lhag yiste/ /kha cig tu ni gzhan yang yin/ /'di dag 8skar ma mchog la ni/ /gza' ni mi bzad bsrung tsobar 'gyur/ /zla ba 7yang ni bzang ba ste/ /yang na zla ba'i bu bdag yin/ /nyin phyed rdzogs na skye ba ni/ /'di yi skye bar tunyesnang ba yin/ /nag pa'i cha dang sa ri dang / /sa ga'i phyed kyis lhag pa la/ /srang gi khyim ste bzang po'i /97don/ /zla ba la spyod sems can gyi/ /'di ni mi bzad zhing yin te/ /skal med ma yin nor gyi gnas/ / 'di yi skye ba skye gyur ( )gnas/ /mtshan mo'i thun gyi tha ma'o / /mi ni 'di la skyes ( nyegyur pa/ /rtag tu btung ba dag la dad(rte/ /spyi ——615

mtshan ma yin ngo tsha med/ /mang pos bkur cing mchod pa dang / /la lar rgyal srid longs 6)spyod dang / /nor chen thob par 'gyur ba yin/ /nges med skye ba yongs lasnang zhing / /byis par mas ni spangs pa duyin/ /gal te skye ba thob 'gyur ④na/ /bu mang bde ba skye bar 'gyur/ /rgyu skar lha mtshams las skyes pa / /bzo yi las ni sgrub pa dang / /byams pa'i bdag nyid grogs po mang / /rtag tu dpa' zhing rtul phod che/ /'jig rten snron la skyes pa (7ni/ /mi ni rab gtum brtan ⑥pa yin/ /sdug bsngal mang po bzod pa dang / /mi ni ma rungs skye bar 'gyur/ /khyim ni sdig par bshad pa stephya/ /rtag tu rno zhing bab col byed / /'di dag nyid la rtag skyes pa/ /skye bar yang dag brjod pa yin/ /de bzhin nyin phyed nyi ma la/ /gal te mi ni skye ⑧gyur na/ /drag 5)cing g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /rgyal por de ni nges par 'gyur/ /byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs yod pa'i/ /de yi skad cig gzas mthong 'gyur/ /sa yi ⑩lha mo'i bur gyur pa/skra/ /gang yin de ni mig dmar gsungs/ /de nyid phyir na sa la spyod/ /rang bu nyid kyis gsod par byed/ /de las gzhan pa bzlog pas ni/ /dge dang mi dge'i skye ba nyid/ /tshe ring gzi tunyebarjid ldan pa dang / /shes ldan nyid du'ang skye bar 'gyur/ /lha mtshams la ni rab skyes pa/ /shes rab che zhing grogs la byams/ /mig dmar gyi ni zhing 'di yin/ /yang na rtag tu gza' 'dres yin/ /rgyu skar snrubs las 1steskyes pa dang / /de bzhin du ni chu stod dang / /chu smad kyi ni cha dag la/ /gzhu yi khyim du rab tu bstan/ /de yi skye ba'i skye ba ni/ /phur bu'i zhing der brtan cha)pa yin/ /nyi ma phyi dror gyur pa dang / /zla ba nam smad gyur pa la/ /de yi skye ba zhes bstan pa/ /gang zhig ——616

skyes pa skye ba'i rgyu/ / snrubs las ②skyes pa rang rigs ②'jig /tha mar bzang por 'gyur ba yin/ /skye duganas bar mar dulongs spyod ni/ /thob par de ni the tsom ⑤med/ /gzhon pa yongs su 'das pa na/ /snang byed dkyil 'khor ji lta bar / /rgas par 0gyur na rgyal por 'gyur/ /longs 0spyod che zhing nor cher 'gyur / /dma' ba'i gyephyogs su lus 'gyur gyi/ /gzhan gyi phyogs su ma yin no / /de las gzhan du bzlog par ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs skye bo snang 6)/ /chu smad kyi ni cha dag dang / /gro bzhin 7nyid du brtan (sprepa dang / /mon gru rgyu skar mchog nyid ni/ /khyim 'di chu srin kho na yin/ /'di ni spen pa'i zhing yin te/ /yang na gza' gzhan gyis tsomatshan pa'o/ /rtag tu 'di la skye gnas pa'/ /de yang sa steng 'di la snang / /dang po'i mtha' dang bar ma'i mtha'/ /mtshan mo'i cha ni 'das pa la/ /de dag las 8skyes longs spyod cher8/ /kun nas snang bar gyur pa yiyin/ /mtho dang dma' ba'i rigs gnas shing / /de dag sa yi bdag por 'gyur/ /rab gtum kha dog nag po 'amatu / /sngo bsangs 4nyamadog tu de dag 'gyur/ /mig mtha' dmar zhing 'jam pa dang / /rtag tu dpa' zhing rtul yang phod/ /de bzhin chu yis /— khyab pa yi/ /phyogs ( )su rgyal po byed par 'gyur / /tshe ring bu ni med pa dang / /sdug bsngal mang po bzod par 'gyur/ /de las gzhan pa bzlog pa la/ /skye bo rnam par bzlog pa ru1snang / /mon gru'i phyed dang mon gre dang / /de bzhin khrums ji )stod phyed dag ni/ /de yi khyim du 'gyur ba ni/ /bum pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /'di la gza' yi gtso bo ni/ /zhing du rtag tu brten pa yin/ /de bzhin 'dres pa'ang zla ba dang / /blo ldan pa wa sonasangs nyid yin/ /'di dag skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ /mtshan mo'am nam 88wa 617

ni langs par snang / /rtag tu skye 'di bzang po stol/ /'jig rten spyod pa dag pa yin/ /mi ni ma rungs las byed cing / /blo dang ldan par brjod pa yin/ /longs spyod sna tshogs phun sum ①tshogs/ /sa steng rjes su spyod par 'gyur/ /de las gzhan du bzlog na ni/ /dbul zhing nad rnams snod du 'gyur/ /rgyu skar khrums nismad nyid dang ni/ /nam gru zhes ni brjod pa dang / /khrums ④stod kyi ni bzhi cha la/ /khyim ni nya ru rab tu brtags⑤/ /skye ba de dag rtag duganas pa//kun tu ji ltar snang zhe na/ /mtshan mo'i thun gyi bar ma dang / /nyin par nyi ma shar ba dang / /nyi ma thun phyed 'das pa dang / /nyin ⑦byed cung zad 'das pa dang / /lhag ma khru gang tsam 'das par/ /'di yi dus su'ang skyes pa ⑧ni/ /dag pa dang ni rab dag nyid/ /pa sangs nyid kyis yonyerab tu mchod/ /pa wa ⑩sangs kyi zhing zhes pa/ /lha yi rigs ⑩zhes tshangs par spyod/ /ser dang dkar ba'i mdog dag gi/ /gza' yis 7kyang ni rab tu bsten/ / des shing yirtag tu dge ba dang / /chos ldan mchog tu bzang ba yin/ /mi ni de la skyes gyur pa//yan lag kun kyang shin tu mdzes/ /brtson 'grus che zhing rgyal po 'dod/ /gnyen dang bshes ni brtan skipa dang / /tshe ring longs spyod che ba dang / /dma' ba'i yul la yang dag brtenasnyi/ /shar gyi phyogs la brten tsonas ni/ /de dag rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /de dag mya ngam phyogs su ni/ /rtag tu skye bar mi 'gyur te/ /nya ni thang la yongs 9)spyod par/ /nam yang snang ba ma yin no/ /drang srong rnams kyi chu gnas dang / /chu bo dag tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de la skye bar rab brtan tunyepa/ /khyim nyid du ni rab tu bstan/ /mi 6)ni de dag las ( )skyes pa/ /dma' ba'i yul du rnam par 'phel/ /rtag tu shar gyi phyogs gnas ——618

pa'i / /sa bdag skal ba chen por 'gyur/ /phur bu dang ni spen pa dag /gza' mchog gi ①ni mngon par bltas②/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi bdag po byed/ /de dag las skyes ②the tshom med/ /khyim ni rnam pa mang po dang / /rgyu skar du ma gsungs pa yang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gza' mchog kyang / /sngon gyi dus ①yin da ltar ⑤min/ /mi rnams de ⑥las skyes pa g.yang / /de bzhin tshes grangs bco (gyelnga dang / /nyin zhag sum cu dag nyid de/ /des na zla bar rab tu bstan/ /zla phyed nyin mtshan bco lnga stel/ /zla phyed gnyis la zla bar brjod/ /des yin zla ba bcu gnyis la/ /lo gcig tu ni rab tu bsgrags/ /'di tsam dus kyi tshod la ni/ /dus kyi tha mar yongs su brtags(me/ /rtsod pa'i dus su phyin pa na/ /'di yi grangs 8su rab tu bstan/ /mi rnams tshe ni de bzhin du/ /lo brgya dag tu bsgrags 8pa yin/ /de dag lo tshigs ④phyin pa na/ /dus ni drug tu rab tu brjod / /dang po bar dang tha mar ni/ /de dag gsum du rab tu bstan/ /lha mtshams tsol ni sa 'gul na/ /mi rnams 'dir ni 8tshe ring ⑩'gyur/ /de dag mi yi 'jig rten 'dir/ /skye zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin/ /mi ma yin pa 'jig rten 'dir/ /phan tshun du ni 'byer bar 'gyur/ /de dag rnam skrag 'jigs pa dang / /phan tshun du ni rnam par rgyu/ /lha dang lha min gtso bo (sheni/ /gang tshe 'thab par rab 'jug pa/ /de tshe mi yi 'jig rten 'dir/ /nad ni 'byung bar byed pa yin/ / mjug rings 4)las dang skar mda' dang / /gnam lcags dang ni rdo rje dang / /dud pa phyogs ni mtha' dag tu/ /du ba mjug rings ( byerab tu snang / /zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mun nag gis ni khebs (spepar gnas/ /nyi zla rdzu 'phrul chen po dag /bug pa yod par snang ——619

ba dang / /de ltar rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /rnam mang yang ni snang gyur ①na/ /mu ge tshe ni nyams pa dang / /de bzhin yul 'khor 'jig pa dang / /mi yi bdag po 'chi ba dang / /sdom brtson 'jigs pa chen po 'byung / /②'jig rten dag ①ni thams cad la/ /der ni 'jigs su rung ba 'byung / /mchu rjodang tha skar dag dang ni/ /nab so la ni sa 'gul na/ /de tshe dbus kyi yul dag tu/ /rkun ⑤ma bab col byed la gnod/ /lho yi phyogs ⑥la gnas pa yi/ /rgyal po chen po rnam par 'jig /bra nye smin drug nyid dang ni/ /gang tshe snar ma dang ni mgo / /'gul lto)na 'jig rten 'jigs ⑧pa che/ /de la dogs yo)pa rab tu 'byung / /nub phyogs na ni gnas pa yi/ /de tshe rgyal po 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang yang mtha' 'khob gnas pa yi/ /kla 7klo rku bas 'tsho byed dang / /de bzhin 'bigs byed steng gnas dang / /nang du mi yi dbang phyug gnas/ /de yang de yi dus dag tu/ /nad kyis brgyal zhing gnod par 'gyur/ /de dag la ni dgra rnams 'byung / /gcig la gcig ni yul 'phrog 'gyur/ /rgyu skar lag dang rgyal dang ni/ /skag dang de bzhin gre dang dbo/ /'di dag la ni sa 'gul na / /mi bdag kun ni mi mthun nas/ /phan tshun gnod pa byed 'gyur ba/ /gsod (1dang 'ching dang gnod pa dang / /mu ge dag kyang rab tu 'byung / /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang / /de bzhin lha mtshams /)snron nyid la/ /snod kyi 'jig rten sar gyur pa/ /'di la gang tshe 'gul gyur nye na/ /kha ba can gnas kla klo dang / /rkun ma kun nas gnas pa dang / /bal yul gyi ni bdag po dang / /kha sha'i lung par gnas pa yi/ /der ni mi bdag ma lus pa/ /phan tshun du ni mi mthun nas/ /thams cad g.yul la spyod 'gyur bar/ /'dir ni the tshom 89—620

med pa yin/ /rgyu skar gang yin snrubs ①dang ni/ /chu ni stod smad gnyi ga la/ /sa yi steng du 'gul bar ni/ /'di dag la ni rab mthong na/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi mi rnams dang / /pon ②dra o ṭa kā ②ma ru/ /bhaṅga dul bdag rgyal po ni/ /'chi bar ⑤'di la the tshom med/ /gi ṭā'i dubadag po dpal dang ldan/ /yul 'khor gzhan gyis yongs bskor ba'amartsi/ /'phral la na bar gyur pa dang / /la lar yang na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten rgya mtsho'i ngogs ⑧gnas dang / /gaṅgā'i yo)'gram du yang dag gnas/ /chu yis 0thams cad khyer ba 'am/ /nad rnams mang po kun gnod (7byed/ /gro bzhin tsodang ni mon gru dang / /mon gre dang ni chu stod dang / /de bzhin du ni chu smad dang / /gal te nam gru las skyes pa / /rab tu 'gul ba nyin phyed tsol/ /snod kyi 'jig rten yang dag 'gul/ /sa rnams thams cad rab 'gul ba/ /ri bo dang ni nags su bcas/ /rtag tu nam mkha' la snang ba/ /'phar 8zhing 'og tu 'byung byed na/ /byang phyogs kyi ni yul dag dang / /nub phyogs la ni yang dag gnas/ /lho yi phyogs ni thams cad dang / /phyogs rnams kun la gnas byed pa'i/ /mi mchog sa ni mang spyod pa / /phan tshun du ni gnod pa byed/ /sems can rnams ni gnod chen ldan/ /mu shes 7yul 'khor 'byer 7bar 'gyur/ /tho rangs 4)sa ni 'gul gyur na/ /lus can shis dang zhi bar 'gyur/ /de las cung zad phyi tu dus na/ /drag po'i 'gul ba rab tu skye/ /de nas cung zad phyis 'gul na/ /yul ni ma ga d+mar ⑪gnod dang / /aṅga'i yul du gnod 'gyur te/ /ma ga dhā ( )rgyal de bzhin no/ /de nas cung zad nyin phyed dam/ /phyi dro'i ( nyadus su gyur pa na/ /gal te sa ni 'gul bar gyur/ /sa steng ma lus nyid dag gi/ /rab tu byung ba thams cad ——621

la / /rtag tu nad ni 'byung ba 'thob/ /rims ①dang yi ga 'chus dang gzer/ /de bzhin nad ni 'brum bu yis/ /zhag bdun btab par gyur nas ni/ /de nas de dag sos par 'gyur/ /de nas nyi ma yang 'das nas/ /sa ni gal te 'gul gyur na/ /rigs ②bzhi dag gi mchog gyur pa/ /bram ze rtswa ①ni so ma 'thung / /nyon mongs rgyal po'i blon po ni/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar the tshom med//mdun na 'don ni chos dang ldan/ /blon po'am zham 'bring ④byad pa na/ /gzhan yang sdom can gtso bo ni/ /sngags rgyud don la mkhas pa dang / /bram ze dang ni rgyal rigs dang / /de bzhin dmangs rigs rje'u rigs dang ⑤/ /brtan pa mkhas pa dag dang ni/ /bstan bcos de nyid don lugs ldan/ /gsod 6)dang rab tu nyams (7pa 'am/ /dran ldan (shethos dang de nyid shes/ /sngon byung dzi)ba ni sems pa dag /myur du nad kyis 'jigs 'gyur te/ /gnam lcags rdo rjes bishing la bzhin/ /de nas nyi ma nub pa na/ /de nas yang ni song ba na/ /phyi dro dus kyi mtha' la ni/ /gal te sa ni rab tu 'gul/ /de bzhin sems can 'dres pa dang / /dud 'gro dag gi 'gro ba dang / /mi yi 'jig rten gtso bo dag /de tshe 'gum lhamedang rnam par 'jig /mtshan mo'i thun ni dang po la/ /gal te sa ni 'gul gyur yinan/ /sems can 'dres pa sna tshogs dang / /dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnams dang yo ni/ /mi ni rdzi'ajig rten gtso rnams su/ /char chen rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /cung zad thun de bri gyur la//sa ni 'gul bar gyur pa yi7/ /de tshe rtags de snang gyur na/ /rlung dang char pa'i 'jigs chen 'byung / /de nas thun de zad pa'i mthar/ /'gul snang las ni mi bzad pa/ /nub phyogs mi yi bdag po yi/ /pha rol dmag tshogs 88—622

'byung bar shes/ /thun ni gnyis pa dang po la/ /gal te sa ni 'gul ba byung ①/ /gzhan gyi dmag tshogs nad dang 'chi/ /khong pa'i nad ni mi bzad 'byung —/ /mkhris pa bad kun las gyur nad/ /skye bo rnams la 'byung bar 'gyur / /'byung po rnams ni skyo 'gyur zhing / /de tshe phyogs dang phyogs su 'gro//de nas gnyis pa'i thun dkyil du/ /sa ni rab tu 'gul byung na/ /rlung chen 'byung bar ⑤shes bya ste/ /shing dang lha khang 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /yang thog ra ba ri rnams kyil/ /rtse mo 'jig ④par the tshom med/ /gnas dang 'dug duganas bzang po dang / /khang pa dang ni rta babs dang / /dud 'gro 0rnams kyi 'dug gnas kyang / /sa la myur du ltung bar 'gyur/ /de nas mtshan phyed dus dag tu/ /gal te sa ni 'gul ba byung ⑦/ /de tshe shar phyogs yul gyi bdag /mi mchog gtso bo 'chi ba 'am/ /de bu 'chi bar 'gyur ba 'am/ /mu ge 'byung bar rab tu ston/ /bar ma'i thun ni bri gyur nas/ /tha mar nye la 'gul ba byung / /sa rnams dag ni ma lus la/ /zhi zhing nad med nges par ston/ /de nas mtshan phyed mthar gyur la(kye/ /gal te sa ni 'gul bar snang / /gsher chen 6)yul gyi dbus dag tu/ /mi yi bdag po nad kyis gnon⑩/ /phan tshun mi mthun gyur nas ni/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /thun ni gsum par phyin nas 'gul/ /byis pa rnams la bde ba 'byung / /sbrang bu sha sbrang phye leb dang / /rkun po rnams ni 'jig par 'gyur(nya/ /tho rangs 'gul bar gyur na ni/ /tshe ring nad med lo legs byed/ /grong khyer gyi ni khor yug dag /me yis tshig ⑩par shes par bya/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i dus dag tu/ /sa ni rab tu 'gul ba byung ⑫/ /dbus kyi yul ni thams cad du/ /rkun mas rnam par 'tshe ——623

bar 'gyur/ /de tshe zhag ni bdun dag las/ /rgyal po 'chi bar snang ba yin/ /gang du ⑨stobs ni rab che ba/ /sa ni 'gul bar gyur pa yin/ /de tshe gnas ni de dag tu/ /dge dang mi dge'i spyod pa 0snang / /skar mda' gnam grum las 'gul ni/ /skar mda' dkar po 'bar gyur ④na/ /des ni sngar bstan sel bar byed/ /de ⑤bzhin dkar mdog rtag tu ni/ /dge zhing rab tu bsngags pa yin / /mi bzad chen po kha dog dmar/ /me yis tshig par nye bar ston/ /dud ku'i mdog nag nag po ni/ /rgyal po 'chi bar ston pa yin/ /ser ba'am yang na ser skya 'am/ /'dres pa'i mdog ⑥ni snang gyur ⑦na/ /de tshe 'dres pa'i las 'gyur ba(nya/ /skar mda' ltung bas rnam par ston/ /gnam grum 6)nyid du bstan pa ni/ /gar byung der ⑩ni ston pa ste/ /gal te dbus na de tshe dbus / /yul nyid du ni rab tu bstan/ /sgra brnyan nya/ snyan pa byung na ni/ /bde zhing nad med ston par byed/ /ma rungs mi bzad 'jig rten tsodu/ /rnga sgra yis ni dge ba sbyin/ /'jigs dang shin tu 'jigs rung tu sgra/ /der ni mu ge ston pa yin/ /de la sogs par sbyor ba ni8/ /rtag tu gza' rnams 'dod pa yin/ /rgya skar 'di dag mthong ba la/ /grub pa'i las 8ni de tshe bya/ /tha skar snar ma snyed dang ni/ /rgyal dang khrums ni stod smad gnyis/ /nam gru dang ni lha mtsham sa 7dag /bzlas pa'i dus su rab tu bsngags/ /'di dag la ni sngags rnams 'grub/ /grub pa'i don yang ster bar byed/ /skar yonyem dag ni 'di das la/ /dkyil 'khor nyid kyang bri bar bya/ /gza' yi res kyi gtso bo ni / /ser dang dkar bar snang ba yin/ /tshes ni 'di dag la dge ste/ /rtag tu zla ba nya ba yin/ /yul gzhan dag yo tu 'gro byed dang / /dkyil 'khor dag 88—624

kyang bri bar bya/ /dang po gsum pa lnga pa dang / /bcu pa dang ni bdun pa dang / /bcu gsum pa la ci bde bar/ /mi yi bdag po 'gro bar brtag /skye bo kun la dge ba sbyin/ /chas 6)shing 'gro bar rab tu bsngags/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sngags rgyud dag /sngags rnams thams cad mi bri'o②/ /'di dag la ni sngags mi 'grubadu/ /bgegs kyi rgyur ni bstan pa yin/ /'gro dang sbyin sreg grub pa la/ /tshes grangs gza' ni dam par ldan/ /phur bu pa sangs zla ba dang ske/ /gza' lhag mchog ni las kun la/ /gza' mchog 'di dag rtag tu ni//bzhi po tshes dang ldan pa ni/ /sa steng 'jig rten kun tu ni/ /'gro ba'i las ni grub par byed/ /ma rungs 'chi ltas bral ba yi/ /nyi ma la ni brtag par bya/ /yud tsam bcu gnyis kho na ni/ /de yi dus su rab tu sbyar/ /dkar phyidang byams ldan nyid dang ni/ /mig dmar du yang rab tu bstan/ /drag bu ⑤dbang chen dag pa dang / /byi bzhin nyid dang legs mdzes dang / /'khor dang 'khor bar byed pa nyid/ /dge ba sbyin zhes bstan pa yin/ /zla ba mchog ni ⑥sbyin pa nyid/ /'di dag bcu gnyis mtshan nyid yin/ /yud tsam dag tu bstan pa ni/ /nyin zhag sum cu nyid la'o/ /bcu pa char ni 'bab 'gyur (/tshote/ /bcu bzhi pa ni yul 'khor 'jig /brgyad pa bcu gnyis pa nyid dang / /bzhi pa nyid ni spang bar bya/ /myur la sogs pa'i grangs dang ldan/ /mar ngo la ni mtshan mo yin/ /lhag ma bgegs ni byed pa yang / /log 'dren yin te bzhi pa'o / /'di dag grangs ni ldan pa la/ /dus 'di dag tu rab tu bstan/ /mig ni 'byed dang 'dzums (8)pa dang / /se gol myur ba'i 'gros 'di 7ni/ /'di dag dus kyi tshad dag ni/ /rgya cher yang ni bstan par bya/ /se gol brgya ——625

yi tshogs dag la/ /rtsa rgyun gcig tu bstan pa yin/ /rtsa rgyun bzhi la chu tshod bstan / /chu tshod bzhi la thun zhes hu)bya/ /thun bzhi la ni nyin par te/ /mtshan mo dag kyang de bzhin bstan/ /de ltar brgyad dang ldan pa la/ /nyin mtshan du ni rab tu brtagasal/ /mig gi 'byed 'dzums bcu la ni/ /skad cig tsam du rab tu brtags③/ /skad cig bcu zhes bshad pa ni/ /yud tsam du ni yongs su brtagasali/ /yud tsam bzhi la thun gcig ces/ /sngags rig ⑤pas ni yongs su brtagasadu/ /'di tsam dus kyi tshad la ni/ /gsum gyi grangs su yongs su brtagasaphya/ /sbyin sreg dus dang bzlas pa yi/ /grub pa'i dus dang ⑧sbyar bar bya/ /nyal ba'i dus dang mi nyal dang / /rtag tu nyin zhag phrugs btungs (1)la/ /nyin dang mtshan ni nyi ma zhes/ /de ltar ming ni 'jug pa yin/ /nyi ma bcwa 7lnga nyid la ni/ /zla ba phyed du rab tu bstan/ /zla phyed gnyis la zla ba zhes/ /rtsis shes 'jigs pa med pas lha)bstan/ /de bzhin zla ba zla drug gis / /sgra gcan gyis 7kyang 'dzin pa yin/ /de nas zla ba bcu gnyis la/ /lo yi sgrar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /de nas lo ni bcu gnyis la/ /lo chen zhes ni de la bya/ /gza' dang rgyu skar phyin ci log /lha min (spyodabang po thams cad kyang ske/ /de nas lo ni bcu gnyis la/ /'dir dhini dge dang mi dge byed/ /gang tshe yar ngor lha min dbang / /sgra gcan rab tu snang 'gyur zhing / /sa ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ma lus rab tu zin gyur 7na/ /mtshon gyi tshogs ⑩ni chen po yang / /sa yi steng du snang bar 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa chen po ni/ /dus dang dus su rab sbyor 'gyur/ /rnam pa du ma mang po yi/ /bgegs ni mi bzad /tsho snang bar 'gyur/ /dus kyi tha 6ltamar phyin pa na/ /'jig rten snod ni ——626

chos min la/ /rgyu skar snrubs 6)la gnas pa la/ /zla ba ma lus 'dzin 'gyur tshizhing —/ /mtshan mo ma lus 'dzin pa nyid/ /zla ba 'dzin pa nub bzhin dang / /gal te nyi ma nyin par ni/ /nub bzhin gdu ni 'dzin 'gyur lidang / /nyi ma dang ni zla ba nyid/ /mtshan phyed dag tu gzung (nyagyur nas/ /lha min dbang po'i 0grib ma yis/ /gal te 'jigs (3)shing nub gyur dun/ /shar phyogs 5)gnas pa'i rgyal po ni/ /sdang bas gsod par the tshom 7med/ /rang nyid 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas sam/ /gzhan gyis de ni gsod par 'gyur/ /kla klo yi ni bdag po nyid/ /shar phyogs su ni gsod par byed/ / o ḍa'i 4)yul gyi mi rnams dang / /de tshe rdo rje zhes bdag kyang / /gal te tha skar snar ma dang / /de bzhin du ni bra nye dang / /smin drug dag la nyi zla ni/ /gang 4)tshe 'dzin par snang 'gyur 4nyan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bad kun dang / /mkhris pa dang ni rlung gyur dang / /de bzhin 'dres par gyur pa nibla/ /gzhan yang lus can kun la 'byung ske/ /byis pa dag ni thams cad la/ /rnam pa du ma'i nad rnams 'byung / /gal te rgyu skar mchu dang ni/ /gre dang de bzhin dbo nyid dang / /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang / /sa ga dag gi rgyu skar ni/ /de la nyi zla shar ba na/ /'dzin par the tshom blamed 'gyur zhing / /nyi zla gnyis ni shar phyogs su/ /sgra gcan gyis ni zin gyur yin/ /shar phyogs mi yi bdag po dang / /lā ḍa yul gyi bdag po dang / /aṅga ma ga dhā 7rgyal po/ /mig gi nad kyis 'debs pa 'am/ /bu rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ba 'am/ /de rnams 'chi bas nyer 'jigs 'gyur/ /dgra rnams snang ba'i sems ldan pa'i/she/ /tshogs kyang de tshe 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mgo dang lag dang nab 47so dang / /de bzhin rgyal dang skag nyid dang / /nyi ma 88—627

zla ba 'di dag la/ /sgra gcan gyis zin snang gyur ①na/ /ma ga dhā ②rgyal gnod 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin yul mi dag la'ang gnod/ /blon po nad 'jigs shes par bya/ /'ching dang nyon mongs grong khyer 'gyur/ /lha mtshams ①dang ni snron dag la/ /sgra gcan gyis zin kun la snang / /de tshe nad rnams kun tu 'grol/ /yul mi kun la'ang nad rnams 'byung / /gsod ④dang 'ching dang nyon mongs dang / /gnod pa rnam pa du ma 'byung ⑤/ /'ching dang gzhan gyi yidamag tshogs ni/ /skye bo'i gtso la de dag skye/ /chu stod dang ⑦ni gro bzhin ⑧dang / /de bzhin chu smad kho na la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas dang / /zla ba la ni dmar bar snang / /gza' ni 'dzin par snang gyur pa/ /rtag tu mu ge 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gro bzhin 6)mon gre'i 0rgyu skar dang / /de bzhin du ni khrums stod dang / /gang (7tshe mon gru 8dag la ni/ /gal te nyi zla gzas tsozin te / /gza' ni byung bar shes gyur na/ /kha dog nag pa la brten yinas/ /mya ngan chen po nyon mongs dang / /mu ge kun tu 'byung bar ni/ /yul mi kun la 'byung ba dang / /rgyal po rkun ma'i 'jigs chen 'byung / /nam gru rgyu skar nyid dang ni/ /gang tshe khrums smad dag la ni/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /shar nas sgra gcan 'dzin pa na/ /nub phyogs nas ni nyi ma 'dzin/ /ma ga d+mar snyini mi yi bdag /sems can rgyal po'i thabs nyams par/ /zla phyed gcig gis snang bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu sgra gcan 'gro ba yi/ /mtshan ma 'di dag bstan pa yin / /zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyisatso/ /phyogs ni gang nas zin gyur pa/ /de dang de yi phyogs dag tu/ /dge dang mi dge 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang nyid sa steng 'gul ba ni/ /'jig rten mtshan mas bstan (nepa dag /dge dang mi ——628

dge de dang der/ /de bzhin gzas zin shes par bya/ /khug rna ①ser ba mjug rings ②ni/ /nyi ma lnga yi bar du yod/ /de 'og 'jig rten sems las 'byung ske/ /ngogs la ⑧spyod cing gnas pa yibya/ /yul mi thams cad 'jig 'gyur zhing / /nad kyi gzhi ni 'byung ba yin/ /byang phyogs gang gā'i ⑤'gram gyi ni/ /rgyal po dag kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /de bzhin kha ba can gyi dbus/ /bgrod dka' khyad khrod la yiganas dang / /sa yi bdag po la gnas dang / /kho ra yug na rtse rje dang / /byang phyogs gang gā'i (pe'agram dag na/ /de tshe 'gram spyod bdag po dag /mya ngan gdung ba du ma yis/ /skye bo'i bdag po de 'ching 'gyur / /rgyu skar gang la sa 'gul ba/ /de la khug rna yang dag bstan/ /phyogs rnams ma lus khug rna ni/ /mi bzad 'od ni spangs pa dang / /nyin zhag lnga yi bar du yang / /rtag tu nyin zhag mang por ni/ /phan tshun chos ni mi mthong dang / /mi yi spyod yul mthong ba min/ /mi rnams dag ni phan tshun du/ /der ni mthong bar 'gyur ma yin/ /der ni 'jig ③chen 'byung bar shes/ /rgyal po yul 'khor bcas te 'jig /skar mda' 'khor 6)yug dag tu ni/ /gang ⑩dag las kyis byung gyur pa/ /phyogs kyi mthar ni rab snang ba/ /gnyis dang gsum ni mi bzad yin/ /mtshan mo dbang po'i gzhu nyid dang / /bya rog gal te 'dab (nyam dkar/ /dkar ba'am yang na kha dog nag /yang na dkar dang nag par tsomathong / /phyin log 'dab chags kha dog dang / /phyin ci log gi dus tu sgra dang / /phyin ci log yigi bya rnams yod/ /gang du der ni 'jigs chen 'byung / /rkang gnyis rkang pa bzhi nyid dang / /rkang med dang ni rkang mang 8dang —/ /'dab 7chags dud 'gro srog chags rnamasaXn/ /phyin ci log 'gyur ——629

'jigs chen byung hu)/ /khyi ni gyen du gdong bltas te/ /yang dang yang du zugs gyur pa②/ /nyin par ram ni mtshan mo ru/ /gang du der ni 'jigs chen 'byung / /de ltar rnam pa du ma dang / /rnam mang gang du rab brtags pa/ /der ni char mi 'bab par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i tshogs kyang rnam par 'jig /ji ltar skye ba'i ①skar ma ni/ /dge dang mi dge'i srog chags yin/ /de bzhin mtshan ma gang skyes pa/ /dge dang mi dge gobyed pa yin/ /sngon gyi rgyu ni ma yin pa / /rgyu mtshan cung zad mi mthong ste/ /rgyu med rab tu 'jug byed pa'i/ /bgegs 'byung ba ni yod ma yin/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod (7phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las / skar ma'i dpyad kyi rgyu 6)mtshan shes pa'i le'u rab 'byam las bcwa ⑦brgyad pa rdzogs so(nya// // de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gzhan yang gza' dang (9)rgyu skar dang skar ma dang skar mkhan gyi tshogs rnams la bka' stsal pa/ kye kye gza' dang rgyu skar kyi tshogs rnams 7khyed cag thams cad nyon cig /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i cho ga'i rgyal po 'di las 'da' bar ma byed cig /sngags dang /rgyud dang (1/ dbang bskur 12ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang / cho ga rnams dang /bzlas pa dang / nges par sdom pa dang / rig pa sgrub yo pa la 'jug pa dang /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi cho ga dang / rgyu skar kyi spyod pa dang / rtsis mngon par shes pa rnams kyi cho ga'i rgyal po de la khyed cag rnams kyis 7der bgegs ma byed cig /bstan pa la rab tu zhugs pa rnams la lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis tso——630

kyang de la srung ba gyis shig /sems can ma rungs pa thams cad kyang dgag 6)par gyis shig /bstan par gyis shig /thams cad kyi thams cad du gsod par ma byed cig /stobs bcu dang ldan pa rnams ②kyi bstan pa la rnam ②par gzhag par gyis 0shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas sems can thams cad kyi ma rungs pa thams cad bzlog (9pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams yicad kyi gtsug tor mngon par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rnam par bzhugs ⑦pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang na bzhugs pa la rnam 58)par blta ba'i phyir nye bar lhags par gyur to/ /bsam gyis dzi)mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas nye bar lhags 7pa rang rang gi byin gyis brlabs kyis yibacom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la bos te(nye/ gsungs shig gsungs tunyeshig dpa' bo che/ /'jig rten rnams la'ang phan pa'i phyir/ /sngags rgyud cho ga ji lta yibar/ /sngags rnams kun la rab 'jug phyir/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis skegasungs pa yi/ /gtso mchog yi ge gcig pa ni/ /dus nyams rtsod pa'i dus dag tu/ /sngags rnams kun gyi rab mchog ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs yipa yin/ /gtsug tor rgyal po stobs po che/ /'byung po kun ni zlog 5 par byed/ /gza' dang rgyu skar ma mo rnams/ /ma rungs yo sems ldan 'gog par byed/ /'jig rten bgegs yi/rnams ji snyed dang / /de bzhin gzhan shu nayang gdug sems ldan/ /sems can rnams ni rjes gzung dang / /zlos pa rnams ni bde sa bya'i phyir/ /bstan pa 88—631

'di la cho ga mchog /stobs chen 'khor los sgyur ba yin/ /gtsug tor rgyal po mthu bo che/ /kun la dbang phyug dam pa ni/ /gang gi dus ni 'di yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyod kyis gsungs/ /de skad gsungs nas sangs rgyas rnams / /mi gsung bar ni bzhugs par gyur/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'dus pa de rnams kyis/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can thams cad snod kyi 'jig rten rnams gcig tu 'bar bar gyur la/sangs rgyas kyis ①byin gyis brlabs kyis ②sems can gcig la yang gnod par ma gyur te/ snang ba chen po yang dag par snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas thams cad dang ①ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med dukhang la gzigs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang de na gnas pa'i lha'i bu rnams (snyedang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang bcom ldan 'das dang (6)'khor chen po 'dus pa la bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dgongs su gsol/ yi ge gcig pa 'di ni rig pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor gong nas gong du gnas pa bstan pa thogs pa med pa/ dpag tu med pa'i stobs dang pha rol gnon ⑦pa/ bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor gyi rgyal po 'khor los sgyur ba'i phyag yang ngas bshad par bya'o/ /bstan pa nub pa'i dus su rtsod pa'i dus 'di la bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba de bstan pa 'di la srung ba gcig (kyephur 'gyur zhing dus thams cad du grub par yang po)'gro ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa nub pa'i dus tshod la 'di nyid sangs rgyas bcom ——632

ldan 'das yin te/ bstan pa'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /yi ge gcig po ①'di la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod 'dus par 'gyur ro/ /kye lha'i tshogs dang sems can thams cad nyon cig /rgyutshul/ bcom ldan 'di ni thams ①cad mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas sngags gzugs rnam par ④gnas/ /ston pa thugs rje ①che dang ldan⑥/ /sems can kun la rnam par spyod/ /sngags rnams bdag po dpal dang ldan/ /gtsug tor las byung bstan pa yin/ /snying rje tsodabang la brten nas ni/ /'di ni yi ge gcig tu gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings la brten dunas ni/ /'di ni sna tshogs gzugs la gnas/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sku rnams ni/ /skye bo rnams la sku gdung gyur⑨/ /'jig rten gyis mchod zang zing bcas/ /zang zing med pa'ang khyad par du/ /dam chos sku gdung dag tu bstan/ /'jig rten zang zing med pa'i rgyu/ /sku ni zang zing bcas par gsungs/ /thub pa'i zla ba zag pa med/ /zang zing bcas dang zang zing med/ /'jig rten rgyur ni gsungs pa yin/ /chos kyi ⑩dbyings 7la brten 8nas ni/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 0sems can la/ /'jig rten mgon po 'od byed pa/ /sngags kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa yinardzi/ /sna tshogs gzugs can thams cad mkhyen/ /sa steng 'di la snang ba yin/ /sems can rnams kyis sngags sgrub 8pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa yin/ /sngags 'di yongs su mdor bsdu na/ /rang gis yicho gas 'dir (nyebazlas na/ /sngags rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rtag tu 'bras bcas byed par 'gyur/ /'di yi cho ga mdor bsdus nas/ /dus su yang ni bshad par bya/ /dus mthar thub mchog 'jig rten du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nub pa na/ /de yi dus su cho ——633

ga 'grub/ /sngags 'grub par 6)ni gsungs pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor los sgyur ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor gzhan gyi las kyis ②sbyor ba rnam par 'jig par byed pa/ ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba/ sngags thams cad kyi bdag po/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis don ①du gnyer ba gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i cho ga yi ge gcig pa sngar rgya cher bstan nas/yang mdor ④na re zhig dang po (5)bzlas pas gang du gnas pa las/ dpag tshad lnga'i nang nas ma rungs pa'i (6)gdon thams cad 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /grub pa thams cad kyang nus pa med par 'gyur zhing lha thams cad kyi nus pa ⑦dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po'i 'dod pa ma gtogs par lha thams cad kyang gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa po gzhan rnams kyis (8)grub pa 'phrog par byed cing / gzhan gyi sbyor bas gsang ⑨sngags bcad pa dang bcom pa dang phur bus yo )btab pa'ang thar bar byed do/ /bdag gis gzhan gyi rig 17sngags gcod par 'dod na/ rtswa kyiku sha sngon po chang pa gang blangs la/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags ()pa byas nas mtshon gyis bcad na/ rig pa gang gi phyir dmigs te bcad pa de gcod 8par 'gyur ro / /gzugs brnyan 1)byas te 'dis miseng ldeng gi phur pas snying la btab na gnad la bab par 'gyur ro/ /le brgan du btsos pa'i skud pa la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa bor na bcing bar 6)'gyur ro/ /kham phor tunyekha sbyar gyi nang du brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te kha bkab pa byas na rengs 6)par 'gyur ro / /mtshon chas snying dum bu gnyis su byas na gnyis su gas ( )par 'gyur ro/ /ske tshe la (27dug dang khrag gis btags pas bsku gyu snyeb byas na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /glu 634

ka ra bī ①ra'i lcug mas kun tu brdeg ②na gnod par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gyi rig pa thams cad la mngon spyod bya ba ni ci dgar byar ①rung ngo / /sngar gsungs ④pa'i las thams cad la 'o mas khrus byas nas sbyin sreg byas na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mar gyi sbyin sreg gis ⑤ni thams cad zhi bar 'gyur zhing nyams rtas 6)pa byas par yang 'gyur ro/ /khu metshur bcings pas sngags thams cad rengs par 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis ni dgrol bar bsams pas ⑧bkrol 6)bar 'gyur ro/ /sngags sgrub par 'dod pas kyang 'di nyid kyis bcing ba ⑩byas te bsgrub par bya'o/ /cho ga gang sgrub par 'dod pas (mekyang de nyid 'dis ⑫bsgrub par bya'o/ /sngags sgrub pa dang 'di nyid kyi sngags kyis tunyespyan drang ba bya ba dang tsoyang slar gshegs su gsol ba libya ba yin no/ /gang 'di nyid kyis sung bar 7byed pa thub par dka' bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis sngags 'di ma grub bam lan ma thob na 'di nyid dang lhan cig tu bzlas (/phobarjod byas na/myur du 'grub bam lan thob cing / gal te ma grub bam lan ma byin na de ring por ( mi thogs (7pa nyid du 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /sngags gang la dmigs te zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis til la btags ( note brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg dus gsum du zhag bdun byas pa de 'di'i dbang du 'gyur zhing / gang brjod pa de'i las byed par 'gyur ba'am lan thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha dbang du bya bar (spe'adod na thang shing so gi yam shing gi khri brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na zhag bdun gyis dbang du 'gyur ro/ /klu dbang du bya bar 'dod na mngar gsum gyi soshesbyin sreg bya'o/ /dri za dang dri za mo thams cad dbang du bya bar 'dod na shing mya ngan med pa sa dang pri yang ku'i yam shing ngam me tog gi ru sbyin sreg byas na 88—635

dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo'i gdon rnams ①la ni ske tshes ②bya'ol/ /rgyal po rnams la ni yungs dudakar gyi ④bya'o/ /bram ze rnams la ni me tog gi dusbyin sreg bya'o/ /rje'u rigs la ni zho dang 'o ma dang mar gyi dubya'o/ /dmangs ④rigs la ni phub ma'i rdul gyi nibya'o/ /bud med la ni lan tshwa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /gdol pa la ni mon sran gre'u dang dzam ①bu li ku'i sbyin sreg bya'o / /bu mo gzhon ⑥nu ma la ni 0'bras yos kyi ⑩sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la ni mar dang til gyi ⑩sbyin sreg byas na dbang du byed do/ /thams cad du yang shus gsum du zhag bdun du bya'o zhes gsungs nas/ rgyal ba'i mchog cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /thub mchog bdun pas sngags 'di ni/ /de tshe lha yi tshogs la gsungs/ /'jig rten chos shes grol ba dang / /de tshe de ni chags bral zlosadhi/ /de tshe thub pa mchog gis ⑩ni/ /sangs rgyas sras po thu ⑫bo lha/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /'jam dpal la ni de tshe gsung ⑩/ /lha yi lha ni blo ldan pa/ /mgon po 'khor lo'i bdag po yi/ /cho ga 'di ni rgya che bas/ /gang gi yonyebaskal pa'i tshad du yang / /rgyal bas kyang ni bshad mi nus/ /mi rnams la ni phan pa'i phyir/ /cho ga yi yini phyogs gcig tsam / /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad pa yin/ /de tshe de skad gsungs ⑦ nas ni/ /dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs rdzu 'phrul che/ /gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs pa'i / /sangs rgyas de la skul 87bar byed/ /gsungs 6)shig gsungs shig dpa' bo che/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dus mtha' 'jigs ()pa'i dus su ni/ /mi rnams bde ba skyed (gi )pa'i phyir/ /mthu chen sngags kyi rgyal po ste//gzi brjid chen po 'di yis 69ni/ /ras ris ji ltar grub par 'gyur/ /myur ——636

du ras ris 'grub par ①gsungs/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo ②las / yi ge gcig pa 'khor los sgyur ba 'byung ba'i le'u rab 'byam las bcu dgu pa rdzogs sol// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ④pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal nyon cig /mdor na yi ge gcig pa 'khor los sgyur ba rdzu 'phrul chen po'i phyiras ris kyi cho gar 'gyur ba rgya che ba ni sngar bstan to/ /de ni dus kyi tha ma'i dus su sems can rnams brtson 'grus chung bar 'gyur zhing / shes rab chung ba dang / yid gzhungs 6)pa dman pa'i phyir ras ris kyi tshad rgya che ⑦ba'i sbyor ba sgrub pa nyams ⑧par 'gyur bas/ sems can rnams la phan par 'dod pas zlos pa pos ⑨ji ltar dngos grub mchog thob par 'gyur ba de ⑩ltar ngas mdor bshad par bya ste/ sgrub pa mchog byed par 'dod pas ras ma nyams pa kha tshar ma bcad pa skra dang bral ba dag la tshon ⑩ma 'dres pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das 'drir 8gzhug par bya ste/ chos kyi rgyal po chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor 8ba 'jig rten thams cad kyi bdag po skyes bu dam pa rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tsotog ces bya ba rgyal ba'i mchog chos 'chad pa kun nas 'bar ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa'o/ /'og tu ni tshangs pa dang 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje/ steng du ni phreng ba 'dzin pa'i lha'i bu gnyis 'og tu sgrub pa po de'i mdun du dus gsum du a ga ru sreg cing 'bum ——637

phrag bcu bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas las su bya ba ni dang po ①'khor lo'i sgrub pa byed par 'dod na/ lcags bzang po'i rang bzhin las rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo byas te/ cho 'phrul gyi zla phyed la bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan phyisngar dus gsum du a ga ru'i dud pas bdug cing 'bum phrag bcu bzlas pa bya'o/ /tha mar zla ba nya ba la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas lag pas bzung ste/ ji srid rab tu 'bar ba'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /de bzung na rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis lamathong ba de dang lhan cig nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gdugs bsgrub ④par 'dod na/gdugs (5)kha dog sna tshogs pa sar (6)pa byas la gser gyi 'khor los mtshan pa ka shi ma'i gos 'phyang ba/ de nyid kyi cho gas mgo la gdugs bzung bar gabyas teni/bzlas pa byas na rig pa rang nyid nye bar bzhugs par 'gyur 6)ro/ /'di nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 1 )dus gsum du a ga nyunyaru'i dud pas bdugs (stete / 'bum phrag bcu bzlas pa byas la/ tha mar zla ba nya ba la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas lag pas bzung ste/ ji srid du (sterab tu 'bar ba'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /de thogs cin rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba re re zhing zla ba nya ba dang cho 'phrul gyi zla ba yiphyed lnga'i bar gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'di grub pa tsam gyis 7chos thams cad mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ byu /mngon par shes pa thams cad rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mngon par dgyes pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis khrinarjes su bsngags pa 'grub par 'gyur ro//'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag gi 'khor los sgyur ba stong gi g.yog 'khor dang ——638

ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gtsug tor ①'khor los sgyur ba bsgrub ②par 'dod na/ gser dang / dngul dang / zangs ma dang / nor bu'i rang bzhin gyi dbyug ②pa khru gang tsam byas la 0ji srid rab tu 'bar ba'i bar du bzlas pa byas nas de blang phyin nam mkha' la 'gro ste/ thams cad la chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa chen por 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bum pa bzang po bsgrub ⑥par 'dod na/ gser gyi bum pa bzang po byas la 'bru thams cad dang rin po che dang sman gyis yongs su bkang la/ ras dkar pos bcings ⑦te de la sngags 'dis bsgrub (shepar bya ste/ cho 'phrul gyi zla phyed gcig la brtsams na gnyis pa la 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de la lag pa rab tu bcug na ci (9༄'dod pa de thob cing mi zad par yang 'gyur ro/ /ji ste nor bu rin po che bsgrub tsopar 'dod na gser gyi dbyug 7pa'am/ nor bu bzang po dang shel gyi nor bu byas te⑩/ gos 'phyang bar byas la cho ga 'di nyid kyis bsgrubs na gang bsams tu pa de thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te/ lha dang mi'i nang du thogs skipa med cing stobs dang pha rol gnon par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bcom ldan 'das la bzlas pa bye ba byas na rang gi lus kyis nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i lus thob cing bskal pa chen por 'tsho 7bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gang yang gtsug tor gyi rgyal po gdugs skyedakar po la sogs pa de 5)yang 'dis bcom ldan 'das la 'bum phrag bcu bzlas pa byas na las rnams byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar thogs pa med pa tho de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor /smugazhan gyi rtog pa'i cho gas ji lta ji ltar sa )rab tu sbyar ba de lta de ltar ring po nu )mi thogs ( shepar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la 88—639

'bum phrag bcu bzlas yonyen/ thams cad la 'grub ②par 'gyur ba rig pa dang sngags thams cad kyi bdag po 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ①ste rdo rje bsgrub ④par 'dod na tsan+dan dmar po la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'am yang na lcags bzang po las dubyas te/ ba'i rnam lngas bkrus la yar gyi ngo'i bcwa lnga la ras ris kyi mdun du mchod pa chen po bya zhing mar gyi mar me brgya sbar la dri'i chus rdo rje bkrus te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid phul nas/ gtsug tor gyi rgyal po'i 'khor ram gzi brjid phung po'am/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar po'i sngags 'dis ⑥bsrung ⑦ba byas nil/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du grogs la yang bsrung 6)ba byas nas rdo rje lag pa g.yas pas blangs te/thun dang po 'das shing thun gnyis pa la nye bar 'dug stekyi/ sems rtse gcig pas ji srid rab tu 'bar ba'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /skabs 'dir rig pa 'dzin pa lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin thams cad 'dus te/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyang (1'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag rig pa 'dzin pa'i bstod pa byed cing khyim du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /lus phyag na rdo rje dang 'dra zhing phyag na rdo rje dang 'dra bar mgyogs pa'i mtshan nyid du 'gyur ro/ /skad cig gis 'og min gyi 8lha'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa byams pa mthong zhing chos nyan par 'gyur ro/ /shi (nyenas gang du 'dod pa 7der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs drung du yang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste ral gri bsgrub 7par 'dod na skyon med pa'i ral gri blangs ponas nyin zhag gcig smyung bar ⑩ byas te(nya/ bcom ldan 'das la 88wa 640

mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas ji srid du rab tu 'bar ba'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /de grub ①na g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /skra rna cha gdub kor ②dang 'dra bar 'khyil ba dang / lo bcu drug pa'i cha byad can dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs med cing / rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa dang bar gyi ①bskal par 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste sdong ros bsgrub ④par 'dod na dpa' bo'i tshong gis nyos te/ rgyal dang ldan pa'i dus su zhag gsum smyung ⑤ba byas te/ dge slong bzang po'i dge 'dun la bshos drangs ⑥nas bka' lung stsal par bskul lo/ /sgrub pa po la der rjes su gnang nas rang gi ⑦gnas su rab tu ⑧zhugs ①te/ mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas mar gyi mar me stong rab tu sbar yinas zhag gsum smyung yib byas la/ sems can thams cad la byams pa tsobaskyed nas bdag nyid phul te ldong ros blangs nas/ ji srid grub pa rnam gsum thob pa de srid du bzlas pa (3byas te/ dro ba dang du ba 'thul ba dang 'bar bas sngar gang bsams 8pa nyid du grub 8par 'gyur te/ dro bar gyur pas dpral bar thig le byas na/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /'byung po thams cad dang / sha za la sogs pa dang / 'dzam bu'i 7gling na gnas pa'i sems can bran du 'gyur zhing gang cung zad thams cad sgrub par byed par 'gyur ro/ /lo stong gi bar du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /du ba 'thul ba la 4)ni dpral bar thig le byas na mi snang bar 'gyur te/ gal te 'dod na lha rnams kyis kyang mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /skad cig thang cig yud tsam la snang zhing yang mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mi snang ba thams cad kyi rgyal por yi 'gyur zhing lo sum ()stong gi bar du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /'bar bas ni rig pa 'dzin ——641

par 'gyur te/ g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' ①la 'gro bar 'gyur ro//rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal por 'gyur te/ lha gzhon nu'i lus su 'gyur zhing lha thams cad kyis kyang mi thul ②bar 'gyur na/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis ①lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ bskal par yang gnas par 'gyur ro/ /dus byas nas dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris ④su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ⑤ste mdung rtse gsum bsgrub ⑥par 'dod na lcags bzang po las byas pa'i mdung rtse gsum pa byas te/ lo'i bar du bzlas pa ④bya'o/ /de nas bye ma'i rang bzhin gyi mchod rten khru gang tsam gyi tshad byas te/ /de la mchod pa chen po bya zhing (shegator ma rgya chen po btang la lag pa g.yas pas mdung rtse gsum pa blangs la skyil mo krung yi)bcas nas ji srid du spros pa na/ 'od zer stong byung ⑩ba de'i bar du bzlas pa byas na (nyaskabs 'dir dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa lha rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang lha thams cad kyang ()me tog gi char rab tu 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de thams cad kyis yongs su bskor (rtenas/ gang dag gis snyimathong ba dang gang mthong ba de dang lhan cig tu nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po mig gsum par 'gyur 7te/ dbang phyug chen po gnyis pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyis phyag byas shing / bskal pa chen por gnas par 'gyur la/bltas 7pa tsam gyis gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gang gis kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur nalhonye/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ shi 'phos nas bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste ro langs bsgrub 1nyapar 'dod na/ yan lag rma med ——642

pa'i skyes bu'i ro blangs te0)/ seng ldeng gi phur bu ②bzhis btab la brang gi steng du rin po che'i phye mas gtor cing mchod na/ de'i lce'i rtse mo la nor bu rin po che snang bar 'gyur te/ de blangs ①na rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshon gang dag yid la bsams ④pa tsam gyis (snyede dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'od dpag tshad brgya tsam yidu snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod na dus byed ⑦par yang 'gyur ro/ /gang du 'dod pa der 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag tu yang rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar yang ⑧'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang yi)dri ma med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ro langs gnyis pa sgrub ⑩pa ni rma med pa'i lus kyi ro blangs la7 / rgya shug gi shing gi ⑩phur bus btab la de'i khar lcags kyi phye mas gtor zhing byin na/ de'i lce 'byin par 'gyur te/ de bcad na g.yog 'khor brgya dang bcas te /shenam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ bar gyi bskal par gnas par 'gyur / ri rab kyi 7rtse mor rtse zhing dga' bar 'gyur/ gang gi skutshe 'chi ba de'i tshe phyogs gcig gi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /ji ste lcags kyu bsgrub 8par 'dod na/ rtswa ku sha'i rang bzhin gyi lcags kyu bya ste/// thab /shemo ba mdog nag po'i tsho)lag pa'i mthil gyis ba'i rnam lngas bkrus te/ mtshan mo gcig smyung ri skab byas nas lcags kyu khru gang gi tshad du byas la/ mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas phyag na rdo rje la mar gyi mar me brgya sbar bar bya'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyu dang bdag nyid la gdugs dkar pos bsrung bar ( stobya'o/ /gzi brjid phung pos nu ni dkyil 'khor bcing bar bya'o/ /phur bu la lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa byas te/phyogs bzhir gtor la phur bus da btab na 'og tu bcing ba byas shing gnas ——643

yongs su gzung ba byas par yang 'gyur ro/ /de nas thun gnyis pa la rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis skyil mo krung ①bcas la/ lcags kyu la me tog dang dri dang bdug pas mchod na de bsrung ②ba byas pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas/ skabs 'dir lcags kyu lag pas bzung phyinas ji srid du dmyal ba'i sems can rnams 'tshe ④ba nye bar zhi ba'i bar du bzlas la/ sangs rgyas dang cibyang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal na phyinam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po 'gro ba la thogs pa med pa lcags kyu lag na thogs pa lha thams cad dang klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa yang thag ring po nyid nas mthong na phyag 'tshal bar byed do / /bskal par gnas par 'gyur ro/ / gang gi tshe 'chi ba de'i tshe phyag na rdo rje'i gnas su 'gro zhing phyag na rdo rje mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te ras ris sgrub par gyur na/⑥ de 'bar ba na rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ cho ga gang bsgrub ⑦par 'dod kyang de'i sngags kyi ming bzung la 'bum bzla zhing / de nas (kyinub gcig smyung 6)ba byas te/ mchod pa rgya chen po kyibyas la/ shing arka'i 7me rab tu sbar te til dag la zho dang mar gyis btags 9/3pa'i sbyin sreg (nyestong rtsa brgyad byas na/ sbyin sreg gi mthar 'ongs yinas nor gang 'dod pa de ster bar 'gyur zhing mngag gzhug pa dbang du byed pa bzhin du nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ji ste dbang phyug chen po dbang du byed par 'dod na/dbang phyug chen po la mchod pa rgya tsochen po byas la/ lho phyogs su yud tsam gyis ⑩shing arka'i khyename rab tu sbar la sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas pa na(ste/ ha ha zhes pa'i sgra byung bar gyur na 'jigs par mi bya/ de nas de 'ong bar 'gyur te/88—644

bdag gis ①ci zhig bya zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug chen po'i rig pa thams cad bdag la grub par gyur cig ces smras pa dang / mchog gang 'dod pa de ster bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin du gyur cig ces byas nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du khyab 'jug dang tshangs pa la sogs pa gang yang 'gugs ②par 'gyur te/ mchog gang 'dod pa de'ang 'di bzhin te/ cho ga 'di bzhin du byas bul legs par bsrung ba yang bya'o/ /ci ste gnod sbyin mo dgug par 'dod na/ de'i ming bzung la zhag bdun du shing mya ngan med kyi me tog gis sbyin sreg byas na 'ong zhing mchog ster bar byed do/ /zhag bdun gyis ma dang sring mo dang chung ma gang 'dod pa de'i cha byad du nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste mi 'ong na mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /klu mo dbang du byed par 'dod na klu shing gi me tog gis cho ga ④'di bzhin du bya'o/ /srin mo ⑤dgug par 'dod na/ zla ba gsum du zho dang 'bras chan ⑥gyi sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi mthar zhag gcig smyung rtsib byas la/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod cing gnod sbyin la gtor ma chan ⑧rnams sbyin par byas shing gnod sbyin dgug par bya'o zhes yid la byed cing / /a mra'i shing gi yam shing 6)zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags ⑩pa stong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na/ skabs 'dir lus ngan po la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin 'ong bar 'gyur la/ de dag la shing arka'i ⑫me tog gi mchod yon byin na de dag ci zhig bya zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /des tsobarjod par bya ba ni nyin re zhing gnod sbyin lung bzhin du byed tu pa dgos so zhes brjod par bya ste/ des gnod sbyin tsore re ster bar 'gyur ro/ /des tsolung bsgo bar bya ba ni dpag tshad brgya nas bud med rnams 'dir 'ong bar gyis la 88—645

tho rangs de 0)nyid du khyer cig ces pa dang 'khor brgya la yang 'bras chan ②byin cig ces brjod na(kyi/ rgyab tu khur nas gang du 'dod pa der 'gro zhing khyer bar 'gyur ro/ /lung gastsal ba thams zhi)cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste phyag na rdo rje bsgrub (6)par 'dod na bzhi 'gyur ⑦dang bdun 'gyur (8)gyi sngon du bsnyen pa byas la/ cho 'phrul gyi zla ba 5)phyed po ma lus pa la rab tu rgya che ba'i mchod pa byas la ji srid zla ba nya ba'i bar du ste/ zla ba nya ba'i bar du mchod pa byas la dge slong gi dge 'dun khyad par can dag la 7bshos gsol nas/ 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin kho na 9/nyal rjes su yi rang bar byed du gzhug go/ /de nas mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas yinadang po'i thun 'das te gnyis pa'i thun la skyil mo krung (srebacas te 'dug la/ sems rtse gcig pas rdo rje 'dzin blta bar bya'o/ /zhes sems la kun tu brtags skote/ gu gul gyi ril bu ⑩rgya shug gi 'bras bu'i tshad tsam gyi ⑩mtshan mo / 7thun gcig tu sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi yul bskyod 4nyapar 'gyur zhing / sa 'gul ba dang sprin gyi sgra sgrogs (7par 'gyur ba dang / rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad me tog gi char rab tu 'bebs 6 )par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 2nya'adir bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje ( rinarig pa thams ( snyecad kyis yongs su bskor ba dang rig pa mchog la sogs pa'i rig pa'i yirgyal pos yongs su bskor ba byon par 'gyur ro ge/ /lha thams cad dang / klu gu thams cad dang / gnod sbyin thams cad dang / dri za dang mi'am cis sanyabyang chub sems dpa' yongs su bskor ba byon par 'gyur ro/ /de'i mod la dmyal ba'i sems can rnams kyi shin tu drag pa'i tshor ba'i sdug bsngal nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dri'i tsho 7chus mchod yon dbul zhing phyag 'tshal te 'dug par bya'o/ /88wa 646

de nas rdo rje 'dzin gyis 0)gsungs pa ni mchog ci zhig sbyin par bya/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba nyid dam phyis 'og tu 'gro ba'am rgyal srid dam mi snang bar 'gro ba'am zhugang 'dod pa de nyid bcom ldan 'das las thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba nyid dang rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi 4)'khor los sgyur ba rdo rje'i ①sku dang / phyag na rdo rje dang 'dra yib dang bsams (3)pa tsam gyis (nyamatshan ma thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa chen por gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe 'dzin pa de'i tshe 6)rdo rje'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur royi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gzhan dag gi yang cho ga 'di bzhin te/ mdor na phyag na rdo rje'i cho ga gang yin pa dang ske/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 4)cho ga gang yin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis ()gsungs pa'i cho ga gang yin pa dang / tshangs pa'i cho ga gang yin pa dang / dbang phyug chen po'i cho ga gang yin pa dang / mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa gang yin pa de dag kyang 'di nyid kyis sgrub tunyepa byas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sngags gang gis sgrub 8pa byas kyang ma grub pa ni 'dis tsolus la bzlas pa byas na/ nub bdun gyis tshunges par mthong ba sbyin par byed do/ /ji ste mi sbyin na ni rnam par nyams par 'gyur ro / /dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha'i mdun du gal te zlos yonapa byed na nub bdun gyi nang du mthong ba sbyin par byed do/ /gal te sbyin par mi byed na mgo tshal pa bdun phrag gsum du 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba dang nyi ma gzas zin pa na mar dang shu dag dang mig sman dang dag byed dang so shing dang mchod phyir thogs dang ba bla dang ldong ros la sogs pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /ji ste rdzas ——647

rnams bsgrub ①par 'dod na/ ldong ros blangs ②te mi'i 'o ma dang sbyar ba ①byas la ril bu lngar bya zhing / a ga ru'i snod kha sbyar gyi nang du bcug cing yungs kur dudang lhan cig bsgrub par (snyebya'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma gzas zin dupa'i dus su gtor ma'i cho ga byas te(7/ gang gi tshe yungs kur nitsi ti tsi ti zhes sgra 'don pa de'i tshe grub ⑨pa dang po yin te/ skye bo thams cad dbang du 'gyur la de'i tshe 'di thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur te/ gang smras pa de thams cad byed do/ /ji ste du ba 'thul bar byed na mi snang bar byed pa thams cad kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /bar gyi bskal par 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe 'bar bar gyur pa de'i tshe ni lha gzhon nu'i gzugs kyisu 'gyur zhing / nyi ma 'char ku'i gzi brjid dang ldan la 4)rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/bskal ⑩pa chen por 'tsho bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du gi wang tsodang ba bla la sogs pa la'ang bsgrub par bya'o/ /ci ste mig sman bsgrub ④par 'dod na/lig bu mig dang ut+pa la sngon po dang ru rta dang tsan+dan dag gcig tu byas te(nye/zangs ma'i snod du gzhag la zla ba gzas zin pa'i dus su ci srid du ba 'thul ba de srid kyi bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ / de nas ⑩mig la bskus na mi snang bar ⑩'gyur te/ ci ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs dang mi snang bar byed pa thams cad kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /ji ste ral gri bsgrub 6)par 'dod na ral gri ma nyams pa blangs 67la/ mar ngo'i tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la ras ris la so mchod pa rgya chen po dang gtor ma btang zhing bsrung ( nyeb byas na(nya/ ral gri lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste ste/ ji srid 'od 'phro ba dang 'bar ba de srid kyi bar du bzlas pa byas na/ gal te 'od 'phro na ni rig pa 'dzin pa gcig pur 'gyur ro/ /——648

'bar bas ni de rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba dang / stobs dang pha rol gnon pa thogs pa med pa dang gang gis mthong ba dang gang mthong ba de dang lhan cig nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste rdo rje bsgrub ①par 'dod na lcags bzang po'i rang bzhin las rdo rje byas te②/ sor bcu drug pa rtse mo gnyi ga yang gartse gsum pa tsan+dan dmar pos byugs dul/ cho 'phrul gyi zla rjophyed kyi tshes nas brtsams dunas ras ris la mchod pa rgya chen po byas te bzlas pa bya ④zhing / tshes nas nyi ma re re zhing re res bskyed pa'i dge slong dag la bshos drang bar bya'o/ /tha mar nub gsum smyung ⑧ba byas la sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun du ras ris rab tu bzhag cing / mchod pa rgya chen po ⑨byas la/ mar gyi mar 7me brgya rab tu sbar zhing ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug par bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyis yirdo rje bzung (nyal ji srid 'bar ba de'i bar du bzlas pa bya zhing ⑫/ de bzung na de 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje dang 'dra bar 8pha rol tsoganon par 'gyur/ bskal pa chen por 'tsho bar 'gyur / lus zhig nas phyag na rdo rje'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur ro⑩/ /de bzhin du mdung rtse dang 'khor lo dang mda' dang mdung la sogs pa mtshon thams cad dang mchil lham dang so shing dang mchod phyir thogs la sogs pa gzhan gyi cho ga'i bya bas bsgrub par bya zhing / thams cad kyang grub pa rnam pa gsum yin no/ /zhi ba byed par 'dod pa la pad+ma'i rnam pa yina'adra ba'i thab khung byas la/ mchod sbyin la 'os pa'i yan lag gis me rab tu sbar la blugs (shegazar gyis ()zas mchog dang zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar dang sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg 88—649

stong rtsa brgyad zhag gsum byas na/ bdag dang gzhan zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun gyis 0)ni grong ngam grong khyer gyi 'chi ba mang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /shing sha ma'i ( yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags ①pa'i sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad kyang bya'o/ /yang na shing u dum bā dura'i yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags ⑤pa'i sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad kyang bya'o / /char mi 'bab pa la ni mngar gsum gyi (6)sbyin sreg byas na thams cad du mchog tu zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /slong ⑦mo'i zas za zhing cho 'phrul chen po'i zla phyed kyi zla ba nya'i bar du (8)nub gsum smyung 6)ba byas la/ zla ba gzas zin pa na (lhab nag mo'i 'o ma la (nyalan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags (nyate 'thungs ⑫na bcud kyis len gyi yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rtswa drur ciba'i 'jag ma la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags 8pas stong rtsa brgyad nub bcu'i bar du sbyin sreg byas na 7dus ma yin par 'chi ba rab tu zhi zhing tshe ring bar 'gyur ro / /rgyal mtshan dang dung la sogs pa la mngon par bsngags na/ mthong ba dang thos pas pha rol gyi sde dpung gis 6)mi g.yo bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /bum pa sar pa 1)'bru thams cad dang spos chus bkang ba la (7lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas pas log 'dren gyis gtses shing zin pa bkrus te dbang bskur na dpal dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'dis dbang bskur ( nyan sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur te/ dkyil 'khor gyi las dang gdon gyi (nyalas rnams kyang byed par 'gyur ro/ /rma bya'i mjug ma la lan 'bum bzlas brjod byas na dug thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyis rims ( nyadang mig gi nad dang gzer thabs la sogs pa sel bar byed do/ /srung ba'i skud pas ni nad thams 88wa 650

cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i ji skad gsungs ①pa'i sngags kyis seng ldeng gi yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags ②pa'i sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas na lha ma yin gyi sngags 'joms ①par byed do/ /dus gsum du nyin mtshan nyi shu rtsa gcig la 'bras ④bug po che la zho dang sbrang phyiri dang mar gyis btags ༅pa'i sbyin sreg stong stim brgyad byas na longs spyod thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha dbang du bya bar 'dod na a ga ru'i yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis 6)btags pa'i sbyin sreg dus gsum du nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la stong rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /'bras thug po che la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags yo)pa gcig tu byas pas sbyin sreg byas na zas mi zad ⑩par 'gyur rol/ /gnod sbyin dbang du byed na gu gul gyi ril bu la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags (1pa'i sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /shing mya ngan med kyi yam shing gi ⑩ni gnod sbyin mo rnams la bya'o/ /klu rnams la ni klu shing gi yime tog gis tsobya'o/ /'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la ni a ka ru'i yam shing gis bya'o/ / rig pa tso'adzin pa la ni po son cha'i shing gi ⑩yam shing gis tu so/ /a ga (nyeru'i yam shing la tu ru ska'i 'bru 5)mar gyis btags pas gu ni dri za la sbyin sreg bya'ol/ /yi dgas ( nyernams la sgo ni bil ba'i shing gi yam shing gis so/ /mi'am ci rnams la ni sra 6)rtsi pog gi sbyin sreg gis so/ /log 'dren thams cad la ni zhag bdun du sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad (3 rabya'o/ /rgyal po'i bu la ni yungs kur ( getil mar gyis btags rdzu lhapa dus gsum du zhag bdun la sbyin sreg brgya rtsa so brgyad bya zhing / nyi ma la mngon du phyogs nas bzlas brjod 'bum byas na sdig pa thams cad las rab tu grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rig pa thams cad tshim par byed par ——651

'dod na ba gcin dang nas kyi kha zas za zhing rtswa ①su shi ra las gzugs brnyan byas te/ me tog dkar pos mchod cing 'o ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyis ②sbyin sreg byas nas 'o mas khrus byas te/ bzlas pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing a ga ①ru'i dud pas bdugs na tshim zhing rgyas par byas par 'gyur ro/ /lan gcig bzlas pas bdag bsrung ④ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /dulan gnyis bzlas pas gzhan bsrung ⑥ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /lan gsum bzlas pa byas pas rdzas bsrung ⑦ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /lus chad pa dang zhom pa dang dug gis 2reg pa dang phur bus yo)btab pa rnams la rtas par yi byed par 'dod na sman u shi ra las gzugs brnyan du byas te/ me tog dkar pos mchod la 'dis yigatsug tor gyi ⑫rgyal po'i ras ris kyi mdun du yungs kur 8gyi rgyal po la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis ④btags la sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas na rig pa nye bar dmigs nas phur bu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ji srid du bzlas kyang rig pa 'bras bu med par shes na gi wang gis grog snyil bris te⑩/ gro ga tu)de la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags (nyepa tu)byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa rgya chen po byas la/bcom ldan 'das 'di dang lhan cig stong rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ ku sha'i stan de nyid du gnyid so)log na rmi lam du 'ongs 0te 'bras bu med pa'i rgyu ston par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste me tog pad+ma bsgrub 6nyepar 'dod na/ tsan+dan dmar po las pad+ma byas te ste/ mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas zhag gsum smyung ( )ba byas te/pad+ma lag pa g.yas pas bzung 6nyal ji srid 'bar ba de srid kyi bar du bzlas pa byas na/ g.yog 'khor nyi shu dang nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ thogs pa med par ⑩'gro bar 'gyur/——652
