bsams ①shing don du gnyer/ /myur du sngags grub ②kho na la/ /de dag thams cad ston par byed/ /ci 'dod mngon par re ba dag /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob/ /sngags pas slar ni gshegs gsol ba/ /myur du mchod yon phul nas 'gyel/ /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis ①ni/ /snod ni yang dag bsrung ba bya/ /sems can lus ni 'gyel ba yang / /sa yi steng du nyal ba nyid/ /gtsug tor sngags dang ldan pa yi/ /sngags ni cho gar gsungs pa dag /de nyid kyis ni bsrung ④ba dang / /phyag rgya gtsug phud lnga yis so/ /de tshe lus ni bde legs 'gyur⑤/ /sa yi steng las ldang bar 'gyur/ /sems can kun la'ang 'jug pa yi/ /srung ba 'di ni rab tu brtag /snod la brten ༷te 'tshe byed par/ /gdug ⑦pa'i sems can gyis mi nus/ /skye bo snod du gyur pa la/ /'di ni srung ba chen po yin/ /de yi nitshig ni bar mar gnas/ /dbus kyi yul gyir ⑨rab tu bsgragasam/ /lha yi skye gnas la brten pa'i/ /'og min gzugs dang ldan pa dang / /de dang de yi rtags rnams dang / /gzugs ni rab tu snang ba yin/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug dang / /'dod dang ldan pa'i lha dag dang / /de las dman pa'i 'gro ba'i rtags/ /tshig nyid kyang ni shin tu snyan / /de nas sa la gnas pa dang / /gzhal med khang gnas lha rnams kyi/ /tshig ni ku sha'i grong khyer mtshungs/ /ma ga dhā ()yi gnod sbyin tshig /de bzhin aṅga'i 7yul gyi tshig /lto 'phye chen por hunyerab tu bstan8/ /gzi brjid chen po nam mkha' lding / /de dag shar phyogs tshig tu 'gyur/ /bang 8ga'i yul du yang dag skyes/ /gang dag tshig tu ⑩bstan pa ni/ /de bzhin mi 'am ci yi tshig /de yi tu)tshig tu rab brtag bya/ /rtag tu piṇ+ḍa'i tunyetshig gyur pa/ /grub (nyedang ral ——703

gri'i rig pa 'dzin/ /de tshig ①rig pa 'dzin pa dang / /drang srong 'dod pa'i gzugs can yin/ /de tshig mngon shes lnga dang ni/ /drang srong rnams kyis ⑧yongs su brtagasal/ /gang yang yul tshig ma ga dhā/ /gang yang ha ri ki la'i dutshig /mi gsal mi dod nyid dang ni/ /yi ge ta ⑤la shin tu brten⑥/ /la yi yi ge mang ba'i tshig /sha za'i tshig tu brjod pa yin/ /las tshon zhes bya'i gling dang ni/ /na li ke ra 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gling ni rtsub par byed nyid dang / /gcer bu stobs ldan bu gnas kyang / /sems can dag byed gnas pa dag /de bzhin 'di dag gling las byung / /yi ge la mang tshig dag dang / /tshig ni gsal ④ba'i rnam pa med/ /mi gsal nibasri ba med nyid dang / /khro khyabacas ⑩yi dgas skye (meganas tshig /lho phyogs pa yi ⑩tshig dag dang / / an+d+ra kur ṇa ⑫dra bi ḍā/ /sems can ko sa la 'brog gnas dang / /sing ga ④la yi gling dag na / /yi ge ga dang rar 8bcas pa/ /de ni srin po'i tshig tu shes/ /de dag gling la gnas pa de'i/ /ming ⑩ni gang zhig brjod ⑩pa yang / /ma mo rnams ni gzi ()brjid che/ /de yi tshig 'dir gsungs ⑩pa yin/ /tshig ni nub phyogs phyogs mtshams (1dang / /ma la ba yi tshig dag dang / /be'u 0nya dang rgya mtsho'i tshig /shu ra se yi rnam brtags dang / /rgya mtsho bcu 'dus chu bo 'dus//dpal mgrin dang ni ko dz+wa ( )ri/ /'di dag tshig ldan 'jug pa ni/ /nyi ma la sogs gza' mchog gdon/ /de las gzhan gdon dugatso bo ni/ /yul ni ba ri ya tra'i tshig /yul ni cisar bu 6)ta sa h+ya/ /ri ni mā (nyal yar gnas dang / /lang 8 7ba'i yul du yang dag skyes/ /tshig ni ci 'dra yod pa yi/ /de 'dra'i tshig tu smra ba ni/ /grul bum skye gnas 'dzin pa yin/ /yi ge sha ṣa sa dang ni/ /ra ——704

la ①ba las yang dag byung ②/ /yi ge gha dang ldan pa'i tshig /lha ma yin du nges par bstan/ /kha che'i ①yul las byung dub dang / /skye ba'i gnas ni dhika bi sha /gnod sbyin rgyal po'i rigs las byung / /phyag na rdo rje'i rigs su bstan/ /de dag lnga yi gtso bo ni/ /kun gyi tshig tu 'dod pa yin/ /de bzhin dbus kyi phyogs gnas dudag /pad+ma'i rigs kyi skye gnas rten/ /tshig dang 'gros ⑦dang mtshan ma yang (kyi/ /pad+ma'i rigs su snang ba yin/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis rnam brtags ⑨pa/ /snga ma nyid du bstan ⑩pa yin/ /'dod chags bral ba'i mtshan ma gang / /rgyal ba'i mtshan mar rab tu 'byung / /yul phyogs gang gi tshig smra ba / /der gnas 'gros dang spyod pa yin/ /der bstan sems can nyid dang ni / /'gros dang mtshan ma'ang kun tu bstan/ /kha ba can gyi nang gnas pa/ /dri za drang srong skye bo'i tshig /gang gā'i ngogs ⑩kyi byang phyogs pa/ /gnod sbyin tshig tu rab tu snang / /ri ni 'bigs (nyebyed la gnas pa/ /gang gā'i tso'agram gyi lho phyogs dang / /dpal gyi ri bor 8skyes gyur dang / /gang yang skye bo rnam 8dag ni/ /srin pa 8skar ma yi dgas dang / /ma mo cha lugs ngan pa dang / /mi bzad gzugs can bgegs chen po/ /gdon ni shin tu ma rungs pa / /brkam ⑩zhing gzhan gyi srog 'phrog ()byed/ /de yi tshig ni yang dag 'byung / /gang dag yul ni de dag brtagatso /de dag yul gyi 'gros dang spyod/ /de dag tshig tu smra ba ni/ /ma rungs pya gdon 'jug rnam spyod yin/ /'di dag gzhan yang mang po ni/ /gang gi spyod 'gros spyod pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs tshul dang ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mtshan nyid dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sems can gtso/ /rnam pa sna tshogs skye gnas 'dod/ /de ltar gdon 'jug mtshan ——705

ma ni/ /mtshan nyid 'gros dang spyod pa yin/ /mi rnams kyi ni bde skyed pa/ /sems can du yang bya ba ste/ /gzhon nu sna tshogs yang dag 'byung / /bsrung ba'i don du rab sbyar bya/ /yi ge drug pas bya ba ni/ /phyag rgya ①chen po dang ldan pa'i/ /sngags nyid kho na bzlas byas na/ /bsrung ②ba chen por 'gyur ③ba yin / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gdon 'jug pa'i spyod pa'i cho ga'i le'u rab 'byam las/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa rdzogs sokhyi// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas/ gzhan yang gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa / 'jam dpal khyod kyi sngags rnams rgyud thams cad la yang dag par 'jug pa / rig pa thams cad la 'os pa/ dus dpag tu med pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i 'bras (9bu 'byung 6)ba yang rjes su 'brel ba'i mtshan ma'i tshad yod de/ de 'grub par bya ba'i rgyur ⑦bshad pa ni 'di lta ste/ skye ba gzhan gyis 'grub ⑧pa nyid / /dus kyi rgyus stini 'grub pa med/ /de yi tshad dang sbyor ba ni/ /sngon byung rgyu las byung ba yin/ /rtse gcig bdag gir byed pas 'grub/ /grub pa rigs pa rnam dpyod ⑩pa'o/ /rigs (7pa gzhon nu khyod bsten ⑩na/ /lus can kun la rab tu snang / /mthar gyis byas pa'i las rnams ni/ /rigs 8pa zhes ni bya ba yinabi/ /dpa' bo'i rigs ldan de sbyor bas/ /grub pa mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /grub med bsgrub 7bya'i las rnams med/ /las rnams med par 'grub pa'ang med/ /las dang byed par yang dag ldan/ /yang dag ldan 88—706

pas grub pa 'thob/ /cho ga ldan pa'i rgyu yis ni/ /gnas pa mchog ni thob par 'gyur / /sngags pa sngags ni mi sgrogs ①na/ /sngags min pa yang sngags par 'gyur / /thub pa'i las ni yang dag spyod/ /grub pa rgyas pa thob par 'gyur/ /rigs ②kyi sa bon la brten na②/ /blo yi mchog la gnas par 'gyur/ /gnas mchog dam par des sdom na/ /dang po'i ④bgrod pa thob par 'gyur/ /blo dang bsam pa legs gnas na⑤/ /nad med go 'phang 'thob 0par 'gyur/ /gang gi ⑦dus dang mtshan ma las/ /dus min grub par 'dod pa ni/ /mdor na brgya byin yin na yang / /de yi sngags rnams mi 'grub bo/ /'byung po skye bo mi phan dang / /dus min par yang rtsom ⑧pa yang / /bdag nyid chen po tshangs pa yang ske/ /de la grub pa mi snang ngo / /snyom khyidang sred dang yang dag ldan/ /dregs dang nga rgyal ldan pa dang / /lhod dang yun 7ring 'thab la dga'/ /grong gi skye bo la rtag yidaga'/ /le lo phan tshun sbyor ba la/ /'di la grub pa ga la yod/ /gang yang lha yi bla ma dang / /gang yang rtag tu lha min bla/ /sngags rnams de dag gis bsgrub 8kyang / /cho ga spangs tson nus med yin/ /de bzhin cho ga'i las nyams yin/ /sems ni rnam par rmongs par byed/ /de bas sngags ni bzla 8mi bya/ /cho ga med par rigs pa min/ /byis pa rnams kyis mthong ⑩ba rmongs/ /de lta bus ni skyed par 'gyur/ /de bas byis pa rmongs ⑩pa yang /shin tu dka' ba'i 'gro bar lhung / /de nas de dag sngags spyod pa/ /de las de dag drang ba yang / /mthar gyis 8de dag grub pa ni/ /dge ba 'gro ba rab tu 'thebayi/ /de las zlos pa'i sngags pas ni/ /mi g.yo zhi ba'i gnas su 'jog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngags bzlas ( )pa/ /de ltar sngags rnams don ——707

yod de/ /sems can mig zur gyis bltas ①pa'ang / /rjes su gzung ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ /'di dag sems can mnyes ②gshin pa'o/ /'di dag grub par bstan pa steni/ /theg gsum mnyam pa nyid zhi ba / /de bas rnam kun rab 'bad nas/ /mnyam par bzhag cing sngags zlos bya / /sngags zlos rab tu sbyor byed pa/ /sngags ni cho ga med par spyodadu/ /yun ring dus su 'khor ba na/ /nam zhig cig na grub ⑤par 'dod/ /shin tu yun ring dus ⑥song nas/ /sngags rnams grub par snang ba'o/ /cho ga ldan pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /myur du grub pa rab tu 'thob/ /'bras bu 'grub ⑦par mthong ba ste/ /'bras med sngags ni gsung ba min/ /gsang sngags 'bras dubu ldan pa ⑨ni / /tshe 'di nyid la grub par gsungs/ /grub byed ⑩'bras bu las ma yin/ /las med par yang 'bras mi 'dod/ /'bras bu las dang yang dag ldan/ /'bras bcas las su bstan pa yin/ /de bas skye dang rga spangs pa/ /de ltar yang dag byung gyur payi/ /'jig rten zhi bar gsungs (nyepa ste/ /zhi ba srid las rnam grol yin/ /bdag nyid chen po der 'gror gtogasatso/ /sangs rgyas chos ni rjes su bstan8/ /'jig rten phyin ci log dus su/ /de la grub pa ⑫rab tu snang / /tshe 'di nyid la'ang grub ⑩'gyur te/ /tshe rabs gzhan du'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhi ba'i lam ⑩ni 'dus ma byas/ /mthar thug zhi ba'i bar ridu 'gyur/ /gang du 'jig rten rnam bstan pa/ /zhi ba'i gnas ni dri med bzang ske/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni legs bstan pa/ /rgyal bas kun tu bstan 8pa yin / /de la mthar ni de dag phyin/ /sngags grub par ni gsungs pa yin/ /rang rig so so'i rgyal ba yis(nye/ /sngags 'di bstan pa ma yin te/ /thub zla zhu ——708

rdzu 'phrul chen po yis①/ /'jig rten dag la sngags bstan to/ /tshe 'dir lus can rnams la ni/ /mngon sum du ni grub pa bstan/ /de nyid stong pa rig ② pa yis / /sngags ni sangs rgyas nyid du ston/ /rtsod dus tha ma'i dus dag tu/ /zhi ba'i de nyid khyad ④par du/ /sngags 'grub par ni mi 'gro zhing / /myur ba'i las la'ang 'grub pa med/ /de yi dus su sbyor ba ni/ /cho ga mthong ba'i las dag gis/ /sngags rgyud shes pas (gyesgrub bo zhes/ /bstan pa 'di la thub pas gsungs / /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa na/ /grub mchog myur du grub par 'dod / /de bzhin bar ma'i dus dag tu/ /bar ma'i grub pa nye bar bstan/ /tha ma'i dus la brten nas ni/ /tha ma'i grub par gsungs pa yin/ /bzang po yi ni dus dag la/ /de bzhin nam mkhar 'gro ba dang / /sngags rnams kun ni rab 'grub ⑥par/ /'jig rten 'dren ⑦pas bstan pa yin/ /de dus rgyal ba'i dbang po ni/ /rigs kyi mchog de rab tu 'grub(nya/ /pad+ma'i rigs ni bar mar 'grub/ /dus kyi mtha' la rdo rje'i 6nyerigs/ /kha cig smon lam dbang gis ni / /thams cad du ni sngags rnams 'grub/ /spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dpal dang / /sgrol ma khro gnyer gnod sbyin rgyal/ /rin chen rigs spyod gnod sbyin ni/ /dus rnams kun tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /lha rnams kun gyi sngags gzhan ni/ /gang yang chags can gyis yirab sbyar/ /rtsod pa'i dus su 'grub 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten pa yi (stebastan pa'ang 'grub/ /lha dang mi dang lha min gyi/ /dbang po gnod sbyin srin po dang / /drang srong nam mkha' lding dang ni/ /sha za 'byung po gza' spre tshogs dang / /mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / /'dod pa'i khams na gnas pa yi/ /bsod nams ldan pa rdzu 'phrul che//——709

ma rungs las ni mi bzad ①ldan/ /brgya byin tshangs ②pa drag po dang / /dbang ldan de bzhin gzhan dag kyang / /khyab 'jug 'byung po thams cad dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i ③sngags rtsibastan pa/ /de dag dus kyi tha ma la/ /bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /de dus 'jigs pa chen po la/ /snang ba'i las ni de bzhin 'grub/ /'byung po dbang dang ⑤dgug bya ba/ /sa steng sha za'i las dag 'grub/ /don med grub par snang ba ste/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu smod//des yin rgyal ba'i dbang po yicha/ /de dus 'jigs pa chen po yang ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis yang dag bstan/ /kun la rjes gzung gtsor byas nas/ /zlos pa la ni sngags gzugs kyis6)/ /zlos pa bstan pa la dad cing / /dkon mchog gsum la mchod byed la/ /de tshe sems can sngags gzugs kyis/ /gdul bar byed par 'gyur ba yin/ /'phags pa ⑩'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po ⑩shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las cho ga nges par sdom pa'i dus kyi le'u rab 'byam tshulas/ nyi shu rtsa drug pa rdzogs so(ste// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gzhan yang thams cad dang ldan pa'i chaganas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon cinur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyi cho ga'i rgyal po chos kyi dbyings kyi mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu mthun pa'i rjes su spyod pa/ mdo chen po'i mchog /rin po che'i le'u de bzhin gshegs pa'i rmugasang ba'i mchog 8rjes su gnang ba/ sngags kyi mchog ——710

sgrub pa lu rgyu mtshan shes pa dang rtags dang dus gzhan shes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnams nges par bstan cing yang dag par bstan rnal/ /'byung po thams cad kyi sgra sgrogs ②pa dang sems can dang sems can ma yin pa'i ming gi sgrar 'gyur ba ni / sgra las byung ba'i ming du shes pa dang sgra las byung ba ma yin par bstan pa dang de bzhin du 'dren ma dang ldan pa'i sngags rnams ni rnam pa gsum du bya ba yin te/ sgra bzang yang dag ldan pa dang / /rtag tu don dang rab tu 'brel/ /zur chag tshig dang rtag tu bral/ /legs par sbyar don gyis brgyan pa/ /phyi rol grub mtha' yod ma yin/ /'phags pa'i sngags su rab tu bsgrags / /rtag tu tshig don ldan pa ste/ /rnam pa gsum gyi dbye bar 'gyur/ /ring dang thung dang de bzhin du/ /bar ma'i yi shes ④brgyan pa'ang yin/ /sngags kyi lha mor gyur pa duni/ /dbyangs yig sdeb yisbyor gyis brgyan pa/ /ngag ni legs sbyar legs sbyar min/ /ci ste don dang don med min/ /don ldan tshig dang don med tshig /sngags don rnam par gsungs pa ( )yin/ /rnam rtog mang po'i tshig dag ni/ /'jig rten pa rnams kun gyi nisngags6)/ /gcig dang gnyis kyi yi ge dag /sdeb 0sbyor dbyangs yig bzang po'i gzhiyi/ /gsum dang bzhi dang lnga dang drug /de bzhin bdun pa brgyad pa yin/ /dgu pa bcu pa de bzhin du/ /yi ge dag ni grub par 'dod/ /yi ge bcu dang yang dag ldan / /yi ge rnams kyi gnas pa mnyan8/ /ji srid 'di dag bcu 'gyur ni/ /sa steng 'di la yi ge mthong / /yi ge drug dang nyi shu dang / /yi ge gcig gi bar du 'gyur/ /'di tsam tshad kyi yi ge ni/ /sngags kyi tshig ni rtag tu sbyar/ /rkang pa bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /sngags ni don khu kun sgrub pa'o/ /mchog ni ——711

rab mchog don ldan pa①/ /sngags ni gang zhig rgyal bas gsungs/ /de sras rgyal ba'i sras dag gis②/ /gsungs pa dag ni bar ma yin/ /'jig rten kun gyis ②bstan pa yi/ /sngags ni tha mar gyur pa yin/ /bden bral gyis bstan rjongan pa'ang yin/ /bcwa dubargyad bdun nam nyi shu 'am/ /brgya dang lnga bcu dag gi bar/ /'di tsam tshad kyi sngags rnams ni/ /rgyal ba 'phags pas gsungs pa yin/ /gcig dang gnyis kyi buyi ge dang / /lnga brgya'i yi ge'i bar 'gyur ba / /de tsam tshad kyi sngags rnams ni/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑦rab tu gsungs / /de nang (0tshig ni dgod pa dang / /sngags dang ldan par brjod pa yin / /sdeb 6)sbyor ldan zhing dbyangs yig ldan/ / khams kyi don gyis ⑩rnam par brgyan/ /tshig dang legs par rab ldan dang / /rgyud dang rigs 0par ldan pa dang / /sgra dang dbyangs yig rnam bral ba/ /nam zhig na ni grub par 'gyur / /legs par rab ldan sgra rnams kyang / /skye tsobo drod gnas rkan 'dang ni / /so mchu lkog ma'i sgra dag ni/ /sbyar ba bzhin du rim gyis 8'byung / /mi gsal brjod las eldog gyur pa/ /legs par rab ldan brjod pa yin/ /yongs rdzogs tshig dang sgra dag dang / /yang dag ldan pas bsgrub ⑩par 'gyur/ /sgrub pa nyams dang bya ba nyams/ /sgra dang don dang rnam bral na/ /myur du sngags rnams mi 'grub ste/ /yun ring ()dus su 'gor ba yin/ /de la grub pa ruyong (3med min/ /log par yang ni de mi byed/ /skye ba gzhan du'ang snang ba ste//sngags grub mchog kyang ster bar 6)'gyur0/ /yun ring 0dus su bzlas pa yis/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis 9 )ni/ /sngags rig skye 69bo'i sngags de ni/ /don med las ni byed ma yin/ /sngags rnams kun kyi tha ma ni/ /mi ma yin pa'i 'jig ——712

rten pa/ /'byung po kun ni ser snar bcas/ /gang yin des ①ni sngags bstan pa'o②ske/ / yi ge gang dag des bstan pa/ /dugacig dang gnyis kyi grangs dag dang ske/ /rnam pa sna tshogs kla klo'i byaskad/ /yul gyi skad du bstan pa stekhya/ /phreng du bsdebs dang ldan pa dang / /sgra ni 'dres par gyur pa yin/ /de dag yi ge gcig pa nas/ /rtsa brgyad stong gi bar du'o/ /tshig rkang bzhi dang rkang med dang / /rkyang 0pa tshigs su sbyar des bstan/ /tshigs ⑦bcad rgyun chags ⑧cha dag dang / /tshigs ⑨bcad tshigs su brjod pa yin/ /yang dang yang ni brjod don ldan/ /gsal ba'i don gyis brgyan pa yin/ /zur chag ⑩legs sbyar sgra nyams yikyang / /don ni rab tu brtag 8pa yin/ /mi gsal gsal ba med pa dang / /yi ge nyams kyang 'dod pa yin/ /'gro ba yul dang rnam bral ba / /de la'ang sngags ni 'grub 8par brjod/ /de ltar sngags rnams kun la ni / /rtag tu phan pas rigs ④par gsungs/ /zag med zag bcas thams cad kyitso/ /sngags rnams 'di yi mtshan 'di yiyin/ /gang la yi ge sa mang zhing / /oṃ ni ta yis brgyan ⑩pa ni/ /de las 8de yi mod la ni/ /de dag la ni nges 'grub tso'agyur/ /dang po ()sngags ni yi ge oṃ/ /mtha' na yi ge ma yod la / /yi ge sa ni rkang par 0ldan/ /de bzhin ta yis dubar mdzes shing / /ta yi rnam pa zur dubazhir ldan/ /mtha' gnas yi ge rnam par spangs(ste/ /ra gnyis ldan pa yi ge ta(ste/ /sngags rnams kyi ni grub pa byed/ /dang por ra gnyis mang ba dang / /yi ge hūm̐ gi yon tan yodabya/ /yi ge tsa ni gru bzhir snang //de dag yi ge sgrub par brjod/ /yi ge bha ni rar ldan zhing / /yig mthar ma dang yi ge gnas/ /dang por ma ⑦dang mang yi ge/ /de ni sngags kyi mchog tu ——713

bstan / /gang yang yi ge na mang zhing / /rgyud rnams kun la snang ba yin/ /sngags de dag ni zhi bar gsungs/ /gshin rje hūm̐ gis brgyan pa yis① yi ge bha ni mang ba de②/ /dbang po ①rlung gi phyogs su gsungs/ /yi ge ba ni chu lhar gsungs / /'jig rten phan zhing rgyas byed yin/ /sngags gang yi ge e mang ba/ /dbang chen de ni rab tu snang / /dang po dkon mchog gsum skyabs 'gro/ /gang yin sngags ni de bzhin duli/ /phyag 'tshal ba la rab 'jug dang / /zhi ba'i rgyu dang bde ba byed/ /de las gzhan pa'i lha rnams la'ang / /phyag 'tshal don du rab tu sbyar/ /sngags dang rgyud la rang gi sngags/ /rang sngags las ni thams cad pa/ /gang la yi ge ra mang zhing / /mtha' na yi ge phaṭa hūṃ bcas/ /'di dag sngags ni gdug (nyapa che/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing gzi mdangs ①che/ /mi zhi ④srog gcod byed pa ste/ /gdug ⑧pa'i sems can dag la sbyar/ /khyad par du ni 0sdig yod pas/ /de bas las de mi bya'o/ /rtag tu thub pas spangs pas na/ /'bad de zlos pos 7spang bar bya/ /sngags ni zhi dang rgyas pa dag /gnyis kyi don ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /las la ji srid gsungs pa dag /skad cig gis ni thams cad 'grub/ /'di dag sngags ni legs bzlas na/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul che/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sngags kyis ⑩ni/ /zhi ba'i las ni bya ba yin/ /rin chen rigs kyi 7bya ba ni/ /rgyas pa'i las ni thams 7cad do/ /gang dag sdig pa'i las rnams kun/ /mngon spyod la ni rab tu sbyar/ /mngon par spyod pa'i las rnams ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyis tsobya ba yin / /'jig rten mgon gyis tsobakag na yang / /gnod sbyin dbang la rab tu bstan / /sems can rnams ni gdul ba'i 7phyir/ /sngags kyi che ba'i bdag ——714

nyid gsungs/ /rigs ①gsum nyid kyis ②thams cad du/ /rnam pa gsum du bstan pa yin/ /thub pa nyid kyis ③rigs dag ni/ /gang yang brgyad du yang dag bstan/ /grub pa de dag rnam gsum 'gyur/ /rnam pa gsum du yang dag bstan④la/ /mchog dang bar ma tha ma ni/ /de dag rnam pa gsum 'byed pa/ /zhi dang rgyas pa dag dang ni/ /mngon spyod par ni 'dod pa yin/ /sngags dang ldan pa nyid dag dang / /rgyud dang ldan pa kho nar bstan/ /sngags kyi 'gro ba'i bdag nyid che/ /mngon par spyod la sbyar ba yin/ /'di dag las ni mi 'dod de / /thub pa mchog gis dusmad pa yin/ /shin tu nyam yingar gyur kyang ni/ /srog la gnod las mi bya'o/ /mdor bsdu na ni ma 'dres par/ /las kyi bdag nyid chen por bstan/ / der ni rigs ⑦dang cho ga ⑤sngags/ /las ni rgya che rgya che ba/ /cho ga'i rgyal po 'di la gsungs/ /rgyud gzhan dag la'ang snang ba yin//las nyams ⑨rnams ni mi bsten ⑩cing / /sngags rnams kun la rigs (nyepar ldan / /'jig rten sngags rnams ji snyed pa/ /de bzhin cha bcas 'cha med pa'ol/ /'jig rten 'das pa thams cad kyang / /'di 'dra'i yon tan shes par bya/ /sngags grub grangs ni med gyur kyang / /de grangs yongs su brjod ⑫par bya/ /dang po grangs gcig 8'byung ba ste/ /de bzhin nyi shu'ang ldan par 'byung / /de nas mdor na sum cu ste/ /de las gzhan yang bzhi bcu yin/ /de phyed bsnan na drug cu ste7/ /de bzhin bcus bsnan bdun cu yin/ /de steng bcus ⑩ni bsnan pa la/ /brgyad cu'i chagangs su gsungs pa yin/ /de la bcus (nyebasnan dgu bcur gsungs/ /bcu gzhan gyis bsnan brgya yin te/ /brgya yi grangs kyis chabagrang ba yisorte/ /de dag bcu la stong phrag gcig /stong ——715

phrag bcu la khri yin te/ /khri bcu la ni 'bum phrag gcig /'bum phrag bcu la sa ya ste/ /sa ya bcu la bye ba yin/ /bye ba bcu la dung phyur ste/ /dung phyur bcu la ther 'bum ①yin/ /de bcu ②ther 'bum chen por bstan/ /de bcu la ni shu ②rdog ste/ /shu ④rdog bcu la mchog nyal yin/ /mchog nyal bcu la rkyang phye ste/ /rkyang phye ①chen po de bcu yin⑥/ /de bcu la ni khyad phyin yin/ /khyad phyin ①chen po de bcu yin/ /de dag bcu la sgyu mar brjod/ /sgyu ma chen po de bcu yin/ /de bcu la ni mtsho yas zhes/ /'jig rten 'dren pas gsungs pa yin/ /mtsho yas chen po de dag bcu/ /mtsho yas chen po de bcu la/ /dug chen pa yi rgya mtsho yin/ /de dag nyi shu'i phyed la ni/ /dug chen rgya mtsho chen po yin / /dug chen rgya mtsho bcu la ni/ /mchog yas (nyazhes ni brjod ⑨pa yin/ /mchog yas bcu zhes ⑩bstan pa ni/ /ban bun dag tu rab tu bstan/ /ban bun de dag bcu la ni/ /de ni ma lus pa zhes brjod/ /de dag nyi shu phyed (sprel ni / /ma lus chen po zhes su brjod/ /de tshe grangs kyi tshad du ni/ /'jig rten 'dren pas gsungs pa yin/ /bcu yi grangs kyis 8bcur byas na/ /grangs ni grangs med ces su brjod/ /grangs med bcur ni bsgyur byas na/ /de las gzhan du dpag med yin/ /dpag med stong du bsgyur byas na/ /'jig rten zhes ni yongs su bstan/ /'jig rten de bcu 'jig rten che/ /'jig rten chen po bsgres 6nyabyas na/ /de 'og mun pa zhes su brjod/ /mun pa las ni snang skibar brjod/ /snang ba chen po de dag bcu/ /de bcu la ni phung por brjod/ /phung po de bcu bsgres na ni/ /phung po chen por de brjod do/ /phung po chen po de bcu la/ /'di ni zab pa zhes brjod do/ /zab pa las ni brtan 8par ——716

brjod / /brtan pa la ①ni rab brtan 'gro/ /de nas gong ②du mang ldan yin① / /mang por 'dod pa ④gnas su brjod/ /rtsis shes dam pas gnas su brjod / /de nas gnas ni chen por 'gro/ /chen po'i gnas zhes 'dod pa yin⑤ / /dpag dang dpag med mnyam byas nasaX/ /de don chen por yongs su bsgragasaX/ /don chen rab 'byor gnas dang ni/ /de nas ⑧rgya mtsho chen por 'grodhi/ /dang po rgya mtsho chen por ⑩bstan/ /dang po'i yidang por phan pa dang / /dang po mchog ces bya bar 8bstan/ /mchog las tsogatso bor brjod pa ste / /gtso las khyim gyi ming yin no/ /de ni ④bsam mi khyab par brjod/ /bsam mi khyab las mi bzad gzugs/ /mi bzad gzugs las rgyal 8thabs 'dod / /rgyal thabs las ⑩gzhan gter yin te/ /de yi 'og ma dge ba yin/ /dge ba'i pha rol sems las byung / /de las gzhan pa ⑩sems byung che/ /sems las sems ni rnam par tsogayeng / /brjod pa zhes ni de la bya/ /brjod pa las ⑩ni brjod med nas/ /bsnyad gu yas su yang brjod pa yin/ /bsnyad ⑥yas las gzhan bsnyad ( nyeyas che/ /de tshe ( nyephyar phyur zhes kyang brjod/ /phyar phyur las ni phyar phyur che/ /shu rdog de bzhin shu rdog che/ /rtsis ④kyi pha rol phyin pa'i gnas/ /dge zhing zhi ba zhes su bstan/ /de nas bgegs chen mthong ba ste / /chu 'byung zhes ni de las brjod/ /chu 'byung de las sems 'phrul nasatso/ /de las gzhan pa dam pa yin/ /de las pha rol sangs rgyas yul/ /de las (nyegazhan ni 'phel byed sa/ /'jig rten mi yi 6)rtsis dag ni/ /bgrang bar yang ni mi nus so/ /de las gzhan du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang dang ni spyod yul yin / /sangs rgyas zhing ni gang gā'i ⑥klung / /bye ma snyed du brjod pa ni/ /——717

bsdus nas rdul gyi tshogs dag ni/ /'dren pas bstan 67pa mdzad pa yin/ /'di dag dper ni byas ②pa ste/ /tshad ma shes pa'i spyod yul min/ /rgyu yis dngos po bsgrub bya ste/ /rtsis kyi pha rol phyin mi nus/ /'di tsam rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /sngon ni nga yis ①bsnyen bkur byas/ /dpag med bskal pa dag tu ni/ /de dag la ni mnyes byas nas/ /de tsam dus kyi mthar thug par/ /nga ni byang chub sems dpar (gegyur/ /sems can don ni bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du'ang yang dag bstan/ /de dang der ni bdag gi dusngags/ /cho ga rgya chen bstan pa yin/ /cho ga yi ni rab mchog 'di/ /sangs rgyas 'di dag kun gyis gsungs/ /'di tsam tshad kyi sangs rgyas kyis⑥/ /sngon chad 'di ni gsungs pa yin/ /dus kyi tha ma'i skye bo la/ /gzhon nu nga g.yang nga yis bstan / /ji snyed 'jig rten sngags rnams dang / /cho ga'i rgyal po'i snod dang ni / /de bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa dang / /mi dang lha dang lha min dang / /thams cad kun gyi sngags rnams ni/ /rgyud nidang rigs par rab tu bstan/ /cho ga'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /gang du kun gyis yongs su bkur6)/ /de dag cho ga zhib mo yis/ /'jam pa'i ngag ni 'grub ⑩par 'gyur/ /'jam pa'i ⑪dbyangs kyi cho ga ni/ /'di nyid kyi ni zhib mo zhes7/ /de dag 'grub par gsungs pa ste/ /thams cad kun pas mthu ldan 'gyur/ /gang yang mi yi 'jig rten dang / /gang gzhan sngags kyi lha mo dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i sngags kun dang / /'jig rten rdzu 'phrul che dang bcas/ /'di nyid tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /cho ga'i rgyal pos 'grub pa nyid/ /sngags rnams kun dang cho ga kun//'di yi dbang du 'gyur bar tu bstan/ /cho ga'i rgyal po bla med 'di/ /gang du ——718

'jam dpal gyis ①rab bzhed/ /gang yang bzo ni rnam par shes/ /'jig rten pa yi 'jig rten 'dod/ /rgyu mtshan shes dang la nye bzang / /skar ma'i dpyad kyi rtags ②dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan shes dang spyod pa dang / /sgra skad dge dang mi dge dang / /'byung po kun gyi skad shes dang / /spyod dang sems kyi spyod pa dang / /zur gyis shes ③pa dag kyang bshad/ /de bzhin gter lta nor sgyur byed/ / rtsis dang brda dusprod bstan bcos dang / /gos kyi rim pa'i cho ga dang ske/ /nang rig gso ba rig pa dang / /de nyid thams cad phan dang bde/ /gtan tshigs lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / /gzhan yang sgra yi bstan bcos bstan / /sdeb ⑤spyor rig byed dri za'i glu/ /spos sbyor dag kyang bstan pa yin/ /bdag gis byang chub sems kyis ⑥ni/ /sems can don phyir bshad pa yin/ /bdag ni byang chub sems sngon ④gyur/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor sngar gnas tshe/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis su ni bshad pa yin/ /'khor ba'i dgon pa'i (9tshang tshing du/ /bdag ni 0yun ring dus su gnas/ /ji ltar gdul bya'i sems can la/ /de ltar bdag gis de bzhin byas/ /ji lta ji ltar sems can rnams/ /phan pa'i las ni len pa dag /phan don las kyis dge ba'i tshugazhi/ /de lta de ltar 'di dag byas/ /sna tshogs las kyis bsgyur ba yi/ /sems can 'gro ba'i skye gnas dag /'di dag bya ba sna tshogs byas / /sna tshogs skye gnas rab tu bstan/ /las rnams sna tshogs ldan pa yis/ /sna tshogs don gyi (nyabastan bcos bstan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs ldan pas8/ /'di la de bzhin byas pa yin/ / /sna tshogs 'gro ba'i skye gnas su/ /bdag gis 8de bzhin cha byad byas/ /phan pa'i bsam pas sems can la/ /sna tshogs ——719

gzugs ni bdag gis sprul/ /dbang phyug brgya byin tshangs pa sogs/ /khyab 'jug nor sbyin bden bral dang / /sna tshogs gza' yi gzugs ①sogs kyang / /de tshe sngon ni nga yis 6sprul/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang gyur nithugs/ /sems can bsam pa'i spyod yul can/ /de dag la ni rim gyis su/ /zhi ba'i gnas la bzhag pa yin/ /'khor bar phan tshun 'gro ba na/ /yun ring dus su thogs ④pa ni/ /sems can rnams kyi don bsgrub ⑤phyir/ /sngags kyi tshul gyis bstan pa yin / /yun ring 'khor ba'i skye bar ngasayi/ /sangs rgyas rigs la brten ⑦ri nas ni/ /ye shes sngags dang cho ga ni/ /mthar gyis bstan par byas pa yin/ /byed pa dang ni bdag po'ang rung / /nga la gang yang yod min te/ /nges pa'i rigs (8)la brten nas ni/ /nga ni 6)sangs rgyas byang chub mchog /bde ba nad med yang dag zhi/ /dri med mya ngan med zhi ba/ /ngas thob mya ngan 'das zhi ba/ /skye ba'i 'ching 7las nga rab (1grol/ /yang na 'khor lo rab bskor zhing / /yang dag mtha' la brten nas ni/ /sngags kyi tshig ni rgya chen dang / /cho ga 'di ni nga yis bstan/ /las dang cho ga rgya che ba/ /zlos (nyapas don med mi bya'o/ /'jig rten ji snyed sngags rnams dang / /cho ga dag kyang rab bstan pa/ /de kun mchod cing ri mor bya/ /de dag la ni brnyas pa spang / /cho ga rgya chen de dag kyang / /des (sten sngags pas brnyas mi bya/ /rgyu mtshan shes dang rig ④pa dang / /skar ma'i dpyad 'ishes skad shes pa/ /'di dag don med mi bya ste/ /bkra shis don du bstan pa yin/ /mthong ba'i chos kyi don du yang / /grub pa'i rdzas sogs sman dang ni/ /zang zing bcas par mig ṇisman 'grub⑩/ /de las bkra shis 'grub 18pa yin/ /rab bsngags 19rgyal ba'i tshigs (lhabacad dang / /——720

bde legs tshigs ①bcad kyis brgyan ②pa/ /rab bsngags zhag ni bzang po dag /yar ngo dag gis legs mtshan pa/ /gza' semachog dkar ba dag ldan la / /sngags sgrub 0pa ni brtsam ⑤par bya/ /de la sogs pa'i dge dang ldan/ /mi dge dag kyang spang bya ba/ /nga nyid kyis ni sngon bstan te/ /de bas zlos pas gzung bar bya/ /'jig rten ji snyed gang su dag /skar ma'i dpyad stil mkhas pa dang / /gzhan gyi rgyud la mkhas pa dang / /lugs kyi bstan bcos gtan tshigs tshubacas/ /rig (shepa'i bstan bcos legs ⑨'brel ba/ /sems can rnams la phan byed gang / /de kun nga yis sngon gsungs te/ /sngags zlos pas ni gzung bar bya/ /lam 'di grub pa'i rgyu yin par/ /de nyid gzigs pas bstan pa yin/ /grub pa'i mtha' ni mtha' dag kun/ /gang yin thar pa'i rgyur gsungs pa/ /sngags kyi lam gyi 7grub pa'i rgyur/ /nga nyid kyis ni byas pa yin/ /sngags kyi rig (7pa mtha' dag ni/ /zlos pas don med mi bya'o/ /'jig rten pa yi sngags kun dang / /dam par yang ni rab bstan dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten 'das bzang po(nye/ /thams cad kun la rab sbyar bya/ /sems ni log par mi bya ste/ /yid kyis tunyenam yang sun mi dbyung / /sngags rnams kun la mchod byed pa/ /dam tshig shes pas 8rab tu bstan/ /sangs rgyas dgongs shing phan pa yinayi/ /de bzhin ston pa'i bstan pa la/ /rab zhugs rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyang / /zhugs par rab tu shes pa yi/ /thub zla'i dkyil 'khor dag la ni/ /'di ni dam tshig shes par gsungs/ /rtag tu sngags rnams don yod de/ /yang dag bsams yipa thob pa yin/ /gzhan dbang ngas ni ma byas te/ /brnyas pa dag kyang spyad ma yin/ /sngags rnams ——721

'phags pa ma yin pa'ang / /de dag don med byas min brjod/ /'jig rten ji srid sngags ①rnams sam/ /yang na gzugs su byung ba'ang rung / /kun nas nyon mongs mthong lam mtha'/ /de dag 'bras bu yod par bstan/ /khros dang zhe sdang ldan pa yis②/ /don med par ni mi bya'o/ /mi 'dod gus pa med pa yil / /las ni mi bya 'bras bu med/ /de dang ④'brel ba'i sems la ni/ /nam yang de la sbyin mi bya/ /rtag tu mnyam par bzhag nas ni⑤/ /sngags tshig ldan par bzlas byas shing / /cho ga ji bzhin gzung dubyas na/ /'bras bu mtha' dag thob par 'gyur/ /yid ni g.yo med byas nas kyang / /sngags gcig ⑦de ni bzla bar ⑧bya/ /sngags ni don kun sgrub pa stel/ /rtse gcig sems kyis 'grub ⑩par 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid g.yeng ba'i sems/ /de la grub ⑩pa 'grub mi 'gyur/ /gang la yid ni dag pa dang / /bstan pa la ni rab dad pa/ /'bras bu mtha' dag 'grub pa ste/ /'gro ba dam pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa ni/ / 'dod pa'i grub par nye bar bstan/ /'phags pa tso'ajam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ las dang bya ba dang cho ga dang rgyu mtshan shes pa'i le'u rab 'byam (nyalas/ nyi shu rtsa bdun pa rdzogs soli// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gzhan yang gnas gtsang tsoma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa / 'jam dpal khyod kyi phyag rgya skradang sngags rab 'byam ⑩mchog tu shin tu ——722

gsang ba nyon cig /ma dad pa'i sems can dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la mngon par dad pa med pa dang / dam tshig med pa dang 6)/ gnang ba ②med pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun gcod par byed pa dang / mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ①yongs su zin pa dang / bsod nams mi 'dod pa dang / skye bo sdang ba dang / 'grogs shing 'dres pa dang / sdig pa'i grogs pos ④yongs su zin pa dang / sangs rgyas dang chos las thag ring du gyur pa dang / cho ga 'di la ⑤'bras bu med par gyur pa dang / slob dpon gyi byaman ngag med pa dang / gzhon nu khyod kyi ⑦gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la dbang ma bskur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la dam tshig ma mthong ba dang / skye bo mngon par mi 'dod pa dang / snod du ma gyur pa'i sems can rnams la (kyebastan par mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas chos la ma dad dang / /byang chub lam 6)ni ring gyur la/ /de la phyag rgya mi sbyin ⑩zhing / /rgyud nyid kyang ni bstan mi bya/ /bag med rmongs 47par gyur pa 'am/ /yang na gal te chags pas byin/ /zlos pa phyin ci log byed la/ /de la sngags ni mi 'grub bo/ /phyag rgya nye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /sngags nyid kyang ni gzhan du 'gyur/ /myur du grub pa 8mi 'thob cing / /de yi lus kyang nyams (nyepar 'gyur/ /zhi zhing dad pa'i ④sems ldan dang / /der ni dam tshig mthong ba dang / /rgyud dang sngags la rab zhugs la/ /phyag rgya rgyud ni bstan par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod byed dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan la rab dad dang / /cho ga'i sbyor ba mthong ba dag /de dag la ni phyag rgya bstan/ /byang chub sems kyi cho ga shes/ /byang chub sems kyis ⑩rnam par brgyan/ /rtag tu byang chub lam la gnas/ /de dag ——723

la ni phyag rgya bstan/ /sngags ①dang rgyud la rab brtson ②zhing / /phan tshun brgyud ②pas dam tshig mthong / /byang chub chen por rjodam bcas pa/ /de la phyag rgya rab tu bstan/ /rgyal ba'i sras po dag dang ni/ /de bzhin nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /mthong ba'i chos kyi 'bras thob gang ⑤/ /de la phyag rgya rab tu bstan⑥/ /chos rnams la ni rnam rtog med/ /dad cing ser sna bral ba dang //ston pa'i bka' la rigs par shes/ /de la phyag rgya rab tu bstan/ /rtsa brgyad brgya ⑦yi tshad du ni/ /'di dag phyag rgya phyag rgyas btab/ /lhag dang nyung ba ma yin par/ /mngon sum sangs rgyas kyis rab bshad/ /'jam dpal gang gi cho ga la/ /sngags ①kyang de dang mnyam pa yin⑨/ /brgyad bcas brgya zhes gsungs pa dang / /sngags rnams de dang mnyam par bstan/ /phyag rgya'ang brgya ni rtsa brgyad du/ /thub pa mchog gis 7sngon gsungs so/ /'di tsam tshad du cho ga la/ /phyag rgya sngags ni yang dag 'byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzod 7nyid ⑫ni / /sngags kyi mdzod du nye bar bstan/ /phyag rgya sngags ni mnyam ldan na/ /yang dag ldan pas las myur byed/ /'khor lo med pa'i shing rta ni/ /rigs (1par 'gro bar ④mi 'byung ste/ /de bzhin sngags rnams ma lus pa/ /phyag rgya med par las mi byed/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mnyam ldan zhing / /yang dag ldan pas myur las byed/ /lha dang lha min bcas pa yisnyi/ /'jig rten gsum kun ci'agugs yibyed na/ /las gzhan dag gis legs sbyar ba'i/ /mi yi 'jig rten smos ci ⑩dgos/ /mthong chos 'bras bu 'di dag gi/ /phyag tunyergya sngags la snang ba yis/ /gnyi ()ga ldan zhing dag pa dang / /cho ga ldan pa'i don bstan na / /rgyal ba mchog dang sras rnams dang / /'byung po rnams ni 'gugs 4 )par ——724

byed / /sngags dang phyag rgya dka' thub nyid/ /rnam gsum las ni legs ①gnas dang / /ci 'dod phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /de bzhin zlos ②pas thob par 'gyur/ /sngags rnams phyag rgyas ②phyag rgya btab/ /sngags kyis ①kyang ni de rgya ⑤btab/ /sngags ni phyag rgya med pas min/ /sngags kyang duphyag rgya spangs pas ⑦min/ /phyag rgya sngags ni mnyam ldan na/ /yang dag ldan pas las kun byed / /'di dag phan tshun 'bras bu ste/ /phan tshun 'bras bu 'byung ba yin/ /sgrub pas rigs ldan sbyar byas na/ /bsgrub bya min pa'i las rnams med/ /phyag rgya ldan pa'i zlos pa pos/ /sngags rnams ma lus 'grub par 'gyur/ /cho ga mthong bas rab brtson zhing / /sngags dang phyag rgya kun byas na/ /gang du 'gugs ⑧'gyur mi 'thob pa/ /de gnas de ni yod ma yin/ /srid ⑨rtse mnar med bar dang ni⑩/ /'jig rten khams kyi 'gro ba gzhan/ /gang du mi 'bebs mi 'gugs (7dang / /bsgrub bya ma yin gang yang med/ /sems can skye gnas las skyes dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mi snang ba'ang / /cho gas bskul nas mi 'gugs pa(nye/ /de ni gang yang yod ma yin/ /srung ba'i cho ga'i rgyud dag gam/ /las 'grub 8bzlog par bya ba la/ /sa bcu tsol ni gnas pa yi / /byang chub sems dpas 8kyang mi nus/ /sngags dang phyag rgya la gnas la/ /'byung po kun gyis ⑩mi tshugs so/ /dka' thub bzlas ⑩pa cho ga'i lam/ /sbyin sreg las la rab sbyar na/ /'di las skye (nyezhing tunyede las grub/ /phyag rgya sngags la snang ba yin/ /zlos pa rtag tu 'bad brtson zhing / /rtag tu de dag la gnas na/ /sngags rnams grub 6 )par 'gyur ba ste/ /don yod 'gyur bar ⑥thub pa'i bka'( gye/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung dag ni/ /de dag gis 4)ni glu 725

gzhan du byed①/ /sngags dang rgyud ni rigs ②pa la/ /gang zhig rtag tu mi 'jug pa'o/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mtha' dag ni / /gang zhig cho ga ldan byed pa'o / /'jam dpal gzhon nu 'di dag ni/ /yang dang yang du bstan pa yin/ /sngags kyi rig ༷pa mtha' dag ni/ /phyag rgyas sngags ni phan pa 'byung rjo/ /de srid las la cho ga'i 0rgyal/ /'dis ⑦ni 'bras bu rgya chen 'byung / /'jig rten gsang mchog phan pa dang / /sngags dang phyag rgyas dam bcas pa/ /de nas rigs ldan 'jam dpal teni/ /khyab par byed pa 0byis pa'i gzugs/ /cung zad 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyur tshuganas/ /gzhon nu sna tshogs yang dag 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus 7che/ /sa bcu la ni gnas pa yis8/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen gyur pa/ /thub pa mchog la rab tu zhus/ /bcom ldan sngags kyi rgyud 8dag ni/ /gang yin 'di ni 'jig rten bstan/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas dag gis kyang / /de yang bdag la gsungs pa yin/ /de ltar shākya ⑫seng ge yisasnyi/ /ci yi phyir na ⑩rab tu gsungs/ /bdag ni de ltar the tshom ⑩'tshal / /thub pa mchog gis (3bdag la gsungs/ /blo ldan ka la ping ma'i skad / /tshangs pa yi ni gsung yo)dbyangs kyis63/ /sa bcu la ni tshurab gnas pa'i / /byang chub sems dpa' la gsungs pa/ /sngon ni bskal pa mang po ru/ /nga ni 'khor bar 'khor ba na/ /thub dbang me tog kun skyes ()las/ /cho ga'i ji rgyal po'ang nga yis nyithob/ /de dang der ni sems can la/ /phan pa mang po byas pa yin/ /thugs rje'i dbang du song nas ni/ /de tshe bdag gi cismon lam byas / /sangs rgyas mchog tu de tshe bdag /dus kyi mthar ni yang dag byung / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas ni/ /bstan pa'i don ni byas pa yin/ /phyi ma yi ——726

ni dus dag tu/ /de tshe nga ni mya ngan 'da'/ /de ①na cho ga'i rgyal dbang po/ /khyod kyi drung du nga yis bstan/ /nga yang 'jig rten mya ngan 'das/ /'dzam ②bu'i gling ni rab stongs shing ③/ /de bzhin ston pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /rtsod dus duthag ring gyur pa na⑤/ /sems can rnams la bstan pa'i don/ /cho ga'i rgyal po gcig byed 'gyur/ /cho ga'i rgyal po rgya chen la/ /de bzhin 'di ni yang dag 'jug /sems can rnams ni don la brtson/ /de ⑥yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur / /de dus 'jigs gsu rung ba yi/ /de tshe sems can chos ldan min/ /rtag tu lus dul mi gnas shing / /rgyal po rnams ni ma rungs ⑨yid/ /mi dang mi ma yin rnams ni/ /kun kyang bstan la rnam par sdang / /ngas bshad chos kyi mdzod rnams ni/ / nga yi 0thams cad 'jig ⑩par 'gyur/ /de dag gdul ba'i don gyi phyir/ /sngags kyi mdzod ni nye bar bstan/ /bskal pa bsam mi ⑫khyab par sngon/ /gzhon nu khyod kyi smon lam 'di/ /sangs rgyas ji snyed gang su dag /'jig rten gnyen gyur mya ngan 'das/ /de dag bstan pa'i don du ni/ /dus dang dus su bya'o zhes/ /bdag ni byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /dus kun tu ni rnam par spyod/ /sngags kyi 8gzugs kyis 8sems can la/ /de dang ⑫der ni rnam par 'dul/ /gzhon nu khyod kyi yismon lam 'di/ /sngon chad du ni byas pa yin/ / nga ni ⑩byis pa'i gzugs thob gyur/ /des na khyod la bshad par bya/ /skye bo skyabs ni med pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhing ni stongs pa na'/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis yisems can la/ /byis pa'i tshul gyis yang dag shod/ /sems can mang po 'dul byed cing / /phun sum tshogs pa sbyin byed pa(nye/ /dus kyi tha ma de la ni/ /sems can kun la mchog sbyin byed/ /'jig rten nga ——727

ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng ni stongs gyur ①na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ②ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can nang ①yod pa yiX/ /chu bo gser dang ldan 'gram du / /nga ni mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che dutheg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ phyag rgya bskul ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal gyis yiyongs su zhus shing bstan pa'i le'u rab 'byam las/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa rdzogs sophyi// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dushākya thub pas gzhan yang gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya'i mdzod yang dag par bskul khyab zhes bya ba'i ⑩ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 0so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mdzod spu nas 'od zer du ma bye ba khri phrag ()brgya stong grangs med pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa byung ste/ /'od zer gyi dra ba du ma des sangs rgyas kyi zhing du ma gsal bar byas nas/sangs rgyas thams cad la yang dag par bskul nas/ phyir yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mdzod spur tsozhugs par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la yang dag par bskul ma thag tu nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin 5la snyoms par zhugs te/ gnas gtsang ma'i steng gi nam mkha'i dkyil du bzhugs skipar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal phyag rgya'i le'u'i cho ga'i ⑩mdzod sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ⑩byin ——728

gyis brlabs pa bshad kyis ②nyon cig /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ①zhabs la btud de phyag 'tshal phyinas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzod kyi phyag rgya mchog tu shin tu gsang ba gang yin pa de dus la bab par mkhyen nadu/ bcom ldan 'das de ni legs te bshad du gsol/ skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo mang po la bde ba dang 'jig rten la snying brtse ⑤ba dang skye bo'i tshogs mang po'i don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir dang lha dang mi rnams dang sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba dang bde ba'i rnam par smin par 'gyur ba'i slad du'obya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la ⑦'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gsol ba btab nas/ phyag rgya thams cad la gzigs shing sangs rgyas thams cad la mkhyen par byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rab tu dga' bar byed pa/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par tshim par byed pa/ 'phags pa'i sngags rnams la yid brtson par byed pa la yang dag par gzengs stod (kyepa/ ma rungs pa yo)thams cad zlog 0par byed pa/ 'jigs 0pa thams cad dbugs 'byin par byed pa/ 'khor bar gnas pa dag la bde ba dang shis pa dang ༷mya ngan las 'das pa la rab tu 'jog par byed pa/ sems can sdug bsngal ba (nyethams cad la bde ba'i don gyi phyir phyag rgya'i (stele'u'i cho ga ngas bshad kyis yona'ajam dpal gzhon nu nyon cig /dang po gtsug phud lnga pa ni/ /de ni phyag rgya chen por 'dod/ /gnyis pa gtsug phud gsum pa yin/ /ral pa gcig pa gsum pa ste/ /bzhi pa ut+pa lar gsungs pa/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs ——729

sangs rgyas/ /lnga pa bkra shis ldan du brjod/ /drug pa rgyal mtshan zhes su brjod / /bdun pa gang ba zhes bstan te/ /sngags shes dag la legs mdzes shing ske/ /brgyad pa srog shing zhes brjod pa/ /sngags shes dag la legs mdzes yin / /dgu pa gdugs zhes ①bstan pa ste/ /bcu pa mdung du brjod pa yin/ /de bzhin bcu gcig sangs rgyas kyis②/ /kha sbyar zhes ni yang dag bstan/ /bcu gnyis pa ni phub ces gsungs/ /bcu gsum pa ni da pus yin/ /bcu bzhi pa ni ral grir bshad/ /de bzhin dril bu bcwa lnga pa/ /bcu drug pa ni zhags par bstan/ /bcu bdun pa ni lcags kyur shes/ /bcwa brgyad pa ni bzang po'i gdan/ /bcu dgu pa ni gdan du brjod/ /nyi shur bstan pa rma bya'i gdan/ /nyi shu gcig pa partsi sol/ /rtags gcig nyi shu gnyis pa ste/ /rtags gnyis nyi shu gsum pa ④yin/ /de bzhin phreng ba nyi shu bzhi/ /nyi shu lnga pa gzhu yin te/ /nyi shu drug par gsungs pa ni/ /lcags mda' dag tu rnam par brtags⑤la/ /nyi shu bdun par gsungs pa ni/ /rtags ⑥kun dag tu rab tu bstan / /nyi shu brgyad pa gsal shing ste/ /nyi shu dgu pa tho ba yin/ /sum cu pa ni mda' ⑦bo che/ /sum cu gcig pa mche bar bstan/ /sum cu gnyis pa de bzhin kha(nya/ /sum cu gsum pa ras kyi gos/ /sum cu bzhi pa bum pa ste/ /sum cu lnga pa 'khar gsil 6)yin/ /sum cu drug pa bya ma bum/ /sum cu bdun ripa gtun shing ste/ /sum cu brgyad pa skyil krung 7yin/ /sum cu dgu pa pa ṭa ⑪ham/ /bzhi bcu par ni rab bstan pa/ /chos kyi dung zhes nye bar bstan/ /bzhi bcu dag ni gcig pa yang / /lcags thag ces ni yongs su bsgrags8/ /gnyis par 8'dod pa mang por gsungs/ /gsum pa yid la re ba rdzogs/ /——730

bzhi pa skyed ①byed snang ba ste/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod/ /lnga pa ma mo zhes bshad pa/ /rkang gnyis rdzogs ②pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /drug pa rta babs zhes byar gsungs/ /bdun pa rta babs bzang po yin/ /brgyad pa sgra skad dag tu bstan/ /dgu pa rgyal ba'i sgra yang yin/ /lnga bcu pa ni rnga bo che/ /lnga bcu gcig pa chos kyi larnga/ /lnga bcu gnyis pa ba lang dubashad/ /gsum pa lag pa mchog yin te/ /lnga bcu bzhi par shes bya ba/ /phyag rgya de ni ⑤'khrul med yin/ /lnga bcu lnga pa mjug rings duyin/ /lnga bcu drug pa mda' yin te//bdun pa dag ni dgra star bstan/ /brgyad pa 'jig rten gyis mchod yin/ /lnga bcu rtsa dgur shes bya ba/ /mdor na mtshon ni rtse gcig yin/ /drug cu par ni 'gyur ba g.yang / /mdor na gshol du shes par bya/ /drug cu gcig pa pad+ma ste / /drug cu gnyis pa rdo rjer bshad/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor ⑤byed pa/ /'jig rten drug cu gsum par gsungs/ /drug cu bzhi par shes bya ba/ /mdor na pad+ma dkar po yin/ /drug cu lnga par shes bya ba/ /phyag rgya mchog sbyin dam pa yin/ /de yonyenas drug cu drug pa ni/ /theg ⑩pa'i phyag rgyar sangs rgyas gsungs / /drug cu bdun par 'jig rten du/ /mkhas pas mdung du bstan pa yin / /drug cu brgyad par bya ba ni(nye/ /rdo rje dbyug 8pa'i phyag rgyar gsungs/ /drug cu rtsa dgur 'gyur ba ni/ /dgra 'joms 0byed par rab tu bstan/ /bdun cu par ni shes bya ba/ /mdor na klu yi phyag rgya yin/ /bdun cu gcig par gsungs pa ni/ /gzhal med phyag rgya mchog bzang yin/ /bdun cu gnyis pa mdor bsdu yin/ /shing rta zhes ni de la brjod/ /mdor na bdun cu gsum pa ni/ /'jig rten mgon gyi ligadan du gsungs/ /de bzhin bdun cu bzhi ——731

dang ni/ /bdun cu lnga ru bstan pa dag /tshes ①brgyad zla ba pi bang phyidag /phyag rgya gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /bdun cu rtsa drug 'jig rten du/ /phyag rgya pad+ma 'dra ba yin/ /bdun cu bdun pa'i phyag rgya mchog /ut+pa la ni 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdun cu brgyad pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba zhes bstan pa yin / ri/bdun cu rtsa dgu mchod yon rgya/ /dgra bcom phyag rgya brgyad cu pa/ /mar me brgyad cu gcig par shes/ /thal sbyar brgyad cu gnyis par 'dod/ /gsum pa phreng ba zhes bya ba'o①/ /bzhi pa gdan zhes gsungs pa yinadu/ /lnga pa gnas kyi phyag rgyar bstan/ /drug pa rab gnas gsungs pa ste/ /bdun pa dbang gi phyag rgyar (snyebarjod/ /brgyad cu brgyad pa mchog tu 'dod/ /dgu dang dgu bcu'i grangs dag ni/ /phyag rgya gnyis ṅge dge ba mchog /kha sbyar zung gi phyag rgya ste/ / grangs ni dgu bcu 'byung ba ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig ces gsungs pa/ /me tog gi ni phyag rgyar bstan/ /gnyis pa gtor ma'i phyag rgya ste//(93gsum pa rtag tu spos kyi yin/ /bzhi pa dri yi phyag rgya ste/ /lnga pa mar mer shes par bya/ /drug pa sbyor bar shes par bya/ /bdun pa skyil krung phyed kyi ⑦gnas / / brgyad pa (8)dag ni bong ba 6)ste/ /dgu pa dag ni gshegs su gsol//de bzhin brgya rdzogs phyag rgya ni/ /thams cad pa yi las shes bya/ /brgya las rtsa gcig gsungs pa ni/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ /gtsug tor 'jig rten mgon po ni/ /rtag tu bla ma 'khor los sgyur/ /phyag rgya de ni dang por gsungs / /gnyis pa gdugs dkar las byung yin/ /gsum pa yirtsa ba'i (1phyag rgya ste/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs su snang ba yin/ /bzhi pa chos kyi mdzod kyi gnas / /chos kyi phyag rgyar shes par bya/ /lnga pa dge 'dun zhes bya ste/ /de ni ——732

phyag rgya chen po'ang ①yin/ /drug pa ②'byung po zhi byed pa/ /rang rgyal lag ①pa'i phyag rgya nyid/ /bdun pa byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /sa bcu dag la zhugs pa yi/ /phyag rgya pad+ma'i phreng ba ste/ /phyag rgya chen por de shes bya/ /'jig rten pa ni thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya sngags rnams mchog sbyin byed/ /mthu chen gtso bo 9chen po ste/ /gtso bo 'jig rten gsum gyis ⑤mchod/ /brgyad pa yang dag rab sbyar ba/ /phyag rgya srid gsum skye ⑥gnas yin/ /phyag rgya rnams kyi grangs bstan pa/ /rgyud 'di las ni rab 'byung ba/ /brgya gcig de bzhin rtsa brgyad du/ /phyag rgya'i grangs su brtags ⑦pa yin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ⑧'di tshad du/ /sa steng 6)sngon ni bstan pa yin/ /ston dang bstan pa 'jig pa na/ /lus can rnams ni rab spyod 'gyur/ /dang po re zhig lag pa gnyis / /thal mo sbyar te rtse mo 7sprad/ /sor mo phan tshun nang du gshibatso/ /sor mo phan tshun sbyar nas ni/ /de nas yang dag sbyar nas kyang / /lag gnyis yang dag ldan pa la/ /gtsug pud lngas ni legs mtshan 8bya/ /sor mo rnams kyi rtse mo dag /de nas de dag rnam bzlog pa/ /phyag rgya gtsug pud lngar shes bya / /gtsug pud lnga pa nyid dag ni/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes su bsgrags(ge/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbu la yod/ /'di ni phyag rgya mthu bo che/ /rab sbyar las kun byed pa yin/ /'jam dpal gyi ④ni sngags dag gam/ /snying po nyid ni rab tu sbyar/ /skra can ma yi sngags dag gam/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis rtag 'atu bya / /cho ga mthong tsobs sbyar ba 'am/ /sngags rnams kun gyis tu byas na ni/ /las rnams kun ni don yod par/ /thub pa'i bkas hunyeni bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin lag pa rnam bkod nas/ /de yi lag pa kha sbyar bya/ /de bzhin rtse mo ——733

gsum bya stel/ /sor mo rnams ni rab sbyar nas②/ /lag gnyis mthe bo ③spyod pa dang / /rab tu phyung ste drang por bya/ /gung mo dang ni srin lag dag /phyin ci log tu 'brel pa bya/ /'di ni gtsug pud gsum zhes bya/ /ral pa gsum pa zhes bya'ang ④yin/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni blo ldan gyi/ /phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /gang dag cho ga mthong ba yiX/ /las rnams kun ni byed pa yin/ /'jam dpal gsang sngags gang yin pa/ /de dag kun la sbyar bar bya/ /zlos pa yid la gang 'dod pa6)/ /don de myur du grub par byed/ /lag pa de bzhin rnam ⑦bkod nas/ /de bzhin gtsug pud gcig par bya/ /sor mo gung mo yang dag sbyar/ /nges par gtsug pud gcig par 'gyur/ /rgya 'di phyag rgya chen po ste/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ⑧gsungs/ /gzhon nu'i sngags ni rab bkod dang / /gang yang 'jig rten kun gyi ⑨yang / /de dang sbyar na 'grub 'gyur te/ /myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin ⑩'di yis bsgrub bya ni/ /sngags mchog rgyal bas bshad pa yin/ /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis (nyani/ /'di don myur du bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin lag pa yang dag sbyar / /sor mo'i rtse mo dgug cing chadagod/ /mdzub tsomo gnyis ni rtse sprad dgugaci /sor mo gzhan ni rang bzhag lasnyi/ /mthe mo ⑩gnyis ni rab gshib (nyenasal/ /gung mo gnyis ni rab brkyang bya/ /srin (3lag gnyis ni rtse sprad bkug /ut+pa la ru bstan pa yin/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni brjod cing bya/ /gtsug pud lnga par bstan pa yi(me/ /las rnams gang yin de dag nyid/ /de kun ut+pa la yis 6 )ni/ /myur du sgrub par byed pa yin/ /'di ni mchog sbyin phyag rgya ste/ /myur du longs spyod sgrub byed pa'o( nya/ /rtsa ba'i ——734

sngags dang ldan byas na/ /myur du nor ni byed par 'gyur/ /lag gnyis de bzhin sbyar byas nas/ /lag pa gnyis po rab bkan la/ /kho ①ra yug tu sor mo yis/ /de nyid kha ni yang dag sbyar/ /bkra shis ldan pa'i rnam par 'byung / /mdzes pa'i rnam par dgod par bya/ /gung mo'i sor mo'i dbus su ni/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni yang darge sbyar/ /mthe bo gnyi ga ②rnam sbyar ba/ /phyag rgya bkra shis ldan du brjod/ /don kun byed pa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /zhi ba'i las la rab tu sbyar/ /snying po'am yi ge drug ldan pas/ /las rnams kun ni ①byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin lag gnyis sbyar nas ni/ /sor mo phan tshun rab sbyar ba / /'gro ba'i khyad par mkhyen pa yisabya/ /gang ba bzang zhes gsungs pa yin / /rtse mo'i phyogs kyi sor mo rnams/ /kun nas yongs su 'gyed ⑤byas pa/ /gang ba bzang zhes sangs rgyas kyis/ /zlos pa rnams la gsungs pa yin/ /de 'di sdug bsngal dag dang ni/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal rab zhi byed/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis ⑥bskul byas na⑦/ /myur du nor gyis phyug par byed/ /'jig rten mkhyen cing legs spyod pas/ /phyag rgya gzhan yang gsungs pa ni/ /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /g.yon pa phab cing de la brtenani/ /lag pa g.yas pas ⑨bya ba ni/ /de yi sor mo dgug cing gzhag /mdzub mo gung mo nyid dag ni / /bsgreng yib rgyal mtshan zhes brjod de/ /rgyal mtshan phyag rgya zhes grags pa / /bsgreng yibs dgra ni zlog 8par byed/ /phyag rgya 'di yi 'bya ba ni/ /rim gyis chagator ma sbyin sreg sogs/ /phyag rgya 'di yis bya ba ni8/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis tshurab bskul na/ /'di ni las kun byed pa yin/ /lag pa de bzhin rnam sbyar ba/ /thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag rgya ste/ /bgegs rnams ma lus rnam 'jig ——735

cing ske/ /sngags shes mnyam par brjod pa ni/ /rim gyis las rnams byed par 'gyur / /cho ga mthong ba'i ldan pas ni/ /myur du don 6)ni sgrub par byed/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi snying po ni/ /snying gi gnas las ②yang dag byung / /'jig rten ma lus bsam ②pa yi/ /las rnams yang dag ldan pas byed/ /lag pa de bzhin sbyar byas nas/ /g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag /g.yas kyi mdzub mo blangs ④nas ni/ /g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng ⑤byas pa/ /'di ni srog shing phyag rgya yinayi/ /dag rnams kun ni zlog ⑦byed cing / /mi bzad shin tu 'jigs rung ba'i/ /bgegs rnams thams cad zhi bar byed/ /sngags zlos pa yis bstan pa ni/ /ma rungs thams cad gsad ⑧don phyir/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang yang dag ldan/ /myur du las ni byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin lag pa sbyar byas la/ /srog shing 'dra bar btsugs 6)byas nas/ /de steng lag g.yas brkyang byas pa/ /phyag rgya gdugs zhes bya bar brjod/ /phyag rgya 'di yis bya ba ni⑩/ /bdag gi (nyuspyi bor bsrung bar bya/ /sngags rnams kun gyis (stebyed pa ste/ /las ni srung tunyebar byed pa yin/ /dgra rnams kyi ni gdong 8'gebs shing / /mi 'dod pa dag rengs par 7byed/ /mi ma yin dang ma rungs gtso/ /ci ltar 'dod par byed pa yin/ /gdugs kyi phyag rgya de mthong bas/ /bgegs rnams kun ni rnam par 'jig /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /lag pa dag ni mdzes sbyar nas/ /mthe bo mdzub mo rtse sprad ldan/ /gung mo gnyis ni rab brkyang zhing / /srin lag gnyis ni rtse sprad bkug /gung mo'i tshigs tu)gnyis sbyar bar bya/ /de nyid mdung gi phyag rgyar 9/stebastan/ /ma rungs ()thams cad zlog 3 7par byed/ /srin po 8nyagadon rnams 'jig byed nas9 nya/ /'jig rten cha 736

mgon gyis gsungs pa yin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed/ /khros pas rab tu bstan pa yin/ /mi bzad sdig pa'i las byed pa'i/ /'jig rten la ni rab myur byed/ /srog la gnod par byed pa'i las/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis spangs pa ①yi/ /las 'di dag ni mi bya stel/ /'jig rten dam pas bkag pa yin / /yang na kun 'gro'i sngags sbyar ba'i/ /mdung gi phyag rgya dam pa yin/ /gang dag 'jig rten sngags rnams dang / /de bzhin rgyal bas rab bshad pa/ /de dag gi ni sngags rnams sbyar/ /mdung gi phyag rgya legs mnyam bzhag /sngags kyi mchog ni mi bzad mthong / /bden bral thams cad 'jig par 'gyural/ /sha za skar ma yi dgas dang / /srul po dang ni ma mo dang / /byis pa'i gdon dang mi sdug gzugs/ /byis pa rnams la gnod byed pa/ /gang dag gdug pa'i las ldan ①pa/ /ma rungs ④thams cad 'joms ⑤par byed/ /de bzhin lag ni sbyar byas yinas/ /thal mo'i ⑦rnam par byas pa dag /de nyid rnam par bzlog ⑧bya ste/ /sor mo phan tshun 'byar ba ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa zhe ①snang bral/ /de nyid kha sbyar zhes ni gsungs/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sngags dang ni/ /phyag rgya 'di yi las kyis ⑩bya/ /'di nyid phyag rgyas phyogs kun bcing hunye/ /de ni 7phyogs bcing tu zhes bya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bsrung 8ba che/ /kha sbyar byas nas 'dug pa yin/ /gzhan yang gang dag gnod byed pa'itso/ /ma rungs 'thams cad 'jig par byed/ /lus dang sems can 'khor dang ni/ /spyod yul dag kyang yona'adzin par byed/ /gang du zlos pa rtag gnas pa/ /ma lus tshogs ni srung tu bar byed/ /de la sdig pa ci yang med(6/ /phan pa med pa'ang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /bde dang lo legs nad med na/ /pha rol dmag cha 737

tshogs 'jigs ①pa gang / /de nas lag gnyis yang sbyar nas/ /bzlog par yang ni bya ba yin/ /g.yas pa ②'og tu byas nas ni/ /g.yon pa'ang steng du bkan ②par bya/ /lag gnyis phan tshun bsnol dub 'di/ /rgyal ba mchog gis ⑤mchog sbyin gsungs/ /sdig pa yang dag 'byung byed pa'i/ /ma rungs ⑥dgra rnams zlog ⑦par byed/ /yi ge gcig gnyis gsum dag gi/ /yi ge ldan pa brjod pa dang / /sngags ni 'dod pa dang ldan pas/ /'di ni myur du las rnams byed/ /dgra las byung ba'i sdig dag la/ /don gyi las rnams sna tshogs byed / /rtsa ba'i sngags dang ldan pa yisani/ /sbrul gyi dug ni sel bar byed/ /yang na gzhan gyis sbyar po)ba yi/ /lus can skyon ni sel bar byed/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog dag gis/ /'di ni phyag rgya mchog tu gsungs/ /lag pa de bzhin sbyar byas nas/ /sor mo rnams ni sbyar ba las/ /de 0tshe da pus 'dra bya ba/ /rtsa bar yang ni bcing ba ste/ /mthe bo yiganyis kyi dbus su ni/ /mthe'u chung dag gis legs par dkri/ /sor mo drug gis 8bya ba ni/ /rtse mo sbyar te legs mdzes bya/ /'di ni da pus 0phyag rgyar cigasungs/ /lha min thams cad 'joms par byed/ /lha ma yin dang gdug 8sems ldan/ /mthong bas sems ni zhi 'gyur zhing / /phyag rgya brjod na 'jig par 'gyur/ /da pus riphyag rgya legs mchod pa/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni rab sbyar na/ /myur du don rnams byed cing zhi/ /de bzhin ral gri bstan pa yang / /srin lag mdzub mo bkug pas so/ /de bzhin lag gnyis byas nas ni/ /rab brkyang dang po dgug par bya / /sor mo dag gis 'khor tsolug tu/ /kham phor ⑩mnyam pa'i dbyibs su bya//dril bur sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen cing / /lus can rnams la yang dag bstan/ /——738

lag gnyis de bzhin sbyar nas ni/ / gnyi ga ①kha sbyar rab bcings nas/ /phan tshun bsre ba byas nas ni/ /de bzhin gung mo'i sor mo gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'dra bar byas pa yis/ /zhags pa 'dra bar 'byung ba ni/ /de nas mdzub mo gnyis po dag /dbu (snyema'i tshigs su bcing ①bya ba/ /'di ni zhags pa zhes bya ste/ /rgya 'di sangs rgyas kyis ༷sprul pa'o/ /sems can rnams ni gdul don du/ /mi bzad 'ching ba byed par (gegasungs/ /gang yang ma rungs gdug pa'i gza'/ /gang yang gnod sbyin srin po rnams/ /'di ni cung zad rab bskul bas/ /'dir ni ma mor bcas pa 'ching / /mings shig chings shig ces brjod pas/ /brgya byin bcas pa'ang 'dir 'ching na/ /sha za sha ni za ba dang / /mi yi 'jig rten smos ci dgos/ /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ⑥ni / /de ni gnyi ga ⑦mnyam byas nas/ /de bzhin lag pa g.yas pa ni/ /g.yon pa'i steng du yongs su gzhag /gung mo dang ni mdzub mo dag /de nyid lcags kyu 'dra bar bya/ /tshigs ⑧ni bar ma la brten 7nas/ /mdzub mo nyid ⑩ni lcags gyur bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la 'di rab sbyar/ /lcags gyur 'di ni rab tu bya/ /yid (spel gang zhig zlos par 'dod/ /myur du las ni rab tu byed/ /myur du lha dbang tshangs pa sogs/ /brgya byin bcas pa'ang 'gugs par byed8//phyag rgya gtso mchog rab sbyar ba/ /lcags kyu 'gugs nyunyepa dge ba yin/ /lag gnyis de bzhin rab sbyar yinas/ /bzlog pa'i rnam pas nang bcings tshul /g.yon pa'i lag pa'i sor mo ni/ /gung mo srin lag dgug par bya/ /g.yas pa'i lag pa'i sor mo ni/ /gung mo srin lag rnam par dgug /mdzub mo mthe'u chung dag kyang ni/ / gnyi ga sdigs tsomadzub bya ba ni/ /de nas rnam ——739

bzlog bzhag pa la/ /mthe bo dhiganyis ni dgug cing sbyar②/ /de nyid bzang po'i gdan gsungs pa/ /phyag rgya mchog ni dge ba yin/ /sangs rgyas ①kun gyi gdan yin te/ /khro ldan sems can zlog ④pa yin/ /rgyal ba mchog gi rigs las byung / /sngags rnams kun la rab tu sbyar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'joms dubyed cing / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dag /thams cad g.yo ba med byed 6)pa'o/ /bzang po'i stan ni de nyid la/ /gung mo la ni yang dag brten⑦/ /steng du rnam par dgod ⑧pa ni/ /gung mo srin lag rab brkyang ba'o⑨/ /de nyid gdan du gsungs pa ni/ /thub pa dgra rgyal seng ges so/ /de bzhin lag gnyis sbyar nas ni/ /sor mo rnams ni bcing bar bya/ /de nas yal ga 'dra bar ni/ /'og tu mthe'u chung rtse mor ⑩sbyar / /gung mo yang dag dgug bya zhing / /pad+ma'i 'dab ltar yangs pa bya/ /mthe bo 7gnyis ka sbyar bzhag nas/ /rtag tu bsgreng ste tunyebazhag pa yin/ /zhe sdang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyis8/ /'di ni rma bya'i gdan du gsungs/ /'di ni blo ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di yi ④ni/ /byis pa rtag tu rtse byed pa'i/ /gdan du thub pa mchog gis 8gsungs/ /mthu chen phyag rgya chen 7po 'di/ /rang byung rnams kyis 0sngon bshad pa'otunye/ /'jam dbyangs sngags kyis yirab bskul na/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams byed/ /sha ciza sha ni za ba rnams/ /gdug pa rnams ni 'jig par byed/ /nyi shu de bzhin tshang bar ni/ /de dag phyag rgyar 'dod pa ste/ /rdzogs smyo )sangs rgyas pa rkang gnyis mchog /'jig rten gtso bos gsungs pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya rnams kyi cho 8nyag rnams/ /lag pa dge zhing dag pa du nye88—740

dang ske/ /dri med chu yis bkrus pa dang / /tsan+dan dkar dang ga pur dang / /gur gum chu dang ldan pa yinya/ /dri yi khyad par mang po yis/ /byugs ②shing me la bskams pa yi/ /lag pa ma nyams gtsang ba dang ①/ /ma smad shu ba med pa yis④ / /dang por phyag bya durkang gnyis mchog /de yi yiphyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /sa la me tog kun skyes dang ⑦/ /'od dpag med dang rin chen tog /dpag med tshe shes nimi g.yo dbang / /'jig rten mgon po nyin ⑨byed dang / /bde byed 'jig rten mgon po dang / /spyan bzang chos kyi tog dang ni/ /'od kyi phreng ba zhes grags pa/ /gtso bo mchog ni dam pa dag /'di dag ga pur sangs rgyas ni/ /rkang gnyis kyimachog la phyag byas nas/ /gtsang ba'i gnas su gtsang byas nas/ /zlos pa'i dus su phyag rgya bcing / /slob dpon la ni yang dag dris/ /the tshom don las rnam par grol/ /de 'dra'i spyod pa de ldan na/ /ci ltar bde bar phyag rgya bcing / /rnam sbyangs yirnam par dben pa dang / /gnas kyang mngon par bsngags byas pa/ / khros min zas lhag tsobacas pa tunyemin / /gzhan dag gis yini sems g.yeng tsomin/ /sol ba thal ba'i nang dag tu / /nam yang phyag rgya bshad mi bya/ /gzhan gyi bud med la chags dang / /gzhan nor chags la'ang yibashad mi bya/ /langs dang nyal ba dag la ni/ /phyag rgya bde 'byung bshad mi bya/ /lhor bltas ⑩'dug la'ang ma yin te/ /nub tu bltas ()te 'dug par min(6/ /steng dang 'og gi phyogs dag tu'ang / /phyag rgya sum̐ )bcing bar mi bya'o/ /byang dang shar du bltas ( nyepa dang / /phyogs mtshams ( nyedag ni de dag tu/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i sngags dran nas/ /sngags shes pas ni phyag rgya bcing / /phyag rgya ma lus bcing ba la/ /cho ga mchog 'di ——741

'dod pa yin/ /de yi 'og tu brjod bya ba/ /phyag rgya nyi shu gcig pa yin/ /lag gnyis mnyam par byas nas ni/ /sor mo rnams ni sbyar bar bya/ /de nas sor mo gung mo ni/ /rtse mo sbyar bar bya ba yin/ /mdzub mo dang ni mthe'u chung gi / /rtse mo tshigs ①ni bar mar gzhag /phyag rgya shes pas rtag bya ba/ /mthe bong gnyis ni bkug rten ②cing / /rtse mo gsum sbyar yang dag ldan/ /partsi saṃ du mkhas pas shes/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mchog yin te/ /myur du gzhan gyi sngags rnams gcod/ /de nas gzhan gyi phyag rgya gcod/ /ma rungs sems can la sbyar bya/ /gza' dang ma mo srul po yi/ /'byung po kun ni skrag ①par byed/ /las rnam ⑤sna tshogs byed pa ste/ /zhi ba'ang ༷myur du 'gugs ⑥par byed/ /drag po khyab 'jug tshangs pa dag /gang dag rang gis ⑦smras pa'i sngags/ /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis ni/ /sngags shes pas ⑧ni de dag gcod/ /bdag nyid chen po partsi sa'i6)/ /phyag rgya dang ni ldan pa dang / /rgyal ba'i zhal nas byung ba yi / /sngags nyid dang yang ldan gnas na/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las byed de/ /de bzhin gcod dang dral kyiba'i las/ /sems can gzhan gyis ⑩byas pa'i skyon/ /ma lus mtha' dag 'jig 7par byed/ /lag gnyis de bzhin sbyar nas ni/ /gung mo srin lag bsgreng 6)bya ste/ /lag gnyis yang dag ldan pa ni/ /mtshan dang 'dra bar yang dag 'byung / /sor mo bzhi ni yang dag ldan/ /mtshan gyi riphyag rgya zhes 'dod do/ /lha yi bu ni dbang phyug che/ /rang gi rgyas ni phyag rgya ⑫btabarka/ /thub pas sngon ni bkug pa la/ /rgyud 'di las 7ni gsungs pa yin/ /cho ga mchog 'dir dam tshig dang / /bdag nyid sngags ni tsom lus dag /de bzhin phyag rgya rgya cher bcas/ /bkug nas rab tu bstan pa yin/ /phyag rgya yi ——742

ni rab mchog 'di/ /'jig rten dag la rab tu bstan/ /phyag rgya dag ni gang ji snyed/ /drag pos sa steng rab bstan pa/ /de dag gi ni bdag ①po mchog /phyag rgya 'di ni rtags gcig ⑧yin/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni blo ldan pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu yis ①ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bsdus pa ste/ /sbyin sreg ④las ni rab sgrub pa'o/ /gang dag ji snyed gdug pa pa⑤/ /sa yi steng na rgyu ba yi/ /gdon dang sha rjen sha za dang / /ma mo dang ni lus srul po/ /drag pos dubagegs ni byas pa dag /de dag bzlog pa'i don ched du/ /mtshan mo gtor ma'i las dag la/ /phyag rgya mchog 'di gsungs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs 0rdzu 'phrul gyisal/ /las rnams ma lus byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin de ni rnam gnyis byas/ /rtags dhini gnyis su yang dag bstan/ /de bzhin sor mo phreng bar byas/ /phreng ba zhes ni yongs su bsgragasakyi/ /de nyid phreng ba yang dag bsdus/ /kha sbyar 'dra bar yang dag 'byung / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse sprad pa/ /gzhu yidang 'dra bar bya ba yin/ /mthe bo tsoganyis ni chang par gnon8/ /de ni gzhu yi phyag rgyar tsomatshon/ /de bzhin sor mo byas nas ni/ /g.yas pa'i mdzub mo nges par brkyang / /g.yon pa'i mdzub mo'ang brkyang ⑩byas te/ /mthe bo'i tshigs ⑩ni chang pas gnan⑩/ /lcags mda'i phyag rgya zhes bstan te/ /mtshan ma (nyamanyam par yang brjod do/ /de bzhin lag gnyis byas nas ni/ /sor mo rnams ni phan tshun bcing / /mdzub gnyis bslang bar yang dag sbyar/ /mdung dang 'dra bar byas pa yang / /ma rungs thams cad rjes skrag pa/ /'di ni mdung zhes rab tu gsungs()/ /de bzhin lag gnyis byas nas ni/ / gnyi ga'ang gu khu tshur bcing bya rdzu nyezhing / /mthe bo (nye——743

gnyis ni bsgreng ①byas pa/ /tho ba'i phyag rgyar bstan pa yin②/ /kha sbyar tho ba de nyid las/ /cung zad rab tu bskyod pa ni/ /mda' chen mchog tu gsungs pa ste/ /phyag rgya dgra ni 'jig byed pa'o/ /de nas ut+pal bcings ③byas te/ /de bzhin mthe'u chung sor mo gnyis/ /mthe bo'i 'og gi nang dag tu/ /dgod cing mdzub mo bstan par bya/ /'di ni mche ba ④zhes gsungs te/ /rnam par bye ⑤ba zhal zhes brjod/ /sor mo dag ni kun nas kyang / /de dag stimanyam par byas nas su/ /g.yas pa'i lag pa'i dkyil dag tu/ /g.yon pa'i lag bzhag ba dan brjod/ /lag pa dag ni gnyi ga g.yang / /kha sbyar dag ni mdzes par gzhag /sor dang sor mo dag kyang ni/ /phan tshun rtse mo dag sbyar bya / /de nas nisrin lag rtse gnyis dgug /bum pa'i phyag rgyar yang dag bstan//de nyid khu tshur sbyar nas ni/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni sngon du bsgreng yonye/ /rtse mo dgug pa'i rnam par bya/ / 'khar gsil ⑩'dra bar 'gyur ba yin/ /phyag rgya 'di ni yang dag bstan/ / 'khar gsil sgra ⑩ni sel bar byed/ / 'khar gsil 8de nyid cung zad tsam/ /legs par rab tu btud pa ni/ /mthe bo ⑫gnyis la rnam par sbyar/ /de 'dir bya ma bum du brjod/ /mdzub mo dang ni srin lag gnyisaci/ /bsgreng bar yang ni bya ba ste/ /de dag gi ni rtse bzhi sprad/ /gtun 7shing 'dra bar yang dag 'gyur⑩/ /sngags shes yang dag ldan pa yisadhi/ /gtun shing gi ni phyag rgyar bshad/ /lag gnyis de bzhin sbyar nas ni/ /gung mo srin lag 'og dang ni/ /steng du de dag rnam par dgod/ /g.yas pas g.yon pa bcing bar bya/ /6stesor mo mdzub mo mthe'u chung dag /phan tshun du ni yang dag sbyar17/ /khor yug skyil krung ( )'dra ba yi( nya/ /phyag rgyar ( nyede bzhin ——744

gshegs pas gsungs①/ /'di ni skyil krung ②phyag rgya zhes/ /'jig rten kun tu grags ①pa yin/ /phyag rgya 'di dang ①ldan pa dang / /de bzhin sngags dang rab ldan pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs pa dang / /rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs ⑤las byung —/ /'di dag gi duni sngags ldan 'di/ /zhi ba'i las kun byed pa yin/ /gtun shing la sogs mdung gi bar/ /gang yang phyag rgya de bzhin gsungs/ /thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po ni/ /gshin rje gshed 'di'i bstan pa yin/ /mtshon cha drag po 'di dag ni/ /thams cad gdul phyir sprul ba yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu yis ⑦ni/ /de tshe bsgrub bya sgrub pa yin/ /gdul bya gdug ⑧pa thams cad la/ /bum pa la sogs phyag rgya gsungs/ /lag gnyis de bzhin bkod yonyenas ni/ /pa ṭa ⑩ha yi rnga 'dra bya/ /sor mo rnams ni mnyam par sbyar/ /thams cad kyis kyang rim par bsnol/ /mthe bong 7yang ni rim par bya/ /de nas lag pa'i nang du gzhugatso /gung mo mdzub mo gnyis po ni/ /gyen du bsgreng ba dag tu bya/ /'di ni pa ṭa ()ha zhes 8bstan/ /phyag rgya ma rungs tsozlog byed pa'o/ /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /sor mo rnams ni legs par yisbyar/ /gdub kor 'dra bar mdzes pa yi/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni rnam bkug la/ /mthe bo yonaganyis ni 'og mthar bya/ /mthe bo (nyaganyis kyang smad par bya/ /gung mo sbyar la rab gzhug gzhag /dung ni mdzes par 'gyur ba yin / /'di ni chos kyi dung zhes pa'i/ /lag pa'i phyag rgyar (terab tu bstan/ /thub mchog gsungs pa'i sngags ldan na/ /las ni thams cad byed pa yin/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las byed pa/ /rtsa ba'i 6 )sngags dang rab sbyar na/ /mche ba'i dug can thams cad dang / /sbrul gyi dug rnams thams cad sel/ /rig pa'i ——745

rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /phyag rgya dung ni 'bud bzhin bzlas/ /dug gis brgyal ba'i skye bo ni/ /myur du dug ni med par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya mchog ni rdzu 'phrul che / /bzhi bcu dag ni yang dag bstan/ /de nas gzhan yang phyag rgya yi/ /mtshan zhing ①yang dag bshad bya ba/ /lag gnyis de bzhin rnam bkod pa/ /sor mo'i rtse mo legs par ②sbyar/ /g.yon min lag pa'i nang du ni/ /'bad pas lag g.yon nigazhug par bya/ /thams cad 'og tu byas pa yibya/ /lu gu rgyud du bstan pa yin/ /'di ni phyag rgya rab mchog ste/ /gdug ⑧pa ma lus 'ching bar byed/ /thub pa mchog gis gsungs pa yiyi/ /sngags 'di dag dang ldan byas na/ /gza' ⑦dang ma mo sdig ldan rnams/ /'byung po ma lus 'ching bar 'gyur / /lag gnyis de bzhin kun bsdus nas/ /bgrol zhing rim par yang dag bsgreng ⑧/ /gung mo'i tshigs su mthe bo khyani/ /'di nyid cho gas gzhag par ⑩bya/ /mthe bo yiganyis kyi rtse mo yang / /gung tsomo'i bar tshigs tsoyang dag sbyar / /me la mngon phyogs bstan ④byas nas/ /me yi sngags dang legs par sbyar / /me yi las la thams cad du/ /me la 8spyan ni drang bya ste/ /me yi phyag rgya rab sbyar natso/ /myur du me ni spyan drang ⑩'gyur/ /()phyag rgya sngags kyis gshegs su gsol/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mo nyid la ni/ /mthe bo'i 7rtse mo rab sbyar bas / /me 6)yi lha ni gshegs 6)gsol ba'i/ /phyag rgya 'di ni kun gyis ( nyabazhed//me yi las 6)ni rab sgrub pa'o/ /zlos pa sngags ni gang 'dod pa'i/ /lha rnams dag ni spyan drang (ste'agyur/ /phyag rgya kun gyi dubazhed pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas byin brlab srigasungs pa yin/ /sngags mchog dang ni ldan pa yis6)/ /las rnams rnam pa sna tshogs 8)byed/ /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /sor mo tshang ——746

bar sbyar nas ni/ /sor mo'i rtse mo'i mthong ①dbye zhing / /lhod cing zlum par yang dag bya①/ /de nas pad+ma yongs rdzogs pā/ /kha ni bye bar ①ma gyur bya/ /'di ni re ba rdzogs byed pa'iX/ /phyag rgya don kun sgrub byed ces/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rab mchog ste/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod nas/ /'jam pa'i dudabyangs kyis sbyar ba yin/ /sems can yid la 'dod pa dag /yid la re ba'i phan du'adod gang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po sngags ldan pas/ /myur du de dag sgrub par byed/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rab mchog ste/ /yid la re ba rdzogs zhes brjod/ /'di ni phyag rgya rab mchog ste/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa'o/ /myur du sngags rnams sgrub byed cing / /rgya che nyid kyi rdzas dang bcas/ /thub pa'i zla ba de yis ⑦ni/ /zla ba'i 'od la rab tu bstan / /zla bas pad+ma'i rigs dag la/ /des ⑧ni phyag rgya 'di la sbyar/ /sngags mkhan ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams byed/ /lag gnyis de bzhin bsdu byas nas/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni bsgreng bar bya/ /gung mo'i ①sor mo'i rtse mo gnyis/ /cung zad smad pa rta babs 0yin/ /de nyid yang dag bsgreng (7byas na8/ /rta babs tibazang por gsungs pa yin/ /de nyid phan tshun sbyar byas pa/ /sangs rgyas ru dung sgra ru bstan/ /mthe bo'i gtso bo bsgreng 8byas pa/ /mkhas pas rgyal ba'i sgra ru shes/ /lag gnyis de bzhin yang dag sbyar/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mo yang dag dgug /sor mo thams cad sbyar byas la/ /cung zad yangs par 'byung ba ni/ /de ni sangs rgyas rnga chen mkhyen//chos kyi rnga ni bsgreng tsobyas pa'o/ /de nas lag gcig thal mo ni/ /g.yas pa g.yon pa'i steng du bsgreng ⑩/ /'og tu rab tu sbyar yib ni/ /glang po'i rnam ——747

par yang dag sbyar/ /g.yas pa'i gung mo'i sor mo ni/ /glang po'i sna 'drar rab tu bya/ /'khor ba'i pha rol ①phyin pa yis/ /phyag rgya de ni glang por bstan//phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis rab tu bstan/ /las rnams mtha' dag byed pa ste/ /'jig rten kun gyis ②mchod pa yin/ /lag g.yas brkyang ①zhing rab bsgreng ④ba/ /de ni mi 'jigs sbyin par brtags⑤/ /lag pa g.yon pa ⑥brkyang byas pa'i/ / mkhrig ma'i tshigs ⑦la rab bzhag pa'o⑧ / /gung mo mdzub mo sbyar byas la/ /mthe bo ⑨gnyis ni bar du gzhug⑩ /gung mo gnyis ni bsgreng bar bya/ /'khrul 0pa med pa'i rgya de yin/ /de nyid sor mo rnam 7sbyar zhing / /mthe bo 0steng du gnas byas te/ /tshigs ⑫kyi 'og tu rab bzhag pa/ /mjug tsorings kyi ṅge rgya zhes bstan/ /de nyid tsomadzub rtse rab bsgreng ⑩ba/ /mda' yi phyag rgyar bstan pa yin/ /mdzub rtse gnyis ni yang dag ldan/ /phan tshun rtse mo rnam 'asprad cing / /de gnyis tshigs su mtheb gnyis sbyar/ /mthe'u ()chung gnyis ni yang dag brkyang / /de nyid dgra star bstan pa ste/ /phyag rgya don kun sgrub byed pa'o()/ /thams cad yang dag bsdu ba yang 61/ /phyag rgya kun gyis (nyamachod pa yin/ /de bzhin du ni rab bsgreng 9 ༄ba/ /mdzub gnyis rtse mo sbyar byas pa/ /de ni mtshon cha rtse gcig phyirgya/ /de bzhin 'khor lo mda' chen gshol/ /mdzub mo 'khor lo bzhin bya dang / /phyag rgya dam pa gshol (geyang bya/ /phyag rgya drug cu 'di dag ni/ /cho ga dang bcas gsungs pa'ang 69yin/ /'di dag ma lus mtshon cha'i rgya/ /sngags dang yang dag ldan par ( )gsungs/ /dman pa kun gyis byas pa'i skyon/ /gza' edang grul bum ma mo dang / /srin mo 6)kun gyi gtso bo rnams/ /byis pa'i sems ——748

can 'jigs byed pa/ /phyag rgya'i mtshon cha las byung bas/ /de dag thams cad des 'jig 'gyur/ /phyag rgya drug cu 'di dag gi/ /mtshan nyid nye bar bstan pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga yang dag 'byung —/ /lag gnyis de bzhin rnam bkod pa/ /pad+ma 'dra bar yang dag bsgreng ①/ /sor mo thams cad kyis bsgrubs ②pa/ /phyag rgya pad+ma zhes bya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mchog ces bya/ /pad+ma'i rigs la yang dag sbyar/ /pad+ma'i rigs ni ji snyed pa①/ /sngags dang ldan pas dge bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs ④las byung ba/ /myur du las durnams byed par brjod/ /ji snyed pad+ma'i rigs gsungs pa/ /sngags rnams ma lus sgrub par byed/ /pad+ma rnams kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /phyag rgya'i pad+ma (6)zhes su brjod/ /lag gnyis yang dag sbyar nas ni/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni yang dag bsgreng ⑦/ /gung mo'i sor ②mo sbyar byas nas/ /rdo rje rtse gsum yang dag 'byung 6)/ /gung mo'i sor mo'i tshigs ⑩dbus su/ /mthe bo (nyaganyis kyi rtse mo ⑤sbyar0/ /de nyid rdo rje zhes gsungs te/ /phyag rgya dam pa tha ma yin/ /ji snyed rdo rje'i rigs kyi sngags/ /de dag phyag rgya 'di 0sgrub 'gyur/ /cho ga ldan par rab zhugs na/ /myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sgrub pa las dang yang dag ldan/ /bsgrub bya rtag tu sgrub pa na/ /grub tsomachog tha ma bar ma ni/ /de la rtag tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten sngags rnams ma lus pa'ang / /the tshom med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /lag gnyis yang dag sbyar byas nas/ /gung mo gnyis ni yang dag bsgreng ⑪/ /srin lag mthe bo yidag kyang dgug /mthe'u chung gnyis ni sbyar byas la/ /mdzub gnyis rtse mo sprad nas ni/ /mdzub mo'i dbus tshigs (sheganyis dgug bya/ /gung ——749

mo gnyis kyi rtse mo sbyar/ /'khor lo 'dra bar yang dag 'byung / /'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo ste/ /'dir ①ni phyag rgya'i rgyal por bstan/ /de tshe chos rgyal gyis gsungs te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /thub pa'i zla ba bdun pa yis②ske/ /de tshe zhi ba'i 'khor lor chagasungs/ /phyag rgya'i rgyal po rab sbyar nas//dus gsum rgyun mi chad bzlas ④na/ /'jig rten pa yi sngags kun dang / /khyab 'jug dbang ldan gyis bshad pa/ /zlos pa phyag rgyar ⑤yang dag ldan/ /mthong ba tsam gyis ⑥de dag gcod/ /'di ni phyag rgya rab mchog ste/ /chos kyi dbyings las rnam par byung / /sems can rnams ni ci 'dod pa/ /thams cad las ni byed par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rgyal pos gzhi don du/ /phyag rgya 'di ni yang dag bstan/ /cho ga'i rgyal ba'i (kyemachog 'di ni/ /las rnams ma lus rab tu sgrub/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis 6)bstan pa la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya 'di'o/ /ma zhi ba 7yi phyag rgya kun/ /zhi ba'i las la rab tu sbyar/ /sngags pas rtag tu mgo bor ni/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya brtag par bya/ /lag ⑪gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /kha sbyar 'dra bar bya ba yinacha/ /sor mo lhod cing yangs par 6)bya/ /lag gnyis sor mo'i rtse dgug payi/ /'di ni pad+ma dkar po yi7/ /phyag rgya sems can don sgrub shes/ /de las lag pa gcig btang nas/ / khu tshur (7bye zhing sor mo bsrings / /lag pa brkyang (nyab lta bu ()ni / /mchog sbyin gyi ni phyag rgyar brjod/ /lag gnyis kyang ni de bzhin byas/ /kun nas sor mo rnams kyis 2 ni/ /phreng ba bzhin du gshib 0byas pa/ /rgyal ba'i ne phyag rgyar 'di ( gyebarjod do/ /de bzhin lag gnyis 9 )sbyar nas ni/ /gung mo mdzub mo gnyis dag ni/ /khab kyi rnam par bya ba yin/ /de las gzhan pa'i ——750

sor mo ni/ /cung zad dgug par bya ba yin/ /de nas ①mdzub mo gnyis dag ni / /gnas pa'i rnam par legs dgod bya/ /de yang ②yang dag sbyar byas te/ /srin lag gi ni tshigs su brtenag/ /'jig rten mang po'i 'dren pas ni/ /rus dusbal phyag rgyar 'di bstan to0/ /de bzhin lag gnyis rnam par dgod/ /sor mo dag ni kun nas kyang / / gnyi ga khyikhu latshur mnyam byas nas/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni sbyar bya ba/ /mkhas pas phyag rgya de nyid ni/ /rdo rje dbyug par yang dag brjod/ /lag gnyis de bzhin yang dag par/ /kha ①sbyar 'dra bar byas nas ni/ /phan tshun sbyar ba la brten ⑨nas/ /sor mo'i 0thal mor rnam par dgod / /mthe bong gnyis ni nang gzhug ⑩pa/ /dgra 'jig 'phyag rgyar brjod pa yin/ /de nas lag gnyis mnyam byas te/ /de nas thal mor byas tsonas ni//kun nas gzhol bar rab tu bya/ /gru yi bzhon par rab tu 'byung / /'jig rten gsum gyi skyob pa yis8/ /gru yi phyag rgyar 'di rab bstan/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /'byung po rnams ni yang dag sgrol/ /sor tsomo de nyid bsgreng tsonas ni/ /de tshe lag gnyis sna tshogs ⑩bya/ /phyag rgya gzhal med khang zhes bya/ /sems can steng du rjes su 'dzud/ /de bzhin lag tsoganyis yang dag bsdusal/ /shing rta zhes ni de la brjod/ /theg gsum 'gro ba'i gtso bo ste/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 7shing rtar gsung 4 )/ / zlos pa 0sngags ni 'dod pa la4)/ /'byung po kun ni 'dren par byed/ /theg pa mchog la brten dunas ni/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob (nyepar byed/ /de nyid lag gnyis rab bsgreng (nyenas/ /gnyi ga yang ni kha sbyar bya/ /lag mthil gnyis ni mnyam byas brkyang tso/ /lan kun 'dra bar yang dag 'byung / /'di ni phyag rgya rab mchog ste/ /'jig ——751

rten mgon gyis 6)legs mchod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas rnams su/ /thub pa'i zla bas yang dag gsungs/ /gang du 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /ma 'ongs (kyed ltar bzhugs pa dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings la bzhugs/ /gang du gnas mal la bzhugs pa/ /phyag rgya gnas mal zhes bya bar/ /'jig rten 'dren pas de 'dir mkhyen/ /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /sor mo rnams ni yang dag sbyar/ /kha sbyar du ni rnam par dgod/ /g.yas pa'i mdzub mo gcig gis ni/ /g.yon pa'i rtse mor gtug ②bya ba/ /de ni zla ba phyed du brjod/ /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /g.yas pa'i sor mos khu 0tshur bya / /lag pa g.yon (5)la yod pa yi/ /sor mo kun ni mnyam bsgreng 6)ste/ /sor mo'i rtse mos khu tshur bcing / /g.yas dang g.yon pa ldan pa yi/ /sor mo rnams ni sbyar byas nas/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni brkyang byas pa/ /pi bang 0phyag rgyar nye bar bstan/ /lag gnyis de bzhin byas nas ni/ /sor mo cung zad kha bye yang 98)/ /mthe bo (9)gnyis kyi bar du ni/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni brten par bya//'di ni pad mtsho'i phyag rgya ste/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ⑩'gro la gsungs/ /rtag tu mthe bo gnyis brkyang 1lhab/ /ut+pa 1shel yi phyag rgya zhes/ /rkang gnyis dam pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /'jig rten du ni gsungs pa yin/ /de nyid thal mo sbyar byas pa/ /'gro ba phyag 'tshal 'dra ba ste/ /bla ma phyag 'tshal rgya 'di zhes/ /'jig rten kun tu rnam par grags/ /rgya de nyid ni bsngam byas na(ste/ /lag gnyis zung du yang dag 'byung / /rgya 'di lag pa gnyis gzung 7zhes/ /'jig rten gsum du rnam par gragasa'i/ /cung zad mthe bo 7rtsar bzhag ste/ / mtheb rtsar 1 phan tshun legs gnon pa/ /de ni kha sbyar rgya ru 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'khrug ——752
