pa rnam par 'jig /gang dag mtshon cha las byung rnams/ /phyag rgya 'di dag gsungs pa yin/ /me tog gdan dang bzhon ①pa dang / /gzhan yang sa/don ni 'jigs byed pa/ /thams cad las kun byed ldan pa/ /skyob pa'i sngags kun thams cad yin/ /tshes grangs dang ni rgyu skar dang / /smyung ba dag kyang mi bya ste / /phyag rgya sngags su rab ldan na / /las rnams myur du grub par byed/ /zlos pa dka' thub ldan pa dang / /sngags zlos pa la mkhas pa dang / /phyag rgya ⑧sngags su rab ldan snyun/ /bsgrub bya min pa'ang (5)cung zad med/ /lag pa gnyis po bya ba niyi/ /phan tshun thal mo yang dag sbyar/ /mthe'u chung srin lag pya mthe bo yi/ /tshigs ⑧ni bar ma sbyar bar bya(9)/ /gung mo sbyar ba'i tshigs kyigasum par/ /mdzub mo bkug ste sbyar bar bya/ /rigs gsum gyi ni spyi la yang / /mchod yon gyi ni phyag rgyar 67bstan/ /sor mo zung ni gsum po tshonadag /de bzhin phan tshun yang dag sbyar/ /mdzub mo'i rtse gnyis yang dag sprad/ /mthe bo 0gnyis kyi 'gram du bskum7/ /thal mo 'dra bar yang dag ldan/ /me tog phyag rgyar bstan pa yin/ /lag pa'i thal mo bkan byas nas/ /mthe'u chung sbyar byas rgyab tu ni/ /srin lag yang dag sbyar bar bya/ /de yi rgyab tu gung mo sbyar/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni sbyar bar bya/ /sa tsol thal sbyar bya ba yin/ /mthe bo tshuganyis ni 'gram bzhag pa/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar bstan pa yin/ /thal mo gzhan gyi sbyor ba yis/ / /mdzub gnyis cung zad bkug pa ni/ /gtor ma 4shespyi yi phyag rgya ru/ /'jig rten skyob pas de gsungs so/ /ji ltar cho ga bzhin du ni/ /nang du me tog gzhug byas na/ /gtor ma kun gyi las la ni/ /gsang sngags kun la byin par 'gyur/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs 49sbyin pa'i lag /——753

g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bya ba yin/ /mkhrig ①mar sbyor ba'i bya ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon dag ni bsnol bar bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams ma lus pa'i/ /dri yi phyag rgyar brjod pa yin/ /lag g.yas khu tshur bcings ②nas ni/ /mthe bo chadang ni gung mo gnyis/ /de nas rab tu sbyar bar ④bya/ /mar me'i phyag rgyar brjod pa yin / /srin lag dang ni mthe bo 0nyid/ /bgrang 0phreng dag tu yang dag gnas//rtag tu mthe'u chung rnam par brkyang / /de 'og gung mo'ang brkyang bar bya/ /mdzub mo bskums ⑦te bzhag pa la/ /bgrang ⑤phreng gi ni phyag rgyar brjod/ /de nas thal sbyar nang du ni/ /sngags rig ⑨pas ni phreng ba gzhugatso /ci 'dod sngags ni bzla 7byas na/ /myur du grub pa'i mchog rab ster/ /cho ga 'di ni rtag mthong na/ /sngags rnams kun ni spyod par byed/ /me la lag pa g.yas pa ni/ /mi 'jigs ⑩sbyin pa'i phyag rgyar bya/ /me la mngon du bltas ()bzhag nas / /mdzub mo rtag tu dgug par bya/ /mthe bo tsolag pa'i dbus su ni/ /bkug nas yang dag rab tu dgod/ /me ni yongs su spyan drang ba'i/ /phyag rgyar 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /mdzub mo yi ni rtse mo dang / /mthe bo 8gcig tu sbyar bya ba/ /me dang las rnams kun la ni/ /gshegs su gsol bar rab tu snang ske/ /sngags rnams kun la mkhas pa yis0/ /sbyin sreg las la bya ba yin/ /7rgya 'di dag dang ldan pa yis/ /sngags ni me la legs par sbyar/ /phyag 'tshal thal mo byas pa las/ /sor mo kun nas nang du gzhug /de nyid rnam par bzlog byas nas/ /mthe bo (nyaganyis kyang gshib par bya/ /mdzub mo phyi ⑪rol yang dag bkug /gung mo dag la yang dag brten/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mchog tu gsungs/ /mchod pa'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /sngags rnams kun la ——754

phyag 'tshal dang / /sngags kyi mgon po rgyal sras sbyar/ /sngags rnams kun la sbyang ba dang / /gdan dag la yang rab tu sbyar/ /me tog med par gyur na yang / /phyag rgya bcings la mchod par bya/ /cho ga 'di yis ①mchod na ni/ /sngags rnams don kun sgrub ②par byed/ /mchod yon phyag rgya byas pas ni/ /mchod pa bzang po byas par 'gyur/ /gnyis pa sems kyi mchod pa ste/ /me tog ci 'dra yod pas so/ /rdzogs ①sangs rkang gnyis ④dam pa yis⑤/ /mchod pa'i cho ga 'di gsungs so/ /me tog med par gyur na yang / /mchod pa rnam pa gnyis su brjod/ /sngags rnams rab tu 'grub bya'i phyir/ /las rnams kun la sbyar dubar bya/ /sngags kun byed pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa'ang yin/ /gnas dang mal dang bzhon pa dang / /khrus dang btung dang bza' ba dang / /mar me spos dang sngags khrus dang / /dkyil 'khor dag ni byed pa la/ /sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sngags pa rnams kyis ④byin rlabs 2byed/ /'jig rten mgon gyis 6)gsungs pa yiyi /phyag rgya 'di ni las kun byed/ /phyag rgya rnams kyi 4)nges byung ba/ /yongs rdzogs brgyar ⑩ni gsungs pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya dag ni brgyad po ste/ /lag gnyis de bzhin sbyar nas ni/ /gnyi ga kun nas mnyam byas la/ /de dag nyid las yonamadzub mo dang / /gung mo gnyis ni sbyar bar bya/ /mthe bo tsoganyis kyi sen mo ni/ /gsum pa'i tshigs 8char sbyar bar bya / /cung zad nang du bkug nas ni/ /rab tu sbyar ba dag tu bya/ /bdag nyid chen po 'khor lo can/ /sngags kyi bdag po'i phyag rgya yin/ /'di nyid las ni mdzub mo dgugatso /gung mo dag ni mnyam par sbyar/ /srin lag gnyis ——755

kyi sen mo ni/ /sbyar ba'i rnam par dgod par bya/ /'di ni gtsug tor phyag rgyar ni/ /rgyal ba'i dbang pos gsungs pa yin/ /lag gnyis de bzhin bkod nas ni/ /gung mo'i sor mo bcings 6)byas pa/ /mthe'u chung sor dang yang dag ldan/ /gdugs dkar po ②las rgya 'di byung / /gung mo mnyam par byas nas ni/ /sor ②mo gnyis ni yang dag sbyar/ /gdub kor zlum po 'dra ba ni/ /phyag rgya chen por ④de la brjod/ /de nyid las ni mdzub mo yi/ /tshigs (nyeni skam kha lta bur bya/ /de nas gung mo sbyar te dgod/ /lag pa'i 'og gi char ⑥sbyar nas/ /de las ⑦gsum pa'i tshigs (snyedag tu/ /mthe bo'i sor kyimos gnon ⑩par bya/ /'jam pa'i tsodabyangs ni blo ldan gyi8/ /'di ni 8phyag rgya mchog tu gsungs/ /lag gnyis de bzhin bkod nas ni/ /cho ga mthong la yang dag gnas/ /sor mo de nyid kun gyis yini/ /kun nas gang ba'i mdzod ltar gnas/ /lag pa gnyis ni rnam bskyed tsonas/ /lag sor brgyad ni rab tu brkyang ske/ /skyes bu brgyad po de nyid shes/ /zung bzhi dag tu gyur pa ni/ /rdzogs sangs rkang gnyis dam pa yis7/ /de nyid dge 'dun zhes kyang gsungs//de nyid 'phags (1pa'i dge 'dun rgyar/ /srid pa'i gnas 'dir gsungs pa yin / /phyag rgya 'di 1nyani rab mchog ste/ /phyag rgya ma lus rab tu sgrubatu)/ /lag gnyis de bzhin kha sbyar te/ /thal mo sbyar ba'i rnam par gnas/ /mdzub mo gcig ni rab brkyang ba/ /lag pa g.yas pa ( )yang dag brkyang (me/ /de 'di 'byung po zhi byed par/ /de nyid gzigs pa rnams kyis bstan/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mchog ces bya/ /las rnams kun gyi ( stedon sgrub (nyabyed/ /lag gnyis de bzhin sbyar nas ni/ /sor rtse rim bzhin mtshan pa yi/ /bsdus nas kha sbyar ——756

dag tu bya/ / mthe bo ①gnyis ni bsgreng ②nas bskum/ /de 'di pad+ma'i phreng ba zhesal/ /dang po'i lasangs rgyas dag gis ④gsungs/ /lag pa dag ni de gnyis kyisaX / /sor mo kun nas bkan la brkyang / /sor mo gsum gnyis bsgreng ⑥nas ni/ /me tog kha bye'i rnam par bya/ /gnyis pa'i tshigs ⑦la bzhag pa ni/ /mthe bo dang ni mdzub mo gnyis/ /de 'dir srid pa gsum gnas kyi/ /phyag rgyar rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ /phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /las kun byed kyi ⑤phyag rgya brgyad/ /mthu mnyam brtson 'grus chen por ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis yang dag gsungs/ /musbyi gtams phrag ⑨bye ba ni/ /stong phrag brgyad cu kyiyang dag 'byung / /thub mchog grangs med 'das pa yis/ /phyag rgya 'di dag rab tu gsungs/ /phyag rgya cho ga yang dag 'byung / /rtsa brgyad brgya ni rab tu gsungs/ /'di dag kun gyi 7sngags kun dang / /las rnams dag kyang grub pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che kun gyi8/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bzhed cing ⑫gsungs / /cho ga 'di dag sbyar ba yis8/ /don rnams myur du sgrub par byed/ /shākya seng ge mi yi mchog /thub pa mchog gis de gsungs nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la de bzhin gsungs/ /'jam dpal gyi ni cho ga 'di/ /phyag rgya dag ni yang dag byung li/ /sa steng bstan pa bsrung yidon du/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rab tu gtad rte/ /dus mtha' (stenye bar 'od 'gyur zhing / /dus mthar 5)mya ngan 'das pa na/ /nga yi spe )bstan pa bsrung (stedon du/ /nga yis ( na'adi dag thams cad bshad/ /sngags rnams dag ni rgya cher bcas/ /phyag rgya rnams kyi mtshan nyid bshad/ /'jig rten kun la gsang ba dang / /shin tu gsang ba'ang brjod pa yin/ /mdo 'dir cho ga lhag ——757

pa ste/ /yon tan rgya chen gsal bar byas/ /sngags rnams du ma'i tshig dang ni//yon tan brjod pa yang dag 'byung / /phyag rgya rnam ①pa mang por ldan/ /rigs ②pa'i rgyud ni rab tu bstan/ /mthu dang yon tan grub mtha' dang / /zlos pa'i rgyu ni yang dag 'byung / /'gro ba'i skye gnas sems can gyi/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba'ang gsungs/ /gzhon nu khyod kyi sngags rnams kyi/ /grub pa'i gtan tshigs ①rab tu sbyar/ /de skad gsungs nas 'jam dpal ni/ /gzhon nu nam mkhar gnas pa yis④/ /'jig rten mgon po 'od byed pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /dbugs ring phyung nas snying rjes brlan/ /mchi ma de nas phyis nas kyang / /sangs rgyas zhabs drung gnas nas kyang / /de la myur du zhus pa ni/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten 'das pa na/ /sngags kyi mdzod 'di sa steng du/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sems can la/ /de tshe ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de skad gsungs nas sangs rgyas kyis/ /de tshe 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsungs/ /gzhon nu khyod kyis yongs zhus ⑤pa/ /bu khyod 'jam dpal rab tu nyon/ /nga ni 'jig rten mya ngan 'das/ /sa steng stongs (6)par gyur pa dang / /chos kyi mdzod kyang 'jig pa dang / /nyan thos rnams kyang 'das pa na/ /rkang gnyis dam pa ston pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan mchod (7rten dag kyang bya/ /spos dang dri dang byug pa yis / /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gos mchog dang / /gzhan yang nor bu'i gdub kor rgyan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bza' dang bca'acha/ /yang dag sbyar (1)ba dbul bar bya/ /rnam pa sna tshogs phun sum tshogs/ /ci 'dod kha zas byas pa la/ /de bzhin sngags ni bzlas byas dbul/ /sems can dge ba'i skyes 'oganas 'gyur/ /dam pa'i 'gro ba'i skye gnas su/ /grong mchog dag tu ——758

skye bar 'gyur/ /mthar ni byang chub gzhol 'gyur zhing / /phyi ①nas zhi bar de dag 'gro/ /de skad gsungs gyenas 'jam dpal ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni gsungs dul dga'/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /blo ldan de nas cang mi smra/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor byabyed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 'dus par sangs rgyas kyil/ /gtsang ⑤ba'i gnas kyi steng gnas nas/ /'di dag sangs rgyas snga mas gsungasal/ /de tshe chos kyi 'khor lo bskor⑥/ /yun ring ⑦dus su 'das pa yin/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ phyag rgya'i cho ga'i le'u rab 'byam ⑧lasal/ nyi shu rtsa dgu pa rdzogs sol// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gzhan yang gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal mchog tu rab tu gsang ba khyod kyi ⑩phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid 'khor (nyadang bcas pa yod de/ las thams cad la nye bar sbyar tsob phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sbyin par byed pa/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa/sngags thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba/ las thams cad sgrub pa/ mdor na 'jam dpal nyon cig /dang por tire zhig thal mo rab tu brkyang tshul mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung gnyis rtse sprad de tshigs 8bar ma btud tsonas so so so sor rjes su bcug pa yin te/ de la 'di ni 'jam dpal khyod kyi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba las thams cad byed par 'gyur ba'o/ /lag pa gnyis de bzhin du byas la srin lag gnyis sbyar la de bzhin du gung mo dang mdzub mo yang bya zhing ——759

mthe'u chung gnyis kyi ri mo gong ma la mthe bo'i rtse mo bzhag pa ste/ 'jam dpal 'di ni khyod kyi gdong gi phyag rgya zhes bya ba ste ①gnyis pa'o/ /phan tshun du ⑧sor mo bsnol chab khu tshur du byas la gung mo'i sor mo gnyis rnam par bkrol la ④rtse (nyemo sbyar te/ de'i 'gram gnyis su mdzub mo gnyis dkri zhing mthar gzhag par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni 'jam dpal khyod kyi mche ba'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba gzhan yin no/ /mche ba'i phyag rgya'i 'gram du mthe bo 6)gnyis bzhag pa'i phyag rgya 'di ni mngon sum du 'jam dpal gzhon nu khyod nyid yin no/ /gnas de dang lag pa'i kha sbyar der nye bar bzhugs shing dam tshig gis ༷byin gyis rlob par byed do//lag pa'i sor mo phan tshun 2khu tshur du 6)byas la mdzub mo gnyis bkrol te/ mthe bo 7gnyis gung mo'i nang du chung bar (1byas pa 'di ni 'jam dpal khyod kyi gtsug pud kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba ste(3/ gzhan yin no/ /thal mo'i tshigs (nyernams brkyang ba byas la srin lag dang / mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo gung mo'i nang du rtse sprad de bzhag pa 'di ni 'jam dpal mngon sum khyod nyid kyi rtsa ba'i sngags su bstan pa yin no/ /'di nyid kyi phyag rgya la mdzub mo gnyis brkyang bar 8byas pa ste/ de la 'di ni 'jam dpal khyod kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /mthe'u chung dang srin lag gnyis bsnol 7ba 7byas nas lag pa kha sbyar gyi nang du bzhag /nyal gung mo'i phyi rol tu mdzub mo'i rtse mo yongs su bkug la/ mthe bo (sheganyis kyi rtse mo yang dag par bcar ba'o17/ /gzhan 'di yang 'jam dpal khyod kyi zhal gyi phyag rgya yin no/ /las thams cad pa yang yin te 'di nyid kyi rim gyis (3 sor mo re re bkrol ba mthe bo ( medang bcas pa byas na ma rungs pa'i 69gdon thams cad rab tu 'byer bar k+ṣ-i —snye'agyur ro/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang mgrin pa dang lag ngar 88wa 760

pas ci 'dod bar du bzla/ /srung ba chen po'i cho gas kyang / /myur du grub pa ①thob par 'gyur②/ /dus kun phyag rgya kun gyis ①ni/ /las rnams kun ni bya ba yin / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ phyag rgya'i cho ga'i le'u rab 'byam gnyis pa las/ sum cu pa rdzogs sokhyi// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas (snyegazhan yang gnas dugatsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa / 'jam dpal khyod kyi rtsa ba'i cho ga la phyag rgya mchog tu shin tu gsang ba gzhan yang yod de/ phyag rgya dang rgyud thams cad kyi cho ga sngags thams cad kyi mngon par 'dod pa/ sngags thams cad dang lhan cig yang dag par sbyar na/las thams cad rab tu sgrub par byed pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam rnam par sbyor ⑦bar byed pa/ sems can thams cad (nyekyi lam du gyur ⑨pa yin no/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyi 7rtse mo dang gung mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dag yongs su sbyar ba ni gtsug tor 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya yin te/ 'dir sngags ni / oṃ dzā la dzā la ཿstod yig tosbyi ṣa 7dru ra dru ra rtsu rta()/ srin lag de nyid bkug pa dang gung mo sbyar ba de gnyis tho)kyi sor mo'i rtse mo'i sen mo gshibs la/rna cha gdub kor zlum po ltar bya ba ni gtsug tor gdugs dkar po'i phyag rgya yin te / 'dir yang sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ oṃ ma ma ma ma rtsu ni/ mdzub mo de nyid phan tshun mnyam par sbyar snyil gung mo gnyis sbyar ba ni gzi brjid phung po'i phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ ta thā ga to: ṣā ⑩ba lo ki 7te/ mūrti te ⑫——762

dzo rā shi hūṃ dzā la dzā ①la/ dha ka dha ga② /da ra bi da ra/ ts+tshan+da tshin+da/ rgyu hūm̐ ③phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mdzub mo de nyid yang dag par sbyar ba dkyil 'khor lta bur bya ba ni rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ oṃ dza ya dza yo snri ṣa dzā la dzā dul brnya brnya da ma da ma/ tsū r+ghaṃ hūṃ ho ha na r+ghaṃ/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor ⑤gyi sngags so/ /mdzub mo de gnyis kyi rtse mo btud pa byas pa gung mo sbyar ba la/ mdzub mo'i sen mo gung mo'i tshigs dugasum pa'i char sbyar dhib ni 'khor los sgyur ⑧ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ na mo a pra ⑨ti ha ta ta thā ga to: ṣā ⑩yal/ a na ⑩ba lo ki te myurta tson tsakra brti hūm̐ dzā la dzā tsol/ dha ka dha ka /dhu na dhu na/ bi dhu na tā sa ④ya mā ra yo ta sā dha 8ya/ ha na ha na/ s+t+waṃ ā+o hākho/ka ka / dro khi ṇi dro khi ṇi0/ kuṇ+ḍa li ni8/ a pa rā yidzi tā tra ( )pa ri ṇi hūm̐ phaṭarka/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags so/ /mdzub mo de nyid kyi rtse mo mdud ⑥pa byas la/ gung mo sbyar ba byas pa la mdzub mo sen mo'i 'og gi gsum pa'i cha la sbyar ba ni tsosngags kyi bdag po 'khor los sgyur ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo dude nyid kyi rtse mo yang dag par bkug pa gung mor 'asbyar ba'i 'og tu yang dag par bcar 6)ba ni sngags kyi bdag po'i phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo de nyid kyi rtse mo yang dag par bkug la gung mo sbyar ba'i sen mo dang tshigs ( nyenang du yang dag par sbyar ba ni 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo de nyid kyi rtse mo gnyis yang dag par bkug la gung mo sbyar zhing 'og tu yang dag par sbyar te/gdub kor ltar byas pa ni 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo de nyid kyi rtse mo yang dag par bkug la gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa'i nang du yang dag par sbyar ba ni sngags kyi bdag po 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i phyag rgya ste/glu 763

ba tsam gyis 'jigs ①par 'gyur ro/ /'og ma gnyis kyang rtse mo mnyam par gshibs na khu ②tshur gyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyang 'di dag gang yang rung ba dang phyag rgya lag pa gnyis kyis bcings ②te sgrub pa'i dus sam sngon du bsnyen pa'i dus su 'dug pa'am langs te/ lan cig ④gam ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bzlas par bya'o⑤/ /de ltar byas na bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyis glags rnyed ⑥par mi 'gyur zhing grub pa yang mngon ⑦du 'gyur ro/ /mdzub mo de nyid kyi rtse mo gnyis sbyar la kun nas zlum por bya zhing gung mo gnyis sbyar te/ gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa'i du'og tu sbyar ba ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i snying po'i phyag rgya'o/ /'dir snying po ni/ o a pa rā dzi tā 6)dhi ka /gtsug tor gyi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya de nyid la gzhan gang yang rung ba dang lhan cig pa'i 7spyod pas bkod na las thams cad byed par 'gyur rol/ /de las mthe bo'i rtse mo bteg la srin lag gi rtse mo tunyegatugs nas yang dang yang bteg pa ni bod pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba 8te a pra (nyeti ha tosbyi ṣā tsoya/ e h+ye gyi bha ga bān dharma lirā dza pra tīts+tsha tsod aghi/ garnya/pus dhū 7po ba li dī paṃ māṃ tsā bhi rak+ṣa/ a pra ti ha ta(nye/ ba la pa rā kra mā tunyeya swā hā / me tog dkar pos spyan drang bar bya'o/ /rang gi gzugs kyi ⑥ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil ba dbul bar bya'o/ /gdan dang bzhugs su gsol ba yang bya'o / /de la 'di nyid kyi phyag rgya dang sngags kyis phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ( spedang steng 'og bcing bar zhi༄bya'o/ /de nyid kyi srin lag dang mthe bo'i rtse mos gtugs shing pu smad pa byas la/ tshigs bar ma la mthe bos gtugs shing (steyang dang yang bteg par byas nas/ mchod yon phul na rang gis ( gelha ——765

gshegs su gsol bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya g.yon phyogs su bskor na phyogs bcings pa 6)las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo a pra ti ha tosmi ṣā ②ya/ gats+tsha gats+tsha ②bha ga bān dharma rā dudza pra tīts+tsha rda ②arnya/ ga: pu// dhū paṃ māṃ tsā bhi rak+ṣañtsa)/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa ⑦ rā kra mā ⑧ya/ci phyag rgya dang sngags gshegs su gsol ba ni mchod yon gyis so/ /mdzub mo de nyid gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa'i 'og tu bzhag ste/ gung mo yang dag par sbyar la mthe bo ⑨gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis phan tshun mnan cing khu tshur du bya'o/ 'dir sngags ni/ /na mo bha ga ba te ⑩a pra ti ha tosmi ṣā 0ya/ oṃ drwa spre)brnya hūm̐ phaṭa/a pra ti ha to: ṣā 6)ya/ bi ki ri ṇi/ bi ki ri ṇi0/ dhu na dhu na dhu/ rnam par 'jig par byed pa/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po'i gtsug tor gyi sngags bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyis zin pa dag dang dbang bskur ba dang bdag bsrung 7ba dang phyogs bcing ba yidang dkyil 'khor bcing ba la sogs te las thams cad la tu tsharab tu sbyar ro/ /(nyamadzub mo de gnyis kyi ()rtse mo gnyis 3 snabakug cing yang ( medang yang brkyang ba ni me lha spyan drang ba'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi las bya ste/ 'di nyid kyis slar gshegs su gsol ba ni bzlog pa'o / /mdzub mo gnyis kyang 'bar ba'i phreng bar bsam mo/ /gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya 'di ni las thams cad la thogs pa med pa'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba te/ a pra ti ha to: ṣā ( nyaya/ e h+ye hi te dzo sa mā li ni asna sgosteye swā hā / mdzub mo de nyid kyi rtse mo gnyis cung zad bkug par bya zhing gung mo sbyar la gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa'i nang du sbyar bar bya'o/ /gtsug tor gyi stobs shin tu drag po'i 2nyaphyag rgya yin no/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba ti/ a pra ti ——766

ha to: ṣā ①ya/ i rma ga / dhū ②tha/ pu/ ①ba li dī paṃ tsa pra tīts+tsha ༷ha ra sarba bud+dha a dhiXkhri te/ dharma rā dza a pra ti ha tā 0ya swā hā/ dri la sogs pa'i sngags so/ /srin lag gnyis bzlog steg/ tshigs gsum pa la mthe bo ⑧gnyis yang dag par sbyar zhing mdzub mo gnyis kyang sbyar ba ni gzi brjid gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya ste/ log 'dren thams cad kyis 'joms ⑨par mi nus so/ /phyag rgya 'di ⑩ni srung ba dang bzlas pa'i dus dang / sgrub pa'i dus dang dkyil 'khor dang las thams cad la yang bya ba yin no/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba te⑩ma/ a pra ti ha to: ṣā yati/ sarba bisne bi dhā na tsos na ka rā ya gro dhā ④ya swa hā / srin lag gnyis kyi rtsa bar mthe bong gnyis gtugs 8te/ de bzhin du gdub kor ltar bya zhing mdzub mo gnyis kyi ⑩nang stong pa'i rnam par bya'o/ /'di ni thams cad du thogs ⑩pa med cing gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gtsug tor gyi ⑫phyag rgya yin no/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga tsob te/ a pra ti ha tosmi ṣā zhu ya / sarba tra ⑥a pa rā dzi dutā ya/ sha ma ya sha ma ya/ shārnye rādhe dharma 0rā dza ba shi te/ ma hā bibye saṅgātho sā 0dha ni swā hā/ mar gyi sbyin ⑤srog la sogs pas zhi ba dang rgyas pa la sogs pa'i las bya'o/ /srin lag gnyis kyis gdub kor ltar bya zhing mdzub mo'i rtse mo gnyis bkug pa ni thogs (9pa med pa'i bde byed kyi ( nagatsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dir ( nyesngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba te/ a pra ti ha to: ṣā ⑥ya/ oṃ shang ka re swā hā/ las thams cad srung bar byed donu )/ /mthe bo 6)gnyis kyi rtse mos srin lag gnyis kyi gsum pa'i tshigs la mnan la/de bzhin du mdzub mo gnyis kyi ru rtse mo yang rdo rje'i rtse mo ()dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /'di ni dam tshig thogs pa med pa'i spyi gtsug dustegi phyag rgya ste/ dam tshig thams ——767

cad kyi thun mong ngo / /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba te/ a pra ti ha to: ṣā 6)ya/ oṃ shang ka re (gyis ma yaṃ swā hā/ mthe bo chaganyis kyi rtse mos srin lag gnyis kyi bar ma'i tshigs la bcar la mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug par bya zhing gung mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dang tshigs bar ma sbyar ba ni dam tshig thogs ④pa med pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya yin te/ lha dang lha ma yin la sbyar na dam tshig (nyal 'jog par byed do/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba te/ a pra ti ha tosmi ṣā 6)ya/oṃ shang ka re ma hā sa ma yaṃ swā hā/ 'dis dkyil 'khor bcing ba ⑨byas nas bzlas na 'khor los sgyur ba yang dam tshig la gnas par 'gyur zhing 'khor los sgyur ba gzhan yang zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /gnas de nyid du bzlas pa byas na rig (nyapa'i mthu stobs kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi sngags rnams kyis phan tshun gnod pa 6)byed par nus pa ma yin no//bzlas pa ni gnas gcig tu rnam pa thams cad du bya'o/ /de la sogs pa gtsug tor gyi rgyal po grangs med pa yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs la rgya cher bya'o/ /'jam dpal cho ga'i rgyal po 'di la ni sngags tshad med pa yod de/ phyag rgya yang rnam pa sna tshogs nyid de ngas 'di mdor bsdus nas bshad pa yin no/ /ngas gal te rgya cher bshad na ni mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis bskal pa stong gi khri tshad du yang 'dzin pa'am 'chang bar nus pa ma yin no / /'jam dpal de lta bas na mdor bsdus nas bshad par bya yis( spe/mdor na yid la nye bar gzung bar 1 gyis shig /dang po (/2thub pa'i phyag rgya mchog /'dir ni rab tu gsungs pa yin/ /lha yi 7lha ni de nas kyang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i phyag rgya dang / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan ni/ /——768

spyan ras gzigs ni zla ba dang / /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i 6)rgya/ /gnod sbyin dbang po'i bstan pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang phyag rgya ni/ /dpag med chen po'i gzi brjid ldan/ /pho nya pho nya mo tshogs kun/ /bran pho ⑤bran mo ①de bzhin gzhan/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo/ /klu dang klu mo de bzhin gzhan / /mngag gzhug mngag gzhug ④mo dag dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po sha za mo / /de bzhin gzhan yang srin mo dang / /lha dang lha min bu mo dang / /grub dang rig pa 'dzin rnams dang / /mi rnams ma lus pa dag dang / /skye bo thams cad dag gi ⑤ni/ /so so so sor phyag rgya bstan/ /sngags kyang rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /las dang ting 'dzin sna tshogs dang / /glang po nor bu'i rigs dag dang / /de dag so so'i phyag rgya dang / /dgra bcom dang ni rang rgyal dang //legs 'byung phyag rgya de nyid dang / /sa bcu la ni rab gnas pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya snying po sngags dag ni(6)/ /gcig pa nyid du yongs su bsgrags/ /lha dang gnod sbyin rigs dang ni/ /drang srong dri zas mchod pa dang / /phyag rgya dri zas bstan pa dang / /bdun pa'i rigs kyis gsungs pa dang / /de bzhin brgyad pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /gnod sbyin rigs su yongs su bstan/ /phyag rgya thams cad yang dag (7)bstan/ /gzhan yang bder (8)gshegs bka' (9)dag gis/ /rgyud rnams dag ni so so dang / /'jig rten pa yi yang 'dir gzung / /phyag rgya ldan pa'i sngags dag ni/ /las rnams la ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'ching la 'osogs mkhas na/ /log 'dren dag gis gnod mi 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid du 88—769

'gyur ba ni①/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo phan tshun bsdams ②la mthe bo ③gnyis bstan par bya'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byathugs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di nyid la mthe bo ⑤g.yas pa gcig bstan pa ni pad+ma 'dzin pa'i phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon snga ma bzhin du khu ༅tshur bcangs te/ gung mo'i sor mo gnyis rab tu phyung zhing brkyang bar ④byas la gcig tu byas shing rdo rje'i rtse mo 'dra ba 'di ni rdo rje 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de las gcig bkug pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po'i phyag rgya'o/ /yang de nyid brkyang nas gung mo gnyis gdub kor ltar byas pa ⑧'di ni byang chub sems dpa' glang po'i spos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis po thams cad bsdus te/ khu yo)tshur du byas pa 'di ni rin po che'i rigs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /nor bu la spyod pa thams cad dang dzam ⑩bha la chu dbang la sogs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya 'di nyid sbyar bar bya'o / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi tshigs gnyis bkug nas sen mo gnyis phan tshun du ⑪sprad pa 'di ni gnod sbyin gyi rigs lngas kyirtsen la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin rdzu 'phrul chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis snga ma bzhin du khu tshur bcing ba ⑫byas la mthe bo'i sen mo gnyis phan tshun sprad cing steng du bzhag la gung mo gnyi ga'i 8rtse mo rdo rje'i rtse mo dang 'dra bar byas pa 'di ni lha thams cad de lha'i rigs 'og min la sogs pa'i phyag rgya yin no/ /lag pa gnyis de bzhin du bsdams la khu tshur bcangs (snyenas mthe bo yiganyis bstan pa 'di ni rang sangs rgyas rnams dang ⑩'phags pa nyan thos kyi phyag ()rgya'o/ /khu tshur bcang bar byas pa (7'di dag ni 6)'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rgyal ba'i sras thams cad kyi phyag rgya ni gcig tu brjod par bya ste/ thal mo brkyang ba sbyar nas ——770

cung zad rtse mo bskum ①par byas pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpar phyigrags pa'i phyag rgyar bstan pa yin no/ /nor bu rin po che dang / 'khar gsil dang ②/snam sbyar dang / lhung bzed ④dang / chos gos dang / mche ba dang / mi 'jigs pa'i lag pa ste/ bdun po de dag ni thub pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /spyan dang byams pa dang 'od kyi dra ba dang chos ston pa dang mdzod spu'i ༷nor bu dang gnas pa dang phyag rgya bdun po 'di dag kyang rgyal ba'i sku nyid las skyes pa'o/ /bdun gnyis kyi tshogs gnyis pa ⑥'di dag dang phyag rgya lnga ngas bshad pa dang thub pa'i snying po dang ldan pa nyi shu ni dang po'i rang byung gis ④kyang bstan pa yin te 'khor los sgyur ba nyi shu'i 'khor gyi phyag rgya yang bstan to/ /phyag rgya dang sngagase byung ⑧ba 'di grangs kyi mthar yang byas pa yin no/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas gdub kor ltar byas pa ni nor bu rin po che'i phyag rgya'o/ / skyil mo krung 7gi g.yas g.yon brla'i nya'i phyogs su khu tshur ⑩rgyal mtshan du 'dzin pa ni 'khar gsil 7gyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /lag pa thal mo sbyar la phan tshun du tsomangon par phyogs pa ni snam sbyar gyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /lag pa thal mo sbyar ba las bzed pa ltar byas pa ni lhung bzed kyi phyag rgya'o/ /chos gos ni lag pa g.yon pas so/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya bzhin du g.yon pa'i mthe bo tu bteg pa ni mche ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang g.yon pas chos gos la 'dzin pa ni mi 'jigs pa'i lag pa'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo gnyis rdo rje'i 7rtse mo ltar byas la/ de'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug cing bzhag la/mthe bo yiganyis nang du bcug pa 'di ni sangs rgyas spyan gyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /'di nyid kyi gung mo'i tshigs bkug tshul mdzub mo gnyis gcig tu byas pa 'di ni ——771

sangs rgyas byams pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba yangs par byas la 6)mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis bkug la rdo rje rtse gsum du byas pa 'di ni mā ma khri'i ②phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /thal mo sbyar ba ①byas nas mdzub mo gnyis gung mo gnyis kyi tshigs gsum pa la bkug ④nas bzhag la mthe bo (nyaganyis so sor bskyed yinas thal mo'i rnam par bya ba 'di ni longs ④spyod ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ⑤phyag rgya yin no / /lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar nas mdzub mo gnyis dang gung mo gnyis sbyar ba 5nyeni rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum rdo rje'i rtse mo ltar byas la rked pa'i phyogs su brten pa 'di ni gnas pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de ltar bdag nyid kyi mgo bor rig ⑩pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang phyag rgya chen po brgyad bcings la las thams cad bya zhing dam tshig gzung (nyeba'am dkyil 'khor bya ba dag la'ang me tog gtor bar bya'o/ /yang na sngar bstan pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du byas na ci 'dod pa'i las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /sngags dang phyag rgya dang rig (9pa brjod pas ni dam tshig (nyathams cad du 'gyur ro/ /legs par phyag rgya bcing tshun ni phyag rgya'i mthu 'byung bar 'gyur gyi/ gang phyag rgya bab col du byas pa dang gnas ma yin par bcas pa des ni tso'adi'i dam tshig nyams sapar 'gyur ro/ /gang rdo rje'i phyag rgya de nyid ni mdud rtse'i phyag rgya yin mod kyi/ rtse gsum dang rdo rje ni khyad par kyi yod de/ gang gyen du bstan pa de jini rdo rje 'dzin gyi phyag rgyar 'gyur la/ 'og tu bltas 1nyapa ni dbang phyug chen po'i phyag rgya yin no/ /bar du bzhag pa ni sbyin gnas su 'os pa'i slob dpon dang bla ma la ni phyag rgya dbus su gzung 19bar bya'o/ /mi thams cad la ni sor mo gcig gdeg par bya'o/ /mi ma yin pa thams cad dang rkang gnyis dang ——772

rkang bzhi dang rkang mang ①dang srid pa gsum la gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni sor mo gnyis bsgreng ba'o/ /gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin mo thams cad kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni gsum bsgreng ②ba'o/ /rig ①pa 'dzin pa dang rig pa 'dzin ma thams cad kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni sor dumo bzhi bsgreng ⑤ba'o / /lha dang lha ma yin thams cad kyi bu mo'i phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni lag pa'i mthil mnyam por bzhag ⑥pa'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba legs par byas te bzhag pa ni gzugs na spyod pa'i lha thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo de nyid legs par byas pa las khu gatshur bcing ba byas pa ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa 'dod pa'i khams na gnas pa thams cad kyi yin no/ /dmyal ba dang dud 'gro dang yi dgas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sems can thams cad kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni de nyid las sor (0mo gcig yang dag par bsgreng 6)ba'o/ /sha za dang sha za mo la sogs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni sor mo gnyis bsgreng 7ba'o/ /srin po dang srin mo rnams kyi ni gsum bsgreng tunyaba'o/ /sha rjen tu za ba thams cad dang gdon dang ma mo dang grul tu bum la sogs pa dang / sha za rnams dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa thams cad la ni sor mo bzhi bsgreng rdziba'o/ /sdig pa 7thams cad kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni sor mo thams cad bsdus pa'o/ /lag sor bsdus pa'i phyag rgya ni dgug pa'o / /lag sor brkyang tsob ni slar gtang tsho tshoba'i phyag rgya'o/ /las thams cad ni rang gi sems kyis kyi bya'o/ /ci 'dod pa'i phyag rgya 'di dag la rang rang gi tsho/sngags sbyar bar bya'o/ /gzhan gyi phyag rgyar ( zhigazhan gyi las ni mi bya'o/ /gang gi sngags gang la yod pa de dang de'i phyag rgyar rkunasbyar bar bya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ——773

dag ni rin thang ①mnyam pa med pa yin te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ②byin gyis brlabs pa sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya mthong bas ①khro bar byed mi nus so/ /phyag rgya las 'da' bar byed pa ni rnam par nyams pa thob par 'gyur ro / /phyag rgya nyams pa las ni dam tshig nyams pa dang rig pa thams cad las rnam par 'das par 'gyur ro/ /mthar yang ngu 'bod kyi 'gro ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba chen po mnar med par yang shin tu brtan par khyoskye ba thob par 'gyur ba ni phyag rgya la bgegs ①byed pas so/ /gang yang phyag rgya dang dam tshig la gnas pa de dag ni yun ring po mi nyung bar bde bar 'gyur te/lha'i gnas chen po'i 'gro bar 0skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar yang nges par byang chub la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor na dang po'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul chen po dag gis phyag rgya rnam pa ⑦mang po rnams rab tu gsungs so/ /sems can thams cad kyis kyang 'di'i mtha' rtogs par ram gzung ⑧bar ram grangs rtsi bar ⑨byed par mi nus so/ /mdor na rgyal ba'i rigs kyi rig pa'i rgyal po 'khor los sgyur ba'i yi ge gcig pa de'i phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ni lag pa g.yas g.yon snga ma bzhin du khu tshur du byas la/ gung mo gnyis phyir phyung la brkyang ste yigacig tu rtse sprad la/ gnyi (nyega'i yang rtse mo'i tshigs bkug la mdzub mo gnyis kyi tshigs gnyis bkug cing sen mo gnyis phan jitshun rtse sprad de/ mthe bo 6)gnyis kyi sen mo'i steng du bzhag pa 'di ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i phyag rgya ste/ las thams cad byed pa phyag rgya thams cad kyi rab mchog 'jig rten gyi skyob pa rnams kyis 9/stegasungs pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i yi ge gcig pa dang yang dag par ldan na las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /——774

'dis bsgrubs na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi sngags grub par 'gyur ro/ /'dis bzlas pa byas na sngags thams cad bzlas par 'gyur ro/ /༷sgrub pa pos nges par sngon du cho ga'i rgyal po 'dir gsungs pa'i sngags kyi ②mchog brgyad stong bzlas pa ①bya'o/ /de ltar byas na rig pa 'di thams cad mngon du 'gyur zhing myur du grub pa rab tu ster bar 'gyur ro/ /myur du mchog kyang ster bar 'gyur ro / /nges par byang chub la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya rjodang spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po yi ge gcig pa dang ldan par byas na las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang na khyagos dkar mo'i rig ⑥pa phyag rgya dang ldan par byas na'ang de bzhin du las thams cad byed par 'gyur rol/ /rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya dang de nyid kyi snying po yi ge gcig pa dang ldan par byas na yang de bzhin du las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang na mā ma khri'i rig pa chen mo dang ldan par byas na'ang dulas thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 6)glang po'i rigs kyi yi ge gcig pa byang chub sems dpa' glang po'i spos kyi snying po dang de bzhin du de nyid kyi phyag rgya dang rin po che'i rigs dang gnod sbyin gyi rigs dang lha dang 'phags pa dang 'di dag la yang 'dir snying po yi ge gcig pa nyid la phyag rgya dang sngags thams cad dang ldan par byas na las thams cad bya ba yin no/ /ji ltar rigs par rig pa dang sngags kyi stobs bskyed pa mtha' dag bya'o/ /de bzhin 7du drang srong rnams la ni dmod pa 'debs pa'i lag pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du dri za dang lha dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa rnams la ni lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bo dzispenang du bcug pa byas pa'o/ / grub pa yonye——775

bstan pa'i khu tshur du gnas pa'i rgya ni gzhon nu ma bzhi'i phyag rgya dang de nyid kyi sngags kyis 6)so/ /de bzhin du smin drug gi bu la ni mdung gi phyag rgyas so/ /de bzhin du gshin rje (midang chu lha dang lus ngan dang gnod sbyin dang nisrin po dang sha za dang lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa sems can srid pa gsum la yang dag par gnas pa thams cad dang 'gro ba thams cad du gtogs pa dang khams thams cad na gnas pa dang sems can thams cad kyi gdon ④dang ma mo dang sha rjen za ba dang sdig pa can gyi sems can thams cad dang thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang sngags kyang thams cad du gsungs (snyepa yin no/ /rim gyis sbyar zhing mthar gyis thams cad kyi thams cad du 'gyur gyi 6)gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /dang por re ⑦zhig sgrub pa pos cho ga'i rgyal po 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa las byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po dang phyag rgya de'i 98)yan lag tu gyur pa las byung ba dang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po dang mthu chen thob dang dri ma med par grags pa dang 'jam dpal khyod kyi 99)ut+pa la'i phyag rgya dang byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag gi phyag rgya shar du mngon par bltas te gnas pa dang nyi ma la mngon du bltas te gnas nas/ tho rangs belangs la gtsang zhing gtsang ba'i gnas la gnas nas sgrub pa pos nges par 'di dag gi phyag rgya gang yang rung ba bcings la rang gi spyi bo'i steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /'di dag gang yang rung ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa byas na nad thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring ba dang bgegs thams cad kyis zil gyis gnon par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /myur du grub pa ster bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis tsho17byin gyis brlab kyi par 'gyur ro/ /nges par byang ——776

chub la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ①du 'gyur ro/ /snying po dang phyag rgyar 'gyur ba de yang gang zhe na/ dang por ②re zhig dpa' bo chen po'i phyag rgya bca' bar ①bya ste/ lag pa gnyis sbyar bar byas la sor mo rnams nang du bsdus te/ mthe bo gnyis bteg la tshigs ④gsum pa'i cha bkug pa 'di ni dpa' bo chen po'i phyag rgya ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs so/ /'dir sngags ni/ a 0bī ra hūm̐ bespyi/ sngags 'di dang yang dag par ldan na phyag rgya 'di ni las thams cad byed pa yin no/ /lag pa gnyis de bzhin du yang dag par sbyar ba byas la phyir yang rnam par phye (kyezhing / kun nas sor mo rnams pad+ma kha bye (9)ba ltar byas pa 'di ni kha bye ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya mchog yin te/dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis rab tu bstan to/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ ga ga na sam+bha tu )be dīp+ta dīp+ta dzā la ya dzā la yosteya/ bud+dha ()a dhiṣ+ṭha te (stebi kā sā ya sarba bhu ④tā nī/ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi kā si ni phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ni pad+ma kha bye ba'i sngags te/phyag rgya 'di dang yang dag par ldan na las thams cad 7par 'gyur ro/ /gdon zhugs pa la sogs pa yang rab tu shes pa yin no/ /smra bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /gdon gyis 9zin pa rnams dang sha za sdig pa dang ldan pas zin pa dang dug gis brgyal ba rnams la zha ji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba de lta de ltar de thams cad byed do/ /'di ni mdor na rig pa me tog kha bye ba'i phyag rgya dang ldan par byas na don 18thams cad sgrub par byed do/ /ma grub pa nyid kyang myur du 'grub 47par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa gnyis sbyar ba khri )byas la sor mo rnams sastonang du mnyam par ( gebyas te bcug pa ni snying po'i phyag rgya ste/ snying pos lan bdun rin 88—777

mngon par bsngags la bgrol bar bya ste/ de bzhin du thams cad du yang bya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ go da ro bī ra swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'o/ /lag pa de nyid khu tshur du bya ste sor mo rnams brkyang 6)la sor mo'i rtse mo phan tshun sprad ②cing nang du stong pa ni gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ oṃ brnya ②swā hā/ 'di ④ni las thams cad byed pa ste/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo ⑤bteg la khu tshur bcangs ⑥pa ni 'khar gsil ⑦gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ dhu ⑧na dzi ta ra tsā nī hūm̐/ 'khar gsil ①gyi sngags ni las thams cad pa'o/ /'di nyid kyi phyag rgya dang ldan pas lag pa g.yon pa chos gos la 'dzin par byas pa ni chos gos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba bud+dha ⑩a dhiṣ+ṭha ⑩ta da ma ṭī ba ra swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos gos kyi sngags so/ /'di nyid kyi phyag rgya dang ldan par byas na las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /gos la mngon par bsngags nas gos bgos na bsrung tsob chen po byas par 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad dang ma mo dang sha za dang sha rlon za ba dang sdig pa can rnams dang bgegs thams cad kyang mthong ba tsam gyis rab tu 'byer ro/ /mthe bo tigayas g.yon dang mthe'u chung gnyis 8phan tshun sprad pa byas la lag pa'i kha sbyar thur du bstan pa ni lhung bzed kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ lo ka mi'i la a dhiṣ+ṭha ⑩lta ba ra dhā rā ()ya/ ma hā nu bha ba nu dha 1 pā tā swā hā/ phyag rgya 'di dang sngags 'di yang dag par ldan par byas na las thams cad byed do/ /kha zas za ba'i dus su dran par byas na sbyar ba'i dug thams cad nus pa med par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcang (7la mdzub mo gnyis dang gung mo bkug pa 'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /——778

'dir sngags ni/ oṃ te dzo dzā ①la sarba arba sā gedha ka sid dha tsin tā ma ṇi rat+na ①rdul/ nor bu rin po che'i sngags so/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid dang yang dag par ldan na las thams cad byed cing dge ba yin no/ /rgyan gyi khyad par thams cad la 'di nyid kyis ④mngon par bsngags te rgyan rjodu byas na bdag nyid la bsrung ⑥ba chen po byas ⑦par 'gyur ro/ /mchog tu skal ba bzang po ⑧dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /go cha la mngon par bsngags te rang nyid kyis bgo bar byas nas g.yul du 'jug na/ 'di ni 6)lus la mtshon gyis mi phog ⑩cing mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad kyi rang gi yidapung 'byed par 'byed cing pha rol gyi sde yang rab tu gnon 0par byed de/ de la sogs pa tshad med pa'i ④las ma grub pa nyid kyang grub par byed do/ /rin po che pad+ma rā ga dang margad ta la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i rin po tsoche'i khyad par blangs la/ brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa byas nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'am rang gi mgo bo'am glang po che'i mchog tsomar bcing ba byas nas g.yul gyi thog mar zhugs na 7nges par pha rol gyi yidapung dang 'thab pa med pa 0kho nar mthong bas 'jigs par 'gyur ba'am rmugs pa chen po nyid du 'gyur 4 )ba'am bdag po dpung dang bcas pa de dag rab tu 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /sor mo rnams phan tshun bsdus nas khu tshur du byas la sor mo gung mo'i gnas kyi gsum pa'i tshigs kyi cha la mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug pa 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ sbyirnya sbyirnya 0ha na (gyed ha/ tsakra dīp+ta hūm̐/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i sngags so/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bteg (3la rkang pa g.yas pa sa la bzhag ste( ste/ g.yon pa'i rkang pa'i bol gyis g.yas pa (gebarkyang ba'i brla la bzhag la/ lag pa g.yas pas brdeg (nye——779

pa'i tshul du nga rgyal gyis brtan par byas pa 6)'di ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phyag rgya'o / /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tsaṇ+ḍa (mili cham tang gi swā hā/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dang gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags 'di dag nyid dang yang dag par ldan pas las ④thams cad par 'gyur ro / /mdor na sdug bsngal (9thams cad nges par gcod par byed do/ /yiji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba de lta de ltar las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa g.yon pa brla'i steng du dkur brten ⑦la/ lag pa g.yas pas chos ston pa'i phyag rgya ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdung gi phyag rgya yin no/ /'dir sngags ni/oṃ bi dza ye ma hā sha ka (nyeti dhu ra dha 5)ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ bi dza yi ni phaṭa/ mang ga lā ya 7phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdung gi sngags so(nya/ /'di nyid kyi 8phyag rgya dang yang dag par ldan na las thams cad par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs thams cad dang ma rungs pa nyurtethams cad dang dgra thams cad dang lha dang bcas pa yang rengs par byed do/ /'di'i yon tan ni mtha' yas te ji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba de lta de ltar las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa'i sor mo rnams phan tshun de bzhin du byas la/ lag pa gnyis bkan te mdzub mo gnyis kyi mi rtse mo sbyar la de nyid bzlogs la thur 7du bstan te dpral bar bzhag pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi yimadzod spu'i phyag rgyar gsungs so/ /'dir sngags ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha yo 7te bh+yaḥsimyakle 18burnye bh+yaḥ he he brnya bad+dha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha (17r+sā ( )ra ya dhā 8mer ya/ ni run+dha 'a ni run+dha / ur+ṇa ‘ lham ṇi swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod spu'i sngags zhu )'di nyid kyi phyag rgya dang / yang dag par ldan na las thams cad par 'gyur ro/ /88—780

gi wang gi lde ①gus dpral ba la thig ler byas la sngags bzlas na dgra'i nang du zhugs kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /ma rungs pa ②thams cad kyis kyang mi 'tshe bar 'gyur niro/ /g.yul gyi nang du zhugs na yang mthong ba tsam ④gyis gzhan gyi sde 'jig ⑤par byed do/ /ma mthong 6)yang las tshad med pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad med pas kyang gsungs so/ /rgyun mi chad ⑦par phan tshun thal mo sbyar ba byas la mdzub mo gnyis phan tshun rtse sprad la/ tshigs ⑧bar ma bkug cing mthe bo ⑨gnyis kyang bkug pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru sgu ru dzā ⑩la tiṣ+ṭha tunyesidha lo tsa ni sarmār+sha sā lidha ni swā hā/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyi sngags so/ /'di nyid kyi phyag rgya dang yang dag par ldan pas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /mig gnyis la mngon par bsngags te dgra'i nang du zhugs na/ dgra rnams mthong ba tsam gyis tunyebyams pa'i sems dang phan pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bshes yiganyen nyid du'ang ldog par ⑫'gyur te grogs nyid du'ang sgrub par byed do/ /yiyang na g.yul gyi thog mar mig gnyis la mngon par bsngags nas pha rol gyi dpung la bltas na/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par 'gyur zhing mtshon brdeg par rab tu nus pa ma yin no/ /'thab pa med pa nyid du'ang ldog par 'gyur te/ /grogs nyid du'ang rab tu sgrub par byed do/ /lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo de bzhin du glegs bam lta bur phan tshun gyi rtse mo sbyar la/ thad kur bzhag pa 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /'dir sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba te tsu 4 snaru dar+sha ne oṃ thā/she/'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags so/ /'di ——781

nyid kyi 6)phyag rgya dang yang dag par ldan na las thams cad byed ②par 'gyur ro/ /sngags 'di bzlas nas snying la byugs shing myangs dun dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dgra ma rungs pa'i nang du bzlas pa byas na de dag gi sems 'phrog par 'gyur ro/ /④yang na g.yul gyi nang du rkang gnyis dang / rkang bzhi la sogs pa phyir rgol ba thams cad rnam par rmongs par byed pa'am sems rnam par g.yengs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na bcom ldan 'das ma 'di ni ji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba de lta de ltar las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na yon tan mtha' yas pa dang 'di'i las mtha' yas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag rgya dang sngags ni mtha' yas par 'gyur te/ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ⑤'khor 'dus pa'i le'ur gsungs pa de bzhin du sngags dang phyag rgya thams cad la yang rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /yang na gzhan dag tu sngags dang phyag rgya'i cho ga grangs med par 'gyur ba de dag kyang cho ga'i rgyal po 'dir nges par sbyar bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i sngags su 'gyur te/ oṃ dzi dzi dzi ṭ+wāṃ ga haṃ ya te di ne ⑥swā hā/ sngags 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang yang dag par ldan na las (7thams cad par 'gyur ro/ /'di (87bzlas na pad+ma'i rigs thams cad bzlas pa yin no/ /'di grub na pad+ma'i rigs thams cad grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gos dkar mo'i rig pa po)chen po lkugang yin pa de'i sngags ni/ oṃ a 6)ka ṭi bi ka ṭi ni (gye ka shetunye/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi 6swā hā/ rang gi phyag rgya'am pad+ma'i phyag rgya sbyar na las thams cad par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod thams cad du song nas bsrung ba yang 7bya'o/ /de 88—782

bzhin du sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can dang skul ①byed ma dang rta mgrin la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /rig pa 'dus pa'i le 'ur gang gsungs pa'i pad+ma'i rigs grangs med pa thams cad kyang 'dir sbyar bar bya'o/ /phyag rgya dang sngags kyi cho ga rgya cher pad+ma dag kyang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje'i rigs ②kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa yin no/ /'dir yang ①sngags ni/ oṃ ku lo ba ④ri brnya brnya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di ni mā ma tī ⑤zhes bya ba'i rig ⑥pa chen mo las thams cad byed par sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstan to/ /sngar rab tu sbyar ba'i phyag rgya dang rig pa chen mo mā ma tī ⑦dang yang dag par ldan na nisgrub pa po 'dod pa bzhin du las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi'i le'u yo)sngar bstan pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i 'khor 7rdo rje'i rigs ma lus pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang sngags dang ldan pa yang 'dir rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du glang po'i rigs la glang po'i spos kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ oṃ ga dza a hwa ye hūm̐ khe tsa ra swā hā/ sngar bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang yang dag par ldan na las thams cad par 'gyur te/ snga ma de bzhin du thams cad glang po'i rigs la grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du kun tu bzang po'i sngags ni/ oṃ sa ma ya sa ma (nyudzin su ra ta mā ( bi yaṃ ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthu chen thob kyi sngags ni/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ma hā s+thā ()ma ga ta bo dhi/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dri ma med par grags pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ bi ma le bi ma le bi ma la mūrteyi/ oṃ dha ka dha ka sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang yang dag par tsoldan na las thams cad par 'gyur ro//de bzhin du ngan song kun spong dang rtag tu ngu dang sa'i snying po dang rin chen ——783

lag pa dang byams pa la sogs pa sa bcu rab tu thob pa rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang grangs med cing phyag rgya dang sngags kyang grangs med par 'gyur te/ de dag kyang cho ga'i rgyal po 'di la rab tu sbyar ba 6)bya bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi shin tu rgya che ba (gedang bcas pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya thams cad kyi cho ga rgya che ba (gudang dam tshig chen po dang dam tshig la rab tu zhugs pa cho ga dang cho ga'i rnam pa thams cad kyi bye brag cho ga'i rgyal po 'dir gsungs te/ sngags thams cad kyang 'di la sgrub (hopa byar rung ba yin no/ /de bzhin du rin po che'i rigs dang gnod sbyin gyi rigs dang lha'i rigs dag la yang sngags dang rgyud dang phyag rgya thams cad rab tu sbyar ba 'dir bstan (5)pa yin no/ /rigs gcig kho nar 67'gyur zhing gzhan du ma yin pa ni 'di lta ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs te de yang 'jam dpal gzhon nu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su blta bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang /zag pa med pa'i phyag rgya dang / cho ga dang cho ga'i rnam pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi nang du gtogs so zhes gzung 7bar gyis (8)shig /'jam dpal rig 9pa dang rgyud thams cad dang sngags kyi gsang ba gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig la ma chud pa de ni sang yang med do/ /be'ajam dpal gzhon nu de 11rab tu rtogs 12pa nyid du zung 1 shig /gang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu gsungs te 1 de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyang ——784

mchog nyid du brjod do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu de ltar na cho ga'i rgyal po 'di yang rigs kyi mchog rin po cher 0)dang po dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis khurab tu bstan pa dang ston pa dang rab tu gzhag pa dang rnam par 'grel par (5)mdzad pa ni / bcom ldan 'das me tog kun tu skyes pa'i rgyal po dang / bcom ldan 'das sā ④la'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / bcom ldan 'das me tog kun nas skyes pa'i dri mchog rgyal po dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen tog dang /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa dang / bcom ldan 'das bsod nams kyi 'od dang me tog dam pa dang / yang dag pa'i me tog dang / me tog bzang po dang / tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa rnam par nges pa'i rgyal po'i dbang po dang / gser thub dang / 'od sung dang / 'khor ba 'jig dang / gtsug tor can dang thams cad skyob dang / da ltar shākya thub pa ngas kyang 55nyerab tu bstan te/ de bzhin du de ltar sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de 'ongs pa 'di ni 'jam dpal gzhon nu cho ga'i rgyal po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mchog rin po cher gyur pa/ phan yon che ba 56)nges par chos kyi dusadabyings la brten (8)pa/ bskal pa stong du'ang 'di'i phan yon bstan par ni mi nus so/ /yon tan chen po rgya che ba'i yon tan 95'byung ba ni mthong ba'i chos dang 'jig rten pha rol du'ang yin no/ /dad pa can ji gang zhig gis the tshom med par 'chang ba dang klog pa dang / the tshom med par rgyud 'di la brtson pa byed cing sngags sgrub pa dang zlos tsho1pa dang phyag rgya 'ching ba dang rtag tu mngon par brtson par byed pa de la ni mthong ba'i chos kho na la yon tan gyi phan yon brgyad rab tu 'thob ste/ 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ba dang phyir rgol ba thams 88—785

cad dang dgra'i 'jigs pa 'di la mi 'byung ba dang / 'di'i lus la dug mi 'byung ba dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas kyang 'di la byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ba dang tshe ring ba dang / bde ba la brten ①par 'gyur ba dang —/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'ang 'di'i dge ba'i bshes ②gnyen du 'gyur ba dang mtshan mo'ang 'di la nyin re zhing rmi lam du mthong ba stsol ba dang sngags thams cad kyang 'di la bsrung chabar 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya'ang 'di la rmi lam du ston par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po ma rungs pa ④dang sems can ma rungs pa ⑤dang mi phan pa 'dod pa rnams kyis ①kyang gnod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /⑦nges par byang chub la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /dad cing the tshom (mimed la mngon par brtson pa'i phan yon ni brgyad po 'di dag yin te/ khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba'am bud med dam skyes pa'am sems can chen po bstan pa la phan par byed pa rnams kyi yin gyi/ sdig pa la zhugs pa gzhan gyi ni ma yin te/ de las bzlog pa de'i 'gro ba ni ngu 'bod la sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya snga dro bcing ba byas na 99)tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngags dang 'khor gyi snying po dang gtsug tor la sogs pa'i kyisngags dang spyan la sogs pa gzhan gyi phyag rgya 67de bcing bar bya'o/ /yang na 'jam dpal gzhon nu khyod kyi phyag rgya bya 7ste/ 'di dag ni brtson 'grus dang stobs mnyam pa yin no/ /gtsang zhing gtsang ba'i 9steganas su 'dug ste zhes bya ba ni gnas gtsang ma'i 7phyogs su zug rngu med pa'i gnas la ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung bar byugs nyinyal me tog dkar po'i 7dri zhim po dag gis gcal yonabakram pa der 'dug la sngags bzla nya zhing phyag rgya bcing bar bya'i gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /gzhan ——786

dag tu ni phyag rgya dang lhan cig bzlas ①pa gcig kyang mi bya'o/ /②gtsang ba zhes gang gsungs pa ni nyi ma nub pa na srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang mas ③khus ④byas te gos sar 0pa bgos la/ gtsug tor gyi sngags kyis srung ba ⑥byas la/grong gi chos rnam par spangs shing gtsang zhing ⑦gtsang sbra la dga' zhing dge ba ska ⑧rags dkar pos bcings pa ⑨de bzhin gshegs pa bsgoms tshul thun gcig 'das pa yidang der nyal bar bya'o/ /bram ze mo'i 'bu mo gtsang mas bkal ⑫ba'i skud pa blangs la/ sngags 'di brgya 8rtsa brgyad mngon par sngags 8pa ⑩bya'o / /oṃ ha ra ha ra brnya ne shu kra dhā ra tsā sid r+sārje swā hā/ mā ma tī'i hu)phyag rgya dang bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas skud pa rked 4)pa la lan gsum dkris nas bcing ba byas na sa bon bcing ba byas par 'gyur te/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gis 4)kyang rmi lam du yid la gnod pa byed ( )par mi nus na/ rmi lam du log 'dren rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lta 0smos kyang ci dgos/ de bzhin du cho ga 'di ⑤'dod chags dang ldan pas kyang mi nus na/ 'dod chags dang bral bas lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dga' ldan gyi bu mo gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'chang ba'i 'dod chags can gyis ( nyekyang yid la gnod pa skyed par mi nus na de las gzhan pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bud med kyis kyang lta smos (shekyang ci dgos/de lta bu'i cho gas nang par langs la so shing bca' sonyezhing gdong rab tu bkrus la/cho ga snga ma bzhin du srog chags med cing dri ma zhunyemed pa'i chus khrus byas te/shar phyogs su bltas la phyag rgya bcing zhing sngags bzlas pa khrinabyas na tshe ring bar 'gyur zhing las thams cad la nus pa dang nad chen po las grol te skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra rnams kyang bshes gnyen nyid du 'byung bar ——787

'gyur ro/ /mthong ba tsam gyis ①gdon thams cad dang sha rjen za ba dang sdig pa ②can la sogs pa rab tu 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra rnams rengs ①par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba tsam gyis ④gtsang ba'am mi gtsang ba'i cho gas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du cho ga'i rgyal po 'di'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyi tshogs kyi 'khor 'di yang grangs med pa yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med pas gsungs pa dang gsungs pa ⑤yin te/ shākya thub pa ngas kyang da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du gsungs te(6)/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu khyod la yang bstan pa yongs su bsrung ba'i ⑦phyir dang chos kyi dbyings yun ring du yang dag par bsrung (kyeba'i phyir 'di khyod la yongs su gtad do/ /nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das te chos kyi de nyid la brten 6)cing yang dag pa'i mtha'i tha mar gyur te zhi bar gyur pa na/ sems can snying rje chen po dang bral ba'i sems dang ldan pa la phan pa'i phyir gsungs shing ⑩dus kyi mtha' 'jigs pa chen po'i dus la bab pa na/ dkon mchog tustegasum la gnod pa byed pa'i sems can rnams kyang bzlog (nyapa'i don dang gdul ba'i don gyi phyir cho ga'i rgyal po 'di ngas gsungs la rgya cher rnam par dbye ba (snyebyas na sems can thams cad kyi don gyi 7phyir yin no/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/sngags dang phyag rgya dang nges par sdom pa dang las dang cho ga'i le'u rab 'byam las / sum cu rtsa gcig pa rdzogs so'i// //tsho 788

de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gzhan yang thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang la gzigs nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal mdor na nyon cig phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang sngags rnams kyi rgya che ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i mdor bsdus pa dang dam tshig la rjes su 'jug cing phyag rgya'i gnas dang sngags thams cad dang rgyud de dag thams cad la gsang ba dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rdzu 'phrul che kun sangs rgyas kyis/ /'di kun sngar ni gsungs pa yin/ /sngags shes bdag nyid chen po dang / /yon tan kun kyang bstan pa yin/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dag gis ①sngar/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo dag dang ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor(snye/ /yang dag mtha' la brten ③nas ni/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo'i rjes su song / /'jig rten sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che / /sangs rgyas de kun zhi bar gshegs/ /dang po'i de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis④ / /'di kun sngon ni bstan pa yin/ /ngas (5)kyang phyi ma'i dus dag tu/ /'jam pa'i 6)blo ldan khyod la bstan/ /sangs rgyas 'od can de yi bka'/ /de tshe 'di ni thos nas kyang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni gzhon nu yang (/ thal mo sbyar byas (khuspyan sngar 'dug /rkang gnyis rdzogs sangs rgyas pa la/ /smra ba'i mchog gis po)yongs su zhus/ /'jig rten rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /shes rab chen po yichos gsungs shig /mdor bsdus rgya ni mi che bar/ /yon tan bdag nyid che 'bras 'byung / /'jam dpal gyis ni de skad gsol/ /de nas cang mi smra bar gnas/ /de nas dpal ldan tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /ka la ping ku'i sgra skad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /de dag kun ni ston pa yin//88—789

gnas gtsang steng du gnas pa'i dus/ /de tshe sngags dang rgyud dag ni/ /shākya seng ge mi mchog ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ①yang dag gsungs/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga 'byung ba dang / /phyag rgya rgyud dang ldan pa yi/ /yon tan bdag nyid rgya che ba/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu khyod nyon cig /sems can sems can ma yin pa'ang —/ /dang po'i ②rtags mtshan bzhin du bya/ /rnam pa ②spyad dang spyod ①pa dang —/ /zur ⑤gyis thams cad smra ba dang / /lag gnyis rkang gnyis spyi bo dang ske/ /lag gcig sor mo'i sbyor ba dag /sngon gyi sangs rgyas de dag gis/ /de kun phyag rgya zhes su gsungs/ /bya bum gdugs dang de bzhin du/ /pad+ma rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /nya dang rdo rje dung dang ni/ /de bzhin bum pa 'khor lo dang / /'jig rten sna tshogs mtshon cha ni/ /ji srid yongs su bstan pa dang / /ut+pal 'dra ba'i phyag rgya dang / /de kun phyag rgya dkyil 'khor dgod / /de dag go rims yiganas pa dang / /cho ga ldan par bstan pa yin/ /rtag tu de dag nyid la ni/ /rang gzugs 'dra bar bri bar ༷bya/ /dkyil 'khor phyag rgyar gsungs pa ni/ /thams cad du ni spyir gsungs pa'o/ /de dag phyag rgyar yongs bstan pa/ /gnas ni ji bzhin dag la dgod/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni kun la yang / /rang dang 'dra ba nyid du sbyar/ /'khor los sgyur la 'khor lo dang / /gtsug tor gdugs dkar nyid la ni/ /gtso bor gdugs ni dkar po yin/ /dkyil 'khor la ni rtag tu bri/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas la/ /pad+ma pad+ma'i rigs dag la/ /rdo rje rdo rje'i rigs la ⑧gsungs / /glang po glang po'i rigs zhes bya/ /nor bu'i rigs la bum pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rab tu sbyar/ /lha gzhan gyi ni rigs dag la/ /dpal ——790

be'u bkra shis ldan pa bri/ /tshangs pa che la ngang pa bri/ /brgya byin la yang rdo rje dang ske/ /dbang phyug che la bri ba ni/ /rtse gsum khyu mchog yang dag bya/ /skem byed rtse gsum partsi sa/ /mdung dang bcas pa nyid kyang yin/ /khyab 'jug 'khor lo bri ba ste/ /lha ma yin la da pus dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs brgya phrag ni / /lha yi mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / /de dag gzhan yang bzhon ①pa ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs de tshe bri/ /gzugs brnyan ji ltar gnas pa ni/ /rang gzugs 'phos pa bzhin du bri/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad du/ /gang yang rung ba ②'di cig ③bri/ /gcig dang gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /grangs med gsum la sogs pa bya/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal ba mchog gsungs ④pa/ /lan kun phreng ni de dang mnyam/ /gang gi ched du dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /de ni dbus su nges par sbyar/ /rgyal ba'i rigs ni nang du bri/ /nang gi dbus su'ang sangs rgyas te/ /de tshe nang du'ang gzugs brnyan ni/ /ston pa yi ni kun tu bri/ /gnyis par pad+ma'i rigs dgod cing / /gsum par rdo rje'i rigs kyang bri/ /mthar gyis ⑧lha dang lha ma (7yin/ /de bzhin de tshe thams cad ni / /de nas sa kun la gnas pa'i/ /gnod sbyin srin po mi dang bcas/ /mthar gyis stiji ltar gnas pa yi/ /mu stegs rnams kyang de nas bri/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad kyang / /phyogs skyong de bzhin bri bar bya/ /mdor na gzugs brnyan gcig dang ni/ /gnyis dang gsum sogs grangs med pa/ /mtha' yas phyogs la gnas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor ji srid kun tu bri/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor nyid dag ni/ /tshad med de tshe bri (kyebar bya/ /gzugs brnyan gcig la sogs pa ni/ /mtha' yas sa yi steng dag tu/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga ——791

gsungs pa ni/ /rnam pa gsum du nges bstan pa/ /mchog dang bar ma de bzhin du/ /tha ma nyid du'ang bstan pa yin/ /mchog la mchog dag grub pa dang ske/ /'bring la 'bring du nye bar bstan/ /tha mas phran tshegs grub par ①ni/ /rgyal ba mchog gis sngon gsungs so/ /sems can yid ni rnam gsum gyis/ /rgyal ba khyamachog gis grub par gsungs/ /sems can chen pos chen po skye'agrub/ /sems can 'bring gis 'bring dang ni/ /gsum pa skye bo phra mo yi/ /las ni phra mor nye bar bstanali/ /sangs rgyas nyid du sems dang la/ /phun sum tshogs pa dam pa ni/ /nges par thob par 'gyur ba ste/ /sems can dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ /de dus sems ni bar ma yis(snye/ /rang rgyal byang chub thob par byed/ /gus pa med pas nyan thos nyid/ /tha mas nges par thob par byed//bdag nyid chen po don bcas 'bras/ /zhi ba'i 'gro bar 6)nye bar bstan/ /dkyil 'khor mthong bas (77mtho ris su/ /nges par de ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin phyag rgya mchog kun dang / /sngags rnams kyang (nyani rgya cher bcas/ /rnam gsum nyid kyang rab sbyar ba/ /rnam gsum bde ba po)rab tu byed/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor gsungs pa dang / /sngags rnams bstan pa'ang phan pa'i don/ /de dag rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /sngags kyang rnam gsum mnyam par bstan7/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor bstan pa bzhin/ /phyag rgya sngags kyang de bzhin te(nye/ /'di dag cho gar yang dag ldan/ /'jig rten 'dren pas nges par bstan/ /de bzhin de yang rnam gsum 'gro/ /stong khri phrag dag ni du ma nyidayi / /rnam gsum rnam pa gsum dag kyang / /rnam pa gnyis dang grangs med pa'o/ /gang phyir sngags ni sems la ltos/ /sngags ni sems kyis spangs ⑩/mi bya/ /sems ——792

dang sngags ni yang dag ldan/ /lhan cig tu ni bsgrub ①par bya/ /de bzhin khugashegs kyi rigs ①sngags dang / /gang yang pad+ma'i rigs dag dang / /gang yang rdo rje'i rigs gsungs dang / /mi yi rigs ni nyid dag dang / /'jig rten pa yi sngags rnams kun/ /de dag ma lus 'di las byung / /gang zhig rgyal dang rgyal sras sngags/ /sems can phyir ni gsungs pa rnams/ /gang zhig de zlos ④mngon brtson pa'ang / /de nas changes par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gang yang sngags ni bar ma dag /gang zhig zlos pa de zlo yibyed/ /rang sangs rgyas su yang dag bstan/ /nges par de yi rigs kyang yin/ /sngags ni tha mar rab zhugs (7pa/ /nyan thos dgra bcom gyis bshad dang / /'jig rten ma lus kun la yang / /sngags zlos pa la mngon brtson pa/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po yis(8) / /nges par rigs su de gnas yin/ /mchog dang tha ma bar ma yi5) /der yang las ni rab sbyar bya/ /zhi bas sangs rgyas byang chub 'gyur/ /rgyas pa yis yini rang rgyal tetunye/ /gzhan pa phran tshegs las kyis ()ni/ /nyan thos kyi ni byang chub brjod/ /de ni rnam gsum dbye ba ste/ /der yang sems ni blta bar bya / /mang por yang ni dbye bya ste/ /grangs med par yang dbye bas so/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa tsochen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag rgya dang / sngags dang /las thams cad dang nges par sdom pa'i le'u rab 'byam yilas sum cu rtsa gnyis pa rdzogs sotso// //de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon phyag na rdo rje 'khor der 'dus par gyur te/88—793

byed dang ni brgya ①byin dang / /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras dag ni/ /dam tshig 'dzin par byed pa dang / /sa bcu la ni yang dag gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /gang zhig dgra bcom rang rgyal dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po chags bral ba/ /dam tshig sngon byas de dag gis/ /bsrung bar ⑤yang ni mi nus sog/ /mdor bsdus stinas ni bshad par bya/ /'byor pa 'dod pas mnyan par gyis/ /zlos pa sems ni ma dang na/ /gzhan gyis nus par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags pa mchog ni mi dga' na/ /de 'dir zhi ba ga la yod/ / bdag nyid chen po gshin rje gshed/ /khro bo'i rgyal po zlos pa po/ /gang tshe yid ni dang ba dang / /gang tshe snying rje (nyebarlan gyur pa/ /de tshe de ni zhi thob pa'am/ /brtan ⑥pa'am 'tsho ba 'dzin par 'gyur/ / brtsu marda yungs ⑦mar dang / /rang skyur dug dang ldan ⑧pa ni/ /khrag dang mi yi sha dang ni/ /lan tshwa tsha ba gsum dang ni/ /ske tshe dug gi phye po)ma dang / /star bu dzodang ni sum gyi sha /lang tang tse 47yi rtsa ba dang / /de bzhin ko sha ta ku'i dang / / e ren (nyed rtsa nas tshig thal/ / le brgan /gertsi dang gze ma dang / /po son cha tsoyi rtsa ba dang //de bzhin sgog skya 8ke'u dang / /gzhan gyi zhag dang chu dang ni/ /kun yidong chang ni btung bar bcas/ /'di kun cha mnyam byas nas ni/ /ras ris nye bar sbyin sreg bya/ /sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas na/ /zla ba phyed kyi nang du ni/ /bu dang gnyen sdug bcas pa yi/ /dgra rnams rtsad yinanas 'jig 'gyur te/ /'khor kun ma lus 'joms par byed/ /gnyis pa'i nang du sbyin sreg byas/nye/ /de yi rtsad dzistenas 'byin par byed/ /zlos pas me nang sbyin sreg byas/ /gsum pa'i dus su phyin pa na/ /de yi grong rdal bcas de ce )la/ /mu ge dag ni 'byung ——805

ba dang / /char mi 'bab cing 'chi ba mang / /srin pos ①kun tu khyab pa dang ske/ /mes tshig rdo yi char 'bab dang / /rdo rje dang ni thog kyang 'bab/ /ljongs dang phyogs dang yul dang ni/ /ji snyed rgyal po de la yod/ /'tshe ba mang po phyirab 'byung zhing / /de bzhin gzhan gyi dmag tshogs 'byung ①/ /de yi yul du 'tshe ba ni/ /du ma mang po dag kyang 'byung / /dpal min mang po rab ston pa / /rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lad ⑥tang rtsa bas sbyin sreg byas/ /de la rims nad ⑤'byung bar 'gyur/ /tsha bas rtag tu sbyin sreg ⑥byas/ /tsha ba chen po skye bar 'gyur/ /shin tu skyur bas sbyin sreg byasal/ /grang ba'i rims ⑧ni yang dag 'byung / /ma rungs rgyal po stobs kyis dregs/ /de yi lus la de dag 'gyur/ /phyogs che 0nor dang ldan pa dang / /gdug cing dpung chen ⑩yang dag gnas/ /de yi 'tsho ba tha ma ni/ /nub gnyis yang na bdun gyis so/ /gang zhig gang la dad lha'am/ / skyes pa'i 7skar ma ming yang rung / /ras ris mdun du gzugs bya ba/ /dur khrod sol bas bris pa la/ /mgo la rdog pas mnan nas ni/ /khro bas bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /glo bur rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i / /mi yi bdag po zug gzer tso'abyung / /nad chen pos ni thebs 'gyur te / /de yi mod la'ang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /yang na dgra stas tsogacod pa 'am/ /yan lag r+sha)kyang ni mi tshang 8'gyur/ /sdig yican mi ma yin pa yi/ /srin po gdug pas za bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi 'khor dang bcas pa dag /sha rjen za dang srul po dang / /sha za yi dgas ma mo yis/ /de yi mod la'ang gsod par byed / /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /de tshe 'khor la 'di 7skad smras/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nas cang mi smra bar gnas/ /'jig ——806

rten rnams la phan 'dod phyir/ /'di skad du ni yang smras pa/ /gnod sbyin mo ni thams cad dang / /gnod sbyin ①kun tshogs bos nas ni/ /de tshe gnod sbyin bdag po stel/ /byang chub sems dpa' ②smras pa ni/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis duras ris smras/ /'dod pa kun dang nye bar ldan/ /'gugs par byed dang dbang byed kun/ /zug rngu ma lus yang dag 'byin/ /sngags pa gang tshe 'khrig ⑤pa 'dod/ /'dod chags ldongs ①pa'am rmongs pa'i blos/ /bder ⑦gshegs bkas kyang bzlog pa dang / /gnyen pos kyang ni mi nus so/ /thog ma ⑧med pa'i 'khor ba nas/ /shin tu sdug bsngal ①rgyu sngon byas/ /de dag sdug bsngal sdug bsngal bar/ /snying rje chen pos ⑩'gro ba gdungs/ /tshangs spyod dbang po dul bas ni/ /bde 'gro dag ni thob par yi'agyur/ /bzang po shis par bstan pa dang / /mthar ni zhi ba'ang thob par 'gyur/ /theg pa gsum la brten nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa legs pa 'thobatso/ /bzlog pa blo ngan gyis ⑫zin pa/ /'dod chags kyis ldongs bka' byathub med/ /'khor ba mi zad ⑫tshang tshing gi/ /'gro ba lngar ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /de dag sdug bsngal ldan don du/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod rjod par byedayi/ /khro bo 'di ni mnyes byas na / /sdig pa kun las ldog ⑩par 'gyur/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed kyi mngon spyod dang legs par sdom pa'i le'u rab 'byam (nyalas sum cu rtsa bzhi pa rdzogs so/zhe// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhi ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba ——807

'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur pa de stan las langs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug steyo)/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la lan gsum bskor ②ba byas nas zhabs gnyis la btud de / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje de dul bltas nas tshig 'di smras so/ /phyag na rdo rje gang khyod sems can thams cad la gnod par byed pa dang / 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i sngags dang rgyud bshad na/kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 0nges par chos 'di ni ma yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 6)chen po ni gang gi phyir snying rje chen pos ⑦rab tu phye zhing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod cing sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir/ phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa la rab tu zhugs na 'khor ba'i 'ching ba las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang sems can la gnod par byed pa'i chos ston pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis (81ni sems can thams cad kyi ched du gsungs pa ma yin te / snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir sems can thams cad la phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa la rab tu zhugs pa yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la smras pa / ji ltar khyod smras pa (khyadang ji ltar khyod rab tu ston pa de bzhin du zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpas kyibaslab par bya/ de bzhin du bsgrub par bya/ji ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bstan par bgyi'o/ /don dam par ni yang dag pa'i 47——808

mtha' la yang dag par brten ①nas chos kyi mtha' las ⑧grol ba thob par 'gyur ro / /sems can mtha' ni bsam mi khyab/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab / /sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /byang chub spyod ①pa'ang bsam mi khyab / /gdul ba'i sems can la brten ④nas/ /phan pa'i spyod pa bsam mi khyab / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnams/ /bsam mi khyab par yongs su bstan / /rgyud rnams kun la rgyud 'di yi/ /mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab ⑤yin/ /gshin rje gshed ni bdag nyid che/ /khro bo'i ⑥rgyal po'i sngags dag dang sti/ /yul gsum dag kyang bsam mi khyab/ /rtogs pa'i bdag nyid bsam mi khyab/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa ni bsam gyis (kyimi khyab ste6)/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu mthun ⑩pa las byung ba'i sgrub pa yang bsam gyis tunyemi khyab bo/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' sngags zlos pa na ti'adi ltar sems bskyed 8par bya ste/ 'phags pa ma yin pa'i sems can 'dod pa la lhag par chags pas bsod nams 8ma yin pa shin tu rab tu mang por 8'phel bas dmyal ba chen por skye zhing sems can 'di dag ni bsod nams kyi phung po shin tu mang po 'di 'phel bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can 'di dag byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi 'askal ba med par mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir/ zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sngags zlos pas sems nye bar gzhag yo sgyupar bya zhing thabs mkhas pa 'di la mngon spyod kyi tunyelas rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /las thams cad la yang mtshan mar 'dzin par mi bya'o/ /mi dge bar 4)'dzin par mi bya zhing snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ru )sems can gdul ba'i thabs la yang bslab par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang chos dang ——809

chos ma yin pa dang / dkar po dang / nag po dang / dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / 'gro ba'i bdag nyid chen po sems can 'dul ①ba'i thabs sgrub pa dang / chos kyi dbyings sgrub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ②rab tu rtogs par 'gyur te/ de nyid chos ston pas sems can smin pa'i thabs kyang rab tu sgrub par byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du bdag cag gis bslab par ③bya zhing / 'di lta ste/ sems can gdul ba dang sems can smin pa 0dang bstan par bya ba'i phyir dang de la rgyal ba'i sras khyed cag gang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir dam tshig chen po la zhugs pa de ⑤thams cad kyis mnyan ⑥par bya/ dad par bya de nyid dge ba dang mi dge ba tshol ⑦ba nyid du bya ste/'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston pa la mngon par dga' bar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhi ba'i blo (nyegros kyis ⑨gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la rnam par bltas nas cang mi smra bar gyur te / /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni bsam gyis ⑩mi khyab bo zhes yid la byas nas / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das (sprel rnam par lta bzhin du rang gi tistan la 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas gsang ba 'o)pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes ④thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de la rnam par bltas 8nas khro bo'i rgyal po'i cho ga yang smras pa/ gang dag lha'i tshogs dang sems can gyi khams la brten ⑩pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs khyed cag nyon cig /dang por chare zhig bsrung ba byas (nyal khro bo'i rgyal po'i ras ris de yongs su blangs la/ gnas dben par song nas dbang phyug chen po'i rtags gcig pa'i gnas su rtags de la dug dang khrag dang ske tshe ()dang / rang skyur gyis gtor la shing bi tsu (nyamar da'i me tog gis mchod cing ——810

mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa dag gis bdag nyid la mchod phyir thogs byas la/ mi'i mgo bo'i thod pa g.yas pa'i lag pa ①na thogs pas brdegs ②pa lta bur byas la/lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs ①mdzub kyis mtshon gcig po la sdigs dupa bzhin du byed cing gtsor khro ba'i dudabang du gyur pa dang rgyal po ma rungs pas dubarnyas pa chen po'i sems kyis ④byas pa'am/ gzhan skyon can gyi skyes dubu phyogs chen po dang ldan pa dang nor chen po dang ldan pa dang rab tu gtum pa chen po dang gtso bo chen po dag gis khyakhyad du gsod par 'gyur na/ sgo bcad (nyepa byas la/gcer bur byas shing skra bshig pas dbang phyug chen po'i mtshan la khro bo'i sngags ji srid dbang phyug chen po'i mtshan dkyil du gas par gyur pa de srid du bzlas pa bya'o / /dum bu gnyis su gyur na yi ge hūm̐ gi sgra chen po yang thos par 'gyur 0te de la 'jigs par yang mi bya'o/ /de thos pa'i dbang gis ⑩rgyal po ma rungs pa'am ()gzhan gang la la dpung chen po dang ldan pa'i dgra de'i mod la rims (stechen pos zin par 'gyur ba'am/ srin po la sogs pa mi ma yin pas zin par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid du 'ji srid yud 8tsam du bzlas pa byas na de'i mod la dgra rnams kyi ⑩'tsho ba ni tha (nyamar 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtshan mo bzlas na yini gza' 'khor dang bcas pa 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang las su 'gyur ba ni de bzhin du dbang phyug chen po'i gnas su nyi ma phyed ( )la song ste/ nim pa'i lo mas mchod cing sha chen po'i spos kyis bdug 0la ji srid dgra'i khyim du mes tshig pa'i bar du bzlas mnyepa byas na dgra yang 'dar ba'i rims 'chen pos thebs (nyepar 'gyur ro/ /yang na khros pas bzlas (gepa ma btang zhing g.yas phyogs su rtags kyang yod na dgra de 'chi bar 'gyur zhing rigs rgyud 'jig 69——811

par 'gyur ro/ /ji ste slar gso bar 0)byed na ni rtags de chus phyir yang rab tu bkrus la shin tu bsil ba'i 'o mas khrus byas na slar yang sos par 'gyur ro/ /las gzhan yang yod de dbang phyug chen po'i mtshan g.yas phyogs ②su bzhag la po son cha'i gshing dang tsher ma can gyi shing gis ④me rab tu sbar la/ shing pā kai duta ku'i yam shing la dug dang khrag dang ske tshe la mngon par btags ⑥la stong rtsa brgyad kyi sbyin sreg byas na/ dgra thams cad nad chen pos thebs ⑦par 'gyur te / las thams cad kyis (nyekyang nus pa med par 'gyur ro/ /zhag gnyis pa la ni rims khyand chen po dang zug gzer 7chen pos thebs ⑩pa'am nad rnam pa sna tshogs sam mi ma yin pas zin cing mthar 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag gsum pa la grangs gsum gyis 8byas na ⑩ni 'tsho ba thams cad kyi tsothams cad du 'dor bar 'gyur ro/ / slar gso bar byed na ni 'o ma'i sbyin sreg byas na zhi bar 'gyur ba ni yul mi thams cad dang dgra thams cad kyang sos par 'gyur ro/ /⑫de bzhin du lha thams cad dam lha 7mo thams cad dam 'byung po thams cad gang zhig gang gi lha la dad pa de rkang pas mnan pa'i las bya ba'am/ / yang na de'i tunyergyu skar ram sngags sam ming yisadag la rkang pas mnan 67la las bya ste( )/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rig pa 31ni ma gtogs te/ thams cad kyis kyang ( nyezhabs kyi mthe bo 7 snyegayon pa bzung ste las bya'i/ mnan 69par yang mi bya bgom par yang dgemi bya'o/ /gang yang 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi sngags ni mnan nas las bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i bzlas 6nyapa ma grub pa nyid kyang bzlas pa tsam kho nas las rnams byed par 'gyur/ sngags thams cad rnam par 'jig par 'gyur / dgra thams cad 'joms ( par 'gyur/ sngags thams cad nus pa ——812

med par 'gyur ①ra/ /mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sngags kyi cho gas kyang ji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba de lta de ltar thams cad sgrub par 'gyur/ bzlas pa tsam gyis re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur rol/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i ②sngags 'di bzlas pa tsam kho nas grub pa nyid de grub pa dam pa'ang rjes su rab tu sbyin no/ /yid la 'dod pas dgra rnams 'joms par byed do/ /mdung rtse chen po'i phyag rgya dang ldan par byas na las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /las gzhan du'ang 'gyur ba ni nyi ma phyed la dur khrod du song ste/ sreg pa'i sar mtshan gcig nismyung ba byas te/ mar ngo'i bcu bzhi la dur khrod kyi shing gis me rab tu sbar la/ dug dang khrag gis btags pa'i ske tshes ④phyin sreg byas na/ de las ha ha zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs ⑧shing / yi dgas thams cad 'ong bar 'gyur na 'jigs (7par mi bya zhing dgra la gnod par ⑦gyis shig ces byas na/ de bzhin du bya'o zhes smras nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ / de nas (nyeyud tsam gyis dpag tshad stong du yang song nas/ dgra rnams 'joms 6)par byed cing rigs rgyud kyang rlag yipar byed do/ /de la (nyasogs pa'i las mang po byed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang las su 'gyur ba ni dben pa'i phyogs gtsang mar yigos gtsang ma bgos te/ /khang stong du rab tu zhugs nas mi'i rus pa'i sreg tu blugs kyis stong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas teyi/ de nas thal ba de lag pa gnyi yigs blangs la/ gos gtsang ma'i dum bu la so sor bcings 7te thum po gnyis su byas la/ kham por kha sbyar gnyis kyi nang du so sor bzhag la/bdag nyid srung ba chen po byas nas rdzas de blangs ()la/ khyim du slar zhugs nas mtshan mo dur khrod chen por song nas/ mar ngo'i bcu bzhi'am tshes ——813
