byed kyi ①khros la 'dug ste/ gtsang zhing gtsang ba'i sa phyogs dben par ji srid nam phyed pa de srid du sngags bzlas pa byas na nges par 'ong bar 'gyur zhing de nas ma dang sring mo dang chung ma sngar ji lta ba de thams cad byed par 'gyur te/thams cad kyang rgya cher brjod par bya'o/ /bdun po 'di dag gnod sbyin ma/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bka' yis ①kyang / /lha dang lha min khams gsum du/ /sa rnams kun tu yongs su rgyu/ /mi yul dag na sbyor bar dga'/ /snying rjer ⑧ldan zhing rnam par rgyu/ /kha cig phag ma byis pa godang / /gnod sbyin ma gzhan blun pa'o/ /gzhan dag phan byed 'tshe ba yang / /de bzhin mtshan mo duyongs su rgyu/ /byis pa'i 'tsho ba 'phrog pa'i phyir/ /bskam yizhing sha ni za byed gzhan/ /gang phyir 'dzam gling 'ongs pa ni/ /de bzhin khrag la chags byed pa'o/ /rtag tu srog la gnod byed pa'i/ /khrag la dga' ba'i gnod sbyin moX/ /srung byed 'chi dang bcas gyur pa'i/ /khyim ni kun tu yongs su rgyu/ /de dag tshar bcad bsgrub (7don du/ /dam tshig 'di ni rab tu bstan/ /ji ltar 'dod chags 'ching ba la/ /byis pa rnams ni bsdus pa'i don/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /de ltar 'di kun gsungs pa yin/ /'dod chags kyis ldongs ⑨sems rmongs pa'i/ /gang tshe sngags pa 'khrig don gnyer/ /sngags kyis ⑩bkug byas longs spyad nya1pa/ /gnod sbyin mo 'am srin mo 'am/ /klu mo'am yang na dri za 'am1ste/ /mi 'am ci 'am lha min mkhyenye/ /lha min lha bas yimachog gyur pa'i / /sa 'og gnas ni nyams dga' bar/ /gang du bud med grangs med pa/ /sngags shes der 'ini rab tu 'jug /sngags shes sngags ni chos ⑩pa dag /der song bskal 7par gnas par 'gyur/ /byams pa zhes bya'i husterdzogs sangs rgyas/ /——830

sangs rgyas chen po 'byung 'gyur te/ /de tshe de ①ni dam chos thos/ /thos nas rab tu grol bar 'gyur/ /lha dang lha min bu mo dang / /rig 'dzin bu mo dam pa dag /sngags kyis bkug nas spyod byed cing / /de tshe lha yi bde bas dga'//sngags pa 'dzam ①bu'i gling gnas pas / /de nyid du ni rtag 'dren pa/ /gang tshe gtsang gnas gsang ba dang / /gtsang sbra spyod la ༷rtag dga' ba'o⑤/ /grub pa dam pa rmongs rnams la/ /nam yang sems la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /bshang gci mi gtsang gnas dang ni/ /rtag tu dri nga rul ba dang / /nad kyis ༷sdug bsngal mya ngan dang / /tha mar 'chi zhing sdug bsngal snod/ /bral ba'i rnam par yang dag ldan/ /mi yi bud med reg mi bya/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa dang / /stong pa gsog dang ther zug med/ /byis pa rnams ni rjes gabrid dang / /kun tu rtogs ⑧las byung ba la/ /thog ma med las 6)'dod kun 'byung ⑩/ /sngags pas 'dod pa (nyebasten 8mi bya/ /de dag chags bral zhes gsungs te/ /rnam grol de dag grub pa nyid/ /gang zhig 'dod la chags bral ba/ /'di yi sngags ni 'grub par 'gyur/ / bshang gci 8khrag gis brlan pa dang / /rul bas kun tu khyab pa dang / /rga dang 'chi dang mya ngan bcas/ /mi yi lus la reg mi bya / /rmongs pa'am chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /der ni 'khrig pa brten ④mi bya / /de dag rtag tu mi gtsang brten8/ /sngags kyi grub pa rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sngags shes sngags kyi snyigazugs can dang / /shes ldan dbang po thul ()ba dang tso//dpa' bo gtsang ba'i spyod la dga'/ /rtag tu de yi sngags kyang 'grub/ /pad+ma mtho ma tunyerab dga' ma( )/ /mi pham ma dang rtag rgyal dang / /sngo bsangs ldan pa'i gnod sbyin mo/ /rdzu 'phrul che 'di sonyeganod sbyin mo(gye/ /pad+ma mtho ma'i ——831

sngags ni/ oṃ pad+ma uts+tsha 0)swā hā/ 'di'i cho ga ni gang gā'i (gengogs sam rgya mtsho'i ngogs sam skyed ②mos tshal gyi me tog gi ldum ra'i nang du lo ma'i spyil po byas te rab tu gtsang zhing bdag nyid kyang gtsang bar ④byas la/ rdo 'am sa'i sgo glegs phyibyas la de nyid du mtshan mo sgo bcad nas 'dod pa'i yo ⑥byad kyi longs spyod rnams bsogs te(3)/ de nyid du bdag nyid dang nye bar gnod sbyin mo'i mal yang bsham par bya ste/ rig pa stong phrag bcu (nyabazlas pa byas la de bzhin du zla ba gcig dzin byas na 7nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs yinas kyang 'dod pa la longs spyad tu par byas na/ mu tig gi phreng ba bzang po mal du yongs su bor nas tho rangs hunye'agro bar 'gyur te/ ji srid zla ba drug gi 8bar du nyin 'ire zhing rtag tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te mu tig gi phreng ba de ⑩len na ni de tsam kho nar (rteyod par 'gyur la(nya/ phreng ba rin po che chen pos ()nye bar mdzes par byas pa de ni ti na ra na )'bum ri ba yin no/ /zla ba drug 'das nas ni rtag tu gnas par 'gyur (1ro/ /chung ma 'dod pa thams cad ster bar byed pa ji ltar rjes su mthun pa 'dod pa de ltar ( nyarjes su mthun par zhu)byas te/ nye bar gnas par byed do/ /sgrub pa pos 9 1'dod pa bzhin du ji ltar 'dod pa bdag nyid kyis mngon par sprul bar byed do/ /gnod sbyin mo thams cad kyi cho ga yang 'di yin no/ /ji ltar bstan pa 'di dang gzhan du yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal ba ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ dza ye su dza ye dza ya ma ti sarba kār+sā ṇi zhi me ku ru swā hā/ gser mdog lus ni sna tshogs lus/ /sngo zhing 'khyil pa'i skra dang ldan/ /lha mo yan lag kun mdzes ma/ /zhi ba'i 'od ldan skal ldan dge po / /snyan smra sgeg ldan gtso mo ste/ /mu tig 'od ldan mthong na mdzes/ /88—832

rab bsngags gzugs ldan smin ma mdzes/ /'jig rten kun gyis legs par mchod / /cung zad dmar ba'i gos gyon pa/ /de ni rgyal mar 6)mngon par stonam/ /'di'i (micho ga ni dang po 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa byas na sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dgon pa chen por rab tu zhugs nas/'bras bu'i zas za zhing ji srid du rang nyid kyi gzugs kyis ni'ong ba de'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /'ongs ④nas kyang smra ba ni ci zhig bya zhes so/ /gal te mar gyur (5nyen ni ma bzhin du re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / rgyal thabs ster bar byed la nor gyi bdag po chen po yang byed la tshe ring ba nyid du yang gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste sring mor 'gyur na ni dpag tshad stong du gnas kyang ji ltar 'dod pa'i bud med 'gugs (6)par byed de gnyin re zhing yang ti na (8)ra 'bum sbyin par byed de de yang zad par bya'o/ /ci ste chung mar 6)gyur na ni rang gi gnas su khyer te/ lha'i gzhal med khang du 'dzegs yinas/de dang lhan cig dga' bar byed cing / dus ring por (nyalo stong phrag sum cu'i bar du ji ltar 'dod par yo rnam par spyod de/ gnod sbyin chen po dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /rab tu dga' ma'i tsho sngags ni/ /oṃ ṣ+ṭṛ ñtsā tu )ma hā nasdi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i/ 'di'i cho ga ni mtshan phyed kyi bar du bzlas pa grangs med pa byas te/phyir yang gnyid log par ma byas na zla ba gcig gi nang du nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /chung mar 'gyur spun ni 'dod pa thams cad sbyin par byed (1)de/nyin re zhing ti na pho ra nyi shu rtsa lnga rab tu sbyin par byed dokhri)/ /rang gi mdzod nyid kyang ston par byed do/ /dus ring por tsho yang 'tsho bar byed do/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin mo brgya stong phrag du ma yang yod do/ /de bzhin du sha za mo 88—833

dang sha za mo 7rdzu 'phrul che ba ②dang / klu'i bu mo dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo dang ske/ lha'i bud med dang / lha ma yin gyi bud med dang / de bzhin du rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi bud med dang mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi sngags grangs med pa dag kyang yod do/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / drang srong ①rnams dang / dri za rnams dang /lha ma yin rnams dang / yi dgas rnams dudang / srin po rnams dang /tshangs pa chen po dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / khyab 'jug dang / ma mo rnams dang / dbang mo dang / rgan byad ⑤ma dang / phag mo la sogs pa'i sngags rnams kyang yod de/ so so so sor thams cad dam tshig gis 'dir bkug ⑥nas khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed kyis zos pa dang dam tshig la bzhag cing /'jam pa'i dbyangs la nye bar gtad nas rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur te/ go rims 4)bzhin du gnas shing bsnyen bkur yang byed do/ /thams cad kyi yang mdor bsdu na 'khrul 'khor gyi gzugs sam de nyid kyi gzugs brnyan byas nas khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed kyi rig pa ci srid gzugs brnyan rab tu 'gul ba'am rab tu g.yo ba'am (8sterdul 'byung ba'i bar du bzlas pa byas na rang nyid kyi gzugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur te/ gang smras pa de thams cadri yang dag par sgrub par byed do/ /de bzhin du gang gzhan yang gzhon nu ma bzhi gnod sbyin ma chen po'i (9)ming po tum bu ru zhes bya ba yang dag par rten pa/ gru'i theg pa la yang dag par zhon pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis rab tu mchod pa/ sems can rnams rjes su 'dzin par byed pa de dag kyang cho ga 'di bzhin du bya'o/ /dper na ras sam rtsig pa'am spang leb la mtsho'i dkyil du bri bar bya ste/ gru'i theg pa 88—834

la zhon pa phu bo ①ming po'i rjes su 'gro ba bu mo bzhi po ②nyid kyang rgya mtsho'i nang du zhugs ①shing mnyam par 'dug pa'o/ /de dag mi snang gnas bzhag ④nas/ /khro bo'i bzlas pa yang dag brtsam/ /de tshe g.yo 'gul rdul 'byung bar/ /de dag kun ni skye 'gyur b.radu/ /de tshe grub pa yin shes nas/ /sngags kyi yibazlas pa yongs su btang ⑦/ /mtshan mo'i tha mar rang tshul nyid/ /dge dang mi dge ston par 'gyur/ /skad cig gis ni zlos pa yis(nya/ /don rnams thams cad sgrub 6)par 'gyur/ /khro bos bkug tho )cing rgyas byas nasatunye/ /smras pa thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /rtag tu nyi ma sogs kyi gza'/ /de bzhin drang srong srin po dang / /nam mkha' lding dang sha zas ()kyang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po de dag mchod / /dbang phyug che sogs 'byung pos kyang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po de dag mchod / /de dag gis bshad cho ga dang / /sngags rgyud rgya che bcas ()pa yi /thams cad de dag khro rgyal gyiyi/ /'bad pa med par dbang du 'gyur/ /gang dag sngags ni ci yod pa/ /khro bo 'chol 8ba rnyog 'byung ba/ /de kun khro bo'i rgyal po yi/ /de dag bsgo ba mnyan 7par bstan/ /gang yonayang 'phags pa'i sngags dag ni/ /thams cad kun 'gro'i khyad par can/ /mchog dang rab mchog drag po dang / /gang yang de bzhin rgyal bas (shegasungs/ /de bzhin pad+ma 'dzin sngags dang / /bdag nyid kyis kyang rab bshad dang / /gang yang gzhan gyi ()sngags mchog ni/ /rigs lnga dag gis gsungs pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'jig rten pa'i( )/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis gsungs lustepa dag /khro bo'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul ches/ /thams cad de dag yang dag 'gugs 5nye/ /sngags dang rgyud ni thams cad kun/ /bstan pa 'di la nges par 'brel/ /gang zhig gang 88—835

dag cho gar bstan/ /de nyid 'dir ni nges par sbyar/ /gshin rje gshed ni khro rgyal gyi/ /las kun byed 0)pa'i mchog yin no/ /sgrol ma khro gnyer can nyid dang / /de bzhin gos dkar mo dang ni/ /de bzhin dkar chen rigs ②ma dang ske/ /rdo rje'i rigs 'byung mā ma kri(gu/ /gtsug tor 'byung ba thams cad dang / /lha mo spyan ni nyid dag dang / /de bzhin gshegs kun rig pa dang / /mthu chen thob dang kun bzang dang / /pad+ma 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag dang / /bdag kyang 'jig rten gnod sbyin bdag(4) /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che / /rgyal sras (5)rmad du byung ba dang / /dpung (6)bzang (77)'jig rten rnam par grags / /rdo rje'i sde dang sde bzang dang / /blo ldan 8)chos kyis 'phags pa dang //bdag gis kyi)kyang ni bshad pa'i sngags/ /zlos pas brnyas zhi 1par mi bya'o/ /sngon du rtag tu mchod bya zhing / /legs gsungs 37de dag bgom tu mi bya/ /khro bo'i rgyal po legs mchod cing / /der ni zlos pas sbyar mi bya/ /dus rnams kun 1 tu sngags dag la/ /de dag rig pa bcad kyi mi bya/ /ji bzhin las ni kun la yang / /'jig rten sngags kyi lha dag ni/ / dka' zlog zhibade byed tshangs sogs dang / /lha chen la yang legs par mchod/ /ji ltar rgyud la sngags rnams ni/ /de bzhin nyid du'ang kun la bya/ /thams cad sngags ni kun la yang / /thams cad nyid du'ang yang dag bstan/ /sngags kun rab tu 'jug pa yang / /khro bo las ni yang dag 'byung / /sngags 'di khro bo chen po ni//gshin rje gshed ces bya ming gis/ /bdag nyid chen po gshin rje yang / /myur du bkug nas 'joms tshapar byed/ /nyi ma'i bu ni gshin 1 rje dang / /brgya byin bdag nyid chen po yang / /bkug nas dbang med mi bzad pa/ /gdul 88—836

dka' 'dul ①byed mnga' bdag yin/ /sngags 'di sngags ni chen po ste/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bshad pa yin②/ /ma rungs las rnams thams cad byed / /sngags kun rab tu sgrub ②par byed/ /de ①skad casmras nas dpal ldan ni//lag na rdo rje rdzu 'phrul ches/ /shākya seng ge mi yi mchog /dpa' chen sangs rgyas la btud nas/ /sngags 'khor rten pa'i rdo rje can/ /rdzu 'phrul can gyis sngags rnams gsungs/ /'byung po kun tshogs dge ba ni/ /sems can kun gyis ⑤mnyan pa yin⑥/ /sngags rnams kun tshogs ⑦lta byed pa/ /sngags kyi mchog ni bdag gis bshad/ /blo dang ldan pa du'ajam pa'i dbyangs/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑨bshad pa yin/ /mi bzad gdul dka' 'dul byed pa0/ /ma rungs thams cad zlog ⑩par byed/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi tu)rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las / gnod sbyin mo 8sgrub pa'i cho ga rab 'byam ④las le'u sum cu rtsa lnga pa rdzogs sotso// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sdug bsngal spang zhing bde bya btso/ /sdug bsngal spang zhes bstan pa ni/ /mdor bsdus na ni bzlog (napa yin/ /de nyid theg pa rnam gsum du/ /nga yi tunye'adi ni bstan pa yin/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /'dus byas thams cad skad cig nyid/ /gsob dang rtag tu kun stong par(6/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba nges par bstan/ /de las chags bral rnam gsum 'gro/ /sems can dge la brten ( )pa yin/ /byang chub sems dang sangs rgyas dang / /rang rgyal byang chub la brten ( spedang / /'dod ——837

chags bral ba rdzu 'phrul che/ /de bzhin gzhan dag dgra bcom nyid/ /nyan thos byang chub la brten ①nas/ /rnam gsum zhi ba thob par byed/ /chos 'di dag ni mdor bsdu lan/ /dge dang mi dge bstan nipa yin/ /rtag tu mi dge spang bya ste/ /dus rnams kun tu dge ba spyad/ /'byung po ⑤kun la mi 'tshe bar//ngas ni chos kyang rab tu bstan⑤/ /'gro ba lnga po'i lam nyid du/ /chos 'di nyid ni 'gyur ba yin/ /gang zhig zag med chos rnams ni/ /yang dag mtha' la yang dag brten⑥/ /dang po'i ⑦sangs rgyas snga ma yis/ /'di nyid lam du gsungs pa yin/ /zhi ba mya ngan 'das 'gro bar/ /ngas kyang thams cad bstan pa yin/ /chos kyi mtha' la brten phyinas ni/ /⑨yang dag mtha' ni thob pa yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtha' med pa/ /yang dag mtha' zhes brjod pa yin / /chos 'di dag ni mdor bsdus yinas/ /nyon cig lha ni thams cad dang —/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /dgra bcom nyan thos dag kyang nyon / /nga ni sa steng mya ngan 'da'/ /kha ba can gyi nang dag tu/ /sā ⑩la'i nags ni yang dag 'byung ⑫/ /gser dang ldan pa'i chu bo dang / /gyad rnams kyi ni nye 'khor du/ /sā la zung (nyegi nags nang du/ /nga ni mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur / /gong khyer ming dhini sdig pa can/ /cod 8pan bcings pa'i ⑩mchod rten dang / /chu bo'i 'gram ni rtag nyams dga'/ /der ni sa steng mya ngan 'da' / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /rdzu 'phrul che ldan nyan thos dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /'jig rten skyong ba rdzu 'phrul che / /brgya byin tshangs bcas 'dab bzang tunyedang / /gzhan yang 'og min la sogs lha/ /der ni thams cad 'dus par ni/ /rab tu 'byung bar tu 'gyur ba ——838

yin / /der ni gyad kyi nye ①'khor dang / /gang gā'i ②byang phyogs 'gram dag ni / /chu bo chen po de las gzhanani/ /kha ba can ri'i lho phyogs char/ /sā dula'i nags zhes bya ba 'byung / /de tshe nub phyogs bltas pa'i maladu/ /de yi gnas su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de tshe chu bo rab dga' ba/ /bzang po gser ldan 'gram dag tu/ /lha rnams kun gyi tshogs la sogs/ /'dus pa dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mi dang rgyal po'i mchog rnams dang / /mi dang mi ma yin pa yi'abyung / /de tshe mi dang 'byung po kun/ /de tshe byis pa 'phags pa dang / /dga' ston chen po dga' chen ltar/ /gnas de la ni yang dag 'dus/ /rang lus zang zing bcas par ni/ /bzang po chen po'i bkod ⑦pa'ang byas/ /chos kyi mtha' ni yongs spangs nas/ /yang dag mthar ni yang dag zhugs/ /de tshe sngon gyi skye ba ni/ /ser skya'i grong ⑧khyer gzhi ⑨dag tu/ /shākya'i 0rigs kyi gtso bo ni/ /nga ni 'khor ba'i btson yirar skyes/ /bdag gi sdug bsngal 8bdag nyid kyis8/ /khyim las nges 'byung tsoyongs su spangs/ /de tshe mu stegs mang po bstenatso / /bdud rtsi tsodag kyang thob ma ⑩gyur/ /dka' (khyab dag kyang bdag gis spyad/ /lus kyi gdung ba'ang yun ring ba/ /lo drug tu ni bsten pa yis/ /lus kyang zhig cing rnam par skams()/ /shes dang shes bya gsal ba ni/ /ngas ni cung zad thob ( )pa med/ /de nas nga ni langs nas kyang / /'bras chen (nyadakar ba'i zas kyang zos/ /lha rnams kyis mchod lam dag ni/ /der ni sa steng nga yis bgrod/ /chu bo nai ()rañdza na'i 'gram/ /shing gi rgyal po legs mdzes pa/ /me tog rnam pa du mas khyab/ /de 'gram sa ni nyams dga' ba/ /nags ()chen 'bras bu ldan pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs shing dag 'byung (ste/ /——839

chu bo chen pos yongs bskor ba'i/ /shing gi rtsar ①ni nga yis phyin/ /sa yi cha ni mthong tsam gyis/ /bdag gi ②sems ni brtan pa thob/ /de lta'i shing ni bdag gis mthong / /yal ga lo ma nyer mdzes pa'i①/ /shing chen grib ma chen po ni/ /rtsa ba mi mngon nyer spyad 'os/ /shing rtsa a shwazir ④'dug nas/ /sems ni shin tu dang bar gyur⑤/ /bsam gtan dang ni ting 'dzin dang / /der ni brtan pa'ang mngon par 'thobadu/ /ma tshan mo'i mthar ni skye mthar ⑦byed/ /der ni snang ba med pa'ang 'thobadu/ /bdud kyi ⑨bgegs ni rnam mang po /rnam pa du ma rab tu sbyar/ /sde rnams bcom nas slar ldog cing / /rang gi gnas su'ang de dag song / /sngags dang rgyud ni 'di don ⑩du/ /rnam pa mang po'ang gsungs pa 7yin/ /rnam pa du ma'i sbyor ba dang / /bsam gtan shes pa'ang bstan pa yin/ /der ni theg pa gsum yang spyad/ /gzhan dag sems can rten la 'dzud8/ /nyes pa rnam pa gsum nyid kyi/ /gnyen po dag kyang rab tu bstan/ /de nas langs nas yang song nas/ /grong ()khyer lteng rgyas chu bzang gis/ /khrus byas der gnas drang srong rnams/ /slob mar bcas pa'ang ④rab tu phyung li/ /sems can rnam ⑩mang don byas nas/ /de nas nga ni yang dag 'das/ /ka shi'i grong ni nyams (byedaga' bar/ /mthar gyis 8su ni yang dag zhugs/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po sngar sangs rgyas/ /de yi gnas su'ang bzhugs tu)pa yin/ /ka shi ( )skye bo'i yul dag tu/ /der ni rang bdag nyid gnas 'gyur( sto / /zhi ba mya ngan 'das byed pa'i/ /dam chos chos kyi 'khor lo bskoratso//'jig rten lha dang lha min bcas/ /'gro ba lnga la yang dag brten( ste/ /'byung po kun la bde ba'i phyir/ /der ni chos kyang rab tu bstan/ /der ni snga ma'i ——840

sangs rgyas kyis①/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /chos kyi ②'khor lo bla na med / /de ni nga yis rab tu bstan/ /srid las grol zhing bde don dang / /sems can nyes pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /bde zhing zhi bar gzhol ①ba'o/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /srid pa'i lam ④ni gzhig don dang / /bden bzhi'i duting 'dzin las byung ba'i/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa ni/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis rnam par brgyanadu/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung dang bcasatshul/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis byas pa yin/ /ma rig 'gag par yang dag ldan / /rig pa bskyed pa'i rim las byung ⑧/ /yang dag mtha' yi legs mthar skyes6)/ /de nyid mthar ⑩ni bstan pa yin/ /lugs su 'byung dang bzlog pa dag /tha mar bdag nyid rtogs yichen skyes/ /sems can mang po thar don du/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo yang dag ldan/ /nyams 8dga' ka shi'i grong ⑫spangs nas/ /de tshe bdag ni mnyan 8yod song / /de tshe mu stegs gdul bya'i phyir / /cho 'phrul chen po'ang tsobyas pa yin/ /mi yul dag tu rdzu 'phrul ni/ /de tshe yang dag bstan par ⑩byas/ /mu stegs (nyemang po'i gnas dag tu'ang / /de tshe'ang rab tu dga' bar byas/ /yul ming me thab yices bya bar/ /lha las babs pa bzang po byas/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dag tu yang / /chos nyid la ni brgya byin sbyar/ /de nas 'og min lha sogs dang / / tshangs sogs brgya (7byin bcas pa dang / /rnam thos gnod sbyin dbang dang bcas/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi ris ( )dag dang / /rtag tu myos dang gzhong thogs dang / /pi wang zhunyagasum pa phreng thogs dang / /lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams kun/ /sa bla lha dang bar snang gnas/ /'phags pa gnod sbyin tshogs ( nyebadag dang / /lha dang lha min ——841

thams cad kyang ①/ /chos kyi 'bras bu ldan par byas/ /mya ngan 'das gsum rjes 'gro byas/ /sems can bsam gyis ②mi khyab pa'ang / /de tshe legs pa nyid la btsud/ /de dag rtsis kyi ①grangs med pa/ /'khor ba'i mtha' bzhin de mtha' med/ /stong chen po yi 'jig rten gyi/ /khams dang 'dra bar bsam mi khyabaske/ /rtag tu sems can mang po ni/ /bden pa'i don la yang dag sbyar/ /de tshe der ni nga 'ongs nas/ /gnas gtsang steng du gnas nas kyang / /theg pa gsum la rjes 'jug pa'i/ /dam chos sngags ni rab tu bskor/ /sems can gdul bya la brten nas/ /nga yis cho ga'i rgyal po 'di/ /'jig rten mang la rab bstan nas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la'ang gtad pa yin/ /nga ni 'jig rten mya ngan 'das/ /sa steng stongs par ④gyur pa na/ /de nas 'jam dpal sems can la/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /dam pa'i chos ni bsrung ⑤ba'i phyir/ /de tshe rtag tu srung bar ni / /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sngags ni rab tu dbye don du/ /cho ga rgya chen bstan pa yin/ /de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /ma rungs mi bzad chen po yi/ /mi bdag gdug 6)pa chen po ni/ /phan tshun gsod pa dag la dga'/ /sdig pa'i las can spyod pa ngan/ /de tshe longs spyod chung ba dang / /de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /'byung bar 'gyur bar rtsithe tshom med/ /sā (nyal zhes bya'i nags su ni/ /de dag mchod don yo)rtsom par byed/ /chu bo gser ldan 'gram ⑩dang ni / /cod pan 'ching ba'i mchod rten du/ /zhi ba'i dbyings la brten yipa'i phyir / /nga ni mya ngan 'das mal 'cha'/ /lus ni sreg pa'i shing la bzhag /rdzogs longs spyod pa longs spyod spangs/ /de'i sngon mdzad pa nyid dang ni/ /——842

nga yi rmad byung spyod mthong nas/ /nga yi gdul bya'i spyod yul dang / /sangs rgyas gdul bya'i mdzad pa dang / /spyod pa dge ba sna tshogs de/ /mi yi bdag po ①kun dran nas/ /thams cad mchod pa ⑤byed par 'gyur/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /de nas sa bdag kun 'dus nas/ /de tshe nga yi drung du ni/ /dga' ston chen po mchod pa kun/ /byed par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sku ni shing la rab bteg nas②/ /zang zing yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dge ba dang ni mi dge dang / /bsod nams bsod nams ma yin spangs/ /yang dag mtha' don stong nyid mtha'/ /phung po lnga ni 'byung ba che/ /sems can mang dupos de rjes mthong / /bsod nams che ba'i don du sbyar/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral⑤/ /nyan thos chen po bdag nyid che/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang / /sa bcu la ni yang dag gnas/ /yang dag mtha' ni rtogs skyonas kyang / /chos kyi mtha' la yang dag gnas/ /sems can kun la snying brtse b.rasti/ /kun gyis byayongs su bskor nas gnas/ /lha yi tshogs ni thams cad dang / /'phags dang so so'i 6)skye bo dang / /'di kun bsod nams chen po'i gnas/ /mchod rten la ni 'dus par 'gyur⑩/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal (nyedon gnas nas/ /dang ba'i sems ni rab tu thob/ /mchod rten mtha' yi nyen kor du/ /'byung po'i tshogs kyang 'dug pa yin/ /mchod pa chen po byas nas ni/ /smre sngags 'don cing ngu bar byed/ /dbugs tso'abyin snying rjes brlan (stenas ni/ / mchi ma'i thigs pa'ang cirab tu 'dzag /smre sngags 'di ltar kun 'don pa/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal 8stong pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos ni sngar ston mdzad/ /da yiltar sa steng 'di yil ni/ /de 'dir thub ——843

mchog dam pa ni/ /drang srong mchog gyur bdun ①pa dang / /sems can kun mchog shākya'i rgyal/ /de mthong ba yi tha ma yin/ /sdug bsngal mi rtag ston ②pa yi ske/ /bcom ldan de 'di gzims ④pa yi/ /mthong ba yi ni tha ma 'am/ /stong nyid don dam ston byed dang / /thog ma nas zhi don ston pa/ /lha yi tshogs dag ci yi phyir/ /kye ma mnga' bdag sad mi byed/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po lha yi bu/ /thams cad 'dir ni lhags par 'gyuraphyi/ /dpa' bo chen po chos don gnyer/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po nyan thos dang / /sems can kun ni sdug bsngal ⑥ba'i/ /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rjes bskor ⑦ba'i / /de yi dus ⑧ni 'di dag yin/ /bcom ldan khyod ni myur du bzhengs/ /sangs rgyas dus kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i dus bzhin du/ /thub pas de 'drar mi 'da' po)mdzod/ /yun ring dus nas brten ⑩mdzad pa'i/ /sems can mang po'i don mdzad stsol/ /zhi ba mya ngan 'das lam mam bsam gtan rnam thar bstan du gsol/ /de ltar ⑩rnam pa du ma yi(nye/ /smra ba mang po'i tshig brjod nas6)/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i lha yi tshogs/ /de nas thams cad cang mi smra/ /mtshungs med smre sngags byas nas ni/ /bdud skyodang bcas pas rab tu 'dug /yun ring ngu zhing smre byas nas/ /'gul tsonas mchi ⑩bcas sgra 'dzer bcas/ /mya ngan yid mi bde dang bcas/ /tshangs sogs ⑩lha dang lha min bcas/ /mi dang mi yi bdag po kun/ /sa steng de la gnas par 'gyur(nya/ /gzhan yang shākya'i rigs skyes pa/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas ni/ /lha yi lha yi gnyen gyur pa/ /dge slong ma 'gags yi pa zhes bya/ /de gcung mi yi nang na dge/ /shin tu phra la mkhas shing ——844

gsal / /chags bral lugs la mkhas pa dang / /dgra bcom gtso bo rgyal po ni//du ma'i 'khor gyis yongs su bskor/ /mya ngan gyis bskyed dbugs phyung nas/ /shin tu yun ring tshig kyang smras/ /snying rje yid mi bdes drangs pas/ /rgyal po dang bcas gyad rnams la/ /grogs po re zhig shing la ni/ /me ni 'jug par ma byed cig /ji srid bcom ldan sras po ni/ /mchog gyur chos nyid las byung ba / /de ni 7nyan thos rdzu 'phrul che/ /'od srung chen po zhes bya ba/ /thub pa chen po blo yi mchog ci /bram ze'i rigs skyes zang zing med/ /ma ga dhā ②yi mi nang skyes/ /ri bo der ni mnyam par bzhag /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab mchog tu / /pi ba la ②yi khyim du gnas/ /de ④ni myur du 'dir 'ong bar/ /byed kyi gzhan du ma yin no/ /lha ni gang zhig der dang brgya/ /sku la me 'bar nges bzlog 6)pas/ /de bar sku la me tsogatong ba/ /ngal ba don med ma byed cig /ji srid rdzu 'phrul che ba'i mchog /nyan thos thub pa thugs dgyes des(kye/ /'jig rten gsum mchod sangs rgyas dang / /ston pa 'jig rten gyis mchod la/ /zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal ponyenas/ /bla ma g.yas su bskor byas pa/ /de tshe sku 'di sbar don du/ /der ⑩ni kun gyis rab byos shig /gang tshe sngar ni sbar gyur (nyan/ /kun tu 'bar ba'ang don med 'gyurasnyi/ /thams cad don med ma byed cig /'dir ni ngal ba kho na 'byung / /blo dang ldan pa ma 'gags tu pas/ /kun la de skad smras nas ni/ /mi dang mi yi bdag po dang / /gyad rnams kun kyang 'dug par gyuratshe/ /mi yi rigs su nga skyes shing / /mi rnams kyis 8kyang rab tu skyedayi/ /longs spyod rnam /rtemang gzhan dang ni/ /bzo dang sgyu rtsal dge ba'ang bskyed/ /sa steng shing gi rtsa dag tu/ /mi yi gzugs kyis byang chub thob//88wa 845

sangs rgyas kun gyi ①mdzad pa ni/ /mi rnams la ni chos kyang bstan/ /de nyid phyir na mi rnams kyis/ /sku sbyang (midon phyir me yang sbar/ /nga ming du'abyung po kun gyi ④ni/ /mchog nyid du ni gyur pa yin/ /mi yi 'jig rten zhi ba dang / /nga ni mya ngan 'das par ⑤brtags/ /gang dag sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyiyi/ /thams cad mi yi 'jig rten du/ /mi yi lus su yang dag 'byung / /skye dang byang chub de bzhin du/ /dam chos 'khor lo dge ba spyod/ /zhi ba yang dag kun gshegs par/ /de bzhin rang rgyal dgra bcom pa/ /mi yi lus la brten nas ni/ /bla med zhi bar gshegs pa yin/ /bskal pa bsam gyis ⑦mi khyab par/ /de dag la ni ngas phan byas/ /nga ni phyi mar zhi ba dang / /bsil bar gyur cing 'gog par gyur/ /sa steng stongs ⑧par gyur pa na/ / der ni 97sku gdung rab bzhag pa/ /mi rnams la ni phan don du/ /mchod pa rjes su gzung ⑩'dod pas/ /'jig rten lha dang lha min bcas / /mi dang gnod sbyin mkha' lho1sding bdag /srin po yi dgas grul bum dang 7/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i 6nyasha za rnams/ /'byung po dag ni thams cad dang ske/ /gzar bcas ma mo rnams dang ni/ /de bzhin 'jig rten thams cad ni / /grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab khams/ /srog chags thams cad nyid dag ni / /mchod pa'i don phyir sku gdung cidag /sa steng stongs 8par gyur pa na/ /de yi tshe na ⑩yang dag bzhag /kha cig sa steng mi dag dang / /lha yi rgyal po de bzhin gzhan/ /lha min dbang po rdzu 'phrul che/ /sa 'og gnas pa gzhan dag dang ske/ /de bzhin klu rgyal lha min dag /sku gdung so so so sor ni/ /yon tan ldan pa rdzu 'phrul ches/ /phyogs nas 4)thams cad bdag gir byas/ /rang gi 88wa 846

gnas su khyer nas ni/ /de tshe mchod pa byed 'gyur zhing / /rdzu 'phrul chen po sangs rgyas su/ /thams cad the tshom med par 'gyur/ /mchog dang tha ma bar gnas pa'i/ /sems ni dad pa rnam gsum gyis/ /'jig rten rnam gsum 'gyur ba ni/ /sangs rgyas bse ru dgra bcom thob①/ /theg pa rnam gsum 'jig rten gsum/ /rnam gsum yang dag bstan pa yin/ /theg chen la 'jug lam gyis ni/ /de la brten ②nas nges par 'byung / /rang rgyal byang chub la brten pa/ /de bzhin 'jig rten 'gyur ba yin/ /de las gzhan pa nyan thos kyang glu/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /de bzhin 'jig rten 'gyur ba yin / /rnam gsum rigs kyis rnam par brgyan / /sa bdag longs spyod chen po dang / /bde chen don du 'khor los sgyur/ /lha dang mi yi phun sum tshogs/ /yun ring de tshe rjes myong nas/ /mthar ni 'chi ba la brten dunas/ /de dag zhi ba rnam gsum 'gro/ /dang por sngar ni sangs rgyas dang / /da ltar ma 'ongs pa dag kyang / /thams cad la ni 'di nyid de/ /'di ni yang dag ji bzhin bstan / /mya ngan 'das pa'i sa de la/ /lha rnams thams cad 'dug nas ni/ /yid byung gsems ni skyo nas kyang / /skad 'dzer ⑥bcas pas smra ba ⑦ni/ /de tshe thams cad 'di skad smra/ /kye ma'o kyi hud mi rtag pa/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che/ /de 'dir yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /lha yi rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che / /de dag kun gyis ⑧de smras nas/ /snying ni yo)mya ngan bcas gyur nas/ /de nas cang mi smra bar gnas/ /ma ga dhā yiyi skye bo mchog /ku sha'i (nyamachog gi grong gnas pa/ /de dang nye ba'i ri bo ni/ /phag rgod ces bya'i ming du grags/ /dge slong bsam gtan der byed pa/ /pi pa li yi phug zhugs 8pa/ /'di ni ——847

nyan thos nga yi ①bu/ /thugs skyes chos las 0byung ba gang / /de ni 'od srung chen po yin/ /de tshe phug mchog la 'dug nas/ /de nas bsod snyoms la spyad ①de / /'dug nas rang nyid sems par byed/ /dus ring bdag gis dusangs rgyas la/ /bdag gis kyang ni de phyag byas/ /rang byung gyur pa mi yi mchog /bdag gis da ⑤ltar de blta (6)bya/ /shākya'i rigs skyes thub pa mchog /bcom ldan de ni ga la bzhugs/ /bram ze'i ⑦rgyal po 'od srung che/ /der ni yang dag dgongs par gyur(snye/ /thub pa'i thub pa kho na ni/ /sems kyis de ltar bsam ⑨par gyur/ /lha yi mig gis 7'jig rten la/ /'jig rten ma lus lta bar byed/ /'og min de bzhin 'jig rten mtha'/ /srid rtse'i 'jig rten khams kyi bar/ /'jig rten ma lus thams cad dang / /stong chen sred yipa las byung ba/ /nyan thos spyod yul ji tsam par/ /lha yi mig gis 8blta byas na8/ /mya ngan 'das gzims 7zhi ba dang / /bsil 8bar gyur cing nad med pa/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po lha tshogs kyis/ /kun nas yongs su bskor ⑩ba dang / /mi dang mi yi bdag po dang / /lha min gnod sbyin srin po dang / /'byung po'i tshogs ni thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /grags chen nyan thos chen po yang / /shes rab gtsor ni gyur pa dang / /'dod chags bcas dang 'dod chags bral/ /lha dang bcas pa'i khri 7mi rnams kyis/ /dpa' bo shing la bteg pa ni/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i rigs las byung / /de bzhin lha yi lhar gyur gtso/ /thub pa dam pa'i mnga' bdag ni/ /sa bdag gling la gnas rnams kyis/ /kun nas yongs su bskor gyur nas/ /mi yi dbang mchog gyad dag gis/ /lag na rtswa sgron yang dag thogs/ /de dag me sbar mi nus par/ /lha rnams kyis ——848

ni bzlog 'gyur zhes/ /dge slong ma 'gags pa 0)yang ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyis de skad smras/ / 'chi mas brnangs ②shing smre sngags 'don/ /sa rnams sgra ni chen pos ③gang / /ha ha zhes bya'i sgra nyid dang / /rnga bo che yi sgra yang thos/ /lha dang drang srong tshogs kyis khyab/ /lha yi bu mo'i tshogs kyis bstod/ /grub pa rig ④'dzin klu dang ni/ /mi 'am ci klu rgya che ba/ /snyan pa'i sgra ni sgrogs ⑤par byed / /bya yi skad ni dge ba dang / /yid 'ong sna tshogs rol mo dang / /lha dang mi yis rjed ⑥pa dang / /lha yi bu mo'i tshogs kyis (7gang / /grub pa rig ⑧'dzin dag dang ldan/ /de tshe sā la'i nags kyi)dag tu/ /rnal 'byor dag gis kyikun tu khyab/ /thub mchog gzims mal dam pa ni/ /kun nas yongs su bskor bar mthong / /rdzu 'phrul chen po mya ngan bral/ /de nas dbugs 7'byin mya ngan bcas/ /de tshe bram ze 'od srung ni/ /mchi ma'i thigs pa'ang tunyerab tu 'don / /nga yi nyan thos mchog gyur pa/ /de tshe sa yi steng du 'gyel/ /tshig kyang myur du brjod pa ni/ /kye ma'o dka' ba rab tu byung tshoste/ /gang du sangs rgyas zhes bya ba/ /zag med mya ngan 'das gyur tam/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal tso stong pa zhes/ /de nyid kyis ni 'dir gsungs pa/ /skye ba gzhan gyi rjes 'gro ba / /bdag gis 8ston pa'i sku mi mthong / /de nas langs nas myur du ni/ /ma ga dhā tsoyi rgyal por song / /sdug bsngal nyam yinathag ma skyes dgra/ /pha yi mya ngan gyis non pa'i/ /de tshe de yi phug 'ongs nas/ /mi yi bdag po de la smras/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rgyal po chen po mya ngan 'das/ /bzhon pa myur du sbyor mdzod dang / /nga ni ston pa'i drung 'gro ba/ / sā lar 4shegazims mal bzhugs 47pa ni/ /nad med sems dang rnam par bral/ /bstan ( ska88—849

pa thams cad las 'das shing / /sku yi dam pa longs spyod rdzogs/ /ma rungs de tshig thos nas ni/ /rgyal po de yang sdug bsngal ①zhing / /nyam thag smre ②bar gyur pa yi/ /de tshe tshig ②ni rgyal po 'don/ /ston pa dang ni pha dag dang / / gnyi ga ④las kyang bdag nyams gyur/ /gnyen rnams kun gyis spangs pa ste/ /de tshe skye bo yid ches med/ /dmyal ba ⑤mi bzad ltung 'gyur na/ /bdag ni su yi skyabs la brtenayi/ /nyan thos ston pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /dpa' bo chen po skyabs mdzod cig /nyan thos chen po gzi brjid che/ /bdag gi 'tsho ba 'di ⑦na med/ /ma ga dhā (nyeyi mi yi bdag /de nas de skad smras pa dang / /nyan thos mchog gi rkang gnyis la/ /de yi mod la spyi 6)bos gtugs/ /der ni sems med brgyal gyur pa/ /de yi tshe na gzhon nu ni/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs / /dbugs ⑩'byin pa ni byed par 'gyur/ /sems can rjes su gzung 'dod pas/ /'jig rten kun tu rgyu bar gyis/ /gang tshe sā yila'i nags su ni/ /nga lus shing gi steng bzhag pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bskor nasal/ /de tshe khyod ni 'dug par 'gyur/ /gang phyir nga lus mchod pa'i phyir/ /sa steng 'dir ni khyod kyis byas/ /'jig rten kun tu bltas tsonas ni/ /su zhig sdug bsngal gang las drang / /gzhon nu zab pa'i blo ldan pa/ /de ltar sa la 'gyel bar gyur(nya/ /'jam dpal gyis ④ni de yi tshe/ /sa bdag de ni sdug bsngal ba/ /der gnas pa la khyod kyis ni/ /khyod nyid kyis ni de 'dul 'gyura'i / /byang chub sems dpas rtogs 'gyur gyisayi/ /lha dang drang srong rnams dang ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal gzhan dag dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen pos mi nus so/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ⑩mi bdag ni/ /rmi lam gnas pa bzhin du ——850

mthong ske/ /khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs ①kyis/ /rgyal po mya ngan gyis brgyal desal/ /de tshe de ni rmi lam du/ /mngon sum byis pa lta bur ②mthong rdzu 'phrul chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gzhon nu bdag nyid sna tshogs pa/ /de bzhin chos ni rnam par 'phrul/ /byang chub sems dpa' byis pa'i gzugs/ /sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /'jam dpal gyis bstan sems dang byas/ /rgyal po mnar med 'gro ba las/ /myur du de las ldang chabar 'gyur/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las dang ④ni/ /ngan song mtho ris bzang po dang / /'gro ba bdag nyid che yon tan/ /nyan thos thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /de nas rgya cher byas pa ni/ /mdo sde 'gyod pa sel ba ste/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi ni/ /shin tu rgya cher gsal (snyeba'o/ /rgya che don gyis brgyan pa yi/ /mdor bsdus nas ni 'di gsungs so/ /dang po bar ma tha ma ⑥yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung dag ni/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /cho ga rgya cher gsungs ⑦pa yin/ /de nas 'jam dpal dus kun tu/ /gzhon nu khyod ni de yi tshe/ /sdig pa'i las la rjes 'jug pa'i/ /sa bdag rnams ni 'dul bar 'gyur/ /khyod ni (0rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /gdul bya dzi)dag kyang bsam mi khyab/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus pakyi/ /khyod ni 'dul byed nyid du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bos de gsungs yinas/ /'od chen ldan pa 7'jam dbyangs la/ /gnas gtsang steng bzhugs de tshe gzigs/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /smra ba'i mchog gis 7de la gsungs/ /bskal pa mang po 'das pa na/ /khyod ni rdzogs sangs rgyas par 'gyur/ /grangs kyis mnyam med bsam mi 8khyab/ /mi yis 8grangs dang mnyam med par/ /'jam pa'i yirgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ /——851

sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu yang ni mthar gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas mdzad pa de 0)tshe byed/ /sems can mang po rnam bkrol nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gzhon nu'i ②gzugs can rdzu 'phrul che/ /gzhon nu la ni de gsungs dunas/ /brtse bas brlan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /yun ring rjodabugs phyung rnam par skyo/ /yun ring rdzogs sangs skyes bltas ⑤nas/ / mchi ma'i thigs 0pa'ang rnam 'dzag cing / /thal mo sbyar dang bcas nas ni/ /de nas kyang ni 'dug par gyur༅/ /de nas de ni sa gnas pa/ /mi yi dam pa ma skyes ⑧dgras/ /rmad byung 'od srung chen po ni/ /bram ze la ni mgos btud nas / /dran pa rnyed cing sems sad 6)nas/ /rkang gnyis skyil kyikrung bcas nas 'dug /de nas yun ring yidabugs phyung la/ /don ni 8rgya cher nges bstan byas/ /dbang phyug chen po ma skyes dgra/ /rgyal po'i bu ni 'dug par gyuratso / /de nas 'od srung ches smras pa/ /nga ni spur ④sbyong gnas su 'gro/ /mi rnams la ni phan phyir dang / /mchod rten gzugs gnas mchod don du'o/ /nyan thos mchog ni gnas de ru/ /rdzu 'phrul nyid kyis nye bar lhags/ /de dang 'brel bar sems skye ba/ /bdag gi rdzu 'phrul rigs pa min/ /mchod rten ⑫chen po mthong bar ni/ /rkang gnyis bdag ni 'gro bar 'tshal/ /de nas lam gyi ⑩bar 'dug nas/ /'khor ba'i stegs ⑩ni rab tu bstanatunye/ /ji tsam de nas 'ongs gyur pa'o)/ /dge 'dun kun dga' rar gnas pa'i/ /dge slong rgan zhugs gsar bu ni/ /sdig pa nyid kyis rnam rmongs pas/ /mthong nas rgan zhugs rnams 8 )'khrugs te/ /gang phyir de dang nye bar 'ongs/ /grags pa che zhing skal ba che/ /sems can dag pa rims nad med/ /bram ze de yi drung ——852

lhags nas/ /de tshe rkang gnyis phyag byas nas/ /de la smras pa skal ba che/ /legs 'ongs khyod ni ci phyir byon/ /myur du khyod ni gang du 'gro/ /yid byung ci phyir rab tu 'dug /de lasmras khro ldan byis pa la/ /tshe ldan khyod kyis ma thos samal/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'jig rten kun gyi ston pa ni/ /sangs rgyas bdag gi pha zhes smral/ /mar me 'bar bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /dpa' bo chen po nub par gyur / /sa yi steng 0ni stongs par gyur/ /de bzhin 'jig rten ma lus stongs/ /bdag gi phyogs rnams kun stongs dugyur/ /byis de phyin ci log ⑥sems kyis/ /der ni rgan zhugs rab dga' nas/ /rab rgod ⑦tshig tu smras pa ni/ /rab tu ring de 'das gyur tam/ /phyag ring lus ni duche ba dang / /mgo ni gdugs kyi ⑨rnam pa 'dra/ /bdag cag rnams kyi ⑩gtso bo mchog /bslab dang bslab min rjes su ston/ /da ltar de ni mya ngan 'das/ /ci 'dod bzhin du bdag cag spyod/ /rgan zhugs kyis ni de smras nas/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po rab 'khrugs nas7/ /gdong la khro gnyer byas nas ni/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni rab tu sbyar/ /sdom brtson bag chags bslang nas ni/ /bram ze de mod rab 'khrugs nas/ /rkang pa'i mthe bos de ma thag /sa yi steng du rab bsnun pas / /sa rnams dang ni ri rab kyang / /rab tu 'gul bar gyur pa dang / /rgya mtsho rnams dang shing rnams dang / /ri rab kun 4)kyang 'khrugs par gyur/ /klu rgyal dang ni lha rnams dang / /ri sul phug kyang rnam par 'gyel/ /zla ba dang ni nyi ma dang / /sa steng yinade tshe snang ba nyams/ /rlung yang rgyu ba med par gnas / /skar mda' dag kyang sa la ltung tso/ /de nas de ni sngags zhes brjod8 / /nyan thos rnams kyi rigs las byung / /yi ge hūṃ de yi ge gcig /——853

las rnams ma ①lus byed cing dge/ /sngags kyi ②rgyal po bzlas tsam gyis/ /'di ni bzlas pa tsam gyis byed/ /'gro dang gnas pa'i dug dang ni/ /de bzhin dgra kun rengs ③par byed/ /sems can gdug ④pa thams cad la/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis rengs par byed/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las byed cing / /khyad par du yang gzhan nyid byed/ /rgan zhugs tshig kyal rab smras pa⑤/ /der ni mi smrar mthur dubaltas 'dug /de yi rdzu 'phrul la dad nas/ /de yi mod la rnam par btul/ /de tshe nyan thos mchog gi ⑦ni/ /gdung sbyong shing gi nidrung du khyer6)/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /dge slong de ni rkang gis ⑩song —/ /der song des ni thub pa'i sku/ /shing la yod par rab tu mthong / /lha yi tshogs ni du mas kyang / /mchod pa chen po byed pa dang / /gau ta ma ni thub pa yi/ /sku ni shing gi ⑩steng bzhag mthong / /'od srung chen po rmad byung ⑫brka/ /skal ba chen po de mthong nas/ /rdzu 'phrul chen pos tsodage slong rnams/ /thams cad smre sngags 'don par 8byed/ /lha dang 'byung po'i tsotshogs kun ni/ /ha ha'i rnam pa rab 'don cing / /de ltar mya ngan ⑩skyes pa yi0/ /nyam thag sgra ni shin tu che/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po lha dang klu/ /de nas kun gyis rab bsu ⑫nas / /rkang gnyis mchog la phyag byos zhes/ /skal ba che la'ang rab tu smras/ /lha tshogs mi dang bcas pa dang / /'byung po kun gyi tsotshogs dag dang / /mi bdag drang srong gnod sbyin dag /khyod la sdod cing gzhol ba yin/ /shing la me gtong 9 nya'abad gyur kyang / /sku ()sbyong shing ni sbar mi nus/ /de nas de ni skyon bral ba/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po skal ba ches/ /gdung sbyong shing gi smad ( )cha la//rdzu 'phrul chen po des phyag byas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rjes dran nas/ /——854

bskor ①ba dag kyang mang du byas/ /de tshe lcags kyi sgrom dral ②nas/ /zhabs gnyis dag kyang rnam brkyang la/ /yang dang yang du zhabs byugs nas/ /zhabs ①gnyis spyi bos phyag byas nas/ /thub mchog dumachog gi zhabs gnyis la/ /lan mang dag tu rnam par bltas/ /des ⑤ni zhabs gnyis yang zhugs te/ /lcags kyi sgrom la yang dag gnas/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /de ni de nas langs 'dug pa/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /dgra bcom rnams kyis duyongs su bskor/ /ma ga dhā ⑦gtso rgyal po yang / /sku sbyong shing gi thad 'ongs pa/ /glang po shing rta bzhon rta dang / /mthar gyis de nas theg pa yisalam/ /de nas dpung chen sa yi bdag /kun kyang stobs dang bzhin par bcas / /de tshe thub pa shāka ⑨thub la/ /de ⑩ni phyag 'tshal don du lhags/ /sa steng ⑩zhi ba'i gzims mal du/ /bas mtha' dgon par mya ngan 'das/ /chu bo gser ldan 'gram dang ni/ /cod pan bcings pa'i tsomachod rten du/ /zhi ba'i dbyings la yang dag zhugs/ /yang dag mtha' la yongs su brtenati/ /ma ga dhā tsoyi rgyal po der/ /dpung chen ldan pas yang dag lhags/ /rnam pa sna tshogs spyod pa yis/ /de yang nga la stod 8par byed/ /phan yon che zhing stobs dang ldan/ /ngo mtshar sa yi rgyan gyur pa/ /thub pa'i sku sbyangs las byung ba'i/ /der ni sku gdung mchod rten byas/ /dge slong kun dga' bo zhes bya/ /slob pa nga yi bsnyen bkur ba/ /mi yi dam pa mnyes tshugashin pa/ /nga la rtag tu yongs su dad/ /yid ni zhum zhing mya ngan gdungs/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'od sung thad song nas/ /rkang pa gnyis la rab btud nas/ /sdug bsngal nyam 'thag 'dar ba yis(nye/ /'di skad sgra ni 'dzer bas smras/ /deng ——855

'dir nga yi ston pa 'das/ / da ltar ①bdag ni mgon med gyur/ /nga yi rten dang gnas dang skyabs②/ /khyod nyid du ni rab tu bstan/ /thub pa'i zla ba de nyid kyis/ /nye gnas khyod kyir ①lung yang bstan/ /nyon mongs kun ni 0rnam spangs pa/ /khyod kyi nye gnas dgra bcom pa⑤/ /thun gyi phyi ma mtshan mtha' ⑥late/ /rgyal ba des ⑦ni bstan pa yin/ /nga nyid mya ngan 'das pa na/ /rtag tu khyod ni yod par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i don du ni/ /phan par 'dod pas (9khyod byed 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal can bdag spangs nas kyang / /thub pa chen po zhi bar gshegs/ /blo ldan ma 'gags pa zhes pas/ /sdom chen de ni dbugs 'byin byed/ /khyod ni mya ngan du ma byed/ /mya ngan dag kyang ma byed cig /gnas ni gang du'ang 'gro ma byed/ /'di nyid du ni gnas par gyis / /'jig rten mig ni 'das gyur nasakhyi/ /'di nyid ston par 'gyur ba yin / /'dir ni ston pas lung bstan nas/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur / /nga yang bcom ldan lhan cig tu/ /'od srung rjes su 'gro bar bya/ /ston pa gnyis po dag gi yang / /sa yi steng na gzugs brnyan yin/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i nyan thos ni/ /'od srung chen po gtso bo ni/ /'tsho zhing yongs su gzhes ⑩pas na/ /khyod ni mya ngan ma byed cig /rdzu 'phrul chen po snying rjes non / /rnal 'byor chen po 'dod chags bral/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po thub pa'i sras / /thams cad de bzhin smre (1bar byed()/ /gyad dang rgyal po dag gis ni/ /pur (2sbyong shing la me btang bas/ /'khor 7yug kun nas me 'bar nas/ /pur 7sbyong shing de thal bar gyur/ /de mthong lha yi tshogs dag dang / /gdengs can brang 'gro rnams kyis ⑩ni/ /pur (1sbyong shing gnas zhi ba'i phyir/ /——856

tsan+dan chu yi rgyun dag gi①/ /char chen rab tu gtong zhing gnas/ /de nas de yi mod la yang / /sa steng ②du yang de bzhin du/ /me tog tshogs kyi char yang btang ⑧/ /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel ④mchod pa'i phyir/ /de yi mod la kun der ⑤lhagasal/ /thams cad phan tshun 'thab 0pa'i phyir/ /de yi mod la bya ba rtsom/ /tshangs sogs brgya byin 'thab bral dang / /lha tshogs kun kyang de bzhin no/ ci/nyan thos chen po 'dod chags bral/ /rdzu 'phrul chen pos zlog ⑦par byas/ /sku gdung rgyal ba'i ring bsrel ⑧ni/ /'od srung chen pos rnam ⑨bgos pa/ /mchod pa'i don du yithams cad la/ /cung zad cung zad nges par byin/ /theg pa gsum las mi 0ldog dang / /zhi ba mthar tsophyin bya phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor de tshe 'od srung che/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /rgan zhugs kyis 8ni smras pa'i tshig /de ni yongs su sems par byed/ /'dir ni gsung ⑫rab ma lus pa/ /yan lag 8bcu gnyis bde 'byung gnas/ /mdo dang 'dul ba mngon pa'i chos/ /nam mkha'i dud bzhin ma gyur tam/ /dpa' bo chen po nub gyur nas/ /bstan pa 'jig par 'gyur bas nayi/ /sangs rgyas gsung ba'i ⑩bka' 'di ni/ /ma lus bdag gis bsdu bar bya/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /ma lus lhan cig bgro 8bar bya/ /ma ga dhā yiyi grong mchog tu / /grong khyer bzang po rgyal po'i khab/ /ku sha'i grong khyer nyams 4 )dga' dang / /ri ni rdo 'jog ( nyamatho ba dang / /yul bzang yangs pa can dang ni/ /mchod rten gnas ni legs mdzes pa/ /de bzhin rnam pa du ma'i gnas/ /bstan pa bsdu ba'i ched dag tu/ /'dus nas smra ba kun smra ba( nye/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po byed par 'gyur/ /nga ru yang 'dir ni nub pa dang / /de tshe dus kyi tha ( na——857

ma la/ /phan tshun gsod par dga' ba yi/ /sa bdag rnams ni 'byung bar 'gyur / /las kyi mtha' 6)mang dge slong rnams/ /sems can rnams ni chags pas rmongs/ /de bzhin dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ②ma/ /dus kyi nimatha' la ma zhir 'gyur/ /phan tshun skyon ni 'tshol dubyed cing / /phan tshun gsod la mngon par zhen/ /rma ldan skyon ni ma rungs dzubaltar/ /skyon la rtag tu rtog par byed/ /thub pa de dus nub pa nadu/ /dge slong rnams ni ma bsdams 'gyur/ /de tshe sa steng ⑦bstan pa ni/ /bsrung ⑧ba'i don du bzhag gyur pa/ /chags bral zag med 'jig rten du/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po rnam pa brgyad/ /de tshe dgra bcom thu bo yang ske/ /sgra gcan ⑨'dzin sogs rab tu bsgrags7/ /de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /de dag kyang ni snang ba med/ /sngags pa grub pa'i dus su ni/ /de dag mthong ba don yod 'gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul che/ / ngas kyang 7thams cad bzhag pa yin/ /grags pa chen po chad pa'i ⑩las/ /de dag la ni ngas ⑫bstan pa/ /de dag bka' las 'das pa 'am/ /cung zad bslab las rnam tso'adas na'o/ /ji srid dam chos yang dag mtha'/ /zang zing med par gnas par gyis/ /nga yi gsung gi bsod tsonams 'di/ /ji srid bstan pa stobs dang ldan/ /des na bdag nyid zhir 'gyur zhing / /zag med mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /de tshe thub pa'i bstan pa ni/ /yongs su nub par 'gyur ba na/ /dge slong rnams dang dge tshul rnams7/ /dge slong ma rnams ser snar bcas/ /rtag tu ngan spyod g.yo sgyu can/ /de tshe yongs su ma dag pa'o/ /nga yi bstan la mi gnas shing / /khyim dang chung ma tshol ⑩bar byed/ /de yi tshe na dge bsnyen (shernams / /gzhan gyi 6)bud med la rtag dang / /lhag ma rnam pa bzhi po nyid/ /——858

de tshe rtags dang ming ①tsam yod/ /'khon ②'dzin thams cad goms byed cing //gcig la gcig ③ni rnam 'tshe byed/ /phal cher mu stegs kyis non cing / /lha rnams kun kyang gnod dupar 'gyur/ /de tshe bram ze'i rigs la ni/ /skye bo rnams ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin log spyod rmongs ⑤pa dang / /mi rnams srog yichags 'tshe bar dga'/ /nga ni yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /rtsod dus 'di la lung bstan yin/ /mi ni rnam mang gzhan dag kyang / /rtag tu gzhan gyi bud med dga'/ /mi dge kun la dga' ba dang / /dge ba'i don ni rnam ⑦spangs pa/ /nga ni sa steng zhir gshegs nasal/ /sems can mang po 'byung bar 'gyur / /nga yi sku ni yo)mchod pa'i phyir/ /gzi brjid chen po lha tshogs dang / /bdag nyid chen po mi rnams dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs/ /lha min dang ni dri za dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po mi 'am ci/ /de nas mkha' lding klu dang ni/ /de bzhin srin po drang srong rnams/ /rnal 'byor pa dang grub pa dang ske/ /gzi brjid tsochen po gza' rnams dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs skye gnas dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sems can rnams/ /srid pa'i 'ching bas bcings pa yidang / /blo ldan 'ching ba bcad pa dang / /sku gdung nad bral 'di la ni/ /de tshe mchod 7pa byed par 'gyur/ /chu bo gser ldan 'gram dang ni/ / sā la ⑫zung gi tshal dang ni/ /cod pan bcings pa'i tsomachod rten dang / /gyad rnams kyi ni nyen tso'akhor du/ /nga ni der yang mya ngan 'da'/ /'jig 0med zhi bar yongs su 'gro/ /nga yi sku gdung de blangs chanas/ /de bzhin gzhan gyis 'phrog par byed/ /lha dang lha ma yin rnams dang / /de tshe 'byung po'i tshogs kun gyis(nye/ /so sor cha ni rnam phye nas/ /rnam par gzhag pa byas par gyur(6/ /——859

mi yi rgyal po dpung chen ldan/ /ma ga dhā 6)yi ma skyes dgra/ /rdzu 'phrul che ldan nyan thos ni/ /kun la'ang gsol ba phyirab 'debs pa/ /bsod nams bdag gis ma byas pas/ /bdag gi ①pa yang shi bar gyur/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal ltung gyur pas/ /bdag nyid chen pos 0drang du gsol/ /de nas blo ldan nyan thos mchog /sangs rgyas thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ /'od srung chen po zhes grags pa/ /skye dgu rnams la phan byed pas/ /ma skyes dgra ni ngo tsha ldan/ /sems zhum gyur te mthong nas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul nyid la rab gnas nas/ /de yi dus su yang dag dgongs/ /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel ①sku gdung ni/ /cha gcig khyod kyis yiblang bar gyis/ /rgyal po gzhan ni stobs ldan gyis/ /gzhan dag rab tu khyer bar gyur / /phan tshun bab col 'khrugs phyinas ni/ /gcig la gcig ni 'khon lho)byas nas/ /de tshe nam mkhar yisku gdung khyer/ /rang gi gnas su'ang bzhag par 'gyur(nya/ /de tshe thub pa'i nyan thos mchog /dge slong 'od srung chen po de/ /kye 1nyama'o kyi hud sems pa ni/ /sa steng tso'adir ni rab stongs 7pa/ /sangs rgyas dang ni rang rgyal dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i nyan thos kyis/ /sems can 'jigs par snang ba ste/ /srid pa'i btson charar spyod pa yin/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sdug bsngal drag /yun ring 7rjes su myong bar 'gyur / /'jig rten mgon po skyob pa yi/ / ring bsrel ⑩yang dag mchod byas nas/ /de dag lha yi 1nya'ajig rten du/ /yun mi thung bar bde tu)ba myong / /rgyal srid de nas longs spyod dang / /rnyed par dka' ba'i sngags rnams ni/ /'gro ba sna tshogs spyod pa yis7 lha/ /rnam pa sna tshogs thob par 'gyur/ /phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jig rten mchog /rnam thar gsum gyis rnam par brgyan(nya/ /——860

sku gdung rnams ni mchod byas na①/ /grub pa mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /'jig rten rnams ⑤grags bram ze zhes/ /thub pa mchog ni nyan thos gtso/ /'od srung zhes ni bya ba yis/ /'di ltar de ni bsams srinas ni/ /de tshe sa las ma phye bar/ /de yi sku gdung blangs nas ni/ /ma ga dhā dubadag ma skyes dgras / /'bad nas cung zad yongs su byin⑤/ /de bzhin rgyal po kun la yang ske/ /'od chen po ni ma mthong yang / /nyan thos bdag nyid chen po des/ /kun la'ang thams cad rab tu byin⑥/ /kun la'ang mi rtag 'du shes kyis/ /de na yang ni gnas par gyur⑨/ /snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sems can rnams (kyel mya ngan byed/ /shākya'i skyes mchog bstan pa ni/ /'jig rten dam chos nub pa na/ /bskal pa rnam pa mang por ni/ /yun ring ⑨sems can dud par ⑩'gyur/ /'di dag dud bzhin mi 'gyur bar/ /'di dag gsung ni bsdu bar bya/ /dpa' bo de las langs yinas ni/ /sems kyi 8stobs ni nyams pa med/ /rgyal po ma skyes (nyedagrar gyur pa'i/ /mi yi dbang pos mgron tsodu bos / /ston pa'i bstan pa bya ba'i phyir/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer 'diratso/ /'bad pas sku gdung myur du ni/ /gser gyi snod kyi nang du bcug /de dag ⑩sngon du yang dag btang / /de tshe rgyal po'i khab myur 'gro/ /'od ma'i tshal du phyin nas ni/ /sku gdung dag ni yang dag bzhag /'jig rten mgon po skyob pa yi/ /mchod rten rmad byung tunyechen po byas/ /mchod rten de ni mchod byed pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgyan dang ni/ /phreng ba gos dang gdugs dang ni/ /dar la rol mo byug pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma dang / /mar me me tog phreng ba yis / /phyag 'tshal rjes song sems kyis ni/ /rgyal po rab tu mchod pa byed/ /——861

mchod rten de la mgos btud nas/ /de yi tshe na smon lam btab/ /'jig rten mchog la mchod pa yis/ /bdag gi dge ba mang po gang / /de bzhin gshegs la 6)mchod pa 'dis/ /bsam gyis ②mi khyab mchog thob shog /de nas rgyal po langs nas ni/ /'od srung che la rab tu smras/ /mig ni mchi mas kun khyab nas / /mig gi dumachi ma phyis srinas ni/ /snying ni brtse bas rab brlan nas / /de tshe pha ni yang dag dran/ /shes rab chen po 'phags pa khyod/ /khyod ni bdag gi dbang 'gyur ⑤mdzod/ /bdag gi dusdig pa gang byas pa/ /nges par mnar med rab tu gzhol/ /ston pa'i ⑦bka' yi lam gnas pa/ /de 'dra'i chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /pha yi srog la gnod bcas pa'i/ /mya ngan bsal bar mi nus pas/ /'phags pa dge ba'i bshes (snyeganyen gyis/ /bdag la chos don bstan par 6)rigs/ /de skad smras nas bdag nyid che/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos mchog gyur payi/ /blo ldan 'od srung zhes bya bas/ /'di dag tshig ni rab tu smras/ /rgyal po chen po ma 'jigs shig /khyod kyi (7dge ba mang du byas/ /skye ba brgya phrag 12du mar yang / /khyod la goms hunyepa rab tu yod/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa na/ /rang rgyal gcig ④ni yang dag byung / /grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī 7ru/ /de tshe tshong dpon bu zhig byung / /mi shes byis pa g.yo ba yisatso/ /de tshe shing rta zhon nas byung / /bcom ldan de nyid de ru ni/ /rang rgyal yongs su byung ba ni/ /'jig rten rjes su gzung (me'adod pas/ / der ni slong (sremo'i don du rgyu/ /byis pa des 16ni de mthong nas/ /sems ni yang dag dang ( nyagyur nas / /rkang gnyis la gtugs dris pa ni/ /dge slong khyod ni ci zhig byed/ /bse ru lta bur 87skye ba med/ /bcom ldan de ni mi smrar 'dug /de tshe byis pa de ——862

yi ①ni/ /gos la bzung ②nas yang dag gnas/ / 'deng ngo 'deng ⑧ngo khyim bzang 'dir/ /rgyal mtshan gyis ni rab mtshan pa'oX/ /'di ni bdag gi ⑤khyim yin te/ /zhabs bkrus nas ni bshos gsol te/ /ji ltar dus bzhin myur gsol nasaX/ /ci 'dod par ni rtse bar bgyi'o⑦/ /de nas nyes dang bral ba de/ /nyes gsum mthar byed 'joms pa po/ /gzhan dag rjes gzung ⑧de dag gtsor/ /mthar gyis kyang ni rab 'gro zhing / /song nas sgo yi rtsa ba la/ /'od chen der ni 'dug par gyur/ /de nas byis pa nang zhugs nas/ /ma la yang ni 'di skad smras/ /ma ni bdag la 'bras chan ⑨stsol/ /bza' ba rnam mang dag kyang stsol/ /yun ring byas rdul la rtse ba'i/ /bdag gi grogs po 'dir 'ongs gyur/ /yun ring bdag ni yidagar 'gyur ba/ /sgor ni 'ongs nas 'dug pa yin/ /de tshe de ni rab rings par/ /de yi mod la sgor yang byung ske/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po zhi ba'i gzugs/ /bdag nyid chen po de yang mthong / /de tshe de ni myur 'ongs nas/ /snod ni bzang po blangs nas kyang / /lag pa legs par rab bkrus nas/ /me tog spos sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /'bras chan gtsang ma blangs nas ni/ /du ma'i ro yis rnam brgyan 8pa'i/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bza' ba dang / /dngul gyi snod du rab tu bcugatso /de tshe myur du phyir byung ste/ /de yi lhung bzed la blugs nas/ /khyor bcas chos la dad pa yis / /de yi rkang pa gnyis la gtugasaci/ /de yis 8bsod snyoms blangs ⑩nas ni/ /nam mkha' la ni mngon par song / /de nas de ni rab 'bar zhing / /mar me'i phreng ba bzhin du snang / /bse ru ltar spyod gang yin pa/ /de dag ngag gis chos ston min/ /rdzu 'phrul 'od kyis sems can la/ /bdag nyid ——863

byas / /de ltar 'od ma'i tshal du ni/ /phan tshun de dag sa steng smra/ /nga yi slob ma mchog 'di dang / /gnyis pa mi yi bdag po yis/ /mchod rten lan brgyar phyag 'tshal ①nas/ /de tshe rang gi khyim du song / /de nas slob ma'i mchog gyur pa/ /pi pal phug ②na gnas pa de / /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /thub pa ma lus 'dus nas ni/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dang / /'dul ba ma lus sdud ④par byed/ /gang zhig chos ni ngas bstan dang / /de bzhin sngon gyi rgyal ba mchog /de nas ⑤slob ma'i mchog des kyang / /rnam pa gsum du yang yidag bstan/ /'dul ba dang ni mngon pa dang //mdo sde'i dbye bas gzhung du byas/ /sems can 'ching ba gsum las bgrol/ /nyes pa gsum yang skem ⑦par byed/ /dpa' bo sdug bsngal gsum las 'grol/ /rtag tu theg pa gsum la dgodal/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yo)bstan pa'i don/ /blo yi mchog ni byed par 'gyur/ /rgyal chen ma skyes dgra zhes pa'i/ /ma ga dhā ⑩pa mi yi bdag /ang ga ma ga dhā tunyedang ni/ /bā rā ṇa sī tu)de las gzhan/ /byang du yangs pa can dang ni/ /rgyal chen stobs po che bar ni/ /the tshom tunyemed par 'gyur ba yin/ /bstan pa'i don ni byed par 'gyur/ /gzhon nu khyod ni 'dul byed cing / /zhi ba dam pa ston par 'gyur/ /de yi bu yang rgyal po ni/ /yi ge u zhes bya bar bsgragasatso/ /de tshe 'byung tshubar 'gyur ba ni/ /myur du bstan ⑩pa'i don la brtson/ /des ni ston pa'i gsung rab 'dir/ /rgya cher 'dri ()bar byed 'jug 'gyur/ /mchod pa chen po'ang byas nas ni/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rgyas par byed/ /phyir yang ngan song 'di mi 'gro/ /lhar skye bar (sheni de 'gyur ro/ /lo ni nyi shu sum cur ni/ /pha dang lhan cig 'grogs par 88—865

'gyur / /grong khyer stobs ldan mtshan phyed dul/ /rigs las skyes pa'i nad kyis ni/ /mngon par zil gyis ②don par 'gyur/ /nyin zhag sum cu rtsa drug tu / /nad chen dag gis nyam thag 'gyur/ /nad rnams kun gyis btab nas de ske/ /rnam pa sna tshogs brgyal nas ni/ /rgyal po de myur shi 'phos nas/ /lha rnams su ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de ④ni mthar gyis 'bad nas ni/ /nges par byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /'di dang (5)gzhan yang mang po ni/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs par/ /rang rgyal skyob pa dag la ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs byas pa yisaXske/ /de bzhin lha dang mi rnams kyis④/ /'dod dang khyad par phun tshogs 'thob / /de dag mthar gyis ⑧'gro 'gyur ba/ /zhi ba nad med go 'phang 'thobaske/ /rgyal po mchog dang dman pa dang / /mi yi bdag po bar ma rnams/ /rgyal po na hu 6)sha la sogs/ /dang po'i dus su bstan pa dag /des kyang de bzhin gshegs mchod dang / /rjes yi rang ⑩bas mtho ris song nges par de dag sangs rgyas gyur/ /kha cig nyan thos theg pa la/ /nges par kha cig nyan thos nyid/ /de kun thar 6kyel mngon par gzhol/ /dus kyi rnam gzhag rjes mthun par/ /tshe yang rnam par brtag ⑩pa yin/ /dam pa tshe yang ring ba ste/ /de bzhin bar 0ma bar ma yin/ /shin tu dka' ba'i dus mtha' la/ /dus kyi tha ma rtsod dus la/ /rgyal po rtsod pa la chadaga' bas/ /gzhan ni tha mar bstan pa yin/ /phan tshun khon 7du 'dzin chags pas/ /gcig la gcig ni rnam 'tshe byed / /dman pa'i skye ba thob pa dang / /mtshon gyi reg pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mtshon gyis 7'tsho bas yang dag dga'/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi 8bud med chags/ /rgyal po 'jig rten smod par ni/ /the tsom (stemed par 'gyur ba yin/ /g.yon (kye——866

can las ngan can dang ni/ /de bzhin ①'phags min ser sna can/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /cha gnyis ldan dang rtsod ②dus bar/ /mdor bsdu sa ②nas ni bshad par bya/ /gzhon nu de ni rtogs par gyis/ /dus gang 'byung bar 'gyur ba ④na/ /sa steng rgyal po 'byung ba yi/ /de dag gzugs dang mtshan ma dang / /kha dog kyang ni rtogs par gyis/ /ko sa'i rgyal po dugasal rgyal dang / /gzugs can snying po de bzhin gzhan/ /rgyal rigs gtso bo 'char ba dang / /dmag brgya pa ni yang dag 'byung / /lag bzang gzhu bzang ⑥zhes bya dang / /de bzhin dbang chen tsa ma sha /de bzhin lits+tsha bīr ⑦skyes pa'i//shākya'i rigs skyes seng ge dang / /cher ldan gsal dang rab gsal dang / /sde chen du yang bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin 'phags rgyal gtum po (nyadang / /ser skya'i grong gi rgyal po ni/ /zas gtsang zhes ni bya ba dang / /dpa' bo zhes bya stobs chen dag /'di dag rgyal po'i rigs su gsungs/ /sa srung ston pa mchod byed pa'ol/ /shākya 6)seng ge mi yi mchog /sangs rgyas mngon du lta bar 'gyur/ /de yang de nas chos thos nas/ /yun ring phun sum tshogs pa 'thobatu ) nges par byang chub 'dod nas kyang / /shi nas zhi ba 'thob (nyapar 'gyur/ /sa bdag sa yi dkyil 'khor du/ /'di dag 'jig rten rnam par grags/ /rigs ni rgyal rigs dag tu bstan/ /'du shes ming gis mtshon pa yin/ /sa steng nga yis tsobastan pa'i tshig /de dag mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /gzhon nu byis pa'i gzugs can gyis/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten lung bstan pa/ /ma skyes zhes bya'i rgyal po de/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /nga ni sa steng mya ngan 'das / /lo brgya dag ni 'das pa na/ /snang ba med cing nyes par bcas /——867

mi shes mun pas rab tu bsgribs/ /de tshe sa ni stongs pa steX/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis spangs pa yin/ /de tshe mi bzad chen po yi/ /grong khyer me tog can du ni/ /mya ngan med ces ②bya ba yi/ /rgyal po sa ni skyong byed pa/ /khro bcas las ni drag po byed/ /de tshe de ni snying rje med/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'dod chags bral/ /nad ②med ser sna ⑤bral ba dang / /dge slong tshul khrims ldan pa yi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen thad du lhags/ /sngon gyi (snyebag chags rgyu rtsodang ni/ /sa rdul byin pa'i byin rlabs ⑦kyis/ /rigs ni 6)nges par 'gyur ba ⑨dang / /rgyal po nor chen ldan par 'gyurati/ /chos dang chos min rnam dpyod 0cing / /brtse ldan tsosnying rje ldan pa dang / /chags bral rdzu 'phrul chen po des/ /rgyu ni phye zhing bstan par byas/ /sngon ni khyod kyang rgyal po ste/ /mi shes byis pa g.yo ba yi8/ /rgyal ba shākya seng ge la/ /sa yi rdul yini snyim gang phul/ /zhing de la ni rab phul bas/ /lha yul phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /lha yi 'jig rten shi 'phos nas//sa yi 'jig rten 'dir 'ongs 'gyur/ /'dzam gling nags tshal phun sum tshogs//rgyal po yi yini (1rgyal thabs spyod8/ /bdag nyid chen po dzam ()rta la/ /gnod sbyin gyi ni sngags kyang btsubs/ /bdag nyid chen po sa yi bdag /de nas gnod sbyin shing rta grub/ /de la gnod sbyin 'dug pa ni/ /bka' dang mthun par yid kyang 'jug /klu rnams kyang ni 'dug pa ste/ /bran dang bka' ( )bzhin byed pa'i rgyu/ /de ltar rdzu 'phrul che bdag nyid/ /de tshe stobs kyi 'khor sgyur 'byung ( nya/ /ci 'dod de ni 'gro ba na/ /gang du'ang 'gog ru pa med par 'gyur / /rgyal ba'i sku gdung mchog sa la/ /gang yang sngon ni rab bzhag pa/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer gyi/ /de tshe 'od ma'i tshal du'o/ /sku gdung mchog ni ——868

blangs nas kyang / /dge ba la dmigs yid can gyis/ /ji ltar sngon gyi ①byas pa bzhin/ /mchod rten de la mchod pa byas/ /sku gdung bum pa de blangs nas//de ni de bzhin rnam bgos nas/ /blo ldan des ②ni skad cig gis/ /de nas gnod sbyin la yang smras/ /'dzam ①bu'i gling 'di ma lus paX/ /mchod rten rgyan ⑤gyis brgyan pa dang / /sa rnams sku gdung snying por ni/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rab tu bya/ /'bad pa yis duni mtshan phyed du/ /gnod sbyin gyis ni bka' yang blangs/ /mi ma yin pa'i bya ba ①byas/ /sa steng rdo yi srog shing bsgreng ni/ /ka ba stong phrag du ma ni/ /de tshe yongs su btsugs par gyur/ /mchod rten rnams la mchod don du/ /lus can rnams la mtshon par gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob pa yisal/ /mchod rten sna tshogs byas nas ni/ /skad cig gcig gis tshuganod sbyin rnams/ /rgyal po yi ni drung du lhags/ /de nas gnod sbyin rab btud nas/ /dben (7par tshig ni rab tu smras/ /ji skad bka' stsal ma lus byas/ /sa bdag ji ste gzigs mi mdzad/ /de nas myur du sa bdag de/ /de tshe shing rta de la zhon/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mchod don du/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mdzes pa'i phyir/ /gser dang de bzhin dngul dag dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs mchod rten brgyan/ /de nas gnod sbyin shing rta dang / /myur du rgyal po rab tu song / /gang na rgyal ba'i tsomachod rten yod/ /skad cig gis ni tunyede yul du'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mchod pa yis8/ /rgyal po des ni de la mchod/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i mchod rten gyis/ /sa rnams ma lus mdzes par byas/ /bdag nyid chos rgyal mya ngan med8/ /smon lam dag ni 'debs par brtson/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di don gyis/ /bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas shog /de bzhin des kyang rig ⑩ ——869

nas ni/ /rgyal po chos ni ston ①par byed/ /de ni shi nas lha ru 'gro/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar ②'gyur/ /lo ni brgyad cu rtsa bdun dul/ /sa steng mchod rten mchod par 'gyur/ /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /gnod pa med pa'i rgyal thabs byed/ /de rang las las byung ba yi/ /lus la nad ni yongs su 'byung / /nad des gnod cing sdug bsngal ④nas/ /shi nas mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /lha yi phun sum tshogs pa che/ /thob nas rjes su myong bar byed / /de ni duyid gzhungs rim gyis ⑥su/ /rnyed par ⑦dka' ba'i byang chub thob / /rdo rje (nyapad+ma'i rigs dag ni/ /sngags kyang de tshe 'grub par 'gyur/ /dzam tsabha la sogs gnod sbyin ⑩yang / /'di yi bstan pa'i rjes su 0'jug /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'phrog 8ma sogs/ /gnod sbyin mo yang yang yidag 'grub/ /'khor los sgyur bas bskyed pa yici/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags kyang grubasnyil/ /gang dag rgyal bas bstan pa'i sngags/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul cheli / /gtsug tor la sogs thams cad dang / /gang gzhan rgyal bas gsungs ⑩pa'ang yin/ /de yi dus ni rab bzang la/ /sgrub tu)pa dam pa dag kyang bya/ /dam pas tha ma bsgrub mi bya/ /dam pa thob par bya phyir ro/ /di lī tunyepa dang na hu shashu ) /nga 87las nu dang dug chen mtsho/ /rgyal bas bshad pa'i 'khor los sgyur / /sngags ni de dag sgrub par byed/ /bdag nyid chen po na hu shang sme /de tshe gzi brjid phung po grub ste/ /rgyal po chen po dug chen paniste/ /gdugs dkar po yang grub rngo nyapa yin/ /de bzhin rgyal po di lī pa/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sngags kyang grub / /nga las nu ni 'jig rten dang / /de bzhin gtsug tor dam pa grub me / /rgyal mchog dhun du nam ra ni/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i gtsug tor grub6nye//88—870

de bzhin 'dam gyi ①rgyal po ni/ /rnam rgyal gtsug tor grub ②pa'o/ /de bu skye ①dgu'i bdag po ste/ /de yang sa steng ⑦spyan sngags grubaphyi/ /skye dgu'i bdag po skye ba ste/ /de yang mdzod spu'i sngags kyang grubasti/ /lte ba'i bu ni khyu mchog ste/ /de ni las grub brtul zhugs brtan/ /kha ba can gyi ri ⑦dag tu/ /de yang nor spyod gnod sbyin grubadu/ /khyu mchog bu ni rgyas pa ste/ /de yang de tshe sngags bzlas byed/ /de tshe sa steng de 6)mthar gyis/ /dpa' bo chen po'ang tshurab tu grubatso / /'di dag gzhan yang mang po yi/ /rgyal po tso'ajig rten rnam grags pas / /sngags rnams rab tu bsgrubs nas ni/ /rgyal srid byas nas lha yul 'gro0 / /rig pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /rgyal ba'i dbang pos tsogang gsungs pa / /de kun dus ni bzang po ste/ /lo ni stong phrag brgyad cu pa/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi don mkhas pas/ /grub pa dag ni sgrub par 'gyur/ /'di dag gzhan yang rab mang ba'i8/ /sa bdag 'jig rten rnam 8grags pa/ /de nas stong phrag brgyad cu'i sngags/ /de bzhin yang dag bsgrubs nas ni/ /rgyal srid byas nas mtho yonyeris 'gro/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /de tshe bar ma'i dus dag tu/ /lha mo rdzu 'phrul chen mo dang / /lha rnams kyi ni sngags dang ni / /pad+ma'i rigs kyi sngags dang ni/ /blon po mi yi gtso tunyebo dang / /sa bdag sa kun bdag po'o/ /bā rā ṇa sī grong khyer natunye/ /rgyal po tshangs pas byin pa yang / /'jig rten 'jig rten dbang phyug grags/ /phyag na pad+ma ( )rab tu grub( nya/ /bdag nyid chen po brtson 'grus che/ /lhag ( gepar snying rje chen po de / /sems can rnams la sngags tshul gyis/ /chos rnams ston pa byin pa yin/ /rgyal po yang ni tshangs byin gyis/ /mi yi bde ba rjes myong nas/ /de nas de ni ——871

sngags grub ste/ /lus dang bcas pas mtho ris song / /de yi bu yang blo ldan ni / /bsod nams las ni brtul zhugs brtan/ /brtson 'grus chen po rta mgrin zhes/ /rnam par grags pa de yang grub①/ /de yis sngags kyi ②mthu yis ni / /de tshe brgya byin las rgyal gyur / /de bu dkar po zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal po thams cad gtong ba 'byung du/ /de yang nor ni sbyin pa'i sngags/ /dkar mo che zhes bya ba yang ⑤/ /sngags ni rab tu bsgrubs pas kyang dhi/ /lo ni sum brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis ⑦ni/ /bde ba can tu yang dag 'gro/ /nges par ⑧byang chub 'di nges thobal/ /de bzhin gzhan yang ngas lung bstan/ /de tshe bar ma'i dus dag tu/ /bar ma'i sngags ni rab tu 'grub/ /dka' ba tha ma'i dus dag tu/ /nga ni sangs rgyas nyid thob nas0/ /rdo rje ⑩pad+ma'i rigs dag gi⑩/ /sngags kyang rab tu 'grub par 'gyuraX/ /gzhon nu khyod kyi sngags dag ni/ /gang zhig sa steng sngon bstan pa/ /sngags ni longs spyod rgyu nyid du/ /de yang rab tu grub par 'go④/ /'jig rten rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /phal pa dag gi sngags dag ni/ /mi sdug gzugs can rtog par ldan/ /bar snang dang ni nam mkhar spyod/ /sa blar gnas pa'i gnod sbyin mo/ /de bzhin sna tshogs sha za mo/ /mi 'am ci dang mkha' lding dang / /yi dgas srin pos bshad pa rnams / /sha za lto 'phye rmuganod sbyin dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po klu rnams kyitso/ /dus ngan de tshe tha ma la/ /sngags ni rab tu grub par 'gyur/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs kyi sngags dang ni/ /gzhon nu ma yi gzugs kun yang / /dus ni 'jigs rung de yi tshe/ /de yang grub par kyirab tu 'gro/ /de bzhin sngags ni rnam pa gsum/ /sgrub pa'ang rnam pa gsum yin no/ /rnam gsum nyid kyis ——872

dus kyi ①ni/ /rnam gsum grub pa ②'dod pa yin/ /rgya che'i gtam dang ldan pa dag /mdor bsdus rgyanas ni bshad par dubya/ /gtso bo mya ngan med pa yi/ /de 'og rgyal po byung dub ni/ /mya ngan bral zhes rnam par grags/ /'jig rten chos kyis duspyod par ldan/ /lha mo gos dkar mo ⑦yi ni/ /de yi sngags 'di yongs su 'grub(kye/ /mya ngan rnam bral gyis bsgrubs nas/ /lha yi gnas su rab tu song / /yun ring bde ba mtho ris su/ /rgyal po chen po rjes su myong / /phyir yang mi yul phyin nas ni/ /blo ldan chos kyi ngang tshul ldan/ /rgyal thabs rnam pa sna tshogs ldan/ /'od chen pos ni rjes su myong / /lo ni bdun cu rtsa drug tu/ /dpal ldan mchod rten mchod pa byed/ /de nas de ni nad btab nas / /lus zhig nas ni lha ris 6)'gro/ /de yi 'og 0tu rgyal po ni/ /dpa' bo'i 0sde zhes rab tu brjod8/ /chos la spyod cing rnam par grags/ /bstan pa 'di la mnyam par bzhagatso /lha mo mchod rten dpal chen ma/ /de yi sngags kyang rab tu bsgrubs8/ /des kyang ston pa'i khang chen ni/ /de yi tshe na byas par 'gyur8/ /sa rnams rgyal mtsho'i ⑩mthar thug par/ /ma lus mchod rten rnams kyis brgyan/ /de la rnam smin las kyis ni/ /lus las skyes ⑩pa'i nad kyang 'byung / /zla phyed gcig tu sdug bsngal nas/ /de nas 8shi 'phos lus zhig 'gyur/ /lo ni bdun cu dag tu yang / /mi yi nang du rgyal thabs byas/ /shi 'phos de ni mtho ris 'gro/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /de yi 'og tu rgyal po ni/ /dga' bo zhes bya 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dpal ldan grong khyer me tog ces/ /sde chen stobs ni che bar gnas/ /sha za pi lu zhes bya ba'i/ /sngags kyang des ni bsgrubs (7pa yin/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis (pe ni/ /——873

longs spyod chen po yod par 'gyur/ /rgya yi gtso ①bo zhes bya ba/ /'jig rten 'dir ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nor thob pas blon por 'gyural/ /'jig rten rgyal po nyid du'ang 'gyur/ /de yi dus su 'byung ba ni/ /bram ze tshad ma shes pa'o/ /log pa'i nga rgyal dag la zhen/ /ma ga dhā ①yi grong khyer gnas/ /log pa'i nga rgyal gyis dregs rnams/ /'byung ba nyid du the tshom ④med/ /de dag gis 0ni rgyal po bskor/ /de dag la ni des yinor byin/ /nor ni mang po de dag gis/ /dge ba'i bshes la phyirab mchod nas/ /de yi nor ni zad par byedarka/ /ma 'dres de la goms ⑧pa dang / /sbyin la zhum med rgyu yis 0ni/ /blo ldan de yi ⑩lha khang ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi byed du bcug /grong khyer me tog ces bya bar / /bdag nyid chen po blon po'i gtsoyi/ /bram ze bzang po snying rjer ldan/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po dang ni rab mdza' 8ba'i/ /chos kyi ⑫bdag nyid 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin ma ni dpa' mo ldan/ /sa steng de yi sngags kyang 'grubasti/ /des kyang sa steng dag tu ni/ /mchod rten bzang po byed du bcug /gnod sbyin ma yi mthu yis ni/ /shes rab rab tu che bar 'gyura' / /de yi bag chags las kyis ni/ /sngon gyi bag chags yong bskul ⑩nas / /blo dang ldan pas mthar gyis ni/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i ⑩byang chub 'thob(nya / /mchog sred ces ni rnam grags 9)pa'i/ /de tshe 'dod chags shas che 'byung 3 rte/ /bud med byas pa'i skyon gyis ni/ /bram ze'i (1khye'us 'chi ba thobadu//dpal ldan rgyal po dga' bo yang / /snga ma'i las kyi nyes pa yis(3/ /me tog ces bya'i grong khyer gyi ste/ /mi rnams 'chad 9 nyepas gnod par byed/ /blon po'i tshogs kyang ma dad gyur/ /stobs mnyachen bden par smra ba yang / /sngon gyi las 88—874

kyi nyes pa yisal/ /nad ②chen dag gis thebs ni'agyur te/ /rims nad chen pos ④sdug bsngal gdung du/ /nam phyed tsam na shi bar 'gyur⑥/ /rgyal po de yi tshe 3da ni/ /de bzhin lnga bcu rtsa drug go/ /de ni nyan thos byang chub tu/ /rgyal po 9)nges par 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi grogs po gzhan gyur pa/ /bram ze'i khye'u pa niṇi ni/ /nges par nyan thos byang chub tu/ /nga yis 0lung bstan byas pa yin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bdag nyid che/ /de yang de yi sngags grub pa'o / /bram ze shes rab 'dod pas kyang / /khro bo ha la ha la bsgrubs/ /rgyal po de las gzhan pa yang / /zla ba sbas zhes bya ba ti'abyung / /gnod sbyin chu dbang grub pa ste/ /rgyal srid gnod pa med par 7byed/ /longs spyod che zhing bden par smra0/ /chos kyi bdag nyid sa yi bdag /mi dge'i bshes gnyen rab brten (rtenas/ /srog chags mang po gsod par byed/ /las kyi rnam smin de yis ④ni/ /'brum bu'i nad 'byung tsorab tu brgyal/ /de ni tsomatshan phyed sad ⑩nas ni/ /rgyal srid la ni bu bzhag pa/ /snying po thig le zhes bya ba/ /blon po la sdang byis pa detunye/ /de nas zla ba sbas pa de/ /shi 'phos sa steng dus las 'das/ /mi yi 'gro ba yispangs pa yi/ /de tshe yi dgas 'jig rten song / /'gro ba las grol sngags goms ( )pas/ /de nas lha yi gnas su song / /dge ba'i 0sems kyis dmigs nas ni/ /sngags kyi (nyergyus ni yang dag bskyed/ /rgyal po des ni mthar gyis kyang / /nyan thos kyi ni byang chub 'gro/ /snying po thig le rgyal po yis/ /byis pa mi gsal blo yis ni/ /bye ma las byas srid gzhan du/ /sngon ni sgo mchod rten dag kyang byas/ /de yi 0rnam smin mthu yis ni / /ma smad lha yi gnas su song / /skye ba stong phrag lnga brgyar ni/ /lha yi nang ——875

du bde ba myong / /mtho ris 'jig rten shi 'phos nas/ /mi yi nang du rab skyes pa/ /blo ldan zla ba sbas pa yi/ /rgyal po dga' ba'i rigs su skyes/ /byis pa nyid nas rgyal por 'gyur①/ /yun mi thung bar ②bde ba myong / /'jigs med bstan dudang yang dag rig / spyi brtsan 0pa dang snyan par smraX/ /de nyid rang dbang rgyal srid ni/ /lo ni bdun cur yongs su byas/ /skra can zhes bya'i sngags dag kyang / /rgyal po de la rab tu grub/ /khyod nyid kyi ni sngags nyid kyang ske/ /de tshe grub par byed par 'gyur/ /khyod nyid kyis bshad sngags dag rjokyang ske/ /de yi tshe na grub ⑦par 'gyur/ /byis pa'i tshul can sna tshogs gzugs/ /byis pa rnams la mthu dang ldan/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis lus can la/ /the tshom med par 'byung bar 'gyurabya/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pasal/ /gang zhig khyod kyis bstan pa'i sngags/ /de tshe de yi dus dag tu/ /brjod ⑩pa tsam gyis 'grub ⑩par 'gyur/ /blo ldan snying po thig le yi/ /rgyal po de yi blon po ni/ /tsa nag kya ⑩zhes rnam bsgrags pa'/ /bram ze'i khye'us 8khro bo 'grubatso//gshin rje gshed ⑩ces bya ba ni/ /blo ngan des ⑩ni de yang 'grubatso/ /des ni khro bas zil non nasayi/ /srog chags dag gi 'tsho ba bcadabya/ /de tshe rgyal po gsum gyi bar/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa byas/ /de ⑥ni dus ring 'tsho ba yi/ /bram ze ngan rngo )pa 'byung bar 'gyuradu/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis ④ni/ /lus des lha min brten ⑤par byed/ /lha min lus la zhugs nas ni/ /de ni 0dus ring 'tsho bar byed/ /de nas lus de zhig nas kyang / /mnar med dmyal bar yang dag 'gro/ /de nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de/ /blo ngan des 0ni rjes su myong ske/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /mi 'dod de tshe las las byung / /——876

las gcig sdug bsngal des ⑨zad nas/ /khro bo'i sngags kyis rab bskul te/ /dmyal ba las ni de 'chi 'phos/ /dud 'gro dag tu nye bar skyes/ /klu yi skye gnas brten ②nas ni/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can dag tu 'gyur③/ /khro ldan chen po klu yi rgyalaX/ /gdengs can dug gis dregs 0byed dang / /mi bzad dulas ni rab byed pasaX/ /ma rungs las las de 'chi 'phos/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po yi dgas kyil/ /gshin rje'i rgyal por rab tu 'gyur/ /de ltar sdug bsngal stong phrag ni/ /yang dang yang du rjes su myong / /blo ngan de 0ni mthar gyis su/ /bram ze'i khye'ur sa steng 'ongs/ /mi yi skye bar 'ongs nas ni/ /'jigs pa yi ni gzugs can 'gyur/ /khro ba dang ni dbul ba nyid/ /grags pa chung ⑩ba nyid du 'gyur/ /gang yang 'jig rten rang sangs rgyas/ /'dod med bse ru ⑩lta bur spyod/ /dman pa la ni rjes brtse ba/ /sa yi steng na rnam par rgyu/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod phyir/ /bsod snyoms 8spyod la rab tu zhugs/ /de tshe gzhan sems rig pa des/ /blo ngan de ni rab tu mthong / /snying rjes yin gyis tsogazhan min desatso/ /de yi thad du byon par 'gyur/ /des ⑩ni zan dron gsol ched ⑩du/ /bse ru lta bu la ni khyer/ /des ni sngags la rab brnyas nas / /de tshe rgyu ni yang dag bstan/ /de las gcig gi bdag nyid la/ /bsod snyoms de ni yang dag bstabs/ /kye 'di rab byung ma lus pa/ /ji ltar bde ba bzhin du gsol/ /de la rjes ⑩brtse rang sangs rgyas/ /de tshe rdzu 'phrul bstan par 'gyur/ /de yi mthu yis yid bskyod tsonas/ /de nas ngo mtshar ()rab skyes 0te/ /sangs rgyas bse ru lta bu la/ /spyi bos 0kun la rab tu btud/ /ji ltar 'dod par nyes sgonyebral rnams/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yi mthus/ /rang ——877

rgyal byang chub smon lam btab/ /bdag nyid chen po ci 'dra ba/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po zhi ba'i gzugs/ /sdug bsngal blo ngan mi 'gyur bar①/ /de 'dra bdag ni 'jig rten shog /las kyi lhag ma zad pa dang / /'chi 'phos ②de tshe mtho ⑧ris song / /chos kyi bdag nyid de mthar gyis/ /nyan thos de ni byang chu ba thob / /de bas sngags kyi ④sgrub pa ni/ /mngon spyod dag ni yong mi bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /mngon spyod rab tu bkag pa yin⑤/ /snying rje mchog ldan sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul cheyi/ /sngags rnams mthu bstan don du ni/ /las rnams 7thams cad nibastan pa yin / /de ⑨bzhin nor bu ⑩lta bu'i sngags/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs(1 / /khro dang chags 8pas zil mnan pa'i/ /byis pa rmongs pa'i sems dag gis/ /de dag sngags ni mngon spyod la/ /phan tshun rab tu sbyor bar byed//sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /blo dang ldan pas de bzhin bkag /rnam pa thams cad sngags rnams ni/ /sems can longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /de nas rgyal po dam pa dang / /srung ba che dang dbang phyir (stedang / /skye gnas sna tshogs la gnas pa'i/ /sems can rnams ni dgug don du/ /sngags kyang bsgrub par bya ba ste/ /'tsho ba dgag phyir ma yin no/ /dge slong mang du thos pa ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung 'gyur ba/ /ma khol zhes kyang bya ba ste/ /nga 8nyid kyi ni stod 'byed pa/ /ji bzhin yon tan bzang po ni/ /ji lta ⑩bzhin du brjod tshipar 'gyur/ /kun nas sems ni rab dang zhing / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 1nyabastan la dad/ /sgrub dka'i sngags ni rab bsgrub (7cing 'jam 6 )pa'i dbyangs kyi 31de bzhin no/ /yon tan ldan zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /mang du thos ——878

shing chos kyang smra/ /dud 'gror sngon ni gyur pa na/ /nga yi bstod pa yongs su smra / /nyams dga' grong khyer rgyal po'i khab/ /'od ma'i tshal gyi sa steng du/ /slob ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs pa na/ /der ni bya rog cig ①yod pas/ /nga la sems ni rab dad byas/ /sems ni nga la dad byas pas/ /lus zhig nas ni mtho ris song / /lha rnams las ni shi 'phos nas / /mi rnams nang du nye bar skyes/ /mi yi nang du skyes nas kyang / /nga yi bstan la rab tu 'byung (snye/ /rab byung bdag nyid chen po de / /ji bzhin de tshe 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ma khol zhes bya'i brtul khyizhugs can/ /de ni de tshe 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ji bzhin don ni bstod pas mchod/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dpe dag gis/ /'byung po kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /legs par spyod pa rab ⑤byed pa'o/ /sems can rjes su gzung 5leba'i phyir/ /bstod pa brjod pa de gtsor byed/ /dus mtha'i ( )'jig rten smad pa la/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur / /rnam par smin pa de yis (kyeni/ /lus zhig nas ni bde 'gror 'gro/ /blo ldan de ni mthar gyis kyang / /rnam pa sna tshogs bde 6)myong nas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mchog gsungs 7pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i byang chub thobatunye/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/ /lo ni bzhi brgya tsolon pa na/ /dge slong klu zhes de 'bod ⑩'byung / /bstan pa la ni dad cing phan/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob pa/ /lo ni drug brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /rig pa rma bya chen mo ni/ /bdag nyid chen po des kyang grub/ /bstan bcos tsosna tshogs don dang ni/ /dngos po med pa'i don de rigasa'/ /gang tshe lus de bor ba na/ /bde ba can du'ang skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'amathar gyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /nges pa kho nar ——879

yang dag 'thob①/ /thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos de ni ②don la mkhas/ /mdo sde des don drang ba'i don/ /rnam pa mang po'ang rab tu 'byed②ske/ /'jig rten rig pa ston bdag nyid/ /gzhung byed ngang tshul can du 'gyur / /de yi rig ①pa grub pa 'di/ /sā la'i pho nya mo zhes rjodaphyi/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis 0ni/ /blo ni bzang po skye bar 'gyural/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i ②phyir/ /mdo yi de nyid don sdud byed/ /lo ni brgya ⑨dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /de lus zhig nas lha yul 'gro/ /'khor ba rnams su 'khor ba na//yun ring bde ba rjes 0myong nas/ /bdag nyid chen po mthar gyis de/ /byang chub thob par 'gyur ba yin/ /de ltar rnam pa mang po yi/ /nga yi bstan la dge slong rnams/ /shes rab ldan nyid chos kyang spyod/ /dus kyi mtha' la de tshe 'byung ske/ /phyi ma de tshe dus dag tu/ /dge slong dgra bcom zhes bya ba/ /de ni sngags don bdag nyid ldan/ /rgyud shes de bzhin mang du thos/ /gnod sbyin sngags ni rab brjod pas/ /de la bum pa bzang po 'grubayi/ /sngon ni ngas ni gang bshad pa'i/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde yang / /de yi tshe na bum pa las/ /dka' thub chen po 'dren par byed/ /glegs 8bam de la des bltas nas/ /de la sngags ni zlos pa na/ /gnod sbyin bsgrub 8pa'i bum pa la/ /der ni bsrung ⑫ba ma byas pa'i/ /bag med dran pa nyams 8pa yis/ /gtsug spyod kyis ⑩ni bum pa phrogs / /de ni de nas ⑩sngags grub pa'i/ /dge slong sngags ni zlos byed pa'i6)ske/ /bum pa dag ni bltas pa na/ /der ni mngon par mthong ma gyur/ /de nas khro bas 1)mig dmar zhing / /rnam g.yo tshig tu smra ba ni/ /tshangs pa dka' sonyaba'i mthar gyur par/ /brgya byin sogs bcas dbang phyug che/ /——880
