sngags kyis ma bkug ma 'ongs na①/ /sngags pa bdag min sngags rgyal min/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas sras sngags dang / /rgyal ba mchog gis ②sngags dag ni/ /tshar gcod ③don du gang gsungs ④pa'am/ /gdul dka' 'dul bar ⑤byed pa'ang rung rjo/ /gal te kun rnams ma bkug na/ /sa steng ma lus de dag med//de nas sngags pa chen po langs/ /brtul zhugs brtan zhing ⑦las rnams grub/ /ji ltar nisngags ni byas pa yi/ /sbyor ba mthong bas rgyud ⑨dag kyang / /rkun ma dgug pa de don gtsor/ /sbyor ba rab tu byas par gyur⑩/ /skad cig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /sdom brtson ⑩de ni las myur byed/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi sngags gcig gisal/ /tshangs sogs sa steng 'dren par byed/ /lha rnams ma lus rab bkug pa / /tshangs sogs brgya byin dang yang bcas/ /ha ha zhes bya'i sgra 'don cing //nyam 8thag 'jigs pa'i sgra yang sgrogasatso/ /ci bgyi zhes bya'i blo byed cing / /bdag cag 'dir ni nyes med smra/ /myur zhing rab tu rings par yangs0 blo ldan dge slong 'jigs med pas/ /lha rnams la ni rab smras pa/ /'dir ni bum pa slar byin zhes/ /lha rnams phan tshun thams cad la/ /dge slong des ⑫ni rab tu smras/ /gang gis bum pa bzang po khyer/ /khyod ⑩kyis myur du rab tu smos / /lha rnams kun gyis bltas pa na/ /kun tu yang ni ma tsomathong gyur/ /bum pa 'di ni su yis khyer/ /lha yi dbang pos (nyeyang dag dgongs/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od chen po/ /dpal ldan lag na rdo rje can/ /de yi bu ni mi bzad yod/ /khro ba che zhing shin tu gdug /bgegs kyi gzugs kyis sngags (khe pa la/ /'gro ba kun la rnam par rgyu/ /bum pa de ni des ( )khyer mthong lha yi bdag pos de yang smras/ /rdo rje'i ( nyerigs kyi bgegs ( nyayod pa/ /sa steng rtse (snye88wa 881

zhing rol par byed/ /'dis ①ni bdag la ma mchod pas/ /des ni bum pa de 'dir khyer/ /lha yi bdag pos de smras nas/ /phyir yang lha yi gnas su song / /de tshe rang nyid sngags kyis ni/ /lha rnams ma lus slar gshegs gsol/ /skad cig yud tsam nyid kyis ②ni/ /shin tu legs par yang dag bkug /de tshe dbang med bum par bcas/ /bgegs de nyid dang bcas par 'ongs de nas de ni bgegs de yis③/ /yi dgas rnams la bum pa byin/ /de nas de yi bgegs des ④ni/ /tshig 'di dag ni rab tu smras/ /yi dgas 'jig rten bum pa khyer/ /nga ni de la dga' ba medadu/ /sngags pa des ni dka' ba dang / /dka' bas btud de bgegs la smras/ /song shig song shig bgegs chen po/ /phyin cad 'di ⑥ltar ma byed cig /de nas des ⑦ni yi dgas dag /de yi mod la bkug par gyur/ /ltogs shing ⑤ngal ba'i 6)sems dang ni/ /dman zhing de dag khab tsam kha/ /shin tu mi bzad chen po de/ /nyam 0thag skad kyang rab tu 'don/ /snying rje'i tshig tu smra ba ni/ /bdag nyid chen po yongs su skyobs31 / /khyod kyi bum pa 'dir 'ongs kyisakyi/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin bdag la byos/ /sngags pa snying rje cher ldan pas/ /yang dag 'dar ba rab tu skyes/ /snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis 6)ni/ /tshig ni 'di dag rab tu smras/ /khyod kyi 'jig rten sdug bsngal ci7/ /yun mi ring par rab tu smon8/ /dman pa'i yid kyis de smras pa/ /bkres pas yang dag gdungs par gyurayi/ /yi dgas 'jig rten skom pa yisalho 7/ /bdag nyid chen po yin yang rung (nya/ /dge slong snying rje chen pos ni/ /de dag la ni bum pa byin/ /de nas de dag yid dga' nas / /myur bar rang gi gnas su song / /de dag bsam tu)pa tsam gyis ni/ /——882

bum pa las ni bza' btung byung / /dge slong dga' bo'i la'og tu ni/ /tsan+dan skyong ni 'byung bar 'gyur②/ /de tshe dus ni ①tha ma la/ /lo ni sum brgya ④dag tu 'tsho/ /bdag nyid chen po byang chub ni/ /bgegs med myur du rnyed dka' thob⑤/ /rgyal po btsun pa zhes bya ba/ /nga yi bstan pa nub byed pa/ /dus kyi 0tha ma de yi tshe/ /the tshom ④med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /shar phyogs nas ni brtsams dunas su/ /kha che'i ①yul gyi bar dag tu/ /rmongs pas lha khang mchod rten rnams/ /de tshe de bzhin 'jig par 'gyur⑩/ /dge slong tshul khrims ldan pa rnams/ /blo ngan des ni gsod par 0byed/ /byang gi phyogs su brten tshunas ni/ /de ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /mi ma yin pa nyid 'khrugs nas / /yul 'khor phyugs 8dang gnyen rnams dang / /ri yi dum bus bcom par 'gyurardzi/ /blo ngan de ni sa 'og 'gro/ /de ni 'og nas 'og tu 'gro/ /dmyal las dmyal ba rab drag par/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal drag par ④ni/ /mi bzad par ni yang dag ltung / /mnar med zhes ni bya ba yi/ /sdig ⑩pa'i las kyis dmyal ba ni/ /de nas yibaskal pa cher 'tshed pa/ /bdag nyid ngan pa go mi shan(nya/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen la brten nas/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas4)/ /de ni nga yi bstan pa la/ /rnam pa kun gyis 'bad nas ni/ /sems ni ma lus rab btang ru )nas/ /phun sum tshogs dang de nas spyod/ /nges par sangs rgyas nyid lam ni/ /yan lag brgyad kyi 0theg pas ni/ /de tshe de ni rab 'gro zhing / /mya ngan nad med dam pa thob/ /de yi 'og tu sa srung ba / /sangs rgyas phyogs zhes rnam par grags/ /phyogs che gtong ba che ba dang //sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan la dad/ /de tshe dus kyi ( natha ma la/ /'byung bar ——88 3

'gyur bar the tshom ①med/ /thams cad mngon dga'i ②rgyal po ste/ /ston pa'i bstan pa de gtsor byed/ /kun dga' ra ba mchod rten gnas/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan bla na med/ /mtshe'u rdzing dang khron pa dang / /mtsho ③rnams dag ni du ma dag /rgyal po chen pos byas nas ni/ /tshe zad lha yi gnas su song / /des kyang sa steng grub pa ni/ /pad+ma 'chang ba brtson 'grus che/ /bdag nyid chen po sems dpa' dul/ /sa yi bdag por don du gnyer/ /de yi sngags kyi dumathu yis ni/ /lo ni sum brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /de yi las kyi lhag ma yisadu/ /myur du byang chub 'thob ⑦par 'gyurani/ /de yi bu ni rgyal po yang / /sde chen stobs ni che ba yi/ /zab mo'i phyogs zhes rnam par grags/ /grong khyer sa ni lnga len 'byung ske/ /rig ⑨pa'i bdag nyid rgyal po de'ang / /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur / /gtsug lag khang dang gnas khang dang / /mchod rten rdzing dang khron pa ni/ /'od chen sa yi bdag po de/ /du ma byed par the tshom 0med/ /blo dang ldan pa 'jam dbyangs kyiyi/ /sngags kyang des ⑩ni rab bsgrubs ⑩pa/ /de dag yi ge drug ces bya/ /don chen longs spyod 'phel byed pa'o/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /de ni 8longs spyod che bar 'gyuratso/ /blo dang ldan pa mthar gyis ⑩ni/ /myur du byang 7chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas cini / /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ / lits+tsha bī (3rnams rigs su byung ske/ /de yang sngags kyi don bsgrubs te/ /longs 7spyod che dang ldan par 'gyur / /rig 3 )pa longs spyod (meldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag pos ( stede yang grub//——884

lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid byas/ /des ni rkun ma rnam par spangs/ /rgyal po de ①ni srog spangs nas/ /der yang sngags ni myur 'grub ②ste/ /zhi dang rgyas pa bsil byed pa'o/ /'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags ①dang / /lha mo gos dkar ma dang ni/ /dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan brtson/ /rtag tu yid ni mi skyo ba'o/ /de la sogs pa gsungs pa yi/ /de bzhin rgyal po mang po ni/ /rnam pa du ma mang po dag /kha dog sna tshogs sna tshogs gzugs/ /kha ba can gnas kla klo'i rgyal / /de yang ston pa mchod byed pa'o/ /khyu mchog khyu mchog bzang po dang / /sa 'od de bzhin sa 'od bzang / /de bzhin pha rol gnon dunyid dang / /rkang pa'i 'gros zhes bstan pa yin/ /sa srung dang ni be'u dang / /'od ldan nyid ni phyi ma yin/ /tha mar char ⑧rgyal ngang tshul te/ /kla klo rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ /de snye'og lugs ni rnam zhig cing / /phyi rol skye dgus dunye bar spyod/ /de tshe bal yul bdag po ni/ /mtshon gyis ⑦'thab pas rnam par 'jig⑧ /kla klo'i rkun po bsten ⑨pa yi/ /der ni rgyal po rnam ⑩par 'jig /sa bdag du ma gsungs pa rnams/ /sna tshogs lha dang bram ze dgatso /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgya yul kun la brten 8pa yi/ /rgyal po dbyig gi snying zhes tsobya/ /sde chen stobs kyang che ba dang / /blon po rgya che 8nyid dang ni/ /skye bo rtsa lag rab tu mang / /kla klos tsobatud dang rnam par rgyal/ /ston pa'i bstan pa de gtsor ⑫byed / /gzhon nu bdag nyid chen po nyid/ /de yi sngags ni rab bsgrubs padhi/ /mthu ni chen po dang ldan pa'i/ /rig pa'i rgyal po yi ge brgyad/ / dpa' bo ⑫che zhes rnam par grags/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas chen yin/ /de yi byis pa'i blo yis ⑩ni/ /rgyal srid phyir ni rab smon byas/ /gang gis ( ) dran pa tsam ——885

gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges 'gyur ba/ /mi bdag rgyal thabs nyid kyi ①phyir / /de ni skal ②ba mi nyung 'gyur/ /mchog gi sbyin pa bla na med/ /bsam ①pa tsam gyis thob pa nyid/ /tshangs sogs lha rnams thams cad la/ /ma lus lung ni rtsol byabyed na/ /lha ngan phal pa dag dang ni/ /mi yi 'jig rten smos ci dgos / /lo ni brgya ⑤dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /grags chen lha yi ⑥gnas su 'gro/ /chos kyi bdag nyid de mthar gyisaskyo/ /byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyurani/ /gzhon nus yongs su bshad pa yi/ /rig pa 'di ni de kyiyul du/ /de ni myur du 'grub 'gyur gyisatso/ /rig pa gzhan 0ni nam yang min/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo 8che/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'od chen po/ /mngon sum de yi yul dag na/ /byis pa'i gzugs kyis bzhugs pa yin/ /grub pa'i zhing mchog dam pa la/ /mi ni yongs su sgrub 8par 'gyur/ /rgyal po tu ruṣ+ka zhes bya//byang phyogs la ni yang dag brtenacha/ /sde chen brtson 'grus che ba steX/ /de yi gnas su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /shing shun gyon yul ma gtogs pa/ /kha che'i mthar thug ka shir bcas/ /de ni dpag tshad bdun brgya yidang / /'bum phrag gnyis kyi sa bdag tu/ /de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /de tshe the tshom 0med par 'gyur / /de yang sngags ni grub pas na/ /lo ni sum brgya 4)dag tu 'tsho/ /blo ldan mi yi spyan gyur pas/ /skra can ma yi rig pa bsgrubs(7/ /bdag nyid dge trībar bya ba'i phyir/ /lha khang ( gyedag ni mang po byas/ /stong phrag brgyad ( nyucu rtsa gcig gi/ /mchod rten mchog ni de bzhin byas/ /theg pa chen po mchog chos dang / /de bzhin sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum/ /'jig rten shes rab pha rol phyin / /de yi yul du rab gnas byas/ /rgyal po de ni lus zhig nas/ /mtho ——886

ris 'jig rten 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sa bdag de ni mthar gyis su/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bla med 'thobatunye/ /de 'og sa bdag rgyal po ni/ /chen po tu ruṣ+ka zhes bya/ /blo ldan mang pos bkur zhes bya/ /rtag tu dge zhing mchod la dga'//lha mo sgrol ma rdzu 'phrul che/ /de yi sngags kyang rab tu bsgrubs/ /des kyang sngags ni rab bsgrubs ②pa/ /sa steng rgyal po'i ched du'o/ /phyogs che dpung ni chen po dang / /rgyal po grags pa chen po ste/ /gnyen dang rigs dang rgyal pos kyang / /de ni bkur ①ba nyid du 'gyur/ /rtsa brgyad stong gi ④gtsug lag khang //de yi dudus su yod par 'gyur/ /de yi sngags kyi mthus ⑥yis ni/ /lo ni nyis ⑦brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /gang tshe de lus zhig pa na/ /dga' ldan du ni skye bar 'gyur / /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /lha yi bus kyang bkur bar 'gyur / /chos kyi ⑧bdag nyid de mthar gyis/ /byang chub yan lag mngon rdzogs nas/ /'bad pas de ni mthar gyis kyang / /mnyam med byang chub thob yonyepar 'gyur/ /dus kun de yi yul du ni/ /gsung rab mang po gnas 'gyur ba//sngon gyi rgyal ba dag gis gsungs/ /da ltar ngas kyang gsungs pa yin/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po klu dang ni/ /'dod chags bral bas rnam par gnas/ /de bzhin 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /gnod sbyin bstan pa srung byed dang / /sa steng dam chos srung byed pa/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rnam pa mang po bstan/ /sa bdag 'jig rten rnam grags pa/ /bstan yidang ston par 'gyur ba yin/ /nub phyogs yul ni mtha' yas pa/ /'phags rgyal zhes bya'i pha rol tu/ /la da'i yul gyi skye bo ni/ /ngang tshul zhes bya'i rgyal po yod/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan la dad/ /grong khyer phyin nas yang dag zhugs/ /——887

chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba ste/ /mchod ①rten sna tshogs gtsug lag khang / /de bzhin srog chags dge bar ni/ /sa bdag chos la mnyes gshin ②pas/ /rig ③pa'i bdag nyid byed par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i dugazugs brnyan yid 'ong dul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mchod pa byed/ /'jig rten mgon po grags chen gyidu/ /mchod rten mchog la'ang mchod pa ⑦byed/ /des na de ni sngags kyang grub/ /rgyal po las skyes kho na ni/ /de yi ②yul du yang ⑨dag grags/ /dge slong bsod snyoms 0byed pa ni/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing blo dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan la dad/ /bdag nyid chen po dus su rgyu/ /de ni bsod snyoms rab zhugs rgyu/ /rgyal po'i khab bzang rab mthong ba/ /rgya che skye bos gang ba lam/ /bslang ba'i don du der yang zhugs/ /bkres pa dang yang yang dag ldan/ /ngal zhing ltogs ⑩pa'i yid gyur kyang / /de tshe bsod snyoms rnyed ma gyuratso/ /rgyal po'i skyes bus de myur bzung / /khyim de las ni phyung bar 'gyur8/ /de nas de ni yid byung nas/ /rgyal po'i mi la rab khros te/ /grong khyer de las nges byung nas/ /mod la de yi tsorang gnas phyin/ / ltogs shing 8skom pa nyid gyur pas/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde bar gyur⑩/ /de nas de ni zas chad nas/ /mtshan phyed du ni langs gyur nas/ /sdom brtson de ni sems chud pas0/ /de tshe srog ni gtang bar rtsom(nya/ /de tshe smon lam byed pa ni/ /la da'i yul gyi ru bdag por shog /de nas dge slong dus las 'das/ /spu gri zhes bya'i rgyal rigs su/ /bdag nyid chen po de skyes gyur/ /ston pa'i bstan pa mchod par byed / /lo ni sum cu dag tu yang / /rgyal srid gnod pa med par byas/ /brkam 67chags rang mi'i sbyor ba yis/ /ma zhu'i nad kyis btab par gyur( ) / /——888

de tshe rgyal po lus zhig nas/ /dus byas lha yi gnas song ba/ /byams pa gang du bzhugs ①pa yi/ /dga' ldan lha yi gnas mchog tu/ /bdag nyid chen pos ②chos 'chad par/ /de nyid du ni skye bar 'gyur/ /'od chen byams pa chen po la / /bsnyen rgyabakur byed cing chos kyang nyan/ /bdag nyid chen po de mthar gyisaXske/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i byang chub thobadu/ /tshul khrims zhes bya'i rgyal po'i 'og /g.yo ba zhes bya 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lo ni lnga bcu rtsa lnga dang / /de bzhin zla ba lnga ru 'tsho/ /de srid rgyal srid des ⑥byas nas/ /mtshon chas 'tsho ⑦bas rab bsad pa/ /bud med byas pa'i skyon nyid kyis/ /de ni lamatshon chas bsad par 'gyur⑨/ /de yi nu tsobo brtan zhes bya/ /brtan pa chos ⑩ni brtan par 'gyur8/ /sngon ni bkren pa zham ring gyur0/ /yul ni la da'i bdag por gyur / /lhag ma rgyal po thams cad dang / /skye dgu kun kyang zham ring ④pa'o/ /tshul khrims zhes bya rab 'das nas/ /de ni de dag kun gyi sngar/ /sa bdag thams cad 'byung 'gyur ba/ /dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tsos rol 'gro/ / rgyal po ⑩dbang po zla mdzes dang / /de bzhin du ni gzhu dang togatso /me tog gzhu dang rgyal po'i bu/ /res ldan grong las byung ba yin/ /dang po'i dang po snga ma dag /ba la'i grong du 'byung tsob yin/ /'od ces bya ba stod rnams dang / /de bzhin khyab 'jug ces bya ba/ /rgyal po ()mtha' yas gsungs pa ni0 / / ya nga 0ba yi rigs su 'byung tso/ /de dag phyi ma'i rgyal po ni/ /khyab 'jug ces ni bya ba 'byung ⑫/ /grong dang skye bo gnyen dang bcas/ /drang srong dmod pas gnod gyur pasaci/ /blo ldan rgyal po med par 'gyuras/ /grong khyer chu yis (nyerab tu gang glu/ /de tshe de yi res ldan grong / / rgya mtsho chen pos ()rab tu gang / /byang ——889

gi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /rtsom pa sna tshogs ri zhol brtanatu)/ /sna tshogs rigs la gnas pa yi/ /rgyal po rnams ni mtha' yas gsungs③/ /nyi shu gcig dang sum cu yi/ /mi yi rgyal por dushes par bya/ / bcwa brgyad sa yi ④bdag po zhes / /bar ma'i sa kun bdag po yin/ /mtha' yas klu yi sde la sogs/ /de las tha dum rnam par zhig /de nas khyab 'jug 'phrog byed dang / /mdung zhes bya ba 'phrog byed gzhan/ /dbang ldan dang ni phreng kun dang / /bza' ⑥dang brtul zhugs bzang po gzhan/ /dus kun chos lugs rnam par nyams/ /rgyal po de dag dus las 'das/ /des ni bram ze rigs byung ba/ /de tshe longs spyod che nor dang / /bar mthar ⑦yi ge dang po bha/ /de tshe blon po gnyi ga dugatso/ /gnyi ga nor ldan dpal ldan grags6)/ /bstan pa la ni phan par dga'/ /gzhon nu khyod kyi sngags rgyal po/ /blon pos ⑩de tshe sngags kyang bzlas(nye/ /de nas bzung snyinas sa yi bdag /gnyi ga mi yi dbang phyug gyur/ /bdun dang brgyad dang de bzhin gsum/ /de tshe dpal mgrin gnas na 'dug /ston pa nyi ma zhes bya ba'i8/ /gnas na dbang phyug rab tu gnas/ /thams cad gnas su sa yi bdag /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom snyimed/ /yi ge ha zhes rab gsungs pa/ /sa rnams kun la mi yi bdag /de yi yul du sngags 'di dag /de tshe grub par 'gro ba yinayi/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i rig pa rnams/ /gang zhig cichos rgyal gyis gsungs pa/ /longs yispyod rnam pa sna tshogs tshogs/ /de bzhin rnam pa sna tshogs ldan/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi gzungs dang ni/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po gnod sbyin mo( tsho/ /de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /der ni grub par 'gyur ba yin / /lho yi phyogs la yang dag bstan(ste/ /rgya mchosare 'gram gyi sa dag yo)la/ /——890

rgyal po dkar dang rdzizla mdzes dang / /sa la yi ni bzhon pa dang / /dbang chen dang ni bde byed dang / /sa bdag de bzhin yid du 'ong / /longs spyod skra bzang skra zhes su/ /lho yi phyogs su rnam par grags/ /bkra shis dang ni ②rnyed sla dang / /ba lang nirnyed dang khyu nyid dang / /gru bzang de bzhin gru dag ④dang ske/ /dbang chen dang ni zla ba nyid/ /ba lang ⑤sung dbang zla ba'i stisde/ /'dod lha de bzhin ma ga dhā/ /grong ⑦byed bde byed nyid dang ni/ /stag dang seng ge gza' lhag dang / /sangs rgyas dag pa bum pa dang ⑧/ /bum pa ma lus nyid du brjod/ /mnyam dang legs par 'jam pa dang / / skra bzang skra ni ldan pa dang / /dhilho yi phyogs su sa yi bdag /mtha' yas mang por bstan pa yin/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa dag dang / /da ltar dag tu rtogs par gyisayi/ /rnam pa sna tshogs nad btab nas/ /'di dag rnam pa sna tshogs 'chi/ /mtshon gyis 'debs dang mu ge yisayi/ /'chi zhing kha cig phyogs gzhan tunye'agro/ /de ltar 'di dag rgyal po rnams/ /kun tsi pu rar gnas par bstan/ /de bzhin stong phrag rnam grags pa/ /de tshe 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de dus de tshe phyogs dag tu/ /sngags rnams 'grub par 'dod na ni/ /khro bo rdo rje'i rigs bstan pa'i / /sngags 'di dag ni bsgrub dhipar bya/ /mngon par spyod pa'i las dag dang / /de bzhin dbang gi snyidon yang 'grub/ /gzhon nu byis pa'i gzugs can ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni bdag nyid che/ /de tshe dus mthar yiphyin pa na() / /de tshe yul der 'grub par 'gyur/ /ri bo 'bigs byed la brten (nyenas//rgya mtsho ba tshwa yonacan 'gram du/ /gdong drug ces ni yang dag bsgrags/ /sems can rnams la mchog sbyin byed/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni blo dang ldan/ /byang 88—891

chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod phyir/ /lho yi phyogs su gnas par gyis/ /gdong drug gang gi sngags dag ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rab bstan pa/ /de tshe de phyogs de dus su/ / grub par 'gyur bar ②the tshom ②med/ /de tshe dpal gyi ri bo'i phyogs/ /'bigs ①byed nang dang ri zhol dang / /gling nyid rnam pa thams cad dang / /ka ling ka zhes rab bsgrags rjodang / /yon tan gsum dang kla klo dang / /kho ra 'khor ⑤yug ko sa la/ /rgya mtsho'i nang dang 'gram dag tu/ /rgyal po dag ni mtha' yas yod / /cha shas kā ma rū ⑥zhes pa/ /kha ba can gyi nang na gnas/ /o ḍa yul gyi mtshams kun na⑦/ /rgyal po rnams (kyeni mang po gsungs/ /sna tshogs kla klo'i ⑨rgyal po ni/ /ston pa mchod byed de gtso byed/ /dbang po zla ba dga' ba yi/ /rgyal po kla klo'i gnas na gnas/ /da ⑩las rgyal po gnyis dag ni/ /bstan pa la ni lo brgyad dang / /ston pa'i sku gzugs mchod byed pa'o/ /de las skyes pa thams cad ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la yirab dad par/ /the tshom 8med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /shar gyi phyogs la brten 0pa yi/ /rgyal po'i tsomachog ni mang po gsungs/ /gang zhig 'das dang ma 'ongs dang / /da ltar byung ba thams cad du'o/ /dang po'i rgyal po mchog bshad bya/ /go 87'i rgyud du sa steng skyes/ /grong khyer 'phel byed nyams dga' bar/ /grags 8ldan de ni rab tu skyeX/ /de ming 'jig rten zhes bya ba/ /rgyal po go ḍā 8'phel byed byung ⑪/ /nga 0ni 'jig rten skyes ()med 'dir/ /de ⑤ni chos la sems pa byung ⑫/ /sa bdag mang po rnams mnan chanas/ /zho shas 6)'tsho ba dag tu byas/ /bar ma'i dus su 'di dag mnyam/ /bar ma bar ma'i chos dang ldan/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi ——892

tha ma la/ /mi yi dbang po de nyid nyon/ /rgyal po rgya mtsho ①zhes bya dang / /rnam par gnon pa nyid dang ni/ /rgyal mchog gtso bo dbang chen dang / /de 'og yi ge sa zhes bya/ /lha yi rgyal po zhes bya stel/ /tha ma'i dus la 'byung bar 'gyur / /rgyal po'i gtso bo sna tshogs zhes/ /blo ldan chos ni 'phel byed pa'o/ /de yi nu bo byis zhes bya/ /bstan pa 'di la phan zhing dga'/ /shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i dumathar thug parabya/ /mchod rten gyis brgyan mdzes pa ni/ /de tshe sa rnams ma lus par⑤/ /byed par 'gyur bar duthe tshom memed/ /lha khang kun dga' ra ba rdzing / /skyed mos tshal dang bkad sa ni/ /de tshe dpal ldan byed 'gyur zhing / /gzings ⑤dang zam pa byed pa po/ /de tshe ston ⑨pa'i gzugs brnyan mchod/ /de la zhugs pa'ang mchod par byed/ /rgyal srid sa yi bdag po byed/ /gnod pa med cing 'gran ⑩zla med/ /lo ni sum brgya dag tu'ang ⑩'tsho / /zhag ni sum bcur tsorab byung nas/ /pha rol rgol bas pham byas te/ /de nas rgyal pos rang srog bcad/ /de 'og de nas tsolus zhig nas/ /dmyal ba dag tu rab skyes te/ /zhag gsum dang ni gcig dag tu/ /dmyal ba dag gi 'gro bar gnas/ /de nas dmyal ba'i lus bor nas/ /rtag tu rgyal po lha gnas 'gro/ /lha rnams legs spyad 'jig rten du/ /gtsang ma'i gnas zhes rab tu dran/ /der ni lha rgyal zhes byar 'gyur/— /dag pa'i bdag nyid byang chub gzhol/ /brgya phrag dang ni stong phrag tu/ /lha yi bde ba rjes su myong / /phyir yang mi lus thob nas ni/ /srid pa gzhan la tsosangs rgyas 'gyur/ / skye ba ⑩gzhan du sems can la/ /de nyid kyis (nyeni las kyang byas/ /grong khyer 'phags rgyal zhes bya ba/ /de tshe ma la bar skye'o/ /de ()ni tshong dpon mchog gyur pa/ /——893

ma la bar skyes nor chen ldan/ /'jig rten stong ①zhing gnas med pa/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba med dus su/ /rang sangs rgyas ni 'jig rten du/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po rnam par rgyu/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /sa yi steng du rnam spyod de②/ /gong khyer 'phags rgyal phyin nas ni/ /bsod snyoms ①spyod la rab tu zhugs/ /bdag nyid chen po tshogs spyod pas/ /de tshe ④lam chen grong bar rudhi / /de tshe tshong 0pa de nyid kyis/ /thub pa mngon du mthong bar gyur/ /'bras chan phyal ni mgron ⑧bos nas/ /de tshe rang gi 6)khyim du khyer/ /de nas thub mchog myur khyer nas/ /stan dag la ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zas kyi dus ni nyer gnas pas/ /bcom ldan de ni dgongs su gsol/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag kyang / /de tshe cang mi smra bar gyur/ /de tshe tshong tu)pa de la ni/ /lhung bzed skyodag ni zed ⑩par gyur/ /tshong pa zur gyis go ba dang / /de tshe blo dang ldan gyur pas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bza' (nyeb yis/ /lhung bzed rnams ni yongs su bkang / /de nas des ④ni rang lag gis/ /de dag la ni 'bad pas byin / /thogs 8nas de dag thams cad ni/ /mar me'i phreng ba bzhin du mthong ske/ /nam mkha' la ni lus brten nas/ /de dag de yi mod la song / /de nas ba spu langs nas ni/ /de tshe skyo ba mang po gyur/ /yid yini rdzu 'phrul la dad nas/ /sa de la ni rab tu 'gyel/ /smon lam de tshe byed pa yang / /ji 5ltar tshig tu smra ba ni/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis (1ni/ /de ring bdag gis gang thob pa/ /des 1nyani thub pa rab mchog ni/ /'jig rten blo yi mchog 'gyur ⑩shog /de tshe sa steng 'khor los sgyur/ /skye ba stong phrag bcu ru 'gyur( )/ /de nas de yi lus spangs nas/ /bye ba drug cur ( melha gnas 'gro/ /der ni yun 6)——894

ring bde myong nas/ /lha gnas skye ba ①yongs bor te/ /de tshe mi yi skye ba ni/ /gzhan gyi ②dbang gis 'dir yang phyin①/ /de ni rgyal po'i rigs skyes pa/ /thams cad du ni 'dir yang 'gyur④/ /rgyal po byis pa zhes bya de/ /shar gyi phyogs su 'byung bar 'gyur⑤/ /skye ba stong phrag brgyad du ni/ /bde ba sgrib ⑥med thob 'gyur ba/ /dpal ldan rgyal pos ⑦thob pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid mthar thob 'gyur/ /de ltar rnam nimang sems can dang / /de bzhin phun tshogs rgya che ba/ /de tshe mchod dang skul byed pa/ /ston pa la ni su mi byed/ /rig 6)pa dge ⑩ba byed pa yi/ /byang chub lam la nges par sbyor/ /de las gzhan pa'i ⑩rgyal po ni/ /go ḍā nus pa'i ngang tshul can/ /gzhon nu zhes bya'i rgyal por gsungs/ /de yang shin tu chos dang ldan/ /de nas gzhan pa dpal ldan bcas/ /yi ge u zhes rnam par grags/ /de las gzhan ni rnam 'byed cing / /de bzhin phan tshun 'jigs par byed/ /de dag go ḍā drag sems kyis//'di dag 'byed pa chen por byed/ /de nas lha zhes bya ba yi/ /rgyal po lam ni byed par shes/ /dgra rnams kun gyis yongs khyab nas/ /de ni dgra yis bsnun tsonas shi/ /de'i yo 'og zla ba zhes ni bya/ /des ni rgyal po nyid kyang byas/ /sngon gyi las kyis bskul nas ni/ /de nas ④mtshon gyis rmas tsonas shi/ /de yi bu ni bcu gnyis grangs/ /lo brgyad bcas pa tsodag tu 'tsho/ /de yang mtshon gyis rab btab nas/ /de tshe byis pa nyid du shi/ /de dag gcig la gcig sems shing / /drag po phan pa med la dga'/ /rgyal mchog yi ge ta zhes bya/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /go ḍā'i 'jig rten rnams kyi yinagatso/ /chen po'i nad kyis yang dag btab/ /nad de nyid kyis nyam tsho thag nas(ste/ /dus ——895

byas nas ni 'og tu song / /de 'og yi ge da zhes bya/ /nyin zhag cung zad rgyal po byed/ /go ḍā'i yul du byung gyur pa①/ /gang gā'i ②'gram du yang dag gnas / /de 'og yi ge bha zhes bya/ /zhag gsum du ni rgyal po byas/ /de nas sa srung rgyal po ni/ /thams cad du ni de tshe 'byung ②/ /rgyal po de ni snyan par smra / /byas pa gzo 0zhing stobs kyang che/ /bud med dbang 'gyur ⑤bkren zhing glenastim/ /dgra las rgyal zhing mi phyed 'gyurasti/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas/ /de tshe gtong ba chen por 'gyural/ /mchod rten nyams dga' gtsug lag khang / /kun dga' ra ba rnam mang po/ /rdzing yang chu ni phun sum tshogs / /bsod nams gang ni legs ⑨mdzes pa/ /de dag mang po ston byed cing —/ /grags dang snyan pa'i don la brtson/ /lha yi stegs ni nyams tsodaga' dang ske/ /phug dang gnas khang dag kyang byas/ /ya mtshan can gyis yang dag gnon / /sna tshogs mu stegs gnas kyis ni/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi mthar ⑨thug par / /phyogs 8de thams cad rnam par gnon/ /brtse ldan longs 8spyod ldan dpag ④med/ /rgyal po de ni chos la dga'/ /shar gyi phyogs su rgyas par ni/ /the tshom 8med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu cho gar yang dag ldan/ /ka ba nye bar gnas gyur tshe/ /gang gā'i 'gram la yang dag brten⑩/ /de tshe rgyal thabs byas pa ni/ /lo ni sum cu dag dang bdun/ /lo ni brgyad 0cu dag ni ⑫'chi / /de nas de yi lus zhig nas/ /lha rnams yidag tu nye bar skye(nye/ /de nas dpal ldan klu yi rgyal/ /chos kyi bdag nyid chos la dga'/ /mchod rten gang zhig 'di 0byas dang (nya/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong / /dude tshe sa steng dge 'dun ched/ /logs su gtsug lag 6)khang dag byas/ /rnam par ——896

smin pa de yis ①ni/ /srid pa tha ma la brten ②nas/ /nges par sangs rgyas nyid lam dang / /mi g.yo go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /de yi 'og tu go ḍār ni/ /de dag gtsor ni mu stegs gnon/ /shar gyi phyogs su 'byung ②ba ni/ /grong khyer du ni mu stegs duganas/ /rgyal po'i ming ni bcom ldan zhes/ /go ḍā'i dunang na mthu dang ldan/ /brtul zhugs can ni mthur ldan pa/ /sbyin gnas zhes pas dbang yang bskur/ /der ni rgyal srid byas nas su/ /nub kyi ༷phyogs su yang dag song / /ci 'dod sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i/ /grong khyer nyams ⑦dgar rab tu zhugs/ /ma zhu pas ⑧ni rab btab nas/ /phyir yang rab tu log par 'gyur⑨ / /shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i ⑩mthar thug bar/ /rkun ma rnams kyis ⑩yang dag khyab/ /mtshon gyi tsoganod pas rab bshig nas/ /shi nas yi dgas 'gro bar song / /sa bdag rgyal po mi mang ba/ /des ni lo gsum bar du byas/ /de nas de ni rkun pos bsad/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i yi dgas song / /de nyid du ni lo gsum bar/ /yi dgas rgyal thabs yongs su byas/ /yi dgas 'jig rten mi bzad 8pa/ /de nas de ④ni lus kyang btang / /skye ba de las rnam grol nas/ /rtag tu mtho ris 'jig rten song / /de yi 'og tu rgyal po ni/ /rgya mtsho zhes ni bya bar grags/ /blo ngan lo ni gsum gyi bar/ /blo gros ngan pas rgyal srid thob/ /de yi nu bor rnam grags pa/ /thal ba zhes bya'i 8rgyal po 'byung ⑫/ /srog gcod pa dang yang dag ldan/ /bab col 0chen po rab tu byed / /'bad pas rang gi lus la yang / /brtse med bag ni med pa'o/ /byis par gyur pas 'di nyid sems/ /pha rol don ni de mi sems/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen la brten (nyanas/ / sdig pa'i (telas ni mang po byas/ /g.yo ldan ——897

de bzhin bkren pa yi/ /bram zes ①rgyal srid dag kyang gnon②/ /mi dang mi ma yin dag gi②/ /longs spyod rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs duphun sum tshogs/ /rgyal ①po des kyang rab tu thob/ /de ni mthar gyis dusong ba dang ske/ /rgyal po nub kyi phyogs dag tu/ /kha che'i sgo yi mthar thug bar/ /byang gi phyogs la brten ⑦nas ni/ /der duyang g.yul las rnam rgyal ⑨nas/ /rgyal thabs de tshe byas pa ni/ /bcu gnyis lo dang zla ⑩ba lngar/ /sa la rgyal srid de tshe byas/ /de nas de ni nad kyis btab/ /yang dang yang du brgyal bar gyurayi/ /sdug bsngal tsochen pos zil mnan nas/ /lus ni zhig nas shi 'phos 'gyur0/ /rgyal srid phyir ni rab chags nas/ /de dag phan tshun zhe sdang zhing / /mtshon chen tshogs kyis 8'phen pa ni/ /de dag phan tshun byas par 'gyuratso/ /yi ge sa ming byis pa khye'u/ /de tshe rgyal srid dbang ⑩yang bskur/ /mtshan ma tsam zhig de byas nas/ /phyir ⑩yang de ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bram ze'i gtso bo gnyis kyis yonyeni/ /de dag phan tshun phye nas ni/ /ma ga dhā yiyi yul phyin zhing / /u dum bā 6)ra'i grong zhes par/ /bram ze'i gtso bo byis pa gnyis/ /sa steng rang gis dbang yang bskur/ /de nas mthar gyis de song nas/ /shar phyogs su ni yang dag brten( nya/ /go ḍā'i yul gyi (nyamir yang phyin/ /de tshe 'gran duzla med par gyuras/ /bdag nyid ngan pa'i rtsod rgyal gyis/ /byis pa'i gtso bo de gnyis ( gepos / /mi dge'i 69bshes gnyen la brten nas/ /srog chags mang po rab tu bsad / /gang zhig sngon gyi 6)rgyal pos zho nyabakur/ /dpa' bas nga rgyal byed pa gang ske/ /go ḍār skye bo zho smyuganas pa dag /thams cad dag ni gsod par rtsomadu )/ /de nas rgyal po zla ba zhes/ /dpa' bo gcig pu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang ——898

gā'i 'gram gyi ①mthar thug dang / /bā rā ṇa sī de las gzhan/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan nyams dga' ba/ /blo ngan gyis ni 'jig ②par 'gyur/ /chos kyi stegs ni mi nyung ba/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis nisngon bstan pa/ /blo ngan dag gis dubasreg 'gyur zhing ⑤/ /mu stegs rnams ni gsod par dga'/ /de nas de ni khro dang chags/ /mi sdom log pa'i nga rgyal can/ /mchod rten kun dga' ra ba gnas/ /sa steng gcer yibu'i gnas dag kyang / /de nas thams cad 'jig byed cing / /'tsho ba 'gog pa'ang byed par 'dod/ /yul gyi ⑦dbus su rgyal po gzhan/ /de yi dus su 'byung 'gyur ba/ /yi ge ra ming rigs bdag nyid / /rje rigs kyis 'tsho de las gzhan/ /ston pa'i bstan pa 'di la dad/ /zla ba zhes bya'i rgyal mchog des/ /gcer bu'i rigs gyur rgyal po ni/ /da ⑧yang rab tu bsad par gyur/ /yi ge ha ming de'i nu bo/ /dpa' bo gcig pu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dpung ni chen por 6)yang dag ldan/ /dpa' zhing zil gnon rnam par ⑩gnon/ /rgyal po yi ge ha bya bas/ /zla bar rnam grags gnas las bton/me/ /de nas rgyal po rje'u rigs spyod/ /sde chen ()stobs ni che ba dang / /de tshe shar gyi phyogs dag ni/ /bsod nams che ba'i grong mchog song / /rgyal rigs chos la gnas nas ni/ /chos kyi 4)don shes brtser tsoldan pas / /de ni tsong rgyal khro tshul gyis/ /srog chags mang po gsod byed cing / /sems can gnod pa byed pa dang / /chad pa byed la rab dga' zhing / /las ngan rjes su spyod byed pa'i/ / zla ba zhes bya pham par byas/ /tshuzla ba zhes bya de phyung nas/ /rang gi gnas na rab tu 'dug /yi ge ha ming slar log nas/ /kla klo'i rgyal pos tsorab tu mchod/ /yi ge ha bya dge dang ldan/ /dge ba'i don 88—899

gyi las ①kyis ni/ /ji ②ltar 'dod pa'i 'gros dag gis/ /rang gi ②yul ni nyid du phyin/ /de nyid kyis ④ni las byas pas/ /rgyal srid dga' dang ldan pa thob / /yang na rgyal srid spyod duganas pas/ /longs spyod rab tu thob ldan pa/ /snga mar rang sangs rgyas la ni/ /bza' dang gos ni byin pa dang / /de tshe lham ni ༷byin pa dang / /gos kyis brgyan pa'i gdugs kyang byin/ /de yi las kyi mthu yisaXni/ /lha mi'i rgyal srid chen po ⑧thob/ /lha dang mi yi phun sum tshogs / /longs spyod phun sum tshogs ldan spyod/ /zla ba zhes bya'i bram ze'i rigs / /longs ①spyod cher ldan gang phyir de/ /bram ze dag la longs 0spyod byin / /de tshe rgyal thabs byed pa ni/ /lo ni bcu dang bdun dag dang / /de bzhin gzhan ni zla ba gcig /nyin 7zhag bdun dang brgyad dag tu/ /kha yi nad kyis yang dag btab/ /srin bu rnams kyis zos nas ni/ /dus byas nas ni 'og tu 'gro/ /mi ma yin pas zil mnan nas/ /de tshe grong de bshig par 'gyur8—/ /mi ma yin pas nyen pa yi/ /rims kyis nyam 0thag nad kyis ⑫brgyal / /sngags kyi sbyor bas 'chi ba ste/ /de tshe rgyal po dus las 'das/ /mnar med pa zhes bya ba yikyi/ /dmyal bar sdig pa'i ⑩las byed rnams/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rjes spyod pa/ /de ni ⑩de ru skye bar 'gyur/ /dmyal bar de tshe bskal chen du/ /ma rungs tunyesems ldan 'tshed par 'gyur/ /de nas so thams yikyi hud zer/ /yang sos 6gyedang ni thig nag dang / /mi bzad ral gri'i nags tshal yang / /yang dang yang du ( 1myong bar 'gyur/ /yi dgas 'jig rten dud 'gro nyid/ /de bzhin gshin rje'i 'jig rten du'ang / /de ltar skye ba stong rnams su/ /'khor bar yang ni 'khor 'gyur yang / /des ni bde ba mi thob ——900

cing ske/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal bsten ①par 'gyur②/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /sems ni kun gyis dad byas te/ /nad med phun sum tshogs par song / /sangs rgyas phan 'dogs byed pa yis③/ /'bras bu mtha' yas 'byung 'gyur bas/ /sangs rgyas la ni dang bar bya/ /chos dang dge 'dun de bzhin no/ /rgyal pos rjodakon mchog gsum mchod na/ /'jig rten gyi ni mchog tu 'gyur/ /rgyal thabs chen po'i grags pa thob/ /nor gyi (snyedabang phyug longs spyod che/ /rgyal pos ⑦phun tshogs rgya che ba'i/ /bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs 'thob⑦/ /'jig rten mchog ni mchod byas na/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nyid du 'gro/ /de nas brgya byin 'thab bral nyid / /tshangs pa nyid du'ang ⑧yang dang yang / /nyan thos rang rgyal nyid dang ni / /sa steng sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /theg pa gsum gyi mchog thob cing / /theg pa la ni chags med 'gyur/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bsam mi khyab/ /de dag 'bras bus yo)bsam mi ⑩khyab/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /de nas gzhan yang rgyal po ni/ /zla ba sa steng med pa na/ /phan tshun 'khrug 7pa'i ngang tshul du/ /go ḍā'i rgyud ni 8'byung bar 'gyur / /phan tshun ltos 8pa med par 8ni/ /de tshe mtshon ni 'debs par 'gyur / /zhag ni bdun po gcig dang ni/ /de bzhin gzhan ni 8zla ba gcig /de tshe tshogs kyi rgyal srid rgyud/ /de tshe sa steng byed par 'gyur/ /gang gā'i 'gram gyi grong der ni/ /gtsug lag khang gi gnas kyang byas/ /de nas zla ba zhes bya ba'i/ /bram ze'i khye'u de yi bu/ /zla ba brgyad dang zhag lnga dang / /phyed dang gnyis zhag 'das nas 'chi/ /de'i mthar ⑩rgyal po 'dug pa ni/ /klu 88wa 901

yi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ /go ḍā'i yul gyi rgyal po 'byung / /dang por dza ①ma'i rigs bram ze/ /kun nas rje'u rigs kyis ②bskor ba'i/ /klu zhes bya ba de yang 'byung / /de yang mu ges gnod pa dang / /de bzhin pha rol dmag tshogs gnod / /de dag rgyal srid thob pa na/ /chom rkun chen pos kun tu khyab/ /des kyang de yi lugs gnyams te/ /der ④ni lo ni lnga dang gcig /rgyal srid kun nas 'khrugs bzhin spyod/ /srog gcod mang po byas nas ni/ /de tshe srog la gnod par byed/ /snga ma'i las kyi nyes pa yis/ /rje'u rigs spyod pa de dag byed / /phan tshun 'khrugs ⑤pa'i ngang tshul du/ /de tshe de ni 'byung bar 'gyuraX//de dag de tshe nus ldan tshul/ /rgyal rigs spyod la gnas pa yiphya/ /go ḍā'i rgyud kyi mi yi bdag /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom ⑧med/ /kha cig de tshe mtshon gyis 'chi0/ /nad rnams kyis kyang yang dag 'debs/ /de nas dus byas rgyal po rnams/ /dmyal ba rnams su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bud med gtso bo'i ⑩byis pa ni / /de yang phyis ni rgyal por 'gyur(me/ /de dag de bzhin zla phyed nas/ /mtshon gyis bsnun nas de nyid bsad/ /mu ge chen po yang dag 'byung / /pha rol dmag tshogs dag gis ༷stedakrugs/ /yid ni skrag par gyur pa yis/ /shar phyogs yul mi nyams par gyur/ /de yi yul du mi bdag ni/ /the tshom (3med par 'byung 'gyur ba/ /bcom brlag skyes pa'i rgyal po mchog /yangs pa can gyi tshong 8pa sngon/ /de yang lus la mchod pa yi8/ /ma ga dhā 0yi rgyal por 'gyur7 / /de'i yang nu bo yi ge bha/ /shar gyi phyogs la yang dag gnas/ /de nyeltabu yi ge pra 4)zhes bya/ /shar phyogs nyid du yang dag skyes/ /rgyal rigs mchog tu skyes par bstan/ /legs par spyod pas byis par so )bcings lo ni 88wa 902

bcu dang bdun dag tu/ /'ching ba dag la yang dag bzhag /glang rdzi ①zhes bya'i rgyal pos bcings/ /bcom ldan zhes bya des ni bkrol②/ /yi ge ha zhes ⑧rgyal chen ni/ /nub kyi phyogs na ④yang dag 'ongs/ /shar gyi phyogs ni mtha' med par/ /gang gā'i 'gram du ⑤gnas par gyur/ /dmangs 0rigs gzi brjid che ba dang / /sde chen stobs ni che ba dang / /de ni ⑦de yul 'gram gnas nas/ /kun tu yang ni rab tu gnas/ /go ḍā'i skye bo zhes grags grong / /mu stegs zhes kyang rnam par grags/ /rgyal pos de ni rnam ⑧mnan nas/ /stobs chen ⑨de ni 'dug par gyur/ /der ni rgyal rigs byis pa de/ /tshong pa dang ni lhan cig 'ongs/ /der ni nam phyed zhugs nas ni/ /nam gyi mthar ni de yang mchod/ /dmangs 7rigs rgyal po zhes bya bsatso/ /slar nyid du ni ldog ⑫par byed/ / gang gā'i 'gram gyi tunyemathar thug par/ /grong khyer dga' ba zhes bya bar/ /de tshe rgyal srid ma ga d+marayi/ /byis pa de 8ni bzhag par gyur/ /bā rā ṇa sī'i pha rol tu/ /kā ⑩shi yul 7gyi mir yang phyinatso/ /stobs chen sa yi bdag po ni/ /dmangs 4)rigs der ni zhugs par gyur/ /sdug bsngal (3 nyam (nyethag nad 3chen pos/ /de tshe bu ni dbang yang bskur/ /byis pa khye'u phug ces pa / /de tshe rgyal thabs dbang ()yang bskur/ /chen po'i (stend kyis zil mnan nas / /de tshe sa yang 'khor bar mthong / /de nas 'bad pas shugs nar tsophyung / /lus zhig nas ni dud sgolha'agror song / /de tshe zla ba bdun dang brgyad/ /dud 'gro dag tu gnas par gyur na/ /de yi skye ba las grol nas/ /lha rnams kyi ni nang du skyes/ /de tshe skye ba nyi shur ni/ /lha yi phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /chos kyi bdag nyid de mthar gyis/ /rang rgyal byang chub thob par byed/ /sngon ——903

gyi skye ba'i dus dag tu/ /'di nyid ①las ni nye bar bsags/ /bdag nyid chen po phyirang rgyal la/ /gos kyis kun nas bkab pa dang / /glang po rta dang shing rta'i rgyur/ /lham ni rab tu phul bar gyur/ /de las ①blo ldan sems dang bas / /de tshe de la bza' ba byin/ /rnam par smin pa de yis ④ni/ /lha yi rgyal po brgya byin du/ /skye ba bye ba phrag dgur ni/ /lha yi 'jig rten dag tu gyur/ /sa steng 'ong ⑤nas rgyal po ni/ /de nas ༷skye ba 'di la gyur/ /gzhan gyis rjes bsgrubs rgyal thabs ni/ /rjes su spyod par 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi bu yang rgyal po ni/ /bā rā ṇa sīr rab tu gnas/ /chags ⑦'og rgyal phran gyis bcom pa'i / /rgyal thabs rnam 'jig ⑧'byung bar 'gyur/ /de yi rgyal srid dgra dang ni / /bram zes phal chen khyaganod ⑩par 'gyur/ /bag med 'dod pa spyod pa dang ske/ /rgyal po de ni gdon gyis ⑩'dzin/ /phyi ma 8yi ni dus dag tu/ /de nas mtshon gyi brgyab yinas 'chitso/ /ma ga dhā 8rgyal de dag ni/ /phan tshun du ni gnod byed pas/ /zla ba zhes bya'i rgyal po 'das/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi kun nas kyang / / gang gā'i ⑩'gram gyi mthar thug par/ /bā rā ṇa sī de las gzhan / /yi ge pra zhes rgyal rigs ni/ /de yi tshe na rgyal po ⑩'byung / /gang zhig dmangs yonyerigs gyur pa ni/ /yi ge ha yis ()yongs su mchod/ /grong khyer dga' ba zhes bya bar/ /gang gā'i 'gram la yang dag rten/ /sngon gyi las kyis ru yongs bskul 6)nas/ /rgyal rigs rgyal por 0'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nyid las byas byed bcug dang (ste/ /rjes su yang ni yi rang byasadu/ /de tshe dus 0ni 'das pa na/ /gser thub ces bya'i ston pa 'byung tso/ /bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer dul/ /nor chen (9ldan pa'i tshong dpon yod/ /tshong dpon bu ni byis pa de/ /88wa 904

byis pa dag gis ①yang dag bskor/ /sa rdul dag la rtse ba'i phyir/ /lam chen dag tu zhugs par gyur②/ /rang khyim mchod rten mchog mthong la/ /pha dang ma ni mchod byed pani/ /de nyid yid la bzung byas nas/ /sa rdul gyi ni mchod rten byas/ /de tshe me tog sman ④mas ni/ /mchod pa yang ni byed par gyur⑤/ /sangs rgyas dad pa'i dran pa yis/ /sangs rgyas de la'ang bstod pa byas/ /byis pa rnams kyis yongs bskor nas/ /der ni byis pa rtse bar gyur/ /ston pa gser thub rgyal ba yiX/ /nyan thos mchog de gcig pu zhig /skyon bral bdag nyid grol ba dang / /khams gsum las ni ⑦rnam grol blo/ /de tshe dang por ⑧skyon bral ba/ /bsod snyoms yo)la ni rgyu bar gyur/ /bā rā ṇa sī legs mdzes pa'i / /de tshe grong khyer rab tu zhugs/ /gang du sa steng gyis pa yod/ /de tshe chags bral 0phyogs der phyin/ /der ni byis pa de kun gyis/ /kun nas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ /'dir gshegs dge slong 'dir spyon cigatso /ston pa'i mchod rten phyag byos tsomadzod/ /bdag cag gis ⑩ni 'bad byas na8/ /bzang po 'di la mi gzigs sam/ /de nas tshong dpon bu khye 'us/ /rtsa 8yi thag pa blangs nas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i ⑩'dod chags bral/ /rtse ⑩ba'i tshul gyis de bcings khrid/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po chags bral bas/ /der gnas rnams la yang dag dgongs/ /sa steng tsodag tu gzigs pa na/ /de dag gis yini mchod rten byas/ /byis pa'i spyi ⑥bor lag byugs nas/ /blo ldan de la 'di skad smras/ /gang du khyod kyi (nyamachod rten byas/ / thong shig dukhye'u bdag cag 'deng (3/ /gang du sa steng tsomachod rten ni/ /der ( nyeyang thams cad 'ong 'gyur nas/ /de tshe byis pa dang lhan cig /bdag nyid chen po des phyag byas/ /bsod snyoms sh+yi——905

don du ci 'dod par/ /dpa' bo de ①ni phyir yang chas②/ /de nas tshong dpon byis pa yis/ /chos gos mtha' nas bzung chanas ni/ /dge slong de ni bzung khyer ba/ /bshos gsol dubya ba'i ched du'o/ /de nas tshong dudapon gtso bo des//byis pa khye'u de mthong nasaX/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po chags bral ba'i/ /chos gos mtha' la 'dzin byed laX/ /'jigs shing ba spu ldang ba dang / /nga yi khyim du mchog kyang gshegs/ /myur du rkang gnyis la btud de/ /byis pa yis ni 'dzin ⑧pa btang / /bu de yis kyang bzung byas la/ /'bad pa ⑨yis ni bzod gsol byas/ /skye bo'i ⑩mchog gyur phan 'dod pa/ /de yi lhung bzed 0blangs ⑫nas ni/ / sā lu'i tunyetshod ma bza' ba yis/ /lhung bzed tsodag ni bkang byas nas / /bu la bos nas smras pa ni/ /yang dag long la 'di la byin/ /de nas byis pa shes ldan pas/ /'bad pas lag gnyis bkrus tsonas ni/ /lhung bzed ⑩gang ba blangs yinas su/ /'dod chags bral ba la ni phul/ /phul nas myur ba nyid du ni/ /rkang pa gnyis la phyag kyang byas/ /'dod chags bral bas blangs ⑫nas ni/ /gtsug lag khang song zas la spyad()/ /bde bar rig so)pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de tshe 'dod chags bral (1bar gyur/ /de las byis pa gzhan zhig ni/ /phrag dog sems su gyur nas ni/ /mu stegs 6)rnams la rab dad nas/ /bstan pa la ni de mi mchod/ /khro ba'i sems ni kho na yis/ /'dod chags bral la 3nyin zhag gzhan/ /bza' ba bca' ba 0rnam ( nyamang po/ /khyer nas de la rab tu byin/ /khyod la byin pa'i bsod snyoms kyis(nya/ /dge ba cung zad gang yod pa / /tshong dpon bu ni de bas kyang / /sa steng bdag ni dam par shog /de nas mu stegs de kun dang / /de tshe bram ze'i chung ma rnams/ /de nas thams 88wa 906

cad 'dus nas ni/ /tha dad par ni 'thab ①mo'ang byas/ /byis pa khyed cag yong mi shes/ /ci phyir mgo reg ②gam du 'gro/ /'di dag bdag la'ang gnas med na / /gzhan dag gang du mya ngan zlo/ /byis pa de yi sems can la/ /de lta bu yi zhe sdang skyes/ /ston pas nye bar bsngags pa yi/ /chos kyi zam pa grags pa dang / /sa stedza lha khang ④mchod rten mchog /mu stegs rnams kyis ⑤de dag bshig /tshong dpon mchog gi bu de la/ /kun nas 'khrug ①pa'i sems kyang byas/ /mgo reg 'di la byin pa yi/ /sbyin pa'i 'gro ba gang du 'gro/ /ngan 'gro'i 'gro bas gzin sems la/ /rnam par gnod pa bdag gis ⑧bya/ /gnyis pa byis pa gang yin de0/ /zla ba zhes bya'i rgyal po yin/ /rnam smin de yis 0mi 'dod pa7/ /yun ring sdug bsngal rjes su myong / /tshong dpon mchog gi bu de ni/ /lus zhig nas ⑩ni bde 'gror song / /de dang ⑩der ni lha gnas su / /yun ring bde ba rjes su myong / /de tshe de tshe de dang der/ /shi 'phos lha yi 'jig rten gnas/ /de tshe tha ma'i skye ba la/ /thams cad du ni 'ching ba gcod / /tha ma'i skye ba thob pa na/ /mir gyur sa yiyi bdag por 'gyur/ /las kyis de tshe tshe 8'phos na'ang / /de tshe de tshe de dang der/ /'jig rten dag tu skyes gyur paṇi/ /sa steng mi yi bdag por byed/ /gang zhig me tog dman tu)ma ni/ /byis pa g.yo ba des phul ba/ /des na longs spyod nyon mongs canal/ /de 'di'i 'bras bu nyon mongs ldan/ /sdug bsngal longs spyod thob pa yang / /rgyal po de yi bstan pa nyams/ / mi brtan tunyebyis pa'i rang bzhin dang / /ji lta de ltar g.yo sems kyis/ /sa steng ston pa'i mchod rten la/ /mchod pa chen po yongs su byas/ /rnam par smin pa'i las de yis/ /byis pa ——907

rgyal po'i dbang phyug byed①/ /med par rgyal po byed par 'gyur/ /yod pa rab tu 'jig par 'gro/ /byang dang nub kyi ②bar dag tu/ /de ni rgyal po byed par 'gyur / /blo gros chagang de bcings pa dang / /byis pas yang ni rab dang dub/ /byis pas bcings dang grol sgib yi/ /rnam smin las ni de yis dusu/ /skye ba dag ni lnga brgyar yang / /byis pa bcings dang bgrol bar 'gyuraX/ /tha ma'i skye ba de yi tshe/ /thams cad du ni 'ching ba bcad/ /lo ni lnga bcu lnga dag gam//bdun cu rtsa bdun dag tu 'gyur②/ /shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mthar thug par/ /sa steng ⑨de ni rgyal por 'gyur/ /'bigs byed ri yi nang gnas pa/ /mtha' 'khob tshukla klo'i rkun ma rnams/ /de dag kun la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /yi ge ba ⑩ming rgyal por 'gyur/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa/ /byang gi phyogs la brten ⑩pa yi/ /de tshe rgyal rigs 8rgyal po de/ /yul mi kun la spyod par 'gyur / /mi shes byis par gyur pa yi8/ /mchod rten sa rdul gyis byas pas/ /'gran zla med cing gnod med par/ /ma ga dhā yi 8rgyal por 'gyur⑩/ /shar phyogs rgya mtshor brten ⑩nas ni/ /de 'di 'brog 8gi mthar thug par/ /blo ldan lo hi ta las gzhan/ /byang du de bzhin kha ba can/ /nub tu kā shi'i ⑪nyams dudaga'i grong / /rtse mo zhes bya'i grong de bzhin/ /'di yi nang du rgyal po ni / /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /de ni seng ge lnga zhes bya/ /pham nas rgyal pos gzhan yang pham/ /seng ge las skyes 0thams cad de'ang / /de tshe rtsa nas rnam par bshig nye /gangs can nang dang shar phyogs dang / /rgya mtsho bcu yi 'gram gnas nas/ /de tshe rgyal rigs brgyad 0po de/ /yul mi dag ni kun la spyod/ /lha sogs 3steseng ge rgyal po ni/ /g.yon can gzhan la brten ⑤pa 88wa 908

dang ske/ /'bigs ①byed nang na gnas pa la/ /des kyang rang gi rgyal po ②byas/ /bgrod dka' zhes bya'i yul dbus su/ /dug chen rgyal bas rnam rgyal byas/ /byang shar kun la gnas pa yi/ /seng ge zhes bya de bzhin gzhan/ /zla ba zhes bya'i rgyal po 'das/ /de tshe go ḍā'i ②skye bo'ang 'jig /de tshe rgyal rigs sa yi bdag /'byung bar 'gyur bar duthe tshom med/ /rgyal po mngon 'phel skye zhes bya / /de yi longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur⑤/ /de tshe rgan por gyur pa na/ /de yang g.yo ba med par song / /lo ni brgyad cur 'tsho ba stedu/ /de bzhin gzhan ni bdun dang bdun/ /de nas 'khogs ⑦pas zil mnan nas/ /dus byas lha yi gnas su song / /yun ring lha yi bde ba ni/ /de tshe rgyal pos ⑤rjes su myong //sngon ni kun nas nyon mongs pas/ /las kyi ⑨yang ni shi 'phos te/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po klu yi rgyal/ /blo ldan dud 'gro'i nang du gnas/ /tshong pa sngags ni grub pa ste/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i blo byed cing / /de tshe rig ⑩pa'i rgyal po dang / /de tshe bde 'gro dag tu gyur/ /de yi skyetshe na 'khor los sgyur/ /sna tshogs tog ces rgyal por 'gyur8/ /de bzhin du ni blo ldan de/ /de tshe rig tso'adzin chos kyang 'chad/ /lo ni bye ba brgyad cu dang / /de tshe dgu dang bdun du 'gyur/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba yis/ /'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi 'khor du bu mo ni/ /bye ba drug cu 8skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas de ni lus zhig nas / /lha mo sgrol ma mnyes byas te/ /lha rnams ⑩bdag por song nas ni/ /der ⑩ni chos kyang ston par byed/ /rgyal po de ni mthar gyis su/ /myur du byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /de yang lo ni gsum dag tu/ /rgyal po'i dbang phyug byas nas ni/ /yi ge pa yi rgyal po 'das/ /de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /phan tshun 88wa 909

rgyud ni byas nas su/ /rtsod pa chen po la yang gnas/ /de yi nu bo yig pa zhes//brtul zhugs can du rnam par gnas/ /lo ni gsum dang gcig dag tu/ /rgyal srid yongs su 'phel bar byas/ /de ma thag tu 'khru bas btab/ /'di dag gnyi yo)ga 'chi bar gyur②/ /'jig rten dus cha'adas shi nas ni/ /gnod sbyin dag gi nang du skyes/ /de gnyis mthar gyis chos ldan pas/ /rang rgyal byang chub thob par 'gyur④/ /de'i yang nu bo yig pa zhes/ /rgyal rigs kyi 0ni chos la dga'/ /de yang rgyal po lo gsum du/ /mi yi bdag po byed par 'gyur / ci /de'i yang nu bo rgyal po ni/ /yi ge dza zhes rnam par bsgrags⑥/ /de yang yul ni 'di dag tu/ /sa kun gyi (3)ni bdag por 'gyur/ /rta dang shing ⑧rta glang po dmag /kun nas gru dang theg pa yis/ /g.yul du nye bar gnas nas ni/ /dgra yi tshogs ni kun las rgyal/ /des ni yul 'di ma lus dang / /sa rnams thams cad nyid la ni/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan lha khang dang / /de bzhin rgyal ba'i mchod rten dang / /sa rnams dag ni thams cad la/ /thams cad mdzes par byas par gyur⑨/ /de tshe sngon gyi rgyal po de'i7/ /bram ze de bzhin shāg 11rigs skye'on/ /nga rgyal shes rab ldan zhing rno/ /byang chub mthar byed nga rgyal blo/ /de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /de (nyenyid 'di yi grogs nyid 'gyur/ /rgyal po chos la dga' ba yi7/ /rgyal rigs kyi 7ni mchog tu gsungs8/ /lo ni nyi shu bdun dang brgyad/ /de ni de tshe 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /bud med byas pa'i skyon nyid kyis7/ /dus byas nas ni lha gnas 'gro/ /blo ldan de ni mthar gyis kyang glu/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas grags pa dpal (nyezhes bya/ /de bzhin sa yi bdag po ni/ /u ḍi (7ya ( )na rgyal po che/ /chos la dga' ba ——910

'byung bar 'gyur/ /u ḍi ①yan gyi ②gong mchog la/ /grong khyer ①yi ge pa zhes bya / /der ni rgyal po byed pa ste/ /kun nas ④dgra las rgyal bar ⑤'gyur/ /der 0ni de tshe brgyad dag gi/ /gtsug lag khang yang byed par 'gyur/ /bram ze'i gtso bo de bzhin ldan/ /shākya'i skyes zhes yang dag brten⑦/ /de yi grogs la brten dunas ni/ /'khor 6)yug tu ni rgyal srid byas/ /lo ni brgyad cu gcig bcas par/ /mi yi bdag po ⑩der 'tshor 'gyur⑩/ /las byed skyon gyis chos bdag nyid/ /dus byas nas ni lha gnas 'gro/ /lha rnams kyi ni rgyal thabs kyang la/ /de bzhin mthar gyis byed par 'gyur/ /de nas lus de zhig nas kyang / /mtho ris las kyang mtho ris 'gro/ /de yi byang chub rgyu dag ni/ / dge ba'i 8chos ni yongs 8rdzogs byas/ /de yi bran nyid rgyal po ste/ /rgyal srid gnod med byed par 'gyur/ /yi ge'i tsodang po ya zhes bya/ /sa yi bdag po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lo ni bdun dang gcig dag tu/ /de yi dus su rgyal srid byed/ /de gcig bud med rnams kyis ni/ /brdegs nas kyang ni shi bar 'gyural/ /yi ge pa rgyud yang byung ba/ /rgyal rigs rgyal por 'gyur ba yin/ /des ⑤ni bran tshogs rnams tsobasad nas/ /rang dbang du ni yongs su gyur/ /mi dge'i (sprebashes gnyen la brten yinas/ /rnam mang srog ni gcod pa yin/ /dpa' zhing 'byor yo)la rmongs par ni/ /'jig rten kun la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /g.yo zhing myur du byed pa na/ /chang ( )dang g.yo sgyu can la dga'/ /chang gis bag med rnam rmongs nas/ /des na de ni sa la nyal/ /dgra rnams kyis ni brtson (1byas nas/ /mtshon chas bsnun nas de gsod 'gyur/ /de ( gyenas de ni lus zhig nas/ /dus byas nas ni 'og tu 'gro/ /de yi spun zla gnyis pa ni/ /——911

ming ni yi ge ra zhes shes/ /nyin zhag bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad du/ /de tshe sa la rgyal srid byas/ / bram ze ①rnams la nor byin nas/ /the tshom med par dus kyang byas②ske/ /de nas gzhan yang sa bdag ni/ /de tshe rgyal po bzang po byung / /de yang dmangs ①rigs skye dunas ni/ /yan lag ma tshang ngan pa nyid/ /chos min phal cher tshul khrims 'chal/ /'thab pa la yang rtag tu dad/ /bram ze'i tshogs dang rgyal phran dang / /sdom brtson de bzhin rab phyibyung ba/ /kun la yang ni gnod byed cing / /rtag tu tshar gcod dag la'ang dga'/ /drag pos 'dul bar byed pa dang / /de bzhin rkun ma rnams kyang gsod/ /ma rungs ⑥thams cad gnod byed cing / /ya mtshan can gyi ⑦brtul zhugs sten⑧/ /rnam par grol la'ang 6)sbyin mi byed/ /de tshe rgyal srid byed par 'gyur/ /lo ni bcu dang bdun gyi bar/ /der ⑩ni sa bdag 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /mdze yi nad kyis ⑪sdug bsngal nas/ /de nas dus byas dud 'gror 'gro/ /dud 'gro dag las klu rgyal du/ /gdengs ka che ldan mgyogs par 'gro/ /mchog tu 'jigs rungs ⑫lus ldan zhing / /de tshe sgra ni drag par sgrogasati/ /de la lor ④ni mi 'dod pa/ /yun ring sdug bsngal rjes su myong / /sa srung 'jig rten 'phel byed pa/ /'jig rten kun gyis shes pa ste/ /lus can shar phyogs gnas pa yin/ /rgyal po yi ge pa zhes pa'i/ /rgyud rnams rgyud du ⑩skyes pa gzhanatso/ /rgyal rigs dpa' bo rnam par gnon/ /de bzhin rgya mtsho gsum gyi bdag / bde chen ⑩ stobs ni che ba dag /shar gyi phyogs su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ston pa'i mchod ⑫rten bzang po dang / /gtsug lag khang dang 'dug gnas khyim/ /rnam pa sna tshogs skyed mos tshal/ /rdzing dang khron pa bkad sas bskor/ /de bzhin rtag ——912

tu bsod nams khang / /sa ni mdzes par ①byed par 'gyur/ /de nas ②thub mchog dam pa dang ②/ /theg pa bla na med la brtenaX/ /shākya'i rab byung de nyid ni/ /rtag tu de ni rab gnas byed/ /mi khom rnams ni spong dubyed cing / /dal ba nyid kyang legs par thob/ /yi ge ka duzhes rnam par bsgrags/ /'jig ⑦med dran dang ldan pa nyid/ /lo ni nyi shu gcig bar ⑧du/ /sa skyong rgyal srid byas par 'gyural/ /de nas gsud tshund kyis btab ste0/ /dus tsobyas nas ni lha gnas 'gro/ /blo ldan de ni mthar gyis su/ /myur du byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur / /de yi lhag ma'i rgyud las kyang / /gzhan la rab gnas 'tsho byed pa/ /de yi 'og tu sa skyong ba/ /sa srung 'tsho bas 8gnas pa yin/ /bram ze bkren pa'i skye bo ni/ /the tshom med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de yi dus su chos min ldan / /ston pa'i bstan pa nges par nyams/ /sngags kyi bstan pas sems can rnams / /dge ba'i don du nges par sbyor/ /gang zhig gzhon nus bstan pa yi8—/ /sngags ni longs spyod 'phel byed pa/ /rgyal po'i dbang phyug don du ni/ /de tshe de'i yul phyogs su yang / /grub pa mchog ni bsgrub bya min/ /chos kyi ⑫'khor lo nyams tsodaga' dang / /de bzhin 'od ma'i tshal chen dang / /gang du bcom ldan de zhi bar/ /phung po med par rab zhugs pa/ /sngags gnyis 'di dag bsgrub bya ba/ /lha mo sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rtag tu rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang ni / /snying po med pa'i 'bab chu mchog / gang gā'i ⑩'gram ni thams cad du/ /pad+ma 'byung ba bsgrub par bya/ /sa bcu thob pa'i bdag po ni/ /gang yang byang chub sems de yang / /sems can rnams ni 'dul byed pa/ zla ba zhes ni rnam par bsgrags / /rig 8pa'i rgyal mo rdzu 'phrul che/ /de ni sgrol ma zhes kyang ——913

bstan / /bud med gzugs 'chang lha mo ni/ /'gro ba kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /snying rjes ①brlan pa'i sems kyis ②ni/ /sems can rnams dul phan don du/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams gnas nas④/ /bud med ming gis 'jug par byed//sa bcu la ni rab gnas thob/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /sems can rnams duni 'dul byed pa/ /lha mo sgrol ma zhes su bstan/ /'di ni 'bad ⑥med grub pa ste④/ /srung dang skyob dang sbed par byed/ /longs spyod dbang phyug 'phel byed pas/ /'di ni lha mo bsgrub par bya/ /byang chub tshogs kyi ched du ni/ /skyed pa nyid nas brtsam par bya/ /snying rjes ⑧brlan pas lus can ⑨la / /de tshe lha mo rjes 'brang ba/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis ⑩sems can la/ /byang chub tshogs ni bya phyir ro/ /re ba thams cad dga' rgyas phyir/ /shar gyi phyogs su gnas pa yin/ /bdag nyid rnam pa stong dang ni/ /rnam pa mang por (nyabyas nas kyang / /rgya mtsho bzhi yi mthar thug par/ /sa rnams kun tu rnam par rgyu / /de nas shar gyi 7phyogs su 'amatu)/ /yang na bā rā ṇa sīr 'grub/ /lha mo de yi zhing du ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su rab tu bstan/ /'od chen po ni dzam bha ⑫la / /gnod sbyin rgyal po yang dag 'grub/ /de tshe longs 8spyod ma lus tso'adod//de tshe dus kyi tha ma la/ /lha mo sgrol ma gnod sbyin rgyal/ /de nor ⑩rgyas pa 'dod pas sgrub/ /de tshe khro bo'i sngags dag ni/ /lho phyogs dag tu bsgrub par bya / /kla klo rkun (nyama'i gling dang ni/ /de bzhin rgya mtsho'i nang du ni/ /stobs ⑪chen sgrol ma gnod sbyin rgyal/ /de bzhin du yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /ha ri kel ka da raṃ 57tsa/ / kā ma rū pa gā dā hā ya hi ste/ pho nya mo tshogs rnam ( )mang dang / /gnod sbyin rdzu 'phrul chen mo 'grub/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gang ——914

gsung ①sngags/ /longs spyod kyi ②ni rgyur 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin yul der grub pa ste/ /gzhan yul de bzhin ma yin no/ /shar phyogs dang ni phyogs mtshams ①sul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sngags kyi rgyur/ /de yi dus su bstan pa ni/ /lus can rnams kyis dubasgrub par bya/ /dbus kyi yul du de bzhin sngags/ /de bzhin sa srung mang po ni/ /rgya che thams cad nyam ⑤chung ba'i/ /blo chung rnams kyis rtogs ⑥par byed/ /rgyal po'i gtso bo mdor bsdus ⑦nas/ /ming ni 'di dag nges par brjod/ /dang po'i yi ge sha dang na/ /dang po'i yi ge par yang bstan / /dang po'i (miyi ge ba dang idhi/ /dang po'i yi ge ar yang bstan/ /dang po'i yi ge har bstan te/ /dang po'i yi ge par yang bsgrags/ /dang po'i yi ge dza dang ba⑩/ /dang yig dha ni zla ba'i rigs/ /yi ge ha nyid rnam bsgrags dang / /de bzhin yang ni dang po'i a/ /dang po'i yi ge sa la yang / /bud med rigs min 'jig rten sdang / /dang po'i yi ge a dang ma/ /'jig rten rnams la mthu dang ldan/ /rim gyis rim gyis rigs dag ni(ste/ /bram ze rje'u rigs dag tu 'jugatuge /phal cher chos min las byed cing / /rnam sdang bud med la brkam (nyechags/ /sa srung skyon ni rab mang bar/ /de yitshe dus kyi tha ma la8 / /yul gyi yidabus su mi yi bdag /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /dus kyi tha mar 'di dag tshe/ /lo ni brgya (nyedang nyi shu nyid/ /de yi tshe na mi rnams kyi(nye/ /tshe ni ring bar 4)rab tu bstan/ /de dag bar ste )mo bzang po las / /khyad par ring dang thung ba yin/ /rgyal po rnams ni tshe thung bar/ /de tshe dus su bstan pa ni/ /gang gā'i 'gram gyi ( 〉ngogs dang ni/ /gangs can 4 rtegyi ni ri zhol dang / /de tshe kā ma rū 4 steyul du/ /de 'dra'i rgyal po 'byung bar 88—915

'gyur / /dang po bar ma tha ma yi/ /rigs kyi lhag ①ma brjod bya stol/ /dang po'i dugatso bo chen po ni/ /rna can rgyal por rab tu bsgrags/ /tha ma ang ga'i bdag po dang / /der ni 'byor bzad 'byor pa dang / /legs byin srid 0pa byin pa ni/ / kā ma rū ①pa'i yul du byung / /tha mar legs 'byor gzhon nu dang —/ /yi ge ba dang tha gnyis ni/ /yangs pa can du yang dag byung / /gang du thub pa de skyes payi/ /ser skya zhes bya'i grong mchog tu/ /tha mar zas gtsang shāg ④rigs kyil/ /nyi ma ①bu ram rigs skyes pa/ /tha mar zas gtsang rnam bsgrags ⑩pa/ / shākya shākya'i rnam ⑩'phel byed/ /sems can brtson 'grus chung bar ni/ /'jig rten skyes tsomachog bstan pa yin/ /gang zhig rgyal bas gsung 8sngags dang / /de bzhin bran po'i tshogs kun dang / /pho nya'i tshogs kun du ma dang / /rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs dag kyang / /rgyud rnams kun gyi don rig ④pas/ / bsgrubs na 'grub 8par 'gyur ba yin/ /'jig rten kun gyi sngags dag ni/ /yul gyi ⑩dbus der grub ⑩par 'gyur/ /dbus yul gnas par khyad par du/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa bsgrub 8par bya/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rtags dang ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgyud (7dag dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sbyor bar ldan/ /lus can rnam pa sna tshogs zhu 'grub/ /dbus kyi yul du de bzhin sngags / /longs spyod 'phel ba bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin lus can bsrung ⑥don dang / /skyob dang dbang dang dgug (9pa 'grub/ /dbus kyi phyiyul du mi yi bdag /'das dang ma 'ongs rab tu gsungs(ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rtags dang ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs tshe dang rigs / /rgyal po thams cad gsungs pa tsoni / /mchog dang tha ma phyibar ma yin/ /de bzhin rnam gsum grub pa ste/ /88wa 916

dus kyang gsum du sbyar bar bya/ /de bzhin sngags kyang rnam gsum du/ /de bzhin thub pa mchog gis gsungs/ /rgyal po mtha' yas gsungs pa ni/ /dbus kyi yul dang nub phyogs dang / /byang phyogs dang ni shar phyogs dang / /de bzhin phyogs mtshams ①thams cad dang / /rnam pa bzhi ru ②mtshon pa yi/ /gling dag de bzhin kun tu yang / /sa bdag mtha' yas rab gsungs pa/ /mtha' yas sngags ni sgrub pa dang / /mtha' yas yul la gnas pa dag⑧ /mtha' yas sngags ni yongs su 'grub④/ /thub pa'i bstan pa nub pa na/ /tshar gcad ⑤rjes su gzung bar byed(nya/ /dus su rgyal po ⑦dag la sngags/ /'jam dpal gyis ⑧ni gsungs pa yin/ /rdzu 'phrul rtse ⑨dang rnam 'phrul dang / /'dir ni dus kyi tshuspyod pa'ang bstan/ /sngags kyi bdag nyid sems can gyi/ /'gro ba skye gnas rgyal po'i ming / /sngags ni sgrub ⑩par 'dod rnams la/ /yul dang dus ni yang dag bstan/ /bstan pa nub pa'i 'og tu ni/ /zhar la rgyal po rnams kyis 8bstan/ /yon tan bdag nyid che sngags rnams/ /tha mar 'bras bu rtogs 8par byas/ /rgyal po gzhan ni theg pa dang / /sngon ni 'gal ba med par bstan/ /dus kyi tha tsom de dus su/ /rab tu gnas par the tshom ⑫med / /de dag phyogs la gnas par ni/ /rgyal po thams cad gsungs pa yin/ /de bzhin shākya'i gsung ⑩rab la/ /nges par rab byung chaganas nas ni/ /'jig rten mig tsogacig gyur pa yi/ /thub pa mchog ni med pa na4)/ /rtag tu sngags smra la dad pas/ /bstan pa'i don ni byed par 'gyur/ /de dag gzhon nu bshad par bya/ /rtse gcig yid kyis mnyan zhupar gyis/ /ston pa'i gsung ⑥rab sa steng du/ /dus mthar 6)'jig rten nyams pa na( )/ /sdom brtson rgyal ——917

po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom 6)med/ /dper na ma khol ②zhes bya dang / /me tog ①ces byar rnam par grags/ /yi ge ma zhes gzhon nu zhes / /dang por ④tha mar chos la dga'/ /klus bos zhes bya ⑤rnam par grags//rin chen 'byung zhes bya ming dang / /yi ge ga zhes gzhon nu zhes/ /yi ge ba zhes chos sems byed/ /yi ge a ming bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed/ /blo ldan yon tan kun gyis bkur/ /dang po'i yi ge la zhes bstan/ /rgyal po sangs rgyas pa yi phyogs/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed/ /sdom brtson ⑥yi ge a zhes bsgrags/ /bram ze las ni rab tu byung //grong khyer gnas bcas gnas pa ste/ /de bzhin tshe ni brgyad cur 'tsho/ /dang yig yi ge a dge slong / /lho yi phyogs su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /blo ldan tshe ni drug cur 'tsho/ /ka shi zhes bya'i grong du gnas/ /yi ge dha zhes sdom brtson nyid / /lho yi phyogs su rnam par bsgrags/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog ⑦nas kyang / /de bzhin sdom brtson (shesngags kyang grub/ /gzhan yang rab 6)byung dam pa ni/ /sing ga bol yi grong na gnas/ /'phags pa min la 'phags pa'i ming sing ga (sprel yi gling na gnas/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog tunyenas ni/ /mu stegs rnams kyi sngags sun 6)phyung / /de dus 'jigs su rung ba yisnyi/ /dus kyi mtha' las ⑫'byung bar 'gyur/ /yi ge da dang la dang por/ /sdom brtson gang zhig rab gsungs 7dang / /yi ge ra dang ba dang por/ /dge slong gang zhig rab byung gsungs1 tsho / /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom lho med/ /rgyal po nag po zhes bya bar/ /yi ge sa yi)zhes sdom brtson 'byung 8nya/ /mchod rten kun dga' ra ba gnas/ /rdzing dang khron pa'ang thams ——918

cad du/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan de bzhin rtags/ /gzings ①dang zam pa nyid rnams ni/ /byed par 'gyur bar ②the tshom med/ /mtshon gyis ①lus zhig mtho ris 'gro/ /de nas yi ge sa dang ka /dang po dag tu brjod pa dang / /de bzhin yi ge ra dang gha/ /dang po dag tu rab brjod dang / /dang por yi ge ba dang ni/ /legs byin ④legs de (5)sde zhes bstan/ /sbyin byed sbyin par byed pa nyid/ /gzhan gyi 9grub mtha' sun byed pa/ /tshong pa sngon dang sman pa sngon/ /gnyi ⑦ga sbyin byed sna tshogs byed/ /yi ge ⑧ba zhes sdom brtson bsgrags/ /de las gzhan ⑨pa dang yi ger/ /dang por 0yi ge ba grags dang / /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan don yang byed/ /blo ldan dang por yi ge ma/ /de bzhin sdom brtson dad pa 'byung / /rnam pa du ma sdom brtson gsungs/ /de tshe mtha' yas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sdom brtson thams cad bsgrags 0pa yang / /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa'o/ /bstan pa de tshe sa steng du/ /rnam par nyams shing snang med la/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong / /byed par 'gyur bar the tshom 4)med/ /thams cad byang chub lung bstan te/ /nga yi ( byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'jig rten sbyin gnas 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum gyi mthar yang byed/ /sngags dang rgyud la mngon brtson pas/ /grags pa 'dzin par shes par bya/ /bram ze chos kyi skongang tshul can/ /de ni tsorab tu brjod par bya/ /sngags dang rgyud la mngon brtson yipas/ /rgyal po'i lugs la nye bar gnas / /de tshe mi bzad tsho)dus dag tu/ /'jig rten kun la 'byung bar 'gyur / /yi ge ba zhes bram ze mchog /phyug cing rig byed pha rol phyin/ /de 'dir sa rnams ma lus paranyushe/ /rtsod pa'i phyir ni rab tu rgyu/ /mtsho gsum sa 88—919

yi mthar thug par/ /pha rol mu stegs rtsod la dga'/ /gang phyir dang po gtso bo'i tshig /sems can rnams ①la phan 'dod pas/ /gzhon nus ②yongs su gsungs ①gyur pa/ /yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyang zlosaX/ /cho ga rab 'byam ⑤'di dag las/ /des ni de phan de la bstenadu/ /rgyal dang legs par rgyal ba dang ske/ /grags ①ldan dge ba de dulas gzhan/ /rigs ldan chos dang ldan pa dang ske/ /brtson ldan legs pa 0khyab 'jug dang / /sbrang rtsi sbrang rtsi bzang po dang ske/ /de bzhin grub dang dregs 0bral dang / /ra gha ba dang dmangs sh+yirigs dang / /de bzhin ka shir skyes pa gzhan8/ /gzhon nu 'di yi bzlas pa la / /thams cad kun yang 'byung bar 'gyur8/ /de dag kun kyang bzang po ste / /blo ldan mang du thos pa yin/ /de kun sngags ni mngon du gyur/ /rgyal po'i 'tsho bas yang dag gnas/ /de 'og rnam par grags pa ni/ /bram ze dang po'i yi ge birkyi/ /grong khyer me tog ces tsobya bar/ /de ni khro bo grub par gyur/ /dbul bas yongs su zil mnan pas/ /rgyal po rnams ni tshar bcad byas/ /khro rgyal gshin rje gshed de yi/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis 'dir gsungs pa/ /sems can ma rungs rnams dang ni/ /gdul dka' 'dul bar byed pa dang / /phan pa ⑩min las bzlog don dang / /phan pa nye bar 'phel phyir dang / /sems can rnams ni rjes gzung ⑩dang / /sems can srog 'chad dgag tsophyir rol/ /bram ze'i khye'u rmongs pa de/ /dbul 7ba khro ba chags pa yis/ /rgyal po'i srog la gnod pa'i phyir/ /khro bo'i 0sngags ni zlos ⑥par byed/ /de 'og rnam par grags pa ni/ /bram ze yi ge dang po ()a/ /chos don dge ba ldan bdag nyid/ /bden par smra 6)zhing dbang po thul/ /mnga' bdag mang pos 88wa 920

bkur ces pa/ /de tshe sngags ni zlos par 'gyur①/ /sngags ni bsgrub ②par gyur pa la/ /dbang 'gyur yin gyis chagazhan ma yin/ /'byung po dbang du gyur pa na/ /de tshe nor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de 'og rnam par grags pa ni/ /bram ze chos don sems byed pa/ /de nas mthar ni dang yig sha /ma la'i yul du de ni du'abyung / /sa steng sngags ni zlos par grags/ /bstan pa mchog la'ang rab tu dad/ /rig 0pa rjes bzung dum rungs dang / /tshangs pa'i srin po srin po rgyadang / /'byung po shin tu ma rungs bcasal/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sha za dang / /bstan ⑨dang 'gro ba sna tshogs ni/ /de dag ma lus de dbang ⑩'gyur / /de bzhin bram ze'i mtshan ldan pa/ /thams cad de yi dbang du 'gyur / /de 'og rnam par grags pa ni/ /lho yi phyogs su bram ze ni/ /yi ge dang por yib bstan pa/ /ston pa'i bstan la 8de gtsor 'byed/ /mchod rten kun dga' ra ba gnas/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid 'ong gis/ /sa ni rgya mtsho gnyis mthar thug /thams cad kyi ni rgyan du byas/ /de 'og rnam par grags pa ni/ /bram ze gtso bo nor chen ldan/ /dang po'i yi ge na zhes pa/ /lho yi phyogs su yang dag bstan8/ /bdag nyid chen po sngags zlos ldan/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /dbus kyi 7yul du bstan pa ni/ /bram ze gang ba bzang zhes pa/ /'dul ba dang ni tshul bzang nyid/ /gang ba bcom brlag dag tu gnas/ /dang yig bha ni nor gyi 8spyan/ /rgyal po rnams ni ⑩sngags mchod byed/ /bram ze 'di dag bstan pa ni/ /ston pa'i bstan pa mchod byed pa'o/ /thog ma bar mthar 8gtso bo ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gnas dang rigs/ /sna tshogs phyogs kyi bram ze rnams/ /bram ze gzhan gyis mchod ——921

par byed/ /mu stegs sna tshogs rigs dang ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs spyod yul spyod / /gnas ni kun tu gsungs pa①ste/ /bram ze'i khye'u mang thos yin/ /rang byung ②sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub pa/ /sems can rnams ni ma lus dang / /lha gnas ①kyis kyang mchod pa'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po yang / /'jig rten kun la grags pa ste/ /'phags skyes po dang mig mi bzang / /yul 'khor srung dang gnod sbyin rgyal/ /brgya byin de nas lha rnams kyili/ /nges pa'i tshig 6)ni rab tu bsgrags/ /'thab bral lha yi bu dang ni / /'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / /rgyal po ⑥dga' ldan gsungs ⑦pa dang / /'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug mchog /gcig gi ming ni brgya rdo byin sogs/ /de bzhin 'dod khams dbang phyug yin/ /de yang rtag tu gcig gnas te/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po gcig gi gzugs/ /de yang mtha' yas dag tu bstan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs 'chang lha/ /de las 6)gong du thams cad mnyam/ /de yang thams cad rdzu 'phrul che/ /lha yi gtso bo ming gcig ste/ /'du shes med pa'i mthar yang bstan/ /de dag gtso bo med pa ste//mnyam pa'i tshul du yang dag gnas/ /'og tu mnar med mthar thug par/ /der ni rgyal po yod ma yin/ /'jam dpal de 7bas na/ de ltar phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus su rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo (1gang la las de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi mdzod 'di glegs tu bam du chud par byas te/ 'dri tu bar 'gyur / klog par 'gyur/ kha ton 7du byed par 'gyur ba'am glegs snyibam du byas te 'chang bar 'gyur/ gus par byas te yid la byed 7par 'gyur/ gos rnam pa sna tshogs dang / phye ma dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba ——922

dan dang / dril bu dang / rol mo dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang /spos dang / dri dang / dri zhim po dag gis mchod par byed par 'gyur/ ri mor byed par 'gyur/ yang dag par 'dzin par byed par 'gyur/ yid rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis chos byed par 'gyur ba de la ni/ phan yon bcu po 'di dag tu 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe ①na/ der 'di la pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi ②'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ char 'bab pa ①mi mkhas pa dang gza' dang 'ching rjob chen po'i 'tshe ba ⑤'byung bar mi 'gyur⑥/ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa'am / der 'di la ⑦mi'i 'jigs ⑧pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur⑨/ phyir rgol ba thams cad kyi 'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la ⑩nad kyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin par tso'achi ba'i 'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la dus ma yin pa'i char gyi 8'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /char ches pa'i ⑫'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la rlung chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sha za thams cad kyi 'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la dgra'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /8de bzhin du g.yon can rkun po'i 'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gshin rje'i rgyal pos khyer ba'i 'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za'i 'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la gzhan gyi sngags kyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sbyar ba'i dug thams cad kyi 'jigs pa'am/ der 'di la nad kyi 'jigs pa dang / rims dang / tshad par 'khru ba dang / ma zhu ba dang / yan lag dang / nying lag gi nad kyi tso'ajigs pa tso'abyung bar mi ——923

'gyur te/ phan yon bcu po 'di dag tu shes par bya'o/ /gang du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ①kyi cho ga chen po rab 'byam ②chos kyi mdzod 'di glegs ②bam du byas te/ bzhag la 'dri byab dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa dang /'dzin pa dang kha ton dudu byed na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyisaXshin tu bzung zhing chos kyi mdzod mngon du 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig gi spyod pa la rjes su ma zhugs pa dang dam tshig mi shes pa gzhan dag la ni rnam pa thams cad du bstan par mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir 'di ni gsang ba yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dis ⑦ni thams cad mtshon pa yin ⑧na sems can rnams kyi dran pa med par ma byed cig /'on kyang khyod kyis ①shes par 'gyur mchod pa 0byed par 'gyur 0yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur zhing bsod nams chen po yang rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can skal ⑩ba med pa rnams la bstan par mi bya ste/ gzhan du na dbul ba dang / nad dang / mdze dang / 'tshe ba dang / 'go ba'i nad nyid byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na gzhan dag la yang bstan par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig dang gsang ba pa dang 8gsang ba'i sngags kyi spyod pa la rjes su zhugs pa'i sems can rnams dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la 8legs par bslab 8pa rnams dang legs par rnam par bzhag pa'i dran pa (9dang ldan pa rnams dang /chos kyi don la ⑩mkhas pa rnams chadang bsam gtan la rab tu zhugs pa dang chos la gnas pa dang bden par smra ba (7dang sems can gyi spyod pa la ( nyerab tu gnas shing snying rje'i spyod pa dang rab tu ldan (nyapa rnams te/ sems can 'di dag la bstan par bya'i (shegazhan dag la ni ma yin no/ /dude nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan sgo las langs te/ bla gos ——924

phrag pa gcig tu gzar ①nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ②te/thal mo sbyar ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci zhes ①bya/ 'di bdag gis 0ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dubaka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya bar yang zung 0shig /ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi man ngag legs par bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya bar yang zung ④shig /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa rgyud thams cad kyi mdzod ces bya bar yang zung ⑧shig / theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa nges par bstan pa nyams pa med pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya bar yang zung shig /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhes bya bar yang zung shig⑨ /chos thams cad kyi don rdzogs pa nges par bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung ⑩shig /'jig rten ma lus thams cad la/ /chos dang chos min rnam spyod ⑩cing / /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /gang khyod kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /de bzhin chos kyi dam pa mchog /gsang ba gzhan ni ma mthong ngo / /sngags rgyud don dang mdo rnams dang / /'gro ba yul ni skyon med dang ⑫/ /byang chub chos la rab gzhol ba/ /dpa' bo gzhan ni ma mthong ngo / /gang 'di bla ma gsang ba dang / /drang don mdo yis yongs su brgyan8/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mdo don dang / /sngags dang rgyud kyi 8rjes 'jug pa/ /cho ga rab 'byam 8'di las gzhan / /ma byung gang yang yod ma yin/ /rgyal srid chen po longs spyod cheskye/ /lha gnas dag tu'ang ⑩phun sum tshogs/ /de bzhin lha dang mi rnams kyitso/ /——925

grags pa rgyas pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /mi khom brgyad ni spong byed cing / /dal ba dag ni thob par byed/ /theg pa rnam gsum bdag po dang / /de nges ①sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /mdo 'di 'dzin pa'i bsod nams dang / /de bzhin du ni phan yon 'di/ /'di yi ①lus la mtshon mi 'byung / /dug dang mes kyang ma yin no/ /ro langs dang ni gdon dang ni/ /de bzhin srul po ma mo dang / / srin po sha zas ①'tshe byed pa'ang / /gang zhig mdo 'di 'don la min/ /'chang ba dang ni klog pa dang / /yang dang yang du mchod byed dang / /'jigs pa med pas ④mchod byed dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs mchod byed de/ /phan yon 'di ni (snyerab bstan pa/ /'jig rten 'dir yini thob 'gyur ba/ /nad pa rnams ni nad las grol/ /sdug bsngal spyican ni bde bar 'gyur/ /dbul pos nor ni rnyed 'gyur te/ /bcings pa rnams ni 'ching las grol/ /'gro ba lnga dang ldan pa yi/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ltung (nyab rnams/ /bde ba zhi ba mya ngan 'das/ /mi g.yo go 'phang 6)'thob par 'gyur/ /rang rgyal sangs rgyas nyid dang ni/ /nyan thos mthar ni phyin par 'gyur/ /mdo sde 'di ni bklag pa yis / /sangs rgyas sku mdog thob par 'gyur/ / gang gā'i tunyebye ma mnyam pa yis1nya/ /rgyal ba mchog ni mtha' yas pa6nya/ /mchod pas thob pa'i bsod nams dang / /mdo 'di bton 8pa'i bsod nams mnyam/ /'jig rten ji snyed gang su dag /zhing ni bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /de srid phra rab rdul snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams la rtag mchod pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bza' btung dang / /na ba rnams kyi gso skoman dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gnas mal rnams / /rtag tu thams cad rab sbyin dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gos dang ni/ /——926

phye ma dag ni kun gyis kyang / /bsod nams skye bos ①thob gang yin/ /'di dag 'chang dang klog pas so/ /gang zhig rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /'jig rten nyan thos rdzu 'phrul che/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /sa bcu la gnas de las gzhan/ /de rnams tshad ni de mnyam la②/ /de dag mchod pa'ang de bzhin te/ /gang gi lag par glegs ②bam chud/ /mi yis ④de mnyam bsod nams thob⑤/ /'jig rten ji snyed bstan pa yang ⑥ 'jig rten khams na gnas pa yi/ /grangs med sems can ma lus pa thams cad nad ni med byas te/ /skye bo gang zhig yang dang yang / /bkur ster ④byas nas de mchod pa/ /chos mchog ⑧'di la mchod na ni/ /blo ldan de yis bsod nams 'thobazhu/ /bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas par/ /rgyal ba mchog gis rtag par yang / /'jig rten mgon chos mdzad yimachog 'di/ /mchod par yang ni mi nus so/ /chos mchog 'di ni sa steng du/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dra / /'jam pa'i (nyacho ga 'dir gsungs pa/ /bklags ⑩pa dang ni 'chang ba yisatso / /des ni 'dod 'jo'i ba 'drar 'gyur/ /longs spyod che tsonor phun sum tshogs/ /yid 8ni skyo ba med byas nas/ /sa steng 'di ni rab tu sgrubatso/ /sngags dang rgyud don drang ba'i don/ /don yod tshig ni rab bshad pa/ /bya ba dus la brten ()nas ni/ /sa steng rig pa 'dzin bsgrub na(nye/ /rin chen phun tshogs rab gang ba/ /de yi phyogs kun dag tu gsungs/ /'bras 4)bcas 'gro ba'i bdag nyid che/ /spyod pa ( )bzang bar (nyebarjod pa yin/ /gang zhig cho ga mchog 'di las/ /rgyal po sngags gcig 'chang byed pa/ /rgyal srid phun sum (rtetshogs don bcas she/ /tshe ring phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ——927

longs spyod tshogs/ /rgyal mchog dam pas 'thob ①par 'gyur/ /'gro dang gnas pa'i dug ②dag dang / /gzhan gyis byas pa'i nirig pa dang / /ro langs sngags kyis ④sgrub pa dang / /mtshon gyis kyang ni gnod mi 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi gnod byed gtsor byed pas/ /sa steng 'jig rten gnod mi byed/ /chom rkun nad ni gzhan dag dang / /me yi 'jigs pa de la med/ /rgyal po skye bo dag kyang rung / /su zhig de la mchod mi byed/ /gang zhig mdo sde dkon mchog 'di/ /'chang dang klog pa'ang ༷de bzhin no/ /rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas / /dbang bskur nyeyul du nyer gnas tshe/ /mdo sde mgo la nges bcings nasal/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal na⑦/ /de la rkun pos mi gnod cing / /mtshon gyis de la phog nimi 'gyur/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs su yang dag byung / /rma bya'i gdan la legs bkod pa/ /glang po'i mtshog ⑨ma'i steng bzhag nas/ /g.yul du yang dag zhugs byas na/ /skye bo rnams tsosnang de dag kun/ /mthong ba tsam gyis ldog par byed/ /byis pa'i gzugs can bzang po ni/ /gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis yongs su brgyan/ /gser dang dngul dang ra gan gyisayi/ /rgyal mtshan yu ba bsgreng ba la/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan btags nas ni/ /legs dgad 'ogelegs par mnyam par bzhagatso /g.yul du dgras ni legs gang ba/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs 8byed pa/ /thams cad g.yul du 'dus pa la/ /de yi tshe na 'jug par bya/ /rgyal mtshan sgreng tsol gnas pa yi/ /gzhon nu las ni sna tshogs pa/ /rnam pa du ma'i gzugs dang ldan/ /bdag nyid chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangasayi/ /sa bcu'i bdag po'i bdag po ni/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs ⑩par byed/ /rgyal rigs rgyal po chen po ni/ /'jig rten sa sung sa ——928

gnas pa/ /dad ldan yid gnyis the tshom ni/ /rnam bral chos la mnyes gshin ①pal/ /bde bar gshegs la dad bskyed ②nas/ /snying rjes nibarlan pa'i yid kyis ni/ /'dir bshad 'di dag bya ba ni/ /grub par 'dod pas rab tu bya/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba'i ④sngags dang ni/ /rgyud dang ldan pa ⑤sa steng du/ /chos dbyings tshogs pa'i rgyal ba yis/ /gsung rab 'di dag nges par bstan/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam gnas pa'i/ /rgyal mchog snga ma grangs med pas0/ /sa yi steng gi mi rnams la'ang ⑦/ /chos kyi mdzod ni gsungs pa yinadu/ /lha dang lha min sngon g.yul 'thab/ /pha rol 'jigs pa byung ⑨ba na/ /gang tshe brgya byin sngon gyur pa/ /dpung ni pham byas zhe sdang bas/ /de tshe gcig tu song nas ni/ /sa steng rnam par du bar gyur/ /rgyal mchog 'od srung de la ni/ /thub pa mchog la de tshe zhus/ /ji ltar bya zhes tshig tu ni/ /bde sogs bdag pos ⑩rnam par smrasayi/ /mi bzad lha min gyis pham nas/ /bdag kyang 'dir ni yang dag lhags/ /de skad bcom ldan gsol nas ni/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis/ /de tshe 8thub mchog zhabs gnyis tsol/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gis tsorab btud nas/ /mig stong kau 8shi ka ni/ /de yi spyan sngar 'dug par gyur/ /de skad gsol nas thub mchog ni/ /bram zer gyur pa 'od srung gis/ /de tshe gsung du bka' stsal pa/ /ka la ping ku'i sgra skad du/ /rgyal ba mchog gis sngon gsungs pa/ /gzhon nu sna tshogs yang dag byung ⑩/ /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dpal ni/ /rnyed dka' 0sku ni 'bum gyur pa/ /yang dag mtha' la gnas nas 4sheni / /zab mo'i don gyi don ston byed/ /spros med rnam pa med pa dang / /gnas med pa las ()gzugs byas nas/ /shin tu don ldan chos kyang ston/ /lha ——929

yi dbang phyug de ni dran/ /de nas de ni de dran pas/ /byang chub sems dpa' dran tsam gyis①/ /gzhon nu sna tshogs gzugs can ni/ /der ni de yi mod la ⑧lhags / /der ④ni bcom ldan 'das dang ni/ /bcom ldan lha yi dbang phyug bcas④ / /lhags nas byang chub sems dpa' des/ /de tshe rgyal ba mchog la btud / /rgyal ba mchog kun phyag 'tshal nas⑤/ /'od chen 'od srung la yang btud / /de tshe thub pas skyorjes gnang nas/ /sngags kyi tshig ni 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sate bh+yaḥ a pra ti ha ta shā sa ne bh+yaḥcha ma ha na ha na/sarba bha yor+sā da (nyaya tā sa ⑨ya/ mo ṭa ya/ tshin+da/ bhin+da/ dz+wa la dz+wa ⑩la/ hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas sngags 'di smras ma thag tu sa chen po 'di ri dang rgya mtsho'i mthar thug pa dang bcas pa rnam pa drug tu g.yos te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi zhing mtha' yas pa 'jig rten gyi khams kyi phyogs kyi mthar thug pa thams cad dang bcas pa yang rab tu 'gul bar gyur (1to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis kyang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag byin gyis yonabarlabs so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'jigs pa dang bral nas ba spu langs te ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thob nas()/ mig gnyis phye steci/ stan las langs snyinas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis kyil btud nas lan gsum bskor ba byas shing / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mngon du bltas nas sngags kyi tshig de dag bzung kyi 7ste/ yid la byas nas phyir yang tunyeshing rta la zhon te/rte / lha ma yin gang yin pa de logs su phyin par gyur to/ /de nas lha ma yin thams cad rgya mtsho chen po'i mtha'i 6 )'gram du gang rang gi grong khyer gang yin pa 88—930
