der 6)mngon du phyogs shing song bar gyur te/ sems zhum zhing nyams la dpung gi 'jigs pas sems dkrugs shing gdong gi ②mdog nyams shing nga rgyal dang dregs pa la sogs pa dang bral ③bar gyur la④/ mtshon cha dang bral zhing ri 'bigs ⑤byed 'bar ba bzhin du lha'i dbang phyug de mthong nas byer bar gyur ⑥to / /de nas lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams la smras pa/ grogs po dag ma 'jigs shig /ma 'jigs shig /sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha ma yin las bdag cag nges par rgyal bas rang gi gnas su 'gro bar bya'o / /rang rang gi gnas ci lta ba bzhin du song nas khyod cag 7rtse ba dang dga' ba yongs su spyod par gyis shig /de nas lha de dag thams cad yid shin tu dga' nas phyir yang rang gi gnas su log par gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ gang bdag gis gzhon ⑧nu'i gzugs can gyi gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa po)de byas la rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la'ang btags na/ des na gang 0gi lha ma yin gyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /zhes bstan to/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis (7)chen po la 'os pa'i nor bu rin po che nang 'od dang ldan zhing gsal tunyeba'i phreng ba blangs tunyenas/gzhon nu'i cha byad kyi gzugs brnyan byas te/ steng gi khang bzang du 8grong khyer chen po blta na sdug pa'i dbus na/ lha rnams 7kyi 'dun tsos chos bzang kyi hunyertse mor rgyal mtshan bsgreng (nyeb legs par bkod pa byas nas bzhag par gyur (kheto/ /de nas lha ma yin de dag rab tshim byed dang / thags bzangs ( )ris la sogs pa de dag sonyalha rnams kyi steng du mi 'gro zhing / lha de dag kyang zil gyis rusheganon par mi 'gyur la/ rdzu 'phrul las rnam par 'phrul pa'am/ g.yul mngon du ——931

phyogs par 'gro bar mi nus so/ /de ltar lo bye ba khri phrag du ma mi ①ma yin pa'i grangs kyis ②bgrang bar yang lha ma yin gyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phan yon dpag tu med pa bstan pa dang ①/ tshe dang rjo/ nad med pa 'phel bar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang sngon du gsungs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du phan yon gyi yon tan mchog 'di dag rgya che ba dang / mtha' yas shing mu med pa sngon gsungs pa yin no/ /gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spangs sam/ rnam par rtog par byed na/ bsod nams ma yin pa dpag tu med pa du'aphel bar 'gyur zhing / dmyal bar yang skye bar 'gyur la/ dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang ske/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi skye ba ngan par yang 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /sman dang / sngags rnams med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /de rnams kyi 0bdag nyid chen po rdzu 'phrul che ba dang / rnam par 'phrul ba yang med do/ /cho ga rgya che ba yang med do/ /'phags pa ma yin pas bshad do/ /zhes byas nas spang ⑦ba'am/ yang na 'gro zhing 'di nyan par mi nus so/ /zhes gnas ⑧de las gzhan du 'gro na/ de dag la bsod nams ma yin pa chen po po)'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste blo chung ba gang gis chos 'di ni thub pa mchog dang ske/ thub pa'i sras blo dang ldan pa ma yin no/ /zhes rab tu kyispong bar byed dom/ /mi de dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur zhing / /de nyams nas ni dud 'gror 'gro/ /thig nag dang ni yang sos dang / /spu gri so dang me ma 7myur/ /ro myags 8chu bo rab med skye/ /de nas phyir yang spu gri sor/ /lo ma ral gri lta bu'i nags/ /yang na kyi hud zer de bzhin/ /'jig rten grags pa so thams thamasatso/ /88wa 932

sdig pa'i las kyi ①dmyal ba ru/ /gang gis chos ni sun byed pa/ /de ②ni skye ba ⑧de dag 'gro/ /'jig rten smad par rab bstan pa/ /mi bzad mnar med pa zhes bya/ /ma dad sems kyis ④chos spangs pa/ /sdig pa'i las can gnas yin te / /gang zhig chos ni 'di 'jigs 0pa/ /de la skye bo de 'tshed 'gyur/ /kun gyi mthar thug mnar med pa/ /de nyams de bzhin dmyal chen skye/ /dmyal ba'i sa mtha' mtha' yas par/ /rtag tu blo med de ni 'gro/ /mdo sde de ni rgya cher bcas/ /chos kyi nor kun rab spangs nas/ /de ni du'ajig rten ngan par 'gro/ /dbang med rtag par dbang du 'gro/ /gang zhig mdo sde'i cho ga 'di/ /sngags dang rgyud kyis legs par brgyan⑦/ /grub pa sna tshogs brgya rnams 'thob/ /yang dag mtha' ni sgrib pa med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi sku nyid yin / /dmigs su med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /cho ga cho ga rgya chen bcas/ /le'u rab 'byam du'adis 'dren byed/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni legs dgod pa/ /phun tshogs dpal dang blo gros mchod/ /rtsa ba'i cho ga mi nyung ba/ /rgya che mang por bstan pa yin/ /rtag dang chad dang thog mtha' ni/ /gnyi ⑨ga'i mtha' don rnam par spangs/ /rim bcas rim ni nges par bstan/ /sngags kyi lus ni btus pa yinati/ /me dang rlung dang nam mkha' dang / /stong pa'i de nyid legs gsungs pa/ /spangs pa rtag tu 'gro ba ni/ /'og nas 'og tu de tshe 'grol/ /bskal pa rnam yimang gsum gyi grangs/ /de tshe bsod nams yongs bsags nas/ /de tshe byang chub thob nas ni/ /bdag dang rgyal ba mchog rnams kyis/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi 'don gsungs pa/ /'gro ba yul ni sdig med la'o⑩ / /rtsa ba'i cho ga dag byed dang / /sdig pa med cing bkra shis pa'i/ /——933

le'u rab 'byam rab gsungs pa/ /nges pa'i mdo sde bzang po yin/ /sa bdag yon tan bdag nyid che/ /yul dang dus kyi sbyor ba dang / /rgyal sras mi ru skyes pa yisal/ /sa steng dam pa'i chos bstan ces②/ /'jig rten gtso bo thub pa ni/ /rgyal ba bdun pas bstan pa yin/ /cho ga rgya cher gsungs pa ni/ /blo dang dpal ni mngon par 'phel/ /rtsa ba rab 'byam le'u zhes/ /sngags dang rgyud dang ldan pa de/ /gang zhig mdo mchog gtso bo 'di/ /rgyal bas mchod pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /sa steng mis ni spong byed pa/ /de ni mnar med dmyal bar 'gro/ /bskal pa chen por de 'tshed ces/ /rnam pa du mar dbye bar bstanani/ /nam zhig gang du 'byung ba ni/ /mi yi lus su skyes ④na yang / /dbul zhing nad mang glen pa dang / /kla klo dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten smad par 'gro ba ste/ /de ni mdze can nad par (nya'agyur/ / lkugs shing bya'on pa yan lag nyams/ /blo nyams long ba nyid dang ni/ /rtsub cing rtag tu 'jigs ⑦pa'i gzugs/ /sa steng yi dgas lta bur snang / /gos (nyangan sems ni zhan pa dang / /sen 6)mo dang ni lus kyang ngan/ /srin bu rnams kyis ⑩zos pa dang / /shu ba g.yan par 67yang dag ldan/ /mdo sde 'di ni rab spangs ⑫na / /gang dang gang gis (ste'agro bar 'gro/ /de dang der ni skye ba na/ /blo ngen rmongs par skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur yipa stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ⑩nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ mig phye zhing mi 'dzums par 7thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas ()gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang na gnas pa'i lha'i bu rnams dang / 'byung po'i tshogs du ma chos mnyan pa'i phyir ——934

'dus par 0)shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni ngo mtshar te/mchog tu legs par gsungs pa ②lags na/ de la bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus ①na sems can mi rigs ④pa'i chags pas zil gyis (nyanon pa slu bar byed pa nga rgyal can ma dad pa gya gyu can dmu 0rgod tshul khrims 'chal ⑦pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag sngags rnams kyi rtog pa'i bdag nyid chen po ⑧rgyas pa grub pa 6)dang / dus dang / yul dang / nges par sdom pa dang /sngags dang ⑩/ spyod pa dang / sbyin sreg yidang / bzlas pa nges par sdom pa dang / cho ga rab 'byam 8dag la ma dad par 'gyur/ yid la tsomi byed par ⑫'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma yin no/ /zhes byas nas spong 8bar 'gyur te / de dag nyon mongs pa'i sems su gyur nas dus byed par 'gyur zhing /sdug bsngal drag cing tsha ba'i tshor ba myong zhing de dag dmyal ba chen por skye bar 'gyur rol/ /⑩bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal ba'i sems can de dag la ji ltar bsgrub par byadhi/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tunye'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la spyi bor byugs (nyenas bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir rab tu zhugs pa khyod yang ce )legs so legs so/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 0khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di yongs su zhu bar sems pa de ( nyekhyod yang legs so/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa de'i phyir legs par shin tu rab tu nyon la yid la zung ru shig dang / sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir zhugs pa dang / lha dang /——935

mi rnams dang / 'jig rten la rab tu brtse ba'i phyir ngas khyod la bshad do/ /spyod pa thams cad la zhugs pa dang / byang chub kyi lam dang / thams cad shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku ①la gnas par 'dod pa rnams kyis ②rig pa'i rgyal po mchog tu gsang ba/gzhon nu khyod kyi rtsa ba'i cho ga'i le'u rab 'byam 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe yang 'di dran par bya'o/ /de gang zhe na/ na ma ①ste ya dh+wa duta thā ga te bh+yaḥkhru ar had dhibh+yaḥ samya kle ⑦budhe bh+yaḥ i ku mā ra rū pi rteni/ bi shwa saṃ bha ba/ ā gats+tsha/ā gtsubo/ la hu la hu7/ rdzu :yi/ dzi na dzi ka /mdzi shri 8ye/ su shri ye0/ tā ra ya māṃ/ sarba duḥ8khe bh+yaḥ phaṭa phaṭa/ sha ma ya sha ma ya/ a mṛ tsotod+dha btso/ pā paṃ me nā sha ⑩ya swā hā/ 'jam dpal 'di ni khyod kyi snying po dam pa yin te/ zhi ba thams cad byed pa/ sdig pa thams cad zad par byed pa / sdug bsngal thams cad las rab tu grol bar byed pa/ tshe dang / nad med pa dang / dbang phyug dang / skal ba bzang po mchog dang / ngag gi dbang phyug skyed tunyepar byed pa/ rig pa'i rgyal po thams cad gzengs stod ⑪par byed pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas 'di gsungs ma thag tu sa chen po ri dang rgya mtsho dang bcas pa/ sems can dang snod nye ba'i mthar thug pa rnam pa ⑩drug tu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /'gro ba thams cad de yi dgas kyi 'gro ba dang / dud 'gro dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang /dmyal ba'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rab tu sbyangs shing / bde ba rnams kyang rab tu thob par 'gyur la/ 'jam dpal rig pa'i rgyal po 'di yang yid la byed cing / de'i tshe dam pa'i chos spong ba'i sems kyang med ——936

par 'gyur ①na/ bdud sdig to can gyis kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur la/bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyang 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar yang sems bskyed par bya ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyesangs rgyas dang /chos ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bsam pa'am/ gzhal ba'am/ spang bar ⑧ni bdag ④gis ⑤ci zhig nus te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ phan yon dang nyes dmigs kyi nus pa rab 'byam bstan pa'i le'u sum cu rtsa budrug pa rdzogs sog// //bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / gnas (shegatsang ma'i steng na 6)gnas pa'i lha'i bu'i tshogs rnams dang glu/ sems can bye ba khri phrag brgya stong du ma dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye 0chen po dang / grub pa dang / rig tso'adzin dang ⑫/drang srong mchog dam pa du ma dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang /⑫spyan ras gzigs 8dang / byams pa dang / mthu chen thob dang / mthu chen gnas dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams lidang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dang / chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan ——937

'das nam mkha'i ngo bo dang 'dra bar bzhugs ①pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gyis ②mi khyab pa rnams thugs rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud rdzogs sog// //dpal lha btsan po lha btsun pa byang chub 'od kyi dubakas/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge bsnyen ②chen po ku mā ra ka la sha dang / sgra sgyur ⑥gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te ⑦gtan la phab pa'o ⑧bsdur mchan/354 1)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉la 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud bzhugs/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈co 〉〉mu/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉tan tre/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dkyil / 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa dkyil/ (nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gcig (chos tshan 'di'i nang du thabs cig dang lhan cig sogs kyi cig ces pa rnams 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉la gcig dang /〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉la skabs 'gar gcig ces 'khod pa dang / yang skabs 'gar de dag go ldog ste 〈〈sde 〉〉la gcig ces pa rnams dpe khag 'ga' rer cig ces 'khod kyang gsham du bsdur mchan du bkod med/)67〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ba/355 1nye〈〈zhol 〉〉bsams/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉zung / 〈〈zhol 〉〉zungs/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 dang / ④〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉rnams / ⑧〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉phong bar/ (6)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 la/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 bcom ldan 'das/ (87〈〈g.yung 〉〉 dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉dang / 〈〈zhol 〉〉dang / gnas/ 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉spyo ste/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉'jig lconye〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bzhugs/356 6)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa/ 90〈〈g.yung 〉〉 bya/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 phrag 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉khri phrag ④〈〈li 〉〉shāco 〉〉gyis/ (7〈〈snar 〉〉 gyi/ (6)〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑦〈〈zhol 〉〉gyi/ ⑧〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gyi/ yo)〈〈li 〉〉257 1)༷zhol 〉〉btsal/ (chos tshan 'di'i nang du phyag 'tshal zhes pa rnams 〈〈zhol 〉〉la phyag btsal zhes 'khod kyang 88wa 938
